AI.result: 在NQ、SciFact、FiQA、Touche-2020、DBPedia五个BEIR基准上，MERGE较原始查询提升BM25 nDCG@10达+2.1至+14.9；仅用紧凑开源模型即匹配或超越强LLM查询扩展基线。消融显示Stage-2集成优于任一Stage-1单模型，任务导向APO可将种子提示带来的大幅回退转为稳定增益，无需手工调优。
AI.conclusion: 多LLM生成式集成配合任务导向APO可高效、可扩展地增强BM25检索，兼具检索器无关性与免调优优势。

title: The Invisible Scheduler: Dragging a Sprite Can Change What a Scratch Program Does
summary: Tens of millions of children program in Scratch, whose programs are concurrent: when the green flag is clicked, every sprite's scripts start together and share the project's state. Which script starts first is decided by the sprites' front-to-back stacking order, which no block reads. Dragging a sprite brings it to the front, and the order is saved with the project. Hence, a program can work on the author's screen and fail on the teacher's, with the same blocks. Our key observation is that, with the rest of the file fixed, rearranging the sprites that start scripts among their positions produces exactly the permutations of their initial stacking order. Under a fixed input and seed the unmodified virtual machine reproduces every one of them. StackSwap runs a project under these orders, all of them for up to five sprites, one per class of a conflict graph beyond, and a sample where neither is feasible, and compares the runs under four observation lenses. It returns a two-run witness naming an adjacent pair of sprites whose swap changes the outcome, with the resources they share as candidate causes; otherwise an exhaustive or graph-conditional robustness certificate, or an unresolved verdict. On 767 real programs from a course, an online judge, and a random public sample, 26.4% (course) and 18.2% (public) of those with a scheduling choice behave differently under some stacking order. Among the sensitive programs whose every order ran, the saved order's outcome recurs under a median 17% (course) and 50% (public) of the orders. Under scripted play, a predicate written from a stated requirement holds under one order and fails under another for 5 of 427 student submissions with a scheduling choice. For half of the sensitive programs the random stream is the racing pair's highest-priority shared resource. We close with recommendations for learners, graders, and the Scratch platform.

AI.tldr: Scratch程序是并发的，脚本启动顺序由角色前后堆叠次序决定，导致同一程序在不同机器上可能表现不同。作者提出StackSwap，通过重排角色位置枚举初始堆叠顺序，在固定输入与随机种子下复现并比较运行结果，返回两运行见证或鲁棒性证书。在767个真实程序上，26.4%（课程）与18.2%（公开）存在调度敏感的程序，且保存顺序的结果复现率中位数仅17%与50%。
AI.motivation: Scratch中点击绿旗后所有角色的脚本并发启动并共享项目状态，而脚本启动顺序由角色前后堆叠次序决定，这一顺序没有任何积木可读取。拖动角色会将其置于最前，且该顺序随项目保存，因此同一程序在作者与教师屏幕上可能表现不同。这种隐藏的调度依赖会导致程序行为不可移植、评分不一致，作者希望系统地检测并定位此类问题。
AI.method: 作者提出StackSwap。核心观察是：固定文件其余部分，重排启动脚本的角色位置恰好生成其初始堆叠顺序的全部排列；在固定输入与随机种子下未修改的虚拟机可复现每一种排列。StackSwap对这些顺序运行项目：角色数不超过5时穷举全部顺序，更多角色时按冲突图的每一类各取一个顺序，以及一个两者都不可行的采样；并用四种观测视角比较各次运行。它返回一个两运行见证，指出一对相邻角色，其交换改变结果，并列出二者共享的资源作为候选原因；否则返回穷举或图条件鲁棒性证书，或未决结论。
AI.result: 在来自课程、在线评测和随机公开样本的767个真实程序上，有调度选择的程序中26.4%（课程）和18.2%（公开）在不同堆叠顺序下行为不同。在所有顺序均被运行过的敏感程序中，保存顺序的结果复现率中位数分别为17%（课程）和50%（公开）。在脚本化播放下，根据明确需求编写的谓词在427份有调度选择的学生提交中，有5份在一个顺序下成立而在另一个顺序下失败。对一半的敏感程序而言，随机流是竞争角色的最高优先级共享资源。
AI.conclusion: Scratch的隐藏调度依赖在真实程序中普遍存在，且保存顺序的鲁棒性较差。作者据此为学习者、评分者和Scratch平台提出了建议，例如避免依赖堆叠次序、在评分时考虑调度敏感性、以及平台层面提供顺序无关的语义或提示。

title: Mirror-Score: Calibrated, Inference-only Scoring Exposes the Limits of Sequence-compatibility Ranking in D-peptide Design
summary: D-peptides combine protease resistance with high target specificity, but computational design of D-peptide binders remains immature. Mirror-Peptidizer introduced an in silico mirror-image screening pipeline using target reflection, backbone generation, and ProteinMPNN sequence design, but its raw ProteinMPNN negative log-likelihood (NLL) ranking was not validated against measured affinities, and only 4 of 9 tested MDM2 designs bound detectably. We introduce Mirror-Score, a calibrated, inference-only scoring framework for heterochiral D-peptide/L-protein complexes, and a public benchmark of 31 crystal complexes across four target families, including 18 with literature-verified affinities. Raw ProteinMPNN NLL is not a valid affinity ranker: its pooled Spearman correlation with affinity is 0.19, and correlations reverse between MDM2/CHIP (+0.62) and gp41 (-0.70). We therefore evaluate Boltz-2 mirror-space cofolding confidence. For the complete viral-entry family (7 structures representing 3 peptides), interface predicted local distance difference test (pLDDT) achieves structure-level leave-one-out Spearman rho = 0.90 (p = 0.006) and correctly orders all three peptides by affinity, whereas NLL fails (structure-level rho = 0.18). Because only three independent chemotypes are represented, this result indicates directional consistency rather than a statistically validated predictor. Cross-family calibration does not transfer at current sample sizes, supporting family-matched calibration as the practical deployment mode. We also specify a prospective design protocol for the antimicrobial-resistance targets LasR and LecB from Pseudomonas aeruginosa, including mirrored structures, ligand-derived hotspot maps, diffusion-model-ready inputs, and Mirror-Score ranking. Code, benchmark data, structures, and analysis scripts are openly available at https://github.com/Jiadalee/Mirror-Score.

AI.tldr: 本文提出Mirror-Score——面向异手性D-肽/L-蛋白复合物的校准型、仅推理评分框架，并构建覆盖4个靶点家族31个晶体复合物（含18个有文献亲和力）的公开基准，用于评估D-肽结合物的计算设计排序能力。
AI.motivation: D-肽兼具蛋白酶抗性与高靶标特异性，但其计算设计尚不成熟。已有Mirror-Peptidizer流水线仅用ProteinMPNN的NLL进行排序，该排序未与实测亲和力验证，且9个MDM2设计中仅4个可检测结合，说明缺乏可靠的亲和力排序/打分方法。
AI.method: 构建Mirror-Score校准型推理打分框架与31个晶体复合物基准（含18个有文献亲和力，覆盖4个靶点家族）；系统检验原始ProteinMPNN NLL的亲和力排序能力；评估Boltz-2镜像空间共折叠置信度（interface pLDDT）在不同家族的排序表现，并进行跨家族校准迁移测试；同时给出针对LasR与LecB的前瞻性设计协议。
AI.result: 原始ProteinMPNN NLL并非有效的亲和力排序器：与亲和力的合并Spearman相关仅0.19，且在MDM2/CHIP（+0.62）与gp41（-0.70）间相关性反转。Boltz-2 interface pLDDT在完整病毒入侵家族（3条肽、7个结构）上达到结构级留一Spearman rho=0.90（p=0.006），并正确排序全部3条肽的亲和力，而NLL失败（结构级rho=0.18）。因仅含3个独立化学型，该结果属方向一致性证据而非统计验证的预测器；跨家族校准在当前样本量下不可迁移。
AI.conclusion: 应放弃以原始NLL作为亲和力排序依据，转而采用共折叠置信度（interface pLDDT）等校准指标；鉴于跨家族校准难以迁移，当前实用部署模式应为同家族匹配校准。作者公开了代码、基准数据、结构与分析脚本，并针对LasR、LecB给出含镜像结构、热点图与扩散模型输入的前瞻设计协议。

title: Towards Semi-Automatically Comparing Keyword-Based and Semantic Search Accuracy
summary: The increasing importance of Information Retrieval (IR) in managing large datasets has highlighted significant limitations in traditional keyword-based search systems. Context-aware chat-based search methods, such as Retrieval Augmented Generation (RAG), have recently emerged, but their evaluation compared to keyword-based systems often relies on subjective user feedback. A rigorous, quantitative comparison between these paradigms remains lacking. This work introduces a novel, preliminary framework to quantitatively assess IR accuracy of search systems that produce different output formats, such as lists and messages. It focuses on two key aspects: the ranking accuracy for keyword-based systems and the completeness of retrieved information for semantic chat-based systems. Our approach enables semi-automatic comparisons of semantic and keyword-based methods using interchangeable equivalence classes tailored to domain-specific contexts (e.g., companies or problems). We validate the framework through an industrial case study, demonstrating statistically significant improvements in context-aware search over keyword-based methods, supported by analyses including the Mann-Whitney U-Test. With its adaptable design, the proposed framework provides a strong foundation for objectively assessing keyword-based and semantic chat-based search methods.

AI.tldr: 提出一个可定量评估不同输出形式检索系统（列表式关键词检索 vs. 对话式语义检索）的初步框架，并通过工业案例验证其有效性。
AI.motivation: 信息检索在管理大规模数据中日益重要，传统关键词检索存在明显局限；RAG 等上下文感知的对话式检索虽已出现，但与其对比评估多依赖主观用户反馈，缺乏严格、定量的比较方法。
AI.method: 构建一个可量化评估不同输出格式（列表与消息）检索系统准确性的新框架，聚焦两点：关键词系统的排序准确性，以及语义对话系统的检索信息完整性；借助可互换的等价类（针对企业或问题等领域情境定制），实现语义方法与关键词方法的半自动比较。
AI.result: 通过一个工业案例研究验证框架，结果显示上下文感知检索相较关键词方法有统计显著提升，并采用 Mann-Whitney U 检验等分析予以支持。
AI.conclusion: 该框架设计可适配，为客观评估关键词检索与语义对话式检索方法提供了坚实基础，并为跨输出形式的 IR 评估提供了初步且可扩展的解决思路。

title: Live Architecture Models for Cloud-Native Architecture-as-Code: Early Results from Kubernetes Conformance Checking
comment: 16 pages, 5 figures, 9 tables. Code and evaluation artifacts: https://github.com/AsakoKabe/archer-kdl
summary:
Infrastructure drift can separate a running Kubernetes system from its documented architectural intent. This paper investigates live architecture models: editable architectural representations connected to selected runtime facts through explicit correspondences and recurring conformance checks. The approach is instantiated through an Archer-specific subset of Kubernetes Deployment Language (KDL) and Archer, a VS Code prototype with synchronized textual and graphical views. Snapshot recovery extracts selected Kubernetes facts into KDL; periodic and on-demand read-only checks report model-cluster inconsistencies without enforcing or repairing deployment state.
  We assess feasibility on three feature-selected Kubernetes example applications under an author-defined protocol, reporting precision and recall for snapshot recovery and selected inconsistency detection. Recovery scores can be reproduced from saved ground-truth and recovered models; detection uses a documented manual perturbation protocol. The results support feasibility within the evaluated KDL scope. They do not establish comparative superiority, detection of arbitrary production drift, scalability, or developer benefit. Storage coverage and ingress-host representation/default handling remain limitations.

AI.tldr: 该论文研究"活架构模型"，通过KDL子集与Archer原型，将Kubernetes运行时事实提取为可编辑架构表示并进行一致性检查，在三个示例应用上验证可行性。
AI.motivation: Kubernetes系统运行时状态常偏离其文档化的架构意图，形成"基础设施漂移"。论文旨在提供一种可编辑、与运行时事实显式对应的活架构模型，以识别模型与集群间的不一致。
AI.method: 采用Kubernetes Deployment Language（KDL）的Archer专用子集，实现VS Code原型Archer，提供同步的文本与图形视图。通过快照恢复将选定的Kubernetes事实抽取为KDL；采用周期性及按需的只读检查报告模型-集群不一致，不执行强制或修复。
AI.result: 在三个经特征选取的Kubernetes示例应用上，依据作者自定义协议评估可行性，报告快照恢复与所选不一致检测的精确率与召回率。恢复分数可基于保存的真值与恢复模型复现；检测采用文档化的手动扰动协议。结果支持在评估的KDL范围内具备可行性。
AI.conclusion: 结果未证明方法的比较优越性、对任意生产漂移的检测能力、可扩展性或开发者收益。存储覆盖范围及ingress-host表示与默认值处理仍为局限。

title: Sage: Formalization with Semantic Correction
summary: While neural theorem provers have achieved impressive milestones in formal mathematics, they largely operate on the assumption that faithful Lean 4 formal statements are already provided. Translating informal natural language into a formal language is a critical data bottleneck plagued by an "illusion of rigor": standard type-checkers accept statements that compile but drop hypotheses, introduce vacuous truths, or subtly alter mathematical bounds. To resolve this, we introduce Sage (Semantic Agent-Guided Formalization Engine), an agentic framework that replaces monolithic translation with a four-stage decomposed generation pipeline coupled with a dual-signal semantic correction loop. By pairing Lean 4 compiler diagnostics with multi-dimensional semantic feedback, our correction loop enforces mathematical fidelity alongside syntactic validity. By explicitly accounting for the gap between open-ended queries and declarative formal targets, our pipeline prevents models from achieving high formalization rates by guessing unverified answers (exhibiting a 70.9% answer leakage rate). Consequently, Sage suppresses leakage to 2.7% while achieving 73.3% pass@4 joint compilation and semantic fidelity on the Omni-MATH without proofs (compared to 42.0% for a fine-tuned Goedel-Formalizer-V2 baseline). Finally, on IMO-Unformalized, a novel frontier of 175 unformalized International Mathematical Olympiad problems, Sage demonstrates effective zero-shot generalization with 87.4% pass@4 verified fidelity compared to just 19.4% for the baseline, winning over 79% of blind pairwise evaluations.

AI.tldr: Sage 是一个代理式形式化框架，通过四阶段分解生成流水线与双信号语义纠错回路，将自然语言数学问题转化为忠实的 Lean 4 形式语句，显著抑制答案泄漏并提升语义保真度。
AI.motivation: 神经定理证明器多假定已存在忠实的 Lean 4 形式语句，而自然语言到形式语言的翻译是关键数据瓶颈。标准类型检查器存在"严谨性幻觉"：接受能编译但丢失假设、引入空真命题或微妙改变数学界定的语句。同时，开放式查询与声明式形式目标之间的差距使模型可通过猜测未验证答案获得高形式化率（答案泄漏率达 70.9%）。
AI.method: 提出 Sage（Semantic Agent-Guided Formalization Engine）：以代理式框架替代单体翻译，采用四阶段分解生成流水线，并耦合双信号语义纠错回路。该纠错回路将 Lean 4 编译器诊断与多维度语义反馈相结合，在保证语法有效性的同时强制数学保真度，并显式处理开放式查询与声明式形式目标之间的差距。
AI.result: 在 Omni-MATH（无证明）上，Sage 将答案泄漏率从 70.9% 抑制至 2.7%，实现 73.3% 的 pass@4 联合编译与语义保真度，而微调后的 Goedel-Formalizer-V2 基线为 42.0%。在 IMO-Unformalized（175 道未形式化国际数学奥林匹克问题的前沿数据集）上，Sage 展示有效的零样本泛化能力，实现 87.4% pass@4 验证保真度，基线仅 19.4%，并在超过 79% 的盲测成对评估中胜出。
AI.conclusion: Sage 通过分解式生成与双信号语义纠错，有效解决了自然语言数学形式化中的"严谨性幻觉"与答案泄漏问题，在多个基准上大幅超越现有基线，并在未形式化竞赛题上展现出强零样本泛化能力。

title: SMat-Attention: Structured Long-Context Sequence Modeling
summary: Long-context sequence models face a fundamental tradeoff: softmax attention uses flexible token-level interactions at quadratic cost, whereas linear attention obtains linear-time training and constant-time decoding by compressing history into a fixed-size state. In this work, we ask whether we can connect these regimes through a tunable notion of structure. To this end, we introduce Structured Matrix Attention (SMat-Attention) via a family of causal masks with structured long-range routing whose row supports have VC-dimension $d$. In our construction, $d=1$ recovers the standard causal mask, and increasing $d$ permits richer subset-routing patterns. We give chunkwise forward and backward algorithms to enable hardware-efficiency. For sequences of length $T$, the hard-routing construction takes $O(T^{2-3/d}+T)$ work, despite the mask being dense, for our prescribed family. In fixed-horizon streaming, decoding after the distant prefix takes constant time per token using $O(T^{1-1/d})$ cached states. SMat-Attention therefore makes VC-dimension an explicit knob governing access-pattern complexity, prefill cost, and decoding memory. Empirically, subset-routing and rule-assisted multi-key retrieval experiments illustrate the masks' routing expressiveness. Extensions to Mamba-2 and Gated DeltaNet using learned routing with top-$k$ query reads retain subquadratic prefill, improve recall accuracy over the backbones in several settings, and achieve comparable small-scale language-modeling performance.

AI.tldr: 该文提出 Structured Matrix Attention（SMat-Attention），通过 VC 维为 $d$ 的结构化因果掩码在 softmax 注意力与线性注意力之间建立可调的结构化连续谱。
AI.motivation: 长上下文序列建模存在根本性权衡：softmax 注意力交互灵活但代价为二次；线性注意力训练线性、解码常数，却将历史压缩进固定大小状态。作者希望用一种可调的结构化机制连接这两个极端。
AI.method: 构造一族行支撑 VC 维为 $d$ 的因果结构化掩码，$d=1$ 退化为标准因果掩码，增大 $d$ 允许更丰富的子集路由；设计分块前向与反向算法以适配硬件。硬路由下即使掩码稠密，计算量仅为 $O(T^{2-3/d}+T)$；固定时域流式解码每 token 常数时间，需 $O(T^{1-1/d})$ 缓存状态。进一步用 top-$k$ 查询读取的学习式路由扩展到 Mamba-2 与 Gated DeltaNet。
AI.result: 子集路由与规则辅助多键检索实验展示了掩码的路由表达能力；扩展至 Mamba-2 与 Gated DeltaNet 后，保留次二次预填充，在若干设定下召回精度优于骨干模型，小规模语言建模性能相当。
AI.conclusion: VC 维由此成为显式调节旋钮，控制访问模式复杂度、预填充开销与解码内存，为长上下文建模提供统一框架。

title: Generated Query Expansion Still Helps Strong Sparse Retrieval: A Controlled Study with SPLADE-v3
summary: Scientific queries are often brief, while relevant papers use specialized vocabulary. Generated query expansion can bridge this mismatch, but earlier work suggests that its value shrinks as the underlying retriever becomes stronger. We test the four generated formats of term lists, a pseudo-document, multiple pseudo-references, and corpus-steered text all together with SPLADE-v3 on NFCorpus, TREC-COVID, and SciDocs. Every condition searches the same frozen document index and follows the same query-side integration rule and 256-dimension budget, isolating the effect of the added content. All twelve method-collection comparisons improve aggregate nDCG@10, with best relative gains of 4.81%, 8.92%, and 9.47%. Eleven remain significant after Holm correction. The gain persists in 103 of 114 interpolation settings, including every setting that assigns at least 30% of the mixture weight to the original query. Shuffled-text and non-contextual lexical-bag controls also remain above baseline in all 24 aggregate comparisons, showing that the added vocabulary carries most of the benefit. A corpus-induced typed concept graph, by contrast, produces no consistent gain, and its relation, depth, validation, random, and gating controls do not rescue it. Generated vocabulary can therefore complement a strong learned sparse retriever, provided that the original query remains strongly represented.

AI.tldr: 在冻结索引、统一查询侧融合规则与256维预算下，四种生成式查询扩展格式配合SPLADE-v3在三个数据集上均提升nDCG@10，最佳相对增益为4.81%、8.92%、9.47%。
AI.motivation: 科学查询通常简短，而相关论文使用专业术语，二者存在词汇不匹配。查询扩展可弥合该鸿沟，但已有研究认为随着底层检索器变强，其收益会萎缩。本文旨在系统检验这一结论在现代强学习型稀疏检索器上是否成立。
AI.method: 在同一冻结文档索引上，将四种生成内容格式（术语列表、伪文档、多个伪引用、语料引导文本）与SPLADE-v3结合，在NFCorpus、TREC-COVID、SciDocs上评测。所有条件采用相同的查询侧集成规则和256维预算，以隔离新增内容本身的影响。并设置插值权重扫描、乱序文本与非上下文词袋对照，以及语料诱导的带类型概念图及其关系、深度、验证、随机与门控对照。
AI.result: 十二组方法-集合对比全部提升聚合nDCG@10，最佳相对增益分别为4.81%、8.92%、9.47%，其中十一组经Holm校正后仍显著。增益在114种插值设置中的103种下持续存在，包括所有给原始查询分配至少30%混合权重的设置。乱序文本与非上下文词袋对照在全部24组聚合对比中也高于基线，表明收益主要来自新增词汇。相反，语料诱导的带类型概念图未产生一致增益，其各类对照亦无法挽救。
AI.conclusion: 生成式词汇能够补充强学习型稀疏检索器，前提是原始查询在混合中保持足够强的权重；而结构化概念图式扩展在该设定下无效。

title: The Invisible Throttle: Running on Borrowed Time in Scratch
summary: Scratch has 135 million registered users, most of them children, and 164 million shared projects. What they are taught about the speed of a script fits in one sentence: a loop iterates once per frame. Unfortunately, that sentence describes the exception. In the public virtual machine a frame repeats the scripts until something visible asks the screen to redraw, no script is left running, or three quarters of the frame's wall-clock time are spent. Hence a loop that does not draw is paced by whatever else is visible and by the machine. Hide the moving sprite of a two-sprite project, and the other's counting loop runs 77,000 times faster on a laptop. No documentation states the rule. Our key observation is that the redraw gate is one flag for the whole runtime, so a loop's speed can be changed without touching its code: hide the sprite that draws, change the machine's budget, or run the program in a tool with no renderer. ThrottleCheck implements a budgeted semantics (a stated budget of rounds per frame, the redraw gate emulated) on the unmodified virtual machine, runs a project under each knob, and reports a rate-sensitive project with a witness. On 500 popular public games, 59% contain a loop that never draws and never waits. Muting the requests of the sprites that draw changes the state of a played game after ten seconds in 24% of the games that have one; hiding them changes 18%; running the game without a renderer and without the gate changes 61%. Rules that read a position, a score or a clock after a fixed time reverse between pass and fail once the throttle is released, in 17% of Whisker's own example tests and 19% of a tutorial's checks on 224 of its remixes. A grader without a renderer grades a program the editor never runs, unless it emulates the gate and states a budget; we say what graders and the platform should do, and close with the sentence a child could be taught.

AI.tldr: Scratch的循环速度并非"每帧一次"，而由整机唯一的重绘门控与帧预算决定；作者提出ThrottleCheck在未改动虚拟机上以预算语义复现该机制，揭示大量项目存在帧率敏感的计数循环，并指出评测器若不同步门控与预算会给出错误判定。
AI.motivation: Scratch拥有1.35亿注册用户（多为儿童）与1.64亿共享项目，但官方对其脚本速度的教学只有一句"循环每帧迭代一次"。实际上该句描述的是例外情况：真实虚拟机让脚本在一帧内反复执行，直到有可见内容请求重绘、没有脚本处于运行状态、或该帧墙钟时间已耗去四分之三。因此不绘制的循环受其他可见脚本与机器性能影响，隐藏绘制精灵可使另一精灵的计数循环在笔记本上快77,000倍，而官方文档从未说明此规则。作者希望澄清这一被隐藏的语义，并给出可自动检测帧率敏感项目、以及指导评测器与平台设计的方案。
AI.method: 关键观察是"重绘门控"是整个运行时的一个全局标志，因此循环速度可在不改动代码的情况下改变：隐藏负责绘制的精灵、改变机器的帧预算、或在无渲染器的工具中运行程序。作者实现ThrottleCheck，在未修改的虚拟机上实现"预算语义"（显式声明每帧轮次预算，并仿真重绘门控），对同一项目在各旋钮配置下运行，报告帧率敏感项目并给出见证。
AI.result: 在500个热门公开游戏上，59%含有一个既不绘制也不等待的循环。对含此类循环的游戏，静音绘制精灵的请求在10秒后改变游戏状态的比例为24%，隐藏它们为18%，而在无渲染器且无门控下运行则达61%。在Whisker自带示例测试中17%、某教程对224个remix的检查中19%的规则（在固定时间后读取位置、分数或时钟）会因节流释放而在通过与失败之间反转。
AI.conclusion: 帧率敏感性与重绘门控是Scratch运行时中普遍且未文档化的语义：不绘制的循环速度由全局门控与机器预算决定，可被隐藏精灵、改预算或移除渲染器所改变，从而影响游戏状态与评测判定。无渲染器的评测器实际评测的是编辑器从不运行的程序，除非它仿真门控并声明预算。作者据此向评测器与平台提出应做之事，并给出儿童也能理解的表述。

title: Serverless gossip training of LSTM failure detectors: A matched-protocol comparison with federated, local and centralized learning on NASA C-MAPSS
summary: Industrial predictive maintenance increasingly depends on learning from equipment spread across sites whose sensor data cannot easily be pooled. Federated averaging (FedAvg) solves this with a central aggregation server; gossip learning removes the server, but its behaviour for recurrent failure-detection models has not been measured under controlled conditions. We compare synchronous ring gossip with FedAvg, isolated local training and a centralized reference for a stacked LSTM that detects imminent failure on the NASA C-MAPSS turbofan benchmark. All methods share one open implementation, architecture, initialization, optimizer, data split and training budget, and the primary endpoint uses one terminal window per test engine to avoid the statistical dependence of overlapping windows. On FD001 (five seeds), gossip reached a terminal-window F1 of 89.6 +/- 1.3%, compared with 89.9 +/- 1.1% for FedAvg, 83.6 +/- 6.7% for local training and 93.5 +/- 2.1% for centralized training, while transmitting the same payload as FedAvg without a coordinator. Node models agreed closely but not exactly (1.8% pairwise decision disagreement versus 5.6% without communication). Across FD002-FD004, peer communication improved terminal-window F1 over local training by 13-28 points; gossip matched FedAvg on FD003 and FD004 but was 4.3 points lower on the multi-condition FD002 subset. Simulated message loss, node failure and server outage changed neither method appreciably, whereas larger rings degraded gossip faster. Ring gossip is therefore a practical serverless alternative when data heterogeneity is moderate, and faster-mixing topologies become important as heterogeneity grows.

AI.tldr: 在NASA C-MAPSS涡扇发动机基准上，环形gossip（去中心化）与FedAvg、本地训练和集中式训练对比：FD001上gossip终端窗口F1为89.6±1.3%，略低于FedAvg（89.9±1.1%），但高于本地训练（83.6±6.7%），低于集中式（93.5±2.1%）；通信可显著提升性能，gossip在中等异质性下可作为无服务器替代方案。
AI.motivation: 工业预测性维护中，跨站点设备传感器数据难以集中汇聚。FedAvg依赖中心聚合服务器，gossip learning去除了服务器，但其在循环故障检测模型上的行为尚未在受控条件下得到测量。
AI.method: 使用统一的开放式实现、相同架构（堆叠LSTM）、初始化、优化器、数据划分和训练预算，在NASA C-MAPSS涡扇发动机基准上比较同步环形gossip、FedAvg、孤立本地训练和集中式参考。主要评估端点采用每台测试发动机一个终端窗口，以避免重叠窗口的统计依赖性。实验覆盖FD001（5个随机种子）及FD002–FD004，并模拟消息丢失、节点故障、服务器宕机和不同环规模。
AI.result: FD001上gossip终端窗口F1为89.6±1.3%，FedAvg为89.9±1.1%，本地训练为83.6±6.7%，集中式为93.5±2.1%；gossip与FedAvg传输相同载荷却无需协调者。节点模型高度一致但不完全相同（成对决策分歧1.8%，无通信时为5.6%）。在FD002–FD004上，对等通信使终端窗口F1较本地训练提升13–28个百分点；gossip在FD003和FD004上与FedAvg持平，但在多工况FD002上低4.3个百分点。模拟消息丢失、节点故障和服务器宕机对两种方法均无明显影响，而更大的环规模会更快地降低gossip性能。
AI.conclusion: 当数据异质性适中时，环形gossip是实用的无服务器替代方案；随着异质性增大，更快的混合拓扑变得重要。

title: LongCat-DeepResearch Technical Report
summary: We present LongCat-DeepResearch, a deep research system that combines an enhanced LongCat model with a multi-agent workflow for producing comprehensive, evidence-grounded reports. The workflow separates global planning from detailed investigation and coordinates revision at the section level. Multiple planning agents first explore external sources and refine an actionable research plan, termed ResearchSpec. Research agents then investigate and draft their assigned sections in parallel, gathering additional evidence in separate contexts as their analyses develop. Once the sections are assembled, global review guides targeted local revisions, reducing reliance on repeated full-report rewriting. This workflow also supports the construction of research tasks and trajectories for the mid-training and post-training of LongCat's general-purpose models. LongCat-DeepResearch achieves 55.25 on DeepResearchBench, 51.35 on DeepResearchBench II, and 79.83 on ResearchRubrics. On an in-house benchmark, it scores 76.04, ranking second among four compared systems. Development-set analyses show benefits from combining planning perspectives, while further planning refinement has mixed effects. Additional editing improves average automatic readability preference across two benchmarks, with different trends on each.

AI.tldr: 本文提出 LongCat-DeepResearch，一个将增强版 LongCat 模型与多智能体工作流结合的深度研究系统，用于生成有证据支撑的综合报告。工作流将全局规划与细节调研分离，并在章节级别协调修订。
AI.motivation: 现有深度研究系统在生成长篇报告时往往依赖反复的全文重写，效率低且难以保证证据支撑和结构一致性。作者希望将全局规划与局部调研解耦，并通过章节级修订降低对整篇重写的依赖，同时为模型的中期与后期训练构建研究任务和轨迹。
AI.method: 方法包含多智能体工作流：多个规划智能体先探索外部来源并细化出可执行研究计划（ResearchSpec）；随后研究智能体并行调研并起草各自负责的章节，在不同上下文中持续收集证据；章节组装后，由全局审阅指导针对性的局部修订。该工作流亦支持为 LongCat 通用模型的中期与后期训练构建研究任务与轨迹。
AI.result: LongCat-DeepResearch 在 DeepResearchBench 上得分 55.25，在 DeepResearchBench II 上得分 51.35，在 ResearchRubrics 上得分 79.83。在内部基准上得分 76.04，在四个对比系统中排名第二。开发集分析显示，组合多种规划视角带来收益，而进一步的规划细化效果不一；额外编辑提升了两个基准上的平均自动可读性偏好，但两个基准上的趋势不同。
AI.conclusion: LongCat-DeepResearch 通过全局规划与章节级调研分离、并行起草与定向局部修订的多智能体工作流，在多个深度研究基准上取得有竞争力的表现，并可作为通用模型训练数据与轨迹的来源。分析表明规划视角的组合有效，而规划细化和额外编辑的效果则具有条件性。

title: Effective Dense Retrieval using Only In-Context Examples
summary: Turning decoder-only large language models (LLMs) into strong dense retrievers typically requires some form of retriever training. In this paper, we ask whether LLMs can instead be prompted to produce effective representations for dense retrieval given only a few in-context examples. To answer this, we introduce RICE (Representations from In-Context Examples), a simple "training-free" approach that extracts high-quality dense representations from LLMs. To do so, RICE conditions the LLM on examples that provide a shared context for query and document encoding. Our results demonstrate that RICE embeddings can substantially improve the accuracy of prompt-based LLM embeddings, establishing it as a simple method to build LLM-based dense retrievers that do not require training. We release our code at https://github.com/nourj98/RICE.

AI.tldr: RICE是一种无需训练的方法，通过上下文示例让仅解码器LLM产生高质量的密集检索表示。
AI.motivation: 将仅解码器大语言模型转化为强密集检索器通常需要某种形式的检索器训练。
AI.method: RICE（Representations from In-Context Examples）以少量上下文示例为条件，为查询和文档编码提供共享上下文，从LLM中提取高质量密集表示，属于"免训练"方法。
AI.result: RICE嵌入能显著提升基于提示的LLM嵌入准确率。
AI.conclusion: RICE是一种构建无需训练的LLM密集检索器的简单方法。

title: From Dead Code and Static Requirements to Working Engines: Software Revival with Coding Agents
summary: Can coding agents restore software that no longer runs while preserving its underlying methods, and reconstruct industrial software engines from open specifications? Here we introduce ReviveBench, a benchmark with two task families evaluated by hidden verifiers calibrated against native execution environments, established engineering tools, or purpose-built reference implementations. The revival family comprises ten tasks involving dependency incompatibilities, deleted core modules, legacy builds, and a GPU-based foundation model. Every starting workspace fails verification, and the strongest evaluated model passes all ten tasks in at least one run each. In contamination-control experiments, identifier obfuscation reduces line similarity to the original implementations from 0.51--0.96 to 0.03--0.44 without reducing the observed pass rate of any evaluated model. On repositories created after the stated knowledge cutoffs, the strongest model passes eight of nine runs. The reconstruction family comprises thirteen tasks spanning numerical, geometric, hardware, and transactional systems (e.g. CAD and CRM). Two models meet the benchmark's pass criteria on all thirteen, although our audit shows that the CFD task cannot establish numerical-solver capability. Benchmark construction and auditing uncover 28 verifier defects, including 24 false negatives and two false positives. These findings show that executable verification can itself introduce substantial measurement error. We present three practical checks: test whether prescribed methods can reach the grading thresholds, investigate agreement among independently generated candidates, and recompute diagnostics from submitted artifacts. ReviveBench thus provides both an evaluation of software revival and engine reconstruction, and cases in validating the verifiers used to measure coding agents for software design.

AI.tldr: 本文提出ReviveBench基准，包含"复活"与"重建"两类任务，用隐藏验证器评估编码智能体修复失效软件与依据开放规范重建工业引擎的能力，并揭示验证器自身带来的测量误差。
AI.motivation: 软件复活（恢复已无法运行的软件并保留其底层方法）与工业软件引擎重建是编码智能体的重要应用场景，但缺乏系统化、可验证的评测基准；同时作者关注"可执行验证"本身的可靠性问题。
AI.method: 构建包含两大家族任务的基准：复活家族含10个任务（依赖不兼容、核心模块被删、遗留构建、GPU基础模型），每个初始工作区均无法通过验证；重建家族含13个任务（数值、几何、硬件、事务系统，如CAD与CRM）。验证器为隐藏验证器，并对照原生执行环境、既有工程工具或自建参考实现进行校准。此外开展污染控制实验（标识符混淆）和知识截止后仓库的测试，并对验证器进行审计。
AI.result: 最强的受评模型在复活家族10个任务中每个至少有一次通过；标识符混淆使与原实现的行相似度从0.51–0.96降至0.03–0.44，但未降低任何受评模型的通过率；在知识截止后创建的仓库上，最强模型9次运行中通过8次。重建家族中两个模型在全部13个任务上满足通过标准，但审计发现CFD任务无法确立数值求解能力。基准构建与审计共发现28处验证器缺陷，含24个假阴性和2个假阳性。
AI.conclusion: 可执行验证本身会引入显著测量误差；作者提出三项实用检查：（1）检验规定方法能否达到评分阈值，（2）考察独立生成候选之间的一致性，（3）从提交产物重新计算诊断指标。ReviveBench既提供软件复活与引擎重建的评估，也为验证编码智能体的测量工具提供校验案例。

title: Learning from the Gap Between Pass@K and Pass@1
summary: Large language models (LLMs) are increasingly trained with reinforcement learning from verifiable rewards (RLVR). An exact verifier can also support test-time scaling by selecting a passing response from multiple samples, while other deployments use beam search, adaptive sampling, or tools. We study single-sample decoding, where each query receives one response without search, to ask whether search-exposed behavior can be absorbed into the model. Existing verified-response post-training recipes do not generally distinguish problems already solved on the first decode from failures recovered within K samples. Under a fixed budget, this can spend examples repeating behavior the deployed policy already has. We introduce GapFT, which selects training evidence by the source checkpoint's single-sample outcome and fine-tunes on the Pass@K-Pass@1 gap: problems the policy fails on one sample but solves within K samples. We match training examples, processed tokens, and optimizer steps while keeping the objective unchanged. GapFT fills the matched budget with recovered failures and uses an exact decomposition to distinguish corrections of recovered and missed failures from regressions on first-decode successes. On LogiQA 2.0 and ReClor with Llama-3.1-8B, GapFT improves Pass@1 by 14.4 and 13.9 points over the source model, outperforms budget-matched uniform verified RFT at the same learning rate, and matches fine-tuning on the full verified pool using one third of the data. A single decode matches the source model's verifier-selected Pass@4 accuracy. A randomized control attributes gains to covering distinct failures, and our analysis relates available gains to transferable failure support. A three-seed Qwen2.5-7B replication retains positive gains over uniform RFT on both logic tasks.

AI.tldr: 本文提出 GapFT 微调方法，按源模型单样本结果筛选训练数据，只在 Pass@K 失败而 Pass@1 成功的"已恢复失败"问题上训练，从而将搜索行为吸收进单样本解码，匹配预算下显著提升 Pass@1。
AI.motivation: LLM 常用带可验证奖励的强化学习训练，验证器还支持测试时搜索（多采样选优、beam search、自适应采样、工具调用）。本文关注单样本解码场景，探讨能否把搜索暴露的行为内化到模型中。现有基于验证结果的后训练方法通常不区分"首次解码就解决"和"K 次采样内恢复"的问题，在固定预算下会重复训练策略已具备的行为，浪费算力。
AI.method: 提出 GapFT：依据源检查点的单样本结果选择训练证据，在 Pass@K–Pass@1 差距上微调，即策略单样本失败但 K 次采样内解决的问题。严格匹配训练样本数、处理 token 数和优化步数，目标函数不变。用精确分解区分"恢复失败"与"遗漏失败"的修正和"首次解码成功"上的退化。另设随机对照实验归因。
AI.result: 在 LogiQA 2.0 与 ReClor 上，Llama-3.1-8B 的 GapFT 相对源模型 Pass@1 提升 14.4 和 13.9 分；同学习率下优于预算匹配的均匀验证 RFT；用三分之一数据即匹配全验证池微调。单次解码可达到源模型验证器选优的 Pass@4 精度。随机对照表明增益源于覆盖不同失败。三随机种子 Qwen2.5-7B 复现同样优于均匀 RFT。
AI.conclusion: 把搜索暴露的可恢复失败作为训练信号，可在相同预算下高效提升单样本解码性能；增益可归因于覆盖可迁移的失败支撑集，方法在不同模型与逻辑推理任务上具备可复现性。

title: A Polyphonic Conception of AI Understanding
summary: When a doctor, a judge, or an engineer must decide whether to trust an AI model's output, they cannot avoid asking what the model understands. Purely mathematical or statistical descriptions struggle to distinguish trustworthy from untrustworthy outputs without reintroducing the question of AI understanding in all but name. Yet the question is ill-framed as it stands, because the inherited concept operates within a monophonic paradigm: the idea that a cognitive system's understanding of something must be localised to a single mechanism underpinning all the capacities conferred by such understanding. Drawing on a wide range of mechanistic evidence, we show that LLMs are pervasively polyphonic: outputs emerge from coalitions of parallel mechanisms of uneven reliability, which variously complement, duplicate, or drown out one another, with several coalitions sufficing for a task without any one being indispensable. Polyphony not only complicates attributions of understanding, but renders monophonic inference patterns hazardous. In response, we develop a conception of understanding fit for polyphonic AI. It centres on sound circuitry that is reliably and correctly recruited and in control of outputs. Attributions of understanding thereby become tractable claims about internal organisation, and can do the work of guiding trust in AI.

AI.tldr: 本文提出"复调（polyphonic）"视角理解大语言模型：其输出由多条可靠性不一的并行机制组成的联盟共同产生，机制间互补、冗余或相互淹没，且无单一机制不可或缺；由此重新界定"理解"，将其锚定于可被可靠调用并控制输出的"健全电路"，使理解归因成为关于内部组织的可操作方法，从而指导对AI的信任判断。
AI.motivation: 医生、法官、工程师在决定是否信任AI输出时，无法回避"模型是否理解"这一追问；纯数学或统计式描述难以区分可信与不可信输出，除非以另一种名义重新引入"理解"问题。然而该问题本身框架有误：传统理解概念预设了"单音（monophonic）"范式，即认为认知系统对某事物的理解必须定位于单一机制，并由该机制支撑理解所赋予的全部能力。
AI.method: 借助广泛的机制性（mechanistic）证据，论证LLM普遍呈现"复调性"：输出源自多组并行机制的联盟，这些机制可靠性不均，彼此互补、重复或相互遮蔽，且多个联盟均可完成任务而无任何一个不可或缺。在此基础上，作者提出一种适用于复调AI的理解概念，其核心是"健全电路"（sound circuitry）——能够被可靠且正确调用并控制输出。
AI.result: 复调性不仅使"理解"的归因更加复杂，也使单音式的推理模式变得危险（hazardous），因为基于单一机制 indispensability 的推断在复调架构下失效。同时，以"健全电路"为核心的理解概念，使理解归因转化为关于内部组织的可处理主张。
AI.conclusion: 对AI的理解归因应以可被可靠、正确调用并控制输出的健全电路为判据，从而使"是否理解"成为可操作的内部组织问题，并承担起指导人类对AI信任的功能。

title: GeoOutageBench: Benchmarking Ambiguity-aware, Ontology-grounded Geospatiotemporal KGQA for Multimodal Power Outage and Resilience Analysis
comment: 13 pages, 6 figures, 7 tables. Accepted to the 34th ACM International Conference on Advances in Geographic Information Systems (SIGSPATIAL '26), November 3-6, 2026, Riverside, CA, USA
summary: We introduce GeoOutageBench, a benchmark for assessing LLM-based geospatiotemporal KGQA for multimodal outage and resilience analysis. Unlike existing KGQA benchmarks for Web knowledge, GeoOutageBench considers a spatiotemporal KG that integrates visual, textual, and structured data from outage records, remote sensing, weather observations, storm and power events, geographic entities, and domain ontologies. It provides a competency query taxonomy at different difficulty levels from spatiotemporal containment and proximity, spatiotemporal co-occurrence analysis, multimodal evidence, to hypothetical evaluation. Over multimodal KG and query classes, GeoOutageBench provides user-configurable evaluation of three important, highly coherent yet less studied tasks: (1) LLMs' understanding for ambiguous geospatiotemporal questions in terms of NL to SPARQL interpretation, (2) query-driven assessment of ontology utility, and (3) answer accuracy of multimodal KGQA retrieval. GeoOutageBench provides a design principle and foundation for assessing LLM-KG systems that support real-world infrastructure resilience analysis. Our benchmark, source code, data, results, and other documentation are available at https://github.com/UCF-SAGE/GeoOutageBench.

AI.tldr: 提出GeoOutageBench基准，用于评估面向多模态停电与韧性分析的LLM地理时空知识图谱问答（KGQA）。
AI.motivation: 现有KGQA基准主要面向Web知识，缺乏针对融合视觉、文本与结构化数据的时空知识图谱的评估，尤其是支持现实基础设施韧性分析的应用场景。
AI.method: 构建包含停电记录、遥感、气象观测、风暴与电力事件、地理实体及领域本体的时空KG；提供多难度层级的能力查询分类体系（时空包含与邻近、时空共现分析、多模态证据、假设评估），并支持用户可配置的三类任务评估。
AI.result: 支持对三类任务的评估：(1) LLM对模糊地理时空问题的自然语言到SPARQL解析理解；(2) 查询驱动的本体效用评估；(3) 多模态KGQA检索的答案准确性。
AI.conclusion: GeoOutageBench为评估支持现实基础设施韧性分析的LLM-KG系统提供了设计原则与基础，相关基准、源码、数据与文档已公开。

title: Assay: Claims That Decay With the Code. Content-Addressed Evidence Graphs for Accountable AI-Assisted Software Delivery
comment: 8 pages, 4 figures, 5 tables. Code, experiments, and paper source: https://github.com/OmShiv/assay-research
summary: AI coding agents fail in two coupled ways. They spend most of their context window rediscovering where things live, and they assert success without evidence when the work gets hard. Repository indexes address the first with cheap context, and orchestration frameworks with adversarial review address the second with accountability. Both describe the same object, the structure of the codebase, at two timescales: what is true of the code now, and what was verified to be true, at which revision, by whom. Assay makes that observation operational. Every claim an agent makes (tests pass, no secrets, behavior preserved) is bound to the Merkle hash of the dependency cone of the code it covers, so the claim is stale exactly when that code or anything it depends on changes. We show the binding is sound and minimal, and that the blast radius of a change is precisely the set of claims it invalidates. On the graph we place a risk-proportional evidence obligation, a bounded review protocol with separation of duties, and a merge gate that consults no model: coverage, freshness, signatures, exit codes, plausibility, evidence monotonicity (the mechanical form of "do not delete the failing test"), and review status. Assay is a dependency-free Python tool with an MCP server. On five public repositories a 600-token brief costs 14x to 114x less than an exploration proxy, warm rebuilds are up to 5x faster than cold ones, cone binding re-verifies 7.9% to 81.9% of claims where repository binding re-verifies all of them while per-module binding misses 23% to 68% of required invalidations, and the gate blocks 9 of 9 scripted adversarial behaviours while admitting the honest ones. Every number in this paper is generated by the released scripts.

AI.tldr: Assay 将 AI 编码代理的每条声明绑定到其覆盖代码依赖锥的 Merkle 哈希，使声明在相关代码或依赖变更时精确失效，并配套风险比例的证据义务、有界审查协议与不依赖模型的合并门禁。
AI.motivation: AI 编码代理存在两个耦合失败：大量上下文被用于重新发现代码位置；在任务困难时无证据地宣称成功。仓库索引以廉价上下文应对前者，编排框架与对抗审查以问责应对后者，但二者本质都在描述代码库结构，只是处于两个时间尺度。
AI.method: 提出 Assay：把代理的每条声明（测试通过、无密钥、行为保持）绑定到其覆盖代码依赖锥的 Merkle 哈希；在图上施加风险比例证据义务、职责分离的有界审查协议，以及不咨询任何模型的合并门禁，门禁检查覆盖率、新鲜度、签名、退出码、合理性、证据单调性与审查状态。Assay 是无依赖的 Python 工具并提供 MCP 服务器。
AI.result: 在五个公开仓库上：600 token 的简要说明比探索代理便宜 14 至 114 倍；热重建比冷重建快至多 5 倍；锥绑定仅需重新验证 7.9% 至 81.9% 的声明，而仓库级绑定需重验全部，模块级绑定则漏掉 23% 至 68% 的必要失效；门禁拦截 9/9 脚本化对抗行为并放行诚实行为。
AI.conclusion: 该绑定是可靠且最小的，变更的影响半径恰好等于其失效的声明集合；论文所有数字均由已发布的脚本生成，保证可复现。

title: Calibration-First Cross-Cohort Multimodal Temporal Learning for Transferable Asthma-Risk Forecasting
summary: Asthma deterioration forecasting must remain reli- able when patient populations, sensor ecosystems, and available modalities change across cohorts. Existing models commonly optimize within-cohort discrimination and may produce poorly calibrated probabilities after transfer. We present CALIBRA, a calibration-first multimodal temporal framework for short- horizon risk prediction with incomplete data. Dedicated recurrent encoders process environmental, pulmonary, symptom, medication, wearable, and context streams; a reliability-conditioned gate suppresses stale or absent modalities, while gradient-reversal training discourages avoidable cohort signatures. A shrinkage- based hierarchical logistic layer calibrates probabilities using a patient-disjoint target subset, and split conformal prediction provides abstention-capable prediction sets. To avoid fabricating clinical evidence, we evaluate the complete implementation on a documented three-cohort semi-synthetic benchmark with controlled distribution shift, informative missingness, and sealed target patients. Across five configured seeds, CALIBRA achieved mean target-test AUPRC 0.224 versus 0.240 for the strongest non-ablation comparator, TemporalTransformer; mean AUROC was 0.717, and Brier score was 0.098. Experiments additionally assess complete-modality failures, calibration, conformal coverage, decision curves, subgroup behavior, ablations, runtime, and parameter count. The results verify the method and reproducible pipeline under controlled shift, but do not establish clinical effectiveness. External validation on harmonized real asthma. Overall this artifact provides evidence for carefully governed real-cohort validation.

AI.tldr: 提出CALIBRA：一种以校准为先的多模态时序框架，用于跨队列变化下短时程哮喘恶化风险预测，在受控偏移的半合成三队列基准上验证方法可行性与可复现性。
AI.motivation: 哮喘恶化预测模型在患者人群、传感器生态与可用模态随队列变化时应保持可靠。现有模型多在同队列内优化判别能力（discrimination），迁移后概率校准（calibration）往往很差，难以支撑跨队列的风险沟通与决策。
AI.method: CALIBRA采用模态专用循环编码器处理环境、肺功能、症状、用药、可穿戴与情境六类数据流；以可靠性条件门控（reliability-conditioned gate）抑制陈旧或缺失模态；用梯度反转训练（gradient-reversal）降低可避免的队列特征。概率校准由基于收缩的分层逻辑回归层完成，使用患者不相交（patient-disjoint）目标子集；并以split conformal prediction给出可弃权（abstention-capable）预测集。
AI.result: 在具文档化、含受控分布偏移、信息性缺失与密封目标患者的半合成三队列基准上，5个种子平均：目标测试集AUPRC 0.224（最强非消融对比模型TemporalTransformer为0.240），AUROC 0.717，Brier 0.098。实验还评估了全模态失效、校准、conformal覆盖率、决策曲线、亚组行为、消融、运行时间与参数量。
AI.conclusion: 结果在受控偏移下验证了方法与可复现流水线，但未确立临床有效性；需在经协调的真实哮喘队列上进行外部验证，该工作为受严格治理的真实队列验证提供证据。

title: ThuRunel: Dynamic Decoupling for Structured Advisory Dialogue
summary: High-stakes advisory domains such as medical aesthetics, legal consultation, and educational planning exhibit a two-phase structure. The early phase requires empathetic elicitation and emotional support, and the late phase requires authoritative specialist judgment. Neither fully automated agents nor human junior consultants adequately address this structure at scale. We formalize the core design challenge as dynamic decoupling, asking how an AI advisory agent should decide what to ask, when to stop, what to resolve autonomously, and what to forward to the specialist. We present ThuRunel, an advisory agent combining a finite-state belief management framework, a chain-of-thought teacher synthesis protocol, and learned generation adapters. Against eleven baselines, ThuRunel achieves consistent improvements in elicitation completeness and specialist brief quality. ThuRunel is publicly deployed as a bilingual web application in which the same decoupling decisions operate from the client's side, grounded in a curated knowledge base that cites its sources in every answer.

AI.tldr: 本文研究高风险咨询领域（医美、法律咨询、教育规划）的"两阶段结构"问题，提出核心挑战为"动态解耦"，并给出咨询智能体 ThuRunel，在十一个基线对比中提升信息收集完整性与专家简报质量，且已作为双语 Web 应用公开部署。
AI.motivation: 高风险咨询场景兼具早期情感共情与引导、后期权威专业判断的两阶段需求。完全自动化智能体与人类初级顾问均难以规模化地满足这一结构，因此需要明确 AI 咨询代理在"问什么、何时停止、哪些自主解决、哪些转交专家"上的决策机制。
AI.method: ThuRunel 由三部分构成：有限状态信念管理框架（finite-state belief management framework）、思维链教师合成协议（chain-of-thought teacher synthesis protocol）以及可学习生成适配器（learned generation adapters）。该系统以双语 Web 应用形式公开部署，同一套解耦决策在客户端侧运行，并基于精选知识库，在每次回答中标注引用来源。
AI.result: 在十一个基线的对比实验中，ThuRunel 在信息收集完整性（elicitation completeness）与专家简报质量（specialist brief quality）两项指标上均取得一致提升。
AI.conclusion: 将咨询流程形式化为动态解耦问题，并通过信念管理、教师合成与生成适配器的组合，可在高风险咨询场景中规模化地兼顾共情引导与专业判断，且该方案已具备落地部署能力。

title: How Much Prompt Is Enough? A Blackbox Minimization of Few-Shots in LLMs
summary:
Prompts are the primary mechanism for directing the behavior of large language models (LLMs). Yet the internal structure and causal hierarchy of prompts remain poorly understood: which parts are causally necessary and which are redundant is an open question. This opacity can have severe consequences. Subtle prompt variations can silently shift model outputs in critical software systems, and engineers lack techniques to reason about prompt reliability.
  We present \framework, a blackbox prompt-minimization framework that reduces few-shot prompts to their necessary minimal subset. We use a case study to apply \framework to a few-shot learning system and demonstrate the insights that this framework can provide.
  Our experiments show that few-shot exemplars can be reduced by a mean of 65.3\%~$\pm$~15.8\% in character count while fully preserving propositional output fidelity. The models preferentially retain logical identifiers and constraint declarations while discarding natural language prose and cross-prompt relational annotations.
  Our analysis also shows that some models are universal encoders, able to produce highly legible yet minimized prompts, while others are universal decoders, able to interpret minimized prompts from most other models.
  By identifying which components are indispensable, \framework provides a principled basis for prompt compression and structural analysis of few-shot exemplars.

AI.tldr: 提出黑盒提示词最小化框架，将few-shot提示词压缩为其必要最小子集，平均减少65.3%字符数且保持命题级输出保真度。
AI.motivation: 提示词是引导大语言模型行为的主要机制，但其内部结构与因果层级尚不清晰：哪些部分因果必要、哪些冗余仍是开放问题。这种不透明性后果严重——细微的提示词变动可能悄然改变关键软件系统的输出，工程师也缺乏推理提示词可靠性的方法。
AI.method: 提出黑盒提示词最小化框架，将few-shot提示词归约为其必要最小子集；通过案例研究将该框架应用于few-shot学习系统，进行结构分析与最小化实验。
AI.result: few-shot示例在字符数上平均减少65.3%±15.8%，同时完全保持命题级输出保真度。模型倾向于保留逻辑标识符与约束声明，丢弃自然语言散文和跨提示词的关系注释。部分模型为"通用编码器"，能生成高可读且最小化的提示词；另一些为"通用解码器"，能解读多数其他模型生成的最小化提示词。
AI.conclusion: 通过识别哪些组件不可省略，该框架为提示词压缩与few-shot示例的结构分析提供了有原则的基础。

title: Binarization Flattens the Score Space
summary: Large language model (LLM) judges are often used as rewards to train policies on objectives that deterministic verifiers cannot capture. However, these rewards are often collapsed to pass/fail ({0, 1}), which reports the verdict but not how well a response met each criterion. We model each pass/fail verdict as a score on an unreported scale, compared with one cutoff. A stretch of that scale moves every score proportionally toward or away from the cutoff, but never across it, so no verdict changes. A policy is therefore free to apply any stretch without changing anything the panel reports. Under a joint-Gaussian model, a third grade adds a second threshold and removes this affine stretch ambiguity. On MATH and SciBench outputs from one seven-criterion judge, all 14 constructed criterionwise stretches were invisible after binarization but visible with three grades. At $n=1{,}024$, a test given both population laws had at least 96.5% power at a $1.5\times$ stress. Retaining grades closes one blind spot created by binarization, but verdicts alone remain insufficient as some changes are still indistinguishable from genuine improvement. These include arbitrary within-grade changes and fixed-covariance, loading-aligned mean shifts -- the signature of a sycophancy-shaped lift the panel reads as competence. The shared-factor reference approximation fit MATH and SciBench but not HealthBench, delineating its empirical scope. We recommend keeping at least three grades (for example, asking the judge whether each criterion is fully, partially, or not met and rewarding {0, 0.5, 1}), and externally validating gains along the remaining direction, which no finer scale removes.

AI.tldr: 将LLM评判器的通过/失败判定建模为未报告尺度上的分数与单一阈值的比较，揭示二值化的仿射拉伸盲区；三等级评分可消除该歧义，但对组内变化与负载对齐均值漂移（谄媚式提升）仍不可辨。
AI.motivation: LLM judges常被用作不可由确定性验证器捕捉的目标的奖励信号，但奖励常被压缩为通过/失败（{0,1}），只报告判定结果而不报告响应在各标准上的满足程度，由此产生系统性的信息盲区。
AI.method: 将每个通过/失败判定建模为未报告尺度上的分数与一个截止值的比较；在此模型下，尺度拉伸使分数等比靠近或远离截止值但不跨越，从而不改变任何判定。采用联合高斯模型分析：引入第三等级即增加第二阈值，消除仿射拉伸歧义。以单个七标准评判器在MATH与SciBench输出上构造14个标准级拉伸进行验证，并在n=1,024、1.5倍压力下检验功效。
AI.result: 14个构造的标准级拉伸在二值化后均不可见，而在三等级下可见；在n=1,024且同时给定总体分布时，测试在1.5倍压力下功效至少96.5%。但组内任意变化与固定协方差、负载对齐的均值漂移仍与真实改进不可区分——后者正是被面板读作能力提升的谄媚式提升特征。共享因子参照近似拟合MATH与SciBench，但不拟合HealthBench，界定了其经验适用范围。
AI.conclusion: 建议保留至少三个等级（例如令评判器判断每条标准为完全满足、部分满足或未满足并奖励{0, 0.5, 1}），同时对剩余方向上的增益进行外部验证，因为该方向无法通过更细的评分尺度消除。

title: An Exact Generate - Transform Decomposition of Small-LLM Team Scaling Across Orchestration Architectures
summary:
Replacing one LLM agent with a collaborating team can raise accuracy, but whether scaling the team helps, and which architecture to scale, is unclear. Sweeping eight agent orchestration architectures across five instruction-tuned 7-9B models, five short-answer benchmarks, and an executable-code benchmark up to 30 calls, we find that the returns to team scaling are sharply task-dependent: from three to thirty calls accuracy rises by up to 17 points on the two arithmetic word-problem benchmarks (GSM8K, GSMHard) but by at most four on ARC, GPQA, and MMLU, for every architecture, a split the usual task-averaged number conceals. Proposer-Critic captures the arithmetic gains, scaling steepest and, in aggregate, surpassing every other architecture at the largest budget (item-clustered intervals exclude zero), though it ranks among the weakest elsewhere, and no architecture wins across tasks.
  We explain these trajectories with an exact generate-transform decomposition. Partitioning any workflow into proposal coverage and a downstream transform, any accuracy change splits exactly into an extensive coverage dividend and an intensive transformation change. The decomposition diagnoses each task: arithmetic offers coverage headroom that a critic-guided transform converts, whereas the multiple-choice benchmarks either saturate in coverage or fail to convert it, and on open-ended code generative recovery nearly vanishes so accuracy tracks coverage. At equal call budgets token cost still varies 2.1x. Extra calls therefore create candidate opportunity that only some architectures, on some tasks, convert. Team scaling is a task- and architecture-specific bet, not a uniform lever.

AI.tldr: 团队规模扩展的收益高度依赖任务与架构：3→30次调用时算术类提升达17分，而ARC/GPQA/MMLU最多4分；Proposer-Critic在算术上最优，但无架构全任务通吃。作者提出精确的"生成-变换"分解，将精度变化拆为覆盖红利与变换变化，解释各任务差异。
AI.motivation: 用协作团队替代单LLM智能体可提升准确率，但团队规模扩展是否有效、哪种编排架构值得扩展均不明确；常规的任务平均指标会掩盖这种任务异质性。
AI.method: 系统扫描8种智能体编排架构，覆盖5个指令微调7-9B模型、5个短答案基准与1个可执行代码基准，调用预算最高至30；并提出精确的生成-变换分解，将任意工作流的精度变化拆分为外延的覆盖红利与内涵的变换变化。
AI.result: 3→30次调用时，GSM8K与GSMHard提升最高17分，ARC/GPQA/MMLU至多4分，且对所有架构一致；Proposer-Critic在算术上增益最大、扩展最陡，最大预算下总体超越其他架构（项目聚类区间不含零），但在其他任务上排名靠后；等调用预算下token成本仍相差2.1倍。
AI.conclusion: 额外调用创造候选机会，但仅部分架构在部分任务上能将其转化。团队扩展是任务与架构特定的选择，而非统一杠杆；分解方法可诊断任务属于覆盖受限、变换受限还是生成恢复缺失。

title: Better Nearest Neighbor Graph Indices via (Efficient) LLM-Guided Pruning
summary: Graph-based approximate nearest neighbor search (ANNS) is widely used for large-scale semantic search. Its indices are constructed primarily based on geometric relationships among embeddings of an input dataset (e.g., documents or images), rather than explicitly optimizing for semantic relevance. However, when using these indices for downstream query retrieval, performance is evaluated based on the semantic relevance of the retrieved results to the query. This creates a fundamental "geometry-semantic" mismatch between how the indices are constructed and how their retrieval results are evaluated. While existing LLM-based reranking methods can partially mitigate this mismatch at query time, they leave this underlying structural problem in the graph unresolved. We therefore propose LLM-Guided Graph Pruning (LGP), a general framework that addresses this mismatch directly by leveraging LLM reasoning to refine an existing ANN graph index itself. LGP identifies structurally "low-value" neighbors of nodes and replaces them with LLM-selected alternatives that provide useful semantic information while retaining desired geometric structures of the original graph, including sparsity and efficient navigability. Experiments on representative semantic retrieval benchmarks show that LGP consistently improves end-to-end retrieval performance over both vanilla greedy graph search and LLM-based reranking across widely used graph-based ANN indices such as DiskANN and HNSW.

AI.tldr: 本文提出LLM-Guided Graph Pruning (LGP)，通过LLM推理直接优化ANN图索引结构，以解决图构建的几何关系与检索评估的语义相关性之间的"几何-语义"失配问题。
AI.motivation: 基于图的近似最近邻搜索（ANNS）索引主要依据嵌入向量间的几何关系构建，而非显式优化语义相关性；但下游查询检索的性能却按检索结果的语义相关性评估。这种"几何-语义"失配是结构性缺陷，现有LLM重排序方法仅在查询时部分缓解，未触及图索引本身。
AI.method: 提出LLM-Guided Graph Pruning (LGP) 通用框架：利用LLM推理直接精炼已有的ANN图索引，识别节点中结构上"低价值"的邻居，并用LLM选择的替代邻居替换之，在注入有用语义信息的同时保留原图的稀疏性和高效可导航性等几何结构。
AI.result: 在代表性语义检索基准上，LGP在DiskANN、HNSW等主流图ANN索引上，端到端检索性能持续优于朴素贪婪图搜索和基于LLM的重排序方法。
AI.conclusion: 通过在索引构建层面直接引入LLM语义推理来修剪并重构图邻居，可有效弥合几何构建与语义评估之间的鸿沟，是一种可推广至多种图ANN索引的索引级优化思路。

title: Strategies for Deploying AI Agents in Production at Scientific User Facilities
summary: Agentic artificial intelligence (AI) is moving beyond research demonstrations toward production use at scientific user facilities, including light sources, neutron sources, nanoscience centers, and autonomous laboratories. Its scientific value extends beyond increasing throughput. Agents can perform repeatable tasks in calibration, measurement execution, and quality control, as well as initial analyses that turn data into reviewable evidence, allowing scientists to focus on hypotheses, unexpected observations, and interpretation. Drawing on deployments of LLM-driven agents at the APS, this perspective distills practical strategies with an emphasis on elements that can be reused across instruments and facilities. We discuss agent harnesses for beamline control, facility knowledge retrieval, and data analysis while keeping the underlying design principles independent of any specific implementation. These principles cover inference endpoints, tool-server architectures, non-text data, computationally intensive services, reusable skills, and governed learning throughout an instrument's lifecycle. We also consider how network and Linux operations, governed shared memory, and deterministic orchestration can extend these patterns across facility services. Because LLM capabilities continue to evolve, these recommendations represent a snapshot of the technology as of the date on the cover.

AI.tldr: 该文基于APS的LLM驱动智能体部署经验，总结可在科学用户设施间复用的智能体构建策略与设计原则，涵盖束线控制、知识检索与数据分析，并给出设施服务扩展方向。
AI.motivation: Agentic AI正从研究演示走向光源、中子源、纳米科学中心与自主实验室等科学用户设施的生产应用。其价值不仅在于提升吞吐量，更在于承担校准、测量执行、质量控制等可重复任务及初步分析，从而让科学家聚焦假设、异常观察与解释。然而需要可跨仪器、跨设施复用的实践策略与独立于具体实现的设计原则。
AI.method: 以APS的LLM驱动智能体部署为基础进行经验归纳与观点性总结（perspective）。讨论面向束线控制、设施知识检索与数据分析的智能体harness（框架），并抽象出与具体实现无关的设计原则，包括推理端点、工具服务器架构、非文本数据、计算密集型服务、可复用技能以及仪器全生命周期的受治理学习；同时探讨网络与Linux运维、受治理共享内存、确定性编排如何将上述模式扩展到设施服务。
AI.result: 提出一套可复用的智能体实践策略与设计原则体系，覆盖束线控制、设施知识检索与数据分析三类典型场景，并给出将模式延伸至更广泛设施服务的具体路径（网络/Linux运维、受治理共享内存、确定性编排）。
AI.conclusion: 由于LLM能力持续演进，文中建议仅代表封面日期时的技术快照；其核心价值在于提供独立于具体实现的、可跨仪器与设施迁移的设计原则与实践策略。

title: HeadGuard: Selective Head Protection for Low-Bit VLM KV-Cache Quantization
summary: Low-bit key-value (KV) cache quantization saves storage but can sharply degrade vision-language model (VLM) accuracy. We introduce HeadGuard, a composable head-protection method that augments a base KV-cache quantizer with a fixed high-precision mask. Image-sensitivity and output-sensitivity scores select physical KV heads offline, with approximately 1/8 protected in the main experiments; their image keys and optionally values remain in bfloat16 (BF16), while the base quantizes unprotected image entries. Across eight VLMs, three base quantizers, and eight benchmarks (six discriminative and two generative), HeadGuard recovers a substantial fraction of lost accuracy on weaker quantizers, with the strongest gains for Qwen and InternVL. At 2 bits, the six-task discriminative mean over eight models rises from 0.436 to 0.580 on the weakest base; protection can also improve generated answers and caption fidelity to BF16 outputs. Mean accuracy gains persist across all three quantizers with both tested calibration datasets. Keys-only protection retains substantial recovery at lower modeled storage cost. Evaluated through simulated quantization, HeadGuard offers a composable way to improve low-bit VLM accuracy without replacing the underlying quantizer.

AI.tldr: HeadGuard：通过固定的高精度头部保护掩码增强低比特KV缓存量化，在不替换底层量化器的前提下显著恢复VLM精度。
AI.motivation: 低比特KV缓存量化可节省存储，但会严重损害视觉语言模型（VLM）精度，需要一种能提升低比特VLM精度的方法。
AI.method: HeadGuard是一种可组合的头部保护方法：基于图像敏感性与输出敏感性分数离线选取物理KV头（主实验约保护1/8），被保护头的图像key及可选value保持BF16精度，未保护图像条目由基础量化器量化。
AI.result: 在8个VLM、3种基础量化器、8个基准（6个判别式、2个生成式）上，HeadGuard恢复大量损失精度，Qwen与InternVL增益最强。2比特下，最弱基础量化器的六任务判别均值由0.436升至0.580；可改善生成答案与描述保真度；跨3种量化器与2个校准数据集均维持平均精度增益；仅保护key在更低建模存储成本下仍保留显著恢复。
AI.conclusion: 在模拟量化评估下，HeadGuard提供了一种可组合的方式，无需替换底层量化器即可提升低比特VLM精度。

title: The Layer Mystery of VLA: An Information-Theoretical Analysis of VLA Latent Interface
summary: Vision-language-action (VLA) policies connect a pretrained vision-language backbone to an action head through a latent interface, but which backbone layers this interface should expose remains unclear. We study single-layer selection and multi-layer fusion for frozen backbones across three pretrained models and two manipulation benchmarks, LIBERO and CALVIN, with three policy-training seeds per configuration. Across three fusion mechanisms and three layer-subset strategies, 47 of 54 configurations underperform the best observed single-layer policy. Our stastical analysis further confirms that fusion's advantage is very limited. However, the best layer varies substantially across backbones and benchmarks, making layer selection consequential and exhaustive policy sweeps expensive. We further derive a reweighting equivalence between the proposed information-bottleneck objectives for action-conditioned InfoNCE and action prediction, motivating InfoNCE as a proxy for layer quality. Empirically, InfoNCE provides the most consistent positive association with policy success among four evaluated proxies. Selecting the layer with the highest InfoNCE score requires 9-33 times less GPU compute than exhaustive policy sweeps and reduces mean selection regret from 17.89 percentage points for deepest-layer selection to 3.71 points across six settings. Its mean regret is close to the 3.28-3.50 points achieved by fixed-layer heuristics optimized retrospectively using all six oracle sweeps, without requiring closed-loop evaluations during selection.

AI.tldr: 研究冻结VLA骨干的网络层选择与多层融合问题，发现多层融合优势有限，最佳层因骨干与基准而异；提出以InfoNCE作为层质量代理，可低成本高精度地选出优质层。
AI.motivation: VLA策略通过潜在接口将预训练视觉语言骨干与动作头相连，但接口应暴露骨干的哪些层尚不明确。层选择影响显著，而穷举策略扫描代价高昂，因此需要一个低成本且可靠的层质量指标。
AI.method: 在三个预训练模型、两个操作基准（LIBERO与CALVIN）上研究冻结骨干的单层选择与多层融合，每配置三个策略训练种子；比较三种融合机制与三种层子集策略；从动作条件InfoNCE与动作预测的信息瓶颈目标推导出重加权等价，从而将InfoNCE作为层质量代理，并与四种代理进行实证对比。
AI.result: 54个多层融合配置中有47个劣于最佳单层策略，统计检验显示融合优势非常有限；最佳层随骨干与基准大幅变化。InfoNCE与策略成功率正相关最一致；按最高InfoNCE选层所需GPU算力比穷举策略扫描少9-33倍，平均选择遗憾由最深层的17.89个百分点降至六设置下的3.71个百分点，接近回顾式固定层启发式的3.28-3.50个百分点，且选择过程无需闭环评估。
AI.conclusion: 多层融合难以稳定超越最佳单层，层选择具有实质影响；InfoNCE作为一种基于信息瓶颈等价性的代理指标，能在不进行闭环评估的情况下高效、可靠地识别高质量层，显著降低选择遗憾与计算开销。

title: ARCagent: An Adaptive Retrieval Calibration Agent for Clinical Question Answering
summary: In diseases where clinical guidelines are incomplete, contested, or mutually contradictory, knowledge completeness and dynamic conflict-aware synthesis are two safety-critical properties that standard Retrieval-Augmented Generation systems do not provide. Therefore, we present \sysname, an adaptive retrieval calibration clinical question-answering agent for ME/CFS, a disease where diagnostic frameworks coexist and major guidelines actively contradict each other on treatment. ARCagent contributes three components. First, a 1,706-chunk, 10-source knowledge base with a structured inter-guideline conflict registry spanning all active ME/CFS diagnostic frameworks. Second, a conflict-aware retrieval calibration pipeline that re-ranks retrieved evidence using query-specific focus and conflict signals. Third, a benchmark scored by LLM-as-Judge, avoiding systematic underestimation averaging 10.1 percentage points caused by keyword matching. ARCagent achieves 95.3%, outperforming all base LLMs. Code is available at https://github.com/Yukyin/ARCagent.

AI.tldr: ARCagent是一个面向ME/CFS的自适应检索校准临床问答智能体，通过冲突感知的检索校准管线与冲突登记表，在LLM-as-Judge评测中达到95.3%的表现，优于所有基线大模型。
AI.motivation: 在临床指南不完整、存在争议或相互矛盾的疾病场景中，标准检索增强生成（RAG）系统无法提供知识完整性与动态冲突感知综合这两个安全关键属性。ME/CFS正是此类疾病：多种诊断框架并存，且主要指南在治疗上actively相互矛盾。
AI.method: ARCagent包含三个组件：(1) 1,706个文本块、10个来源的知识库，并配有覆盖所有现行ME/CFS诊断框架的结构化指南间冲突登记表；(2) 冲突感知的检索校准管线，利用查询特定的focus信号与冲突信号对检索证据进行重排序；(3) 由LLM-as-Judge评分的基准，以避免关键词匹配平均达10.1个百分点的系统性低估。
AI.result: ARCagent达到95.3%的评分，优于所有基础大语言模型。
AI.conclusion: ARCagent验证了在指南矛盾型疾病中引入冲突登记与冲突感知检索校准可有效提升临床问答的准确性与安全性；代码已开源。

title: LatentSift: Policy-State Filtering for Token-Efficient Verification of Software Engineering Agents
summary: Test-time scaling improves software engineering agents by generating multiple candidate trajectories and selecting the best one. Verifying and selecting among these long interactions can consume as many tokens as generation itself. Existing hybrid workflows first apply an LLM-based execution-free (EF) verifier to filter candidates before running tests, which adds another model pass over every trajectory. We introduce LatentSift, a token-free and execution-free filter that replaces this first stage with hidden states the policy already produces while generating the candidates. It represents each candidate through its reasoning, observation, and function-call states, compares them with positive and negative banks of such states collected from successful and unsuccessful trajectories during policy training, and fuses the resulting distance scores with a learned linear score to retain promising candidates for the execution-based stages. On SWE-bench Verified, across three agents and two policy sizes, LatentSift cuts EF-verifier tokens by 66.6--81.0% and total verification tokens, which include test generation, by 49.1--62.1% at K=16, while hybrid Best@16 matches or improves on each agent's reference workflow, rising from 59.26% to 60.06% on DeepSWE-Preview.

AI.tldr: LatentSift 提出一种无需额外 token 与执行的筛选器，直接复用策略生成候选轨迹时的隐状态，通过与正负状态库比对距离并结合学习到的线性分数来筛选候选，从而大幅降低验证开销。
AI.motivation: 软件工程智能体的测试时扩展需生成多条候选轨迹并择优，但长交互的验证与选择成本几乎与生成相当。现有混合流程先用基于 LLM 的无执行（EF）验证器过滤候选再跑测试，导致每条轨迹都要额外过一次模型，增加大量 token 消耗。
AI.method: LatentSift 是一种 token-free 且 execution-free 的过滤器，替换混合流程的第一阶段。它利用策略在生成候选时已产生的隐状态，将每个候选表示为推理状态、观察状态和函数调用状态；与训练期间从成功与失败轨迹收集的正、负状态库进行比对，得到距离分数，再用学习到的线性分数进行融合，从而保留有潜力的候选进入基于执行的后续阶段。
AI.result: 在 SWE-bench Verified 上，跨三个智能体和两种策略规模，K=16 时 LatentSift 将 EF 验证器 token 减少 66.6–81.0%，将包含测试生成的总验证 token 减少 49.1–62.1%；同时混合 Best@16 达到或超过各智能体的参考流程，在 DeepSWE-Preview 上从 59.26% 提升至 60.06%。
AI.conclusion: 复用策略生成过程已有的隐状态进行无 token、无执行的候选筛选，可在保持甚至提升 Best@16 性能的同时显著削减验证 token 开销，为软件工程智能体的测试时扩展提供了高效方案。

title: Learned Compression of SAR Phase-History Data: A Rate-Honest Feasibility Study on GOTCHA
summary: On-board compression of synthetic aperture radar (SAR) phase history is bandwidth-critical, and block-adaptive quantization (BAQ) remains the operational standard. We test whether a small convolutional autoencoder, with its encoder on the sensor, can compete with BAQ on complex phase-history patches from the AFRL GOTCHA collection. Every method is charged for all transmitted bits, rates are reported in bits per complex sample (b/cs), and detection is scored by one-to-one matching of CA-CFAR detections. The autoencoder (28,656 encoder parameters) loses at every rate. At 16 b/cs it reaches -2.87 dB NMSE, against -35.5 dB for 8-bit BAQ with $\pm 3σ$ clipping and -41.0 dB with a tuned clipping range. It also loses to a $16 \times 16$ block Karhunen-Loève transform (KLT), a local linear coder with a tenth of its encoder cost (-5.39 dB). Running the network in a companded Fourier domain helps, but its detection F1 remains bounded at 33%. The evidence points to this model, its normalization, and its objective, not to a fundamental limit of learned coding. Per patch, the data have modest lag-1 coherence ($|ρ| \approx 0.3$) and patch-specific spectral concentration. Two findings concern evaluation itself. First, 97% of CFAR crossings on raw $64 \times 64$ patches are border artifacts of the zero-padded detector. Second, on interior cells BAQ's clipping range decides detection: 8-bit BAQ keeps 69% F1 with tuned clipping but 17% at $\pm 3σ$, and at 8 b/cs or less adaptive FFT thresholding preserves more detections than BAQ. We close with an evaluation protocol for learned radar compression.

AI.tldr: 本文检验小型卷积自编码器能否在SAR相位历史片上板载压缩中与BAQ竞争，结论是不能：自编码器在所有码率下均劣于BAQ与KLT，问题出在模型、归一化与目标函数而非学习编码的根本极限，并给出面向学习式雷达压缩的评测协议。
AI.motivation: SAR相位历史的星上压缩对带宽极其敏感，块自适应量化（BAQ）一直是实际运行标准。作者希望验证：把编码器放在传感器端的小型卷积自编码器，能否在AFRL GOTCHA复相位历史片上与BAQ竞争，从而判断学习式压缩是否具备替代经典方案的潜力。
AI.method: 在AFRL GOTCHA数据集的复相位历史片上，对每种方法按全部传输比特计费，码率以每复样点比特（b/cs）报告；自编码器编码器含28,656个参数；检测性能用CA-CFAR检测的一对一匹配打分。对比对象包括8位BAQ（±3σ裁剪与调优裁剪范围）、16×16块Karhunen-Loève变换（KLT），并将网络改在压扩傅里叶域中运行。同时分析每片的lag-1相干性与频谱集中度。
AI.result: 自编码器在每个码率下都失败：16 b/cs时NMSE为-2.87 dB，而8位BAQ（±3σ裁剪）为-35.5 dB、调优裁剪范围下为-41.0 dB；也劣于编码成本仅其十分之一的16×16块KLT（-5.39 dB）。改用压扩傅里叶域有帮助，但检测F1仍被限制在33%。此外，原始64×64片上97%的CFAR过点是零填充检测器的边界伪影；在内区单元上，BAQ检测由裁剪范围决定：8位BAQ在调优裁剪下F1为69%，±3σ时仅17%；在≤8 b/cs时自适应FFT阈值化比BAQ保留更多检测。
AI.conclusion: 结果表明性能劣势源于该模型本身、其归一化方式与优化目标，而非学习式编码的根本极限；BAQ的裁剪范围在内区检测中起决定性作用，且低码率下自适应FFT阈值化更具优势。作者据此提出一套针对学习式雷达压缩的评测协议，强调比特计费、检测级评价与边界伪影排除。

title: AdaST: Adaptive Coupling for Spatial-Temporal Forecasting
comment: Accepted to NeurIPS 2026 (main conference). Code: https://github.com/LzyFischer/AdaST
summary: Spatial-temporal (ST) forecasting underpins many real-world systems such as traffic, climate, and energy networks. While existing methods implicitly assume strong spatiotemporal coupling, we observe that real-world ST data exhibits distinct coupling regimes, ranging from temporal-dominated and spatial-dominated to strongly coupled patterns. This mismatch causes current models to suffer from spurious dependencies and degraded performance when one correlation dominates. To overcome this limitation, we aim to dynamically modulate spatial and temporal modeling based on the data's inherent coupling structure. However, three key challenges exist: unknown coupling structure, heterogeneous coupling dynamics, and suboptimal spatial modeling. We propose AdaST, an adaptive ST forecasting framework that tackles these challenges through a decompose-recompose paradigm. AdaST factorizes inputs into components capturing different coupling patterns using heterogeneity-aware experts. Each component is processed by role-aligned modules, and a correlation-informed adaptive recomposer integrates them for final prediction. Extensive experiments confirm that AdaST significantly outperforms state-of-the-art baselines, validating the necessity of an adaptive approach.

AI.tldr: 本文提出AdaST，一种基于分解-重组范式的自适应时空预测框架，通过异质性感知专家将输入分解为不同耦合模式的成分，并利用角色对齐模块与相关性驱动的自适应重组器完成预测。
AI.motivation: 现有时空预测方法隐含假设强时空耦合，但真实时空数据存在时间主导、空间主导与强耦合等不同耦合模式。这种假设与数据不匹配会导致虚假依赖，当某一相关性占主导时模型性能下降，因此需要根据数据内在耦合结构动态调制空间与时间建模。
AI.method: AdaST采用分解-重组范式应对三大挑战：未知耦合结构、异质耦合动态与次优空间建模。具体地，使用异质性感知专家将输入分解为捕捉不同耦合模式的成分，每个成分由角色对齐模块处理，最后由相关性驱动的自适应重组器整合各成分以生成最终预测。
AI.result: 大量实验表明，AdaST显著优于当前最先进的基线方法，验证了自适应方法的必要性。
AI.conclusion: 时空数据中的耦合结构具有多样性，显式建模并动态调制耦合模式对提升时空预测性能至关重要，AdaST为此提供了有效解决方案。

title: ReMem: Rethinking Perception and Memory in Long-Context Recommendation Agents
summary: Recent Recommendation Agents (RecAgents) offer a promising alternative by shifting recommendation to an active, user-side paradigm, where generative agents autonomously perceive external platforms, reason over user preferences, and execute decisions. However, existing RecAgents still suffer from two critical limitations: brittle item perception based on noisy and heterogeneous item pages, and inefficient long-context reasoning over extended user histories and multi-step interaction traces. To address these challenges, we propose a novel recommendation agent framework, termed as ReMem, that combines OCR-based multimodal perception with time-evolving dynamic memory. Instead of parsing raw HTML, ReMem observes item pages through screenshots and extracts structured multimodal information via an OCR tool, enabling a more humanoid and platform-agnostic perception mechanism. To support long-horizon preference modeling, ReMem further introduces a chunk-wise sequential memory update strategy, where the agent selectively maintains a fixed-size memory of informative historical interactions while processing arbitrarily long contexts with linear inference complexity and bounded context length. This design allows the agent to preserve evolving user preferences without relying on external memory modules or disrupting the standard autoregressive generation process. To enhance the dynamic memory instruction, we further develop a multi-memory GRPO variant, which propagates the final-answer advantage to all intermediate conversations that contribute to the final response. Extensive experiments on three datasets demonstrate that ReMem consistently outperforms state-of-the-art baselines, achieving an average improvement of 5.16\% across three recommendation agent tasks, namely searching, ranking, and judging.

AI.tldr: 提出ReMem推荐智能体框架，结合OCR多模态感知与时变动态记忆，实现平台无关的物品感知和线性复杂度的长程偏好建模，在搜索、排序、判断三类任务上平均提升5.16%。
AI.motivation: 现有推荐智能体（RecAgents）存在两大瓶颈：一是基于噪声大、异构性强的物品页面进行物品感知，鲁棒性差；二是在超长用户历史与多步交互轨迹上进行长上下文推理效率低下。论文希望将推荐转变为主动的、用户侧范式，同时解决感知脆弱与长程推理低效的问题。
AI.method: ReMem将OCR多模态感知与时变动态记忆相结合。感知层面摒弃原始HTML解析，改用截图观察物品页面，并通过OCR工具抽取结构化多模态信息，实现更拟人化、平台无关的感知机制。记忆层面提出分块式序列记忆更新策略，在处理任意长上下文时选择性维护固定大小的有效历史交互记忆，推理复杂度为线性且上下文长度有界，无需外部记忆模块、不破坏标准自回归生成。此外提出多记忆GRPO变体，将最终答案的优势传播到所有对最终回复有贡献的中间对话，以强化动态记忆指令。
AI.result: 在三个数据集上的大量实验表明，ReMem持续优于最先进基线，在搜索、排序、判断三类推荐智能体任务上平均提升5.16%。
AI.conclusion: ReMem通过OCR驱动的多模态感知与分块动态记忆机制，有效缓解了物品感知脆弱与长上下文推理低效的问题，在保持线性推理复杂度和标准自回归生成的前提下实现了长程偏好建模，并在多项推荐智能体任务上取得一致且显著的性能提升。

title: WitnessGym: Benchmarking Coding Agents on the Construction of Bug Witnesses
comment: 30 pages, 8 figures, and 12 tables, including appendices
summary: Bug validation asks a coding agent to produce an executable witness for a reported bug. The witness combines a concrete input with a testing harness and exposes faulty behavior during execution. Such evidence makes audit findings actionable, yet benchmark evaluation is difficult when cases reuse public historical bugs and witnesses or require manual construction. We present WitnessGym, an automated framework for constructing bug-validation benchmarks through bug injection. It injects bugs into test-reached paths of real projects, rebuilds each project, and retains cases exposed by a construction-time witness. Bug specifications and execution adapters allow extension to additional bug types and languages. Bug-preserving transformations vary the surrounding structure while preserving the witness behavior. Based on real-world Java projects with test suites, WitnessGym automatically constructs 1,300 benchmark cases. The injected patches resemble historical bug patches and are difficult for the two evaluated models to distinguish in blinded comparisons. We evaluate four coding agent frameworks in six framework/model pairings across bug types, execution contexts, and transformation depths. Witness construction remains difficult even when the bug pattern is known. Our framework, benchmark cases, and evaluation scripts are available.

AI.tldr: WitnessGym通过缺陷注入自动构建缺陷验证基准，在真实Java项目上生成1300个案例，用于评估编码智能体构建可执行见证的能力。
AI.motivation: 缺陷验证要求编码智能体为已报告缺陷生成可执行见证（具体输入+测试框架），使审计发现可操作。但现有基准评估困难：案例多复用公开历史缺陷及见证，或需人工构建。
AI.method: WitnessGym向真实项目的测试覆盖路径注入缺陷，重建项目，并保留可由构建期见证暴露的案例；通过缺陷规范与执行适配器支持扩展缺陷类型与语言；采用保见证变换改变周边结构而保持见证行为；基于含测试套件的真实Java项目自动构建基准。
AI.result: 自动构建1,300个基准案例；注入补丁与历史缺陷补丁相似，盲测中两个被测模型难以区分；在6组框架/模型配对、4个编码智能体框架上，跨缺陷类型、执行上下文与变换深度评估，发现即便已知缺陷模式，见证构建仍具难度。
AI.conclusion: WitnessGym提供了可扩展、自动化的缺陷验证基准构建框架，揭示缺陷见证构建仍是编码智能体的挑战，并公开框架、案例与评估脚本。

title: A Mesoscopic View of Transformer Weights Through Row and Column Scale Fields
comment: 37 pages, 14 figures, 5 tables. Code and data: https://github.com/tiexinding/NPM-Weibull-public (directory scale_field, tag p5-scale-field-v1)
summary: Pooled statistics of Transformer weights obscure how magnitude is distributed across functional channels, while individual weights are too numerous to compare directly. We study the mesoscopic level between them: row and column scale fields, the median-centred log-RMS profiles of a weight matrix over its channels, which together with a global scale and a full balanced core represent the matrix exactly. Across public Pythia checkpoints at four sizes and controlled runs from three initialization families, balancing reveals similar measured core magnitude profiles. A mixture bridge, with its form fixed before the analysis and its coefficients fitted, predicts the pooled-shape departure from field width on held-out runs and data arms of the controlled grid. The indexed fields retain further structure: they align across projections that share a functional channel, and query/key profiles follow reassigned RoPE frequencies rather than fixed matrix coordinates. Training trajectories show early field formation followed by component-dependent broadening or recession. Extending the channel-based analysis to AdamW's second moment reveals related functional organization in its log-space row and column factors. Finally, edits of a frozen checkpoint separate reciprocal scale balance, which preserves the forward computation, from relative channel gain: flattening the gain increases in-distribution loss while preserving matrix norms and the balanced core. Row and column scale fields thus connect pooled magnitude statistics to channel organization and provide coordinates for tracking and testing trained weight structure.

AI.tldr: 论文研究Transformer权重矩阵中行/列尺度场的"介观"结构，揭示其与功能通道组织的对应关系及训练动态。
AI.motivation: 权重矩阵的池化统计量掩盖了幅度在功能通道间的分布信息，而逐权重比较又过于庞杂，因此需要在二者之间的介观层面寻找可刻画且可解释的结构。
AI.method: 提出"行/列尺度场"，即权重矩阵沿通道方向的中位数中心化对数RMS剖面；与全局尺度及完整平衡核心共同精确表示原矩阵。在Pythia多规模公开检查点及三个初始化家族的受控训练上进行分解分析，并用预先确定函数形式的混合桥接模型拟合系数以预测池化形状偏差；将通道分析扩展到AdamW二阶矩的行/列对数因子；并通过对冻结检查点的编辑实验分离互反尺度平衡与相对通道增益。
AI.result: 平衡后各检查点呈现相似的实测核心幅度剖面；混合桥接模型能预测留出运行与数据臂上的池化形状偏差；索引场在共享功能通道的投影间对齐，且query/key剖面随重分配的RoPE频率移动而非固定矩阵坐标；训练轨迹显示早期场形成后出现依赖组分的展宽或收缩；AdamW二阶矩呈现相关的功能组织；抹平相对通道增益会增加分布内损失，同时保持矩阵范数与平衡核心不变。
AI.conclusion: 行/列尺度场将池化幅度统计与通道组织联系起来，为追踪与检验训练所得权重结构提供了新的坐标系统。

title: Memory Is a Derivation: The Distributed-Evidence Paradox in Long-Term Agents
summary: Long-running LLM agents compress past interactions into persistent memories that may be reused as premises for later tasks. This creates a distinct derivation problem: whether the memory actually follows from what the interaction history supports. Relevant evidence may be scattered across earlier interactions, while compression can introduce relations or event status that the history never established. A valid memory may therefore appear unsupported because its citations omit relevant evidence, while individually supported facts may be composed into a stronger statement the history never established. We characterize this problem through three coupled requirements: (1) Evidence scope; (2) Compositional validity; (3) Admission reliability. We therefore ask whether the interaction history available at write time supports what enters persistent memory. We introduce DerivAudit, a framework for auditing whether a memory is actually supported by the history available when it was written. The audit separates three questions: whether supporting evidence lies beyond writer-provided citations, whether the composed memory introduces unsupported meaning, and how write-time admission decisions affect later memory use. Across two natural memory corpora, audits using broader pre-write history recover support for nearly 60% of memories that appear unsupported from citations alone, while 17-21% remain unsupported after expansion. Yet broader evidence does not by itself make admission reliable: unsupported memories are still frequently admitted across verification models, and evidence expansion alone worsens it on two backbones.

AI.tldr: 该论文提出DerivAudit框架，用于审计长时运行LLM智能体的持久记忆是否真正由写入时可用的交互历史所支持。
AI.motivation: 长时运行LLM智能体将历史交互压缩为持久记忆并复用为前提，由此产生"推导问题"：记忆是否真正由交互历史所支持。相关证据可能分散在早期交互中，压缩也可能引入历史从未建立的关系或事件状态，导致有效记忆因引用不全而看似无据，而各自有据的事实也可能被组合成历史未曾建立的更强陈述。
AI.method: 提出三项耦合要求：证据范围、组合有效性、准入可靠性；并构建DerivAudit框架，将审计拆分为三个问题：支持证据是否超出写入者提供的引用、组合后的记忆是否引入不受支持的语义、写入时的准入决策如何影响后续记忆使用。在两个自然记忆语料上进行审计。
AI.result: 使用更广的写入前历史进行审计，可为近60%仅凭引用看似无据的记忆恢复支持，但仍有17-21%在证据扩展后依旧无据；更广的证据本身并不能保证准入可靠，无据记忆在多种验证模型下仍频繁被准入，且仅靠证据扩展在两个骨干模型上反而使情况恶化。
AI.conclusion: 记忆支持的审计不能仅依赖写入者引用，需引入更广的写入前历史；但证据扩展与准入判定相分离，单靠扩展证据无法保证准入可靠性，反而可能有害。该工作为记忆推导有效性提供了系统化的审计视角与要求框架。

title: CTE-Bench: Counterfactual Trace Evaluation for Stateful Software Simulators
comment: Accepted at NeurIPS 2026 (Track on Evaluations and Datasets). Dataset: https://huggingface.co/datasets/zhangxr7/cte-bench-core-v1
summary: Coding agents change running software: they patch a service's code or overwrite its stored state, and then act on their own expectation of how the service will respond afterwards. A wrong expectation may surface only several calls later. Function-level code-execution benchmarks omit persistent service state, and agent benchmarks score the actions an agent takes or the final state it reaches. We introduce CTE-Bench, which measures whether a model can predict how an intervention changes a stateful service's future behavior, without asking it to choose actions. Each scenario gives the model Python service code, the calls and responses observed before the intervention, the intervention itself (a source edit or a state overwrite), and 40 fixed future calls; the model predicts every future response, and predictions are checked by executing the service. Three memory protocols control whether the model sees the correct earlier responses, none of them, or its own earlier predictions. CTE-Bench-Core-v1 contains 255 scenarios over six deterministic Python services, giving 10,200 predictions per model. The main score is effect-step value match (VM): exact response equality on the 2,476 future calls whose response the intervention changes. With correct earlier responses revealed, four API-hosted models (DeepSeek V4-Flash, Kimi K2.5, Qwen3.6-35B-A3B, and Claude Sonnet 4.6) reach 54.3%-61.5% effect-step VM. Hiding those responses lowers effect-step VM to 23.2%-28.9%; conditioning on self-generated predictions gives 24.8%-33.2%, and at most 1.2% of scenarios are predicted exactly end to end. Current models thus track intervention effects mainly when correct feedback is supplied, and their errors compound over a rollout. We release CTE-Bench-Core-v1 with its executable oracle, evaluation scripts, and an evaluation card mapping each claim to its protocol.

AI.tldr: 该论文提出 CTE-Bench，用于评测模型能否预测代码/状态干预如何改变有状态服务的未来行为，而非选择动作。核心发现：提供正确历史响应时四个模型的效应步值匹配（VM）为 54.3%–61.5%，隐藏后降至 23.2%–28.9%，误差在 rollout 中累积。
AI.motivation: 现有函数级代码执行基准忽略持久化服务状态，而智能体基准只评估所采取的动作或最终状态，均无法衡量模型对"干预改变有状态服务未来行为"的预测能力。编码智能体会修改服务代码或覆盖存储状态，若对服务响应预期错误，可能在若干次调用后才暴露。因此需要一个聚焦干预效应预测的评测基准。
AI.method: 构建 CTE-Bench：每个场景提供 Python 服务代码、干预前观测到的调用与响应、干预本身（源码编辑或状态覆盖）以及 40 个固定未来调用；模型需预测全部未来响应，并由执行服务进行校验。设置三种记忆协议：可见正确历史响应、不可见历史响应、以模型自身先前预测为条件。CTE-Bench-Core-v1 覆盖 6 个确定性 Python 服务、255 个场景，每个模型 10,200 条预测。主指标为效应步值匹配（VM），即在 2,476 个受干预影响的未来调用上要求响应完全相等。
AI.result: 在揭示正确历史响应的条件下，四个 API 托管模型（DeepSeek V4-Flash、Kimi K2.5、Qwen3.6-35B-A3B、Claude Sonnet 4.6）达到 54.3%–61.5% 的效应步 VM；隐藏这些响应后降至 23.2%–28.9%；以自生成预测为条件时为 24.8%–33.2%；端到端完全预测正确的场景最多仅 1.2%。
AI.conclusion: 当前模型主要在获得正确反馈时才能跟踪干预效应，其错误在 rollout 过程中会逐步累积。作者发布 CTE-Bench-Core-v1，包含可执行 oracle、评估脚本以及将每项主张映射到对应协议的评估卡。

title: Position: Let's Strengthen Verifiability If We Can't Enforce Reproducibility
comment: Accepted to NeurIPS 2026 Position Paper Track
summary: In the field of Machine Learning, many papers contain empirical results supporting claimed statements or illustrating the performance of a proposed method. However, most practitioners know that (1) results are generally hard to reproduce, and increasingly so, (2) code is not often available to do so, and (3) it hinders the development of research. In this position paper, we analyze and quantify these issues, and make concrete proposals to improve result checkability, if not reproducibility. Code and supporting materials are available at https://github.com/giddyyupp/position-enforce-verifiability.

AI.tldr: 这是一篇立场论文，量化分析机器学习论文结果难以复现、代码缺失等问题，并提出提升结果可校验性的具体建议。
AI.motivation: 机器学习论文中的实证结果本应支撑其结论或展示方法性能，但实践中普遍存在复现困难、代码不易获取等问题，且这些问题日益严重，阻碍了研究发展。
AI.method: 作为立场论文，作者对上述问题进行了分析与量化，并针对提升结果可校验性（checkability）乃至可复现性提出具体建议。
AI.result: 论文量化了复现困难程度、代码可得性缺失及对研究的阻碍程度；具体量化数据未在摘要中给出，作者将代码与支撑材料公开于指定 GitHub 仓库。
AI.conclusion: 机器学习领域亟需改善结果可校验性；作者呼吁并给出可操作的具体提案，并公开代码与支撑材料以支撑其立场。

title: More Features Are Not More Evidence: Limits of Training-Free Human Activity Recognition with Jev
summary: General-purpose models promise sensor-based decisions without training a task-specific classifier, which could reduce the dependence of Human Activity Recognition (HAR) on labeled data. Yet it remains unclear whether such models can directly interpret deterministic descriptions of physical sensor signals well enough to replace or complement trained HAR models.
