We study this question using Jev, a fixed general-purpose probabilistic decision model, on 1,800 class-balanced accelerometer windows from WISDM, UCI341, and PAMAP2. Jev receives no labeled examples, retrieval context, or HAR-specific parameter updates. We evaluate three deterministic sensor representations and compare 5,400 Jev decisions with a generative baseline and three supervised HAR models. Jev remains far below supervised recognition, with its strongest representation reaching macro-F1 of 0.038, 0.118, and 0.089 across the three datasets, compared with 0.686 to 0.907 for the supervised models. More numerical features do not improve Jev. Instead, they reduce recognition on all three datasets, while augmenting the same numerical evidence with a deterministic semantic rendering partially recovers performance, although the experiment does not isolate semantics from the accompanying serialization and redundancy changes. Jev is fast and inexpensive to query, but its probabilities are not reliably calibrated for recognition. A post-hoc fusion analysis finds a small improvement on WISDM that does not replicate on UCI341 or PAMAP2. These results show that training-free sensor decisions depend not only on the information available in the signal, but also on whether the model can use the representation through which that information is exposed. The sensor-to-model interface should therefore be treated as part of the model evaluation rather than as a neutral preprocessing step.

AI.tldr: 研究通用模型Jev在无监督情况下对加速度传感器信号进行活动识别(HAR)的能力，发现其远劣于监督模型，性能依赖表示形式。
AI.motivation: 通用模型有望在没有任务特定分类器训练的情况下做出基于传感器的决策，从而减少HAR对标注数据的依赖。但目前尚不清楚这类模型能否直接解释物理传感器信号的确定性描述，达到足以替代或补充训练好的HAR模型的程度。
AI.method: 使用固定通用概率决策模型Jev，在来自WISDM、UCI341和PAMAP2的1800个类别平衡加速度窗口上测试。Jev不接收标注样本、检索上下文或HAR特定参数更新。评估三种确定性传感器表示，将5400次Jev决策与一个生成式基线和三个监督HAR模型对比。
AI.result: Jev远低于监督识别水平，最强表示的宏F1在三数据集上仅为0.038、0.118和0.089，而监督模型为0.686至0.907。增加数值特征并未改善反而降低识别效果；在数值证据上加入确定性语义渲染可部分恢复性能，但实验未能将语义与序列化及冗余变化分离。Jev查询快速廉价，但概率校准不可靠。事后融合分析仅在WISDM有微小提升，未能在UCI341或PAMAP2复现。
AI.conclusion: 无训练传感器决策不仅取决于信号中可用信息，还取决于模型能否通过其表征方式使用这些信息。传感器到模型的接口应被视为模型评估的一部分，而非中性的预处理步骤。

title: The Editor Has Read-Only Access: Correctness Signals in Diffusion Language Models
summary: Diffusion language models generate code by repeatedly updating a partially masked sequence. We ask whether their internal activations encode code correctness and whether that information can improve generation. Across six diffusion models, linear probes distinguish passing from failing attempts, with the strongest reads generally appearing beyond the early layers. Controls using small semantic mutations support a connection to correctness rather than surface style alone. In comparisons with model confidence, probe point estimates offer no consistent advantage. Adding a probe-derived direction to the residual stream does not yield a dependable improvement in the tested steering settings, while the opposite direction degrades performance. We distinguish these observations from claims about statistical significance or a general inability to steer. Supplementary methods, archived results, and code document the tested interventions and the limits of their statistical calibration and reproducibility.

AI.tldr: 该论文探究扩散语言模型生成代码时，其内部激活是否编码代码正确性，以及该信息能否用于改进生成。通过六个模型的线性探针实验发现：激活确实可区分通过/失败样本（最强信号多在早期层之后），且与正确性相关而非表面风格；但探针估计相较模型置信度无一致优势，将探针方向注入残差流也无法可靠提升性能，反向注入则会降低性能。
AI.motivation: 作者关注扩散语言模型通过反复更新部分掩码序列生成代码的机制，希望验证其内部激活是否蕴含代码正确性信息，并进一步评估这类信息能否转化为生成质量的提升，从而连接"可解释性"与"可控生成"两个问题。
AI.method: 在六个扩散语言模型上训练线性探针，区分代码生成中的通过尝试与失败尝试；通过细微语义扰动作为对照，排除仅反映表面风格的替代解释；将探针结果与模型置信度进行对比；并将探针导出的方向注入残差流进行激活引导实验，同时测试反向注入。
AI.result: 线性探针能区分通过与失败尝试，最强读出通常出现在早期层之后；小规模语义突变对照支持其与正确性相关而非仅表面风格。与模型置信度相比，探针点估计无一致优势；注入探针方向未带来可靠性能提升，而反向方向会降低性能。作者强调这些结论不涉及统计显著性主张，也不代表模型普遍无法被引导。
AI.conclusion: 扩散语言模型内部激活确实编码代码正确性信息，但该信息在当前测试的探针与引导设置下尚不能可靠转化为生成性能的提升。作者通过补充方法、归档结果与代码公开了所测试的干预手段，并说明其在统计校准与可复现性方面的局限。

title: Mara Chain: Rethinking Failure as a Stepping Stone for AI System Auto-Evolution
summary: Optimizing deployed AI systems increasingly amounts to editing prompts, skills, harnesses, and code rather than model weights. Existing approaches commonly optimize these artifacts through propose-evaluate-select procedures, where candidate configurations are evaluated and only those meeting an acceptance criterion are selected. Yet our analysis shows that discarded candidates often contain information critical for subsequent optimization. Discarding them causes later proposals to revisit the same failure modes. We introduce Mara Chain, a refinement procedure that turns rejected candidates into stepping stones. Rather than discarding a rejected candidate, Mara Chain retains and iteratively refines it using evidence accumulated across preceding attempts. The procedure limits each refinement chain to a fixed depth and applies Pareto-filtered Top-N selection to bound the candidate pool. Across AppWorld skill optimization, TerminalBench 2.1 harness optimization, and MuSiQue retrieval-pipeline optimization, Mara Chain delivers greater task-performance gains with fewer rollouts. It outperforms GEPA, ACE, and SkillOpt-Lite by up to 20.5% in relative performance on AppWorld, reaching the target score with 65.5% fewer rollouts than GEPA. It improves the pass rate by 20.2 and 22.5 percentage points over AHE and Meta-Harness on TerminalBench 2.1, respectively, and improves MuSiQue test nDCG@10 and Recall@10 by 0.104 and 0.131 over a hand-written retrieval pipeline.

AI.tldr: 提出 Mara Chain 优化流程，将传统 propose-evaluate-select 中被丢弃的候选配置转化为可迭代精炼的"踏脚石"，在多个 AI 系统工件优化任务上以更少 rollout 取得更高性能。
AI.motivation: 已部署 AI 系统的优化日益转向对 prompt、skill、harness 和代码等工件的编辑，而非模型权重。现有方法多采用 propose-evaluate-select 流程，只保留满足接受准则的候选，导致被丢弃的候选中所含的关键信息丢失，后续提案反复回到相同失败模式。
AI.method: Mara Chain：一种精炼（refinement）流程。对每个被拒绝的候选不丢弃，而是保留并利用前序尝试累积的证据对其进行迭代精炼；将每条精炼链限制在固定深度，并采用 Pareto 过滤的 Top-N 选择来约束候选池规模。
AI.result: 在 AppWorld 技能优化、TerminalBench 2.1 harness 优化和 MuSiQue 检索流水线优化三个任务上均以更少 rollout 获得更大任务性能增益。AppWorld 上相对性能超越 GEPA、ACE、SkillOpt-Lite 最多 20.5%，并以比 GEPA 少 65.5% 的 rollout 达到目标分数；TerminalBench 2.1 上 pass rate 比 AHE 和 Meta-Harness 分别提升 20.2 和 22.5 个百分点；MuSiQue 上 test nDCG@10 与 Recall@10 比手写检索流水线分别提升 0.104 和 0.131。
AI.conclusion: 保留并精炼被拒绝的候选，而非直接丢弃，可为 AI 系统工件优化提供更有效的搜索信号，在多种任务上同时提升性能并降低 rollout 成本。

title: Principled Thoughts for Latent Recursive LLM Systems
summary: Large language models can reason in continuous space instead of decoded text, by recurring on their own hidden states or by passing those states between agents, while training supervises only the Cross-Entropy (CE) of the final decoded answer and does not constrain the thought. Theoretical and empirical analyses establish and confirm four failures of CE-only training that lead to a lower probability of the correct answer such as collapsing thoughts across distinct questions and retaining irrelevant information. We introduce REST (REpresentation-Supervised Thoughts), a training objective that turns four properties of a valid thought representation (causality, minimality, separability, and stability) into differentiable losses added to CE. We instantiate it in latent single-agent and multi-agent systems, without architectural changes or added parameters at inference. Across 7 benchmarks spanning mathematics, science, medicine, and code generation, with the same training data, compute, and latent budget, REST increases accuracy over CE-only training across agent settings and model sizes by up to 7.5 percentage points and convergence on a final answer by 30\%. Furthermore, REST thoughts encode more of what is required to achieve the correct answer, and decoding them better recovers the intended output of the agent, which makes latent communication easier to interpret. Project Website: https://fard-lab.github.io/REST

AI.tldr: 提出REST训练目标，将有效思维表征的四条性质（因果性、最小性、可分离性、稳定性）转化为可微损失并加在交叉熵上，在潜空间单/多智能体系统中提升推理精度与收敛速度。
AI.motivation: 大语言模型可在连续空间中进行推理，例如在自身隐状态上递归或在智能体间传递隐状态，但训练仅监督最终解码答案的交叉熵（CE），对思维本身不加约束。理论与实证分析表明这种纯CE训练存在四种失效，导致正确答案概率下降，如不同问题间思维坍缩、保留无关信息等。
AI.method: 提出REST（REpresentation-Supervised Thoughts），将有效思维表征的四个性质——因果性、最小性、可分离性与稳定性——转为可微损失，并与交叉熵损失联合优化。方法在潜空间单智能体与多智能体系统中实例化，推理阶段无需修改架构或增加参数。
AI.result: 在数学、科学、医学与代码生成共7个基准上，在训练数据、计算量与潜空间预算相同条件下，REST相较纯CE训练在各种智能体设置与模型规模上最高提升准确率7.5个百分点，最终答案收敛率提升30%。此外，REST思维编码了更多达成正确答案所需信息，解码能更好恢复智能体预期输出，使潜空间通信更易解释。
AI.conclusion: 对思维表征施加结构化监督（REST）可有效弥补纯交叉熵训练的不足，显著提升潜空间推理的准确性、收敛性与可解释性，且不增加推理开销，具有良好通用性。

title: XRepoSkill: Learning Transferable Skills for Software Engineering Agents
summary: Software engineering agents increasingly use reusable skills distilled from prior experience to resolve repository-level issues, yet such skills often fail to transfer across repositories. A central challenge is that a behavior appearing in a successful trajectory is not necessarily responsible for the successful outcome: it may be genuinely useful, merely incidental, or simply a recurring habit of the model. We introduce XRepoSkill, a trajectory-based approach for learning transferable skills. We represent a skill as a collection of rules, each specifying what action to take and when to take it during issue resolution. XRepoSkill first contrasts successful and failed trajectories of the same agent on the same issue and derives candidate rules from where their execution paths diverge. Each rule is paired with an executable predicate that enables its prescribed behavior to be evaluated systematically on other trajectories. A rule is verified based on its association with successful issue resolution and retained only when its prescribed behavior recurs across multiple repositories; repository-specific variants of the same behavior are then consolidated into transferable rules. For a new issue, XRepoSkill selects relevant rules to guide the agent. We learn skills from publicly released trajectories on the official SWE-bench Verified leaderboard and evaluate them on SWE-bench Pro and DeepSWE using three backbone LLMs from different vendors; none of the evaluation repositories appears in the skill-learning trajectory pool. Against three recent skill learning methods, XRepoSkill achieves the highest issue resolution rate in all six benchmark--LLM combinations. In particular, on the challenging long-horizon DeepSWE benchmark, XRepoSkill improves issue resolution by 10.3 percentage points over the same agent without learned skills and by 5.0 points over the strongest skill-learning baseline.

AI.tldr: 提出 XRepoSkill，一种基于轨迹的软件工程智能体可迁移技能学习方法，通过对比成功与失败轨迹抽取规则并验证其跨仓库可迁移性，在 SWE-bench Pro 与 DeepSWE 上六个"基准-LLM"组合中均取得最高问题解决率。
AI.motivation: 现有软件工程智能体依赖从历史经验提炼的可复用技能来解决仓库级问题，但这些技能往往难以跨仓库迁移。核心难题在于：成功轨迹中出现的行为未必是导致成功的原因——它可能真正有用、可能只是偶然附随、也可能只是模型的固有习惯，因此直接模仿成功轨迹会引入不可迁移甚至有害的行为。
AI.method: 将技能表示为规则集合，每条规则规定"做什么"和"何时做"。首先对同一智能体在同一问题上的成功与失败轨迹进行对比，从执行路径发生分歧处推导候选规则；为每条规则配一个可执行谓词，使其规定行为能在其他轨迹上被系统评估；依据规则与成功问题解决的关联性进行验证，仅保留其行为在多个仓库中反复出现的规则；再将同一行为的仓库特定变体合并为可迁移规则；面对新问题时，选择相关规则引导智能体。
AI.result: 从 SWE-bench Verified 官方榜单公开轨迹中学习技能，在 SWE-bench Pro 和 DeepSWE 上、使用来自不同厂商的三个骨干 LLM 进行评估，评估仓库均不在技能学习轨迹池中。相较三种近期技能学习方法，XRepoSkill 在全部六个"基准-LLM"组合中问题解决率最高；在长程困难的 DeepSWE 基准上，较无学习技能的同一智能体提升 10.3 个百分点，较最强技能学习基线提升 5.0 个百分点。
AI.conclusion: 通过成功-失败轨迹对比、可执行谓词验证与跨仓库复现筛选，可以剔除偶发与习惯性行为，提炼出真正可迁移的技能规则，从而显著提升软件工程智能体在未见仓库上的问题解决能力，验证了以因果关联而非行为共现为依据的技能学习思路的有效性。

title: Beyond Keywords: Leveraging Generative LLMs and Label Aggregation to Classify Economic Policy Uncertainty in News Articles
summary: This research describes the adaptation of Large Language Models (LLMs) for economic monitoring in the public sector to automatically determine whether an article discusses Economic Policy Uncertanity (EPU) and to identify its specific type. Previous studies either rely on keywords, which often result in a high count of false positives, or use machine learning approaches that require a large number of quality human labeled data that is costly and time consuming to acquire. In this study, we propose approaches based on weak supervision techniques, using generative LLMs to create synthetic labels through prompting, making the approach both cost-effective and scalable. Additionally, we propose methods for for multi-label and hierarchical classification of articles related to EPU.

AI.tldr: 该研究将大语言模型（LLM）应用于公共部门的经济监测，借助弱监督与生成式LLM提示生成合成标签，自动判定文章是否涉及经济政策不确定性（EPU）及其具体类型，并提出面向EPU相关文章的多标签与层级分类方法。
AI.motivation: 既有EPU识别方法存在明显局限：关键词方法易产生大量假阳性；机器学习方法则依赖大量高质量人工标注数据，获取成本高、耗时长。因此需要一种兼具成本效益与可扩展性的替代方案。
AI.method: 采用基于弱监督技术的思路，利用生成式LLM通过提示（prompting）创建合成标签，从而避免昂贵的人工标注；同时提出针对EPU相关文章的多标签分类与层级分类方法。
AI.result: 摘要未报告具体实验数据或量化结果，仅说明所提方法在成本效益与可扩展性方面具有优势，并支持EPU文章的多标签与层级分类。
AI.conclusion: 生成式LLM结合弱监督可为公共部门经济监测中的EPU自动识别与类型划分提供一种低成本、可扩展的解决方案，并拓展至多标签与层级分类场景。

title: FigAct: Turning Scientific Figures into Active Canvases for Explanation
summary: Scientific figures are designed to communicate information visually, yet MLLMs typically explain them by translating their visual content back into text. This requires readers to manually map the resulting explanations back to the figure. Inspired by how people present visual information, we introduce FigAct, a framework that transforms static scientific figures into question-conditioned visual presentations by acting directly on their existing graphical elements. Like a human presenter, FigAct generates a sequence of short narrations, grounds each narration in the corresponding visual evidence, and applies visual actions to guide the viewer's attention. We develop a hierarchical search strategy for efficient element localization, reducing token usage by approximately 40$\times$. We further train FigAct-8B using three task-specific rewards for grounding accuracy, search efficiency, and rendering quality. We further build a human-verified benchmark from figures in real-world scientific papers to evaluate the ability of MLLMs to generate grounded visual explanations. Our results demonstrate the effectiveness of FigAct and show that treating scientific figures as presentation canvases makes explanations clearer and easier to follow.

AI.tldr: 论文提出FigAct框架，将静态科学图表转化为问题条件驱动的视觉演示，通过直接操作图表已有图形元素、生成旁白并定位视觉证据，配合分层搜索与奖励训练，提升多模态大模型对科学图表的解释清晰度。
AI.motivation: 现有MLLM解释科学图表时，通常把视觉内容转回文本，读者需自行将解释映射回图表，增加了理解负担。受人类演示视觉信息方式的启发，作者希望让模型像人类讲解者一样直接在图表元素上操作以引导注意力。
AI.method: 提出FigAct框架：生成一系列简短旁白，将每条旁白 grounding 到对应视觉证据，并通过视觉动作引导观众注意力。采用分层搜索策略实现高效元素定位，降低约40倍token消耗。使用三个任务特定奖励（定位准确性、搜索效率、渲染质量）训练FigAct-8B，并构建经人工验证的真实科学论文图表基准。
AI.result: 实验结果表明FigAct有效，分层搜索策略将token使用量降低约40倍；将科学图表视为演示画布能使解释更清晰、更易跟随。
AI.conclusion: 将科学图表作为可操作的演示画布，而非仅转述为文本，可显著改善MLLM生成的可定位视觉解释质量，验证了FigAct框架与训练策略的有效性。

title: Cross-Organizational SysML Model Integration: A Survey of Challenges and AI-Supported Tasks
summary: Cross-organizational collaboration is widely regarded as a key promise of SysML-based Model-Based Systems Engineering (MBSE), yet practitioners still face persistent challenges when exchanging and integrating system models. In parallel, Large Language Models (LLMs) raise expectations for AI-assisted model understanding and integration, while reliability and required human oversight continue to pose challenges. This paper reports the results of an online questionnaire survey with 29 MBSE stakeholders involved in cross-organizational collaboration. Respondents rated eight predefined integration challenge categories and six AI-supported task types on five-point Likert scales. The results indicate that stakeholders perceive model integration as a multi-dimensional alignment problem across semantics, behavior, traceability, and exchange interoperability. These perceptions vary by organizational role and frequency of integration involvement. AI is rated highly useful for analysis tasks such as semantic structure analysis and inconsistency detection, and respondents predominantly prefer human-in-the-loop use with mandatory verification. These findings motivate AI support that enhances, rather than replaces, engineering responsibility in SysML-based integration.

AI.tldr: 该论文通过29名MBSE相关人员的在线问卷调查，评估跨组织SysML模型集成中的八类挑战及六类AI支持任务的感知，发现集成是多维度对齐问题，AI在语义分析与不一致检测等分析任务上被认为高有用性，且受访者普遍偏好强制验证的人在环路模式。
AI.motivation: 跨组织协作被视为基于SysML的MBSE的关键价值，但模型交换与集成仍面临持续挑战；同时LLM带来AI辅助模型理解与集成的期望，但其可靠性与所需人工监督仍是问题，因此需要实证了解实践者的感知与需求。
AI.method: 对29名参与跨组织协作的MBSE利益相关者开展在线问卷调查；受访者在五点Likert量表上对八个预定义的集成挑战类别和六类AI支持任务类型进行评分。
AI.result: 受访者将模型集成视为跨越语义、行为、可追溯性和交换互操作性的多维度对齐问题；这些感知随组织角色和参与集成频率而变化。AI在语义结构分析、不一致检测等分析任务上被评为高度有用；受访者主要偏好带强制验证的人在环路使用方式。
AI.conclusion: 研究结果支持以增强而非替代工程责任为目标的AI支持，用于基于SysML的集成实践。

title: ReLOBGen: Replayable Limit Order Book Message Generation
summary: We propose ReLOBGen, a method for generating limit order book (LOB) messages that are replayable by construction. Replayability is required for closed-loop market simulation, yet existing LOB message generators may produce non-replayable raw messages, i.e., messages inconsistent with the current market state. These generators therefore rely on post-hoc correction or rejection followed by resampling, which may alter the replayed message distribution or increase inference cost. ReLOBGen instead ensures replayability during generation: it selects the referenced order from the resting orders in the current LOB and then generates the remaining message fields to be consistent with that order and the market state. For realistic reference selection, ReLOBGen samples from a learned distribution over eligible resting orders, efficiently computed from cached order representations and a context-dependent query. It then enforces the consistency of the remaining fields by masking out invalid tokens. Together, these components enable efficient generation of realistic messages without post-hoc correction or resampling. In 500-message rollouts, ReLOBGen achieves 100% replayability, improves market realism, particularly for top-of-book statistics and the relative prices of LOB messages, and provides a $2.7\text{-}3.6\times$ speedup per replayed message over the LOBS5 baseline.

AI.tldr: ReLOBGen 提出一种"构造即可回放"的限价订单簿（LOB）消息生成方法，在生成过程中即保证可回放性，无需事后修正或重采样，实现100%可回放、更高市场真实性与2.7–3.6倍加速。
AI.motivation: 闭环市场仿真要求生成的订单簿消息可被回放，但现有LOB消息生成器可能产生与当前市场状态不一致的原始消息，导致不可回放。这类方法因此需要事后修正，或拒绝后重采样，前者会改变回放消息的分布，后者会增加推理成本。因此需要一种在生成阶段就保证可回放性的方法。
AI.method: ReLOBGen 在生成时确保可回放性：先从当前LOB的挂单中选定被引用的订单，再生成与该订单及市场状态一致的其余字段。为获得真实的引用选择，方法从基于可引用挂单的学习分布中采样，该分布由缓存的订单表示与上下文相关查询高效计算得到；随后通过对无效token进行掩码，强制其余字段的一致性。二者结合实现了无需事后修正或重采样的高效真实消息生成。
AI.result: 在500条消息的rollout中，ReLOBGen达到100%可回放性；市场真实性提升，尤其体现在盘口顶部统计量与LOB消息相对价格方面；相较于LOBS5基线，每条回放消息的生成速度提升2.7–3.6倍。
AI.conclusion: ReLOBGen 通过在生成过程中内嵌可回放性约束（引用订单选择+字段一致性掩码），在保证100%可回放的同时提升了市场真实性与生成效率，避免了事后修正带来的分布偏移与重采样带来的额外推理开销，为闭环市场仿真提供了更实用的LOB消息生成方案。

title: An Empirical Study and Assessment of EU AI Act Compliance Checkers
summary: The EU AI Act introduces extensive compliance requirements for organizations that develop, deploy, or integrate AI systems. Many of these requirements are directly relevant to security and privacy, while also addressing closely related issues such as data governance, transparency, accuracy, and robustness. However, stakeholders such as small-to-medium businesses and individual developers often lack the legal expertise required to interpret these obligations and translate them into engineering and governance practices. This disconnect creates challenges for implementing the EU AI Act and may lead to missing safeguards or misdirected development and deployment efforts. To address this, various automated EU AI Act compliance checkers (AIACCs) have emerged, claiming to streamline compliance assessments and provide practical guidance. In this paper, we present the first empirical study and assessment of AIACCs. We characterize 12 mainstream AIACCs across multiple dimensions, evaluate their legal coverage and alignment, and analyze checker-generated compliance reports for structure, determinacy, and actionability. We find that the quality of AIACCs varies significantly and that they currently can only serve as early-stage orientation tools. Specifically, we observe inconsistent interaction modes and user-friendliness, a tendency to overly simplify or omit key obligations, and a failure to provide determinate, actionable guidance. As a result, reliance on the current generation of AIACCs may foster a false sense of compliance. With our study, we provide a critical baseline of the current AIACC landscape. We further offer design principles for the implementation of more reliable compliance-support tools.

AI.tldr: 本文首次对12款主流欧盟AI法案合规检查器（AIACC）开展实证评估，从法律覆盖与对齐、以及合规报告的结构性、确定性与可操作性等维度进行刻画，发现其质量差异显著，目前仅能充当早期定位工具，甚至可能带来"虚假合规感"。
AI.motivation: 欧盟AI法案对AI系统的开发、部署与集成提出了大量合规要求，涉及安全、隐私、数据治理、透明度、准确性与鲁棒性等。但中小企业和独立开发者往往缺乏法律专业知识，难以将法条义务转化为工程与治理实践。这种"法律—工程"脱节催生了一批自动化合规检查器（AIACC），然而其实际能力与宣称效果尚缺乏系统验证。
AI.method: 对12款主流AIACC进行多维度刻画；评估其法律覆盖范围与法条对齐程度；分析检查器生成的合规报告在结构、确定性（determinacy）和可操作性（actionability）方面的表现。
AI.result: AIACC质量差异显著：交互模式与易用性不一致；倾向于过度简化或遗漏关键义务；无法提供确定、可执行的指导。总体而言，当前一代AIACC仅能作为早期定位工具，依赖其可能滋生虚假合规感。
AI.conclusion: 本文提供了当前AIACC生态的关键基线，并进一步提出若干设计原则，用以指导更可靠的合规支持工具的研发。

title: GitCF: Reducing Incomplete Changes by Exploiting Multiple Similarities Among Commits
summary: Software developers often struggle to identify all locations that their changes affect, and incomplete changes frequently result from these omissions. To mitigate this problem, several approaches have been proposed to recommend additional locations that should be modified together with a developer's current change. A large class of these techniques mines co-change rules from repository revision histories, but because they rely solely on which elements have been modified together, they cannot recommend elements that have rarely co-changed, and they disregard the textual information that accompanies commits. A second class of techniques does exploit textual information, but it derives it from the source code or from a change request rather than from commit history, and it does not use the developer's current change as its input. To address these limitations, we propose GitCF, a change recommendation method that compares a developer's current change with past changes in the revision history and recommends additional change locations by combining two sources of similarity: the set of modified elements and the textual content of commits, including commit messages, code diffs, and linked issue descriptions. We evaluate GitCF on 543 incomplete changes from 17 open-source projects, where an incomplete change denotes a commit in which an omitted modification is supplied in a later commit, comparing it against three co-change-rule-based techniques. GitCF outperforms the strongest baseline on all five metrics (MAP, Recall@10, Recall@20, Hit@10, and Hit@20); in particular, it raises Hit@10 from 0.322 to 0.403, and the improvement in average precision is statistically significant.

AI.tldr: 本文提出 GitCF，通过结合"修改元素集合"与"提交文本内容"两类相似性，将开发者当前变更与历史提交进行比对，为其推荐遗漏的修改位置。
AI.motivation: 开发者常难以识别变更所影响的全部位置，导致提交不完整。已有方法存在两类局限：基于共变更规则的方法仅依赖元素共现关系，无法推荐很少共变的元素，且忽略提交文本；基于文本的方法虽利用文本，但文本源自源代码或变更请求而非提交历史，也未将开发者当前变更作为输入。
AI.method: GitCF 将该问题建模为相似性检索：把开发者当前变更与修订历史中的过往变更进行比对，融合两类相似性来源——被修改元素的集合，以及提交的文本内容（包括提交消息、代码 diff 和关联的 issue 描述），据此推荐应一并修改的附加位置。
AI.result: 在 17 个开源项目的 543 个不完整变更上评估（不完整变更定义为遗漏的修改在后续提交中被补上的提交），与三种基于共变更规则的技术对比。GitCF 在 MAP、Recall@10、Recall@20、Hit@10、Hit@20 五项指标上均优于最强基线，Hit@10 从 0.322 提升至 0.403，平均精度的提升具有统计显著性。
AI.conclusion: 融合元素共变信息与提交文本信息能有效弥补现有共变规则方法的不足，GitCF 在变更位置推荐任务上显著优于共变规则基线。

title: Hybrid Ensemble Learning for EEG-Based Epileptic Seizure Forecasting
comment: Accepted at the 2026 IEEE Cyber Awareness Research Symposium (CARS 2026)
summary: Epileptic seizure forecasting aims to provide actionable warnings before seizure onset, yet patient-independent generalization and false-alarm control remain major challenges. We propose a calibrated hybrid ensemble for EEG-based seizure forecasting that combines five deep learning models and three classical machine learning models through a logistic regression stacking meta-learner. The proposed pipeline integrates signal preprocessing, handcrafted feature extraction, class-imbalance handling, probability calibration, and clinically motivated post-processing. We evaluate the framework on CHB-MIT using strict Leave-One-Patient-Out (LOPO) cross-validation, with threshold and post-processing parameters selected only on held-out meta data. On the filtered cohort, excluding patients with anomalous preictal rates below 1\% or above 15\%, the model achieves 74.2\% seizure-level sensitivity at 1.24 false alarms per hour, with an average warning time of 16.9 minutes. A test-tuned oracle constrained to the target false-alarm budget achieves 60.9\% sensitivity at 0.951 false alarms per hour, highlighting the importance of reporting sensitivity together with realized false-alarm rates. Our code is available at: https://github.com/DanaMason/IEEE-CARS-Hybrid-Ensemble-Learning-for-EEG-Based-Epileptic-Seizure-Forecasting

AI.tldr: 该论文提出一种经过概率校准的混合集成方法用于EEG癫痫发作预测，在CHB-MIT数据集上采用严格LOPO交叉验证，实现74.2%发作级灵敏度、每小时1.24次误报，平均预警时间16.9分钟。
AI.motivation: 癫痫发作预测的核心难点在于患者无关的泛化能力不足以及误报率难以控制，两者共同限制了临床可用性。
AI.method: 将五个深度学习模型与三个经典机器学习模型通过逻辑回归堆叠元学习器组合，流程涵盖信号预处理、手工特征提取、类别不平衡处理、概率校准与临床导向的后处理；阈值与后处理参数仅在留出的元数据上选择，评估采用严格的留一患者交叉验证（LOPO）。
AI.result: 在过滤队列（剔除发作前期比例低于1%或高于15%的异常患者）上，模型达到74.2%发作级灵敏度、每小时1.24次误报，平均预警时间16.9分钟；限定于目标误报预算的测试调优oracle达到60.9%灵敏度、每小时0.951次误报。
AI.conclusion: 结果表明混合集成与概率校准有助于提升患者无关的癫痫预测性能，同时强调灵敏度必须与实测误报率共同报告；代码已开源。

title: MERID: Multimodal Exploration via Recursive Self-Improvement Agents for Major Depression Analysis
summary: Major depressive disorder (MDD) severely impacts daily activities and quality of life. Detecting MDD involves multimodal data, such as interview recordings and sensor measurements. This is particularly challenging, as these heterogeneous modalities often demand distinct, customized prediction pipelines. Existing efforts to address this challenge have explored both manually engineered multimodal architectures and agent-assisted pipeline development. Despite their progress, it remains challenging to autonomously revise pipelines based on experimental feedback and carry verified improvements forward into subsequent designs. To this end, we propose Multimodal Exploration via Recursive Self-Improvement Agents for Major Depression Analysis (MERID). The framework develops depression pipelines through experience-based recursive self-improvement (RSI). Grounded State Construction (GSC) grounds experience by aligning multimodal records with subject-level depression targets. Coupled Pipeline Exploration (CPE) jointly modifies representations, fusion, and predictors to build successor pipelines for classification and severity estimation. Evidence-Guided Evolution (EGE) guides revisions through feedback and verifies gains under uncertainty in small depression cohorts before inheritance. Extensive experiments on depression benchmarks show that MERID achieves the best results on multiple tasks compared with multimodal and agent-based baselines. Further analysis highlights the value of acoustic and linguistic cues for depression detection. Our code is available at https://github.com/DiscoAILab/MERID

AI.tldr: 提出MERID框架，通过经验驱动的递归自我改进智能体自动构建和迭代多模态抑郁检测流水线，在多个基准任务上取得最优结果。
AI.motivation: 重度抑郁症严重影响日常生活与生活质量，其检测依赖访谈录音、传感器测量等多模态数据。这些异质模态通常需要定制化的预测流水线，检测难度较大。已有工作虽探索了人工设计的多模态架构与智能体辅助的流水线开发，但仍难以依据实验反馈自主修订流水线，并将经证实的改进继承到后续设计中。
AI.method: 提出MERID框架，以基于经验的递归自我改进（RSI）方式开发抑郁分析流水线，包含三个核心组件：Grounded State Construction（GSC）通过将多模态记录与被试级抑郁目标对齐来「落地」经验；Coupled Pipeline Exploration（CPE）联合修改表征、融合与预测器，生成用于分类与严重度估计的后继流水线；Evidence-Guided Evolution（EGE）依据反馈引导修订，并在小规模抑郁队列的不确定性下验证增益后才进行继承。
AI.result: 在抑郁基准上的大量实验表明，与多模态基线及智能体基线相比，MERID在多项任务上取得最佳结果；进一步分析凸显了声学与语言线索在抑郁检测中的价值。代码已开源于 https://github.com/DiscoAILab/MERID。
AI.conclusion: MERID验证了「经验驱动的递归自我改进」在异质多模态抑郁分析中的有效性与可行性，能够自主修订并继承经证据验证的流水线改进，为抑郁症自动检测提供了新的范式。

title: LoLBench: Evaluating Coding Agents with Long-Horizon Proposals on Large Software Systems
summary: Modern coding agents can deliver increasingly large repository-level changes, and recent benchmarks reflect this by emphasizing long-horizon tasks with large reference implementations. Many benchmarks evaluate coding agents' implementation capability to produce correct code edits from detailed specifications. However, practical modular development tasks also require the perception capability of grounding user intent and high-level design to derive a specification. We introduce LoLBench to evaluate both capabilities through the entire proposal-to-implementation process on large software systems. It is a multilingual benchmark of 100 tasks across 29 software systems in five domains. Each task provides a human-written enhancement proposal with user intent and high-level design. On average, proposals contain about 5,000 words, software systems contain 2.4 million source lines of code (LoC), and implementation pull requests (PRs) change approximately 5,500 LoC. Across 28 agents we evaluated, the best agent resolves only 14% of tasks and achieves a 52.7% Fail-to-Pass (F2P) pass rate. Failure analysis identifies incomplete code localization as a major bottleneck, while providing reference-derived file trees alongside API specifications improves resolved rates by 16--22 percentage points (2.4--17$\times$), reaching at most 34%. These results show that both perception and implementation remain central challenges for coding agents in practical modular development on large software systems. LoLBench is available at https://huggingface.co/datasets/lolbench26/LoLBench.

AI.tldr: LoLBench是一个多语言、大规模软件系统基准，覆盖100个任务、29个系统，评估编码代理从"提案理解"到"实现"的全流程能力。最佳代理仅解决14%任务，表明感知与实现能力仍是核心挑战。
AI.motivation: 现有编码代理基准多聚焦于依据详细规格生成正确代码编辑（实现能力），但实际模块化开发还要求代理具备将用户意图与高层设计转化为规格的"感知能力"。二者结合的全流程评估缺乏，因此需要新基准来同时衡量感知与实现能力。
AI.method: 提出LoLBench，跨5个领域、29个软件系统、100个任务的多语言基准。每个任务提供约5,000词的人工编写增强提案（含用户意图与高层设计），软件系统平均240万行代码，实现PR平均改动约5,500行代码。评估28个代理，并进行失败分析及消融实验（提供参考派生的文件树与API规格）。
AI.result: 最佳代理仅解决14%任务，F2P通过率52.7%。失败分析显示"代码定位不完整"是主要瓶颈；提供参考派生的文件树及API规格后，解决率提升16–22个百分点（2.4–17倍），最高达34%。
AI.conclusion: 在大型软件系统的实际模块化开发中，感知能力与实现能力对编码代理仍是两大核心挑战，LoLBench为此类全流程评估提供了基准。

title: From Static Policies to Adaptive Priors in Offline Reinforcement Learning
comment: Accepted to NeurIPS Position Paper Track, 2026
summary: Offline reinforcement learning (RL) has traditionally focused on learning policies for direct deployment under conservative objectives, where uncertainty outside the offline dataset is treated pessimistically to ensure robustness. We argue that this formulation becomes incomplete when an offline-trained policy is subsequently updated through online interaction, as increasingly occurs in modern intelligent systems through test-time adaptation and online fine-tuning. This position paper argues that, in such settings, the objective of offline RL should extend beyond immediate deployment and instead prioritize learning adaptive policy priors: policies that preserve the capacity to improve during subsequent interaction through memory, exploration, and self-correction. We formalize this perspective as adaptive offline reinforcement learning (AORL), distinguish it from offline-to-online RL, and explain why adaptability becomes important under distributional shift, limited dataset coverage, and changing test-time conditions. We further discuss Bayesian offline RL as one principled direction for constructing adaptive policy priors by preserving epistemic uncertainty over plausible environments. Finally, we outline connections, open challenges, and research directions for treating offline RL as preparation for future experience rather than as a static deployment problem.

AI.tldr: 这是一篇立场论文，主张离线强化学习的目标应从"直接部署"转向"学习自适应策略先验"，并提出AORL（自适应离线强化学习）这一新视角。
AI.motivation: 传统离线RL聚焦于在保守目标下学习可直接部署的策略，对数据分布外的不确定性采取悲观处理以保证鲁棒性。但当离线训练的策略后续通过在线交互（如测试时自适应、在线微调）更新时，这一设定显得不完整，因此需要重新审视离线RL的目标。
AI.method: 这是一篇立场/观点论文，采用概念论证与框架构建的方式：形式化提出"自适应离线强化学习（AORL）"视角，将其与offline-to-online RL进行区分，并讨论将贝叶斯离线RL作为构建自适应策略先验的一种原则性路径（通过保留对可能环境的情节不确定性）。
AI.result: 论文并未给出实验性结果，而是提出概念性论点：在分布偏移、数据集覆盖有限以及测试时条件变化的场景下，策略的自适应能力（记忆、探索、自我纠正）变得关键；贝叶斯离线RL可作为实现自适应先验的一种方向。
AI.conclusion: 应把离线RL视为"为未来经验做准备"而非静态部署问题，并给出了相关联系、开放挑战与未来研究方向。

title: ChronoSRL: Temporal Geometry for Self-Supervised Reinforcement Learning
summary: A goal that is close in space can be far away in time. Obstacles, terrain, and the agent's own capabilities determine how long it takes to get there. Yet, critics in contrastive and survival reinforcement learning do not measure the distances in their representation space in units of time. We therefore introduce ChronoSRL, which gives the critic's embeddings an explicit temporal geometry. The distance between state-action and goal embeddings is trained to match the time that the agent takes to reach the goal (goal-reaching time), while goals that were not reached, and goals from other trajectories, are pushed at least one discount horizon away. Furthermore, reaching a goal quickly once does not mean that reaching it is reliable in general, so the policy should not follow the temporal distance directly. Instead, we build on survival reinforcement learning and predict from our temporal embeddings not only the full distribution of goal-reaching times but also the time spent near the goal. Thereby, the policy is trained to favor actions that reach the goal sooner and more reliably and that keep the agent near it. ChronoSRL learns faster and reaches higher performance than contrastive, action-chunked contrastive, and survival reinforcement learning baselines on seven standard locomotion and navigation benchmarks, even with much smaller networks. To test the limits of self-supervised reinforcement learning, we introduce velocity tracking, goal-position reaching, and box climbing tasks with a quadruped robot in a realistic sim-to-real locomotion setup, and show how the shaping terms that are typical for robotics can be naturally incorporated into our framework. ChronoSRL is the only one of the tested self-supervised reinforcement learning methods that learns to stay at the commanded velocities and goal positions, and climbs the highest boxes.

AI.tldr: ChronoSRL为critic的嵌入赋予显式时间几何：状态-动作与目标嵌入的距离对齐到达目标的实际时间，未到达目标和其他轨迹目标被推至至少一个折扣视界外，并结合生存强化学习预测到达时间分布与在目标附近停留时间以训练策略。
AI.motivation: 空间中接近的目标在时间上可能很远，障碍、地形与智能体能力决定了到达所需时间。然而对比式与生存强化学习中的critic并未以时间单位衡量其表示空间中的距离，缺乏显式时间几何。
AI.method: ChronoSRL在critic嵌入上引入显式时间几何，将状态-动作与目标嵌入间距离训练为匹配目标到达时间，并把未到达目标及其他轨迹目标推至至少一个折扣视界之外；基于生存强化学习，从时间嵌入预测目标到达时间的完整分布及在目标附近的停留时间，从而让策略偏好更快、更可靠到达且能保持在目标附近的动作。
AI.result: 在七个标准运动与导航基准上，ChronoSRL比对比式、动作分块对比式与生存强化学习基线学习更快、性能更高，且网络更小。在四足机器人逼真sim-to-real运动设置中引入速度跟踪、目标位置到达与箱体攀爬任务，表明机器人学常用的塑形项可自然纳入该框架；ChronoSRL是所测自监督强化学习方法中唯一学会保持指令速度与目标位置并攀爬最高箱体的方法。
AI.conclusion: 以时间单位度量表示空间中的距离并预测到达时间分布与目标附近停留时间，可为自监督强化学习提供有效时间几何，兼顾效率、性能与机器人任务中的可扩展性。

title: CRJudgeBench: Can AI Detect Plausible but Invalid Code Reviews?
comment: 26 pages, 5 figures, and 14 tables. Under review at ICLR 2027. Dataset available at https://huggingface.co/datasets/dcloud347/CRJudgeBenchmark
summary: Large language models can generate plausible code-review comments, but such comments may contain technically incorrect claims that mislead developers. We study technical trustworthiness judgment: determining whether a review comment's core technical claims are correct and applicable to the reviewed code in its repository context. Existing code-review benchmarks primarily evaluate review generation, issue discovery, or general comment quality, but do not directly assess whether an agent can determine the technical trustworthy of an individual review comment. To fill this gap, we introduce CRJudgeBench, a benchmark of 1199 instances constructed from real pull requests and expert-verified perturbations, covering both trustworthy and plausible but untrustworthy comments. We further present Sentinel, a repository-grounded agentic judge that actively gathers code evidence to verify review comments before making judgments. Starting from Qwen3-Coder-30B-A3B-Instruct, Sentinel is trained on the CRJudgeBench training split through iterative action-level learning from a privileged teacher. On the 359-instance CRJudgeBench test set, Sentinel achieves 76.60\% accuracy, outperforming GLM-5.3 by 6.13 percentage points and its base model by 19.78 points. These results show that even state-of-the-art general-purpose LLMs struggle to identify untrustworthy comments, while iterative action-level learning substantially improves the accuracy of repository-grounded trustworthiness judgments. Our dataset is available at https://huggingface.co/datasets/dcloud347/CRJudgeBenchmark

AI.tldr: 论文提出CRJudgeBench基准与Sentinel智能体评判器，用于判断LLM生成的代码评审意见在仓库语境下的技术可信性，Sentinel在测试集上达76.60%准确率。
AI.motivation: 大语言模型能生成看似合理的代码评审意见，但其中可能包含技术性错误论断，误导开发者。现有代码评审基准主要评估评审生成、问题发现或总体评论质量，未直接考察智能体能否判断单条评审意见的技术可信性，存在评估空白。
AI.method: 构建CRJudgeBench基准，含1199个实例，源自真实pull request及专家验证的扰动，覆盖可信与貌似合理但不可信的评论。提出Sentinel——基于仓库证据的智能体评判器，主动收集代码证据以验证评论。以Qwen3-Coder-30B-A3B-Instruct为基座，在CRJudgeBench训练集上通过特权教师驱动的迭代动作级学习进行训练。
AI.result: 在359实例的CRJudgeBench测试集上，Sentinel达76.60%准确率，超GLM-5.3 6.13个百分点，超其基座模型19.78个百分点。
AI.conclusion: 即便是最先进的通用大模型也难以识别不可信评论；迭代动作级学习能显著提升仓库语境下可信性判断的准确率。

title: Learning in the Transverse Subspace: A Minimal Representation for Divergence-Free Operator Learning
summary:
Divergence-free vector fields are fundamental state variables in incompressible flows and many PDE systems. Redundant parameterizations, including Neural Conservation Law (NCL) potentials, map multiple auxiliary representations to the same physical field. Our experiments show that this redundancy can reduce static representation-fitting error by enlarging the set of equivalent solutions, but the resulting many-to-one mapping does not provide a unique state for operator learning.
  We introduce a minimal representation that encodes a real \(D\)-component divergence-free vector field on a \(D\)-dimensional domain as a real \((D-1)\)-component field on the same domain. Exploiting the transverse structure imposed by incompressibility in Fourier space, we use a Householder orthogonal transformation to construct the reduced coordinates directly. For periodic and closed impermeable fields, the transform is invertible, isometric, and angle-preserving. For open nonperiodic flows, Fourier extension constructs a compatible periodic field, and a minimum-energy rule selects a unique reduced representation.
  Neural operators then learn temporal evolution entirely in this reduced space. At inference, the predicted \((D-1)\)-component field is decoded directly into a physical divergence-free \(D\)-component field, without predicting an ambient field or applying post-hoc projection.
  Experiments on static fitting and temporal prediction reveal a task-dependent trade-off: redundancy facilitates static optimization, whereas unique invertible coordinates provide a well-defined state for temporal dynamics. By removing unconstrained longitudinal or null directions from the learned state space, the proposed formulation achieves lower prediction error and greater robustness while preserving divergence freedom by construction.

AI.tldr: 本文提出一种极简散度自由矢量场表示：将D维域上的D分量无散场编码为同域上的(D-1)分量场，利用Fourier空间的横向结构与Householder正交变换构造可逆、等距、保角的约简坐标，并让神经算子在该约简空间内学习时间演化，推理时直接解码为物理无散场。
AI.motivation: 无散矢量场是不可压缩流与众多PDE系统的基本状态变量。现有冗余参数化（如Neural Conservation Law势函数）将多个辅助表示映射到同一物理场。实验表明这种冗余虽能通过扩大等价解集合降低静态拟合误差，但其多对一映射无法为算子学习提供唯一的状态定义，因而损害时间动力学的可学习性。
AI.method: 提出最小表示：把D维域上实值D分量无散场编码为同域上的实值(D-1)分量场。利用不可压缩性在Fourier空间施加的横向结构，采用Householder正交变换直接构造约简坐标；对周期场与封闭不可渗透场，该变换可逆、等距且保角；对开放非周期流，先用Fourier延拓构造相容周期场，再用最小能量准则选取唯一约简表示。神经算子完全在该约简空间中学习时间演化，推理时将预测的(D-1)分量场直接解码为物理无散D分量场，无需预测环境场或后处理投影。
AI.result: 静态拟合与时间预测实验揭示了任务相关的权衡：冗余有利于静态优化，而唯一可逆坐标则为时间动力学提供良定义的状态。通过从学习状态空间中移除无约束的纵向或零方向，所提形式在构造上保持无散性的同时，取得了更低的预测误差与更强的鲁棒性。
AI.conclusion: 冗余参数化与唯一可逆表示之间存在任务依赖的权衡。将无散场压缩为(D-1)分量最小表示并在此空间内进行算子学习，可同时保证无散约束的严格满足与时间演化的良定义状态，从而获得更低误差与更高鲁棒性。

title: CoRe: Co-Evolving Reward Models for Mitigating Latent Reward Hacking in Video Diffusion Models
summary: Latent reward models (LRMs) enable efficient alignment of video diffusion models by scoring intermediate states directly in latent space. However, we find that optimizing against a fixed latent reward rapidly leads to latent reward hacking: the predicted reward stays high while perceptual and motion quality deteriorate. Our analysis identifies distributional escape as the central cause: within a few hundred updates, the generator moves beyond the reward model's training support, where its scores no longer reflect video quality. Based on this insight, we introduce CoRe, a co-evolving reward framework that treats latent-space alignment as a dynamic interaction between the generator and the reward model. Rather than optimizing against a stationary proxy, CoRe continually refits the reward model on the generator's current samples while anchoring it to real-video preferences, so the generator cannot gain reward by drifting away from the data. On Wan2.1-T2V-1.3B, experiments show that CoRe consistently improves generation quality over both the pretrained model and prior alignment methods, while avoiding the quality collapse of fixed-reward optimization.

AI.tldr: 本文揭示潜在奖励模型（LRM）优化中的"分布逃逸"问题，提出协同进化奖励框架CoRe，通过持续重拟合奖励模型并锚定真实视频偏好来避免奖励黑客，在Wan2.1-T2V-1.3B上提升生成质量。
AI.motivation: 潜在奖励模型可在潜空间直接对中间状态打分，从而高效对齐视频扩散模型。但作者发现，针对固定潜在奖励进行优化会迅速导致"潜在奖励黑客"：预测奖励维持高位，而感知质量与运动质量却下降。分析表明其核心成因是分布逃逸——生成器在数百次更新后即移出奖励模型的训练支撑域，此时奖励分数不再反映真实视频质量。
AI.method: 提出CoRe（协同进化奖励）框架，将潜空间对齐视为生成器与奖励模型之间的动态交互。区别于针对静态代理进行优化，CoRe持续在生成器当前样本上重拟合奖励模型，同时将其锚定于真实视频偏好，使生成器无法通过偏离数据分布来获取奖励。
AI.result: 在Wan2.1-T2V-1.3B上，CoRe 相比预训练模型及既有对齐方法持续提升生成质量，同时避免了固定奖励优化带来的质量崩塌。
AI.conclusion: 潜在奖励优化中的分布逃逸是奖励黑客的关键诱因；通过让奖励模型与生成器协同进化并锚定真实数据偏好，可有效抑制奖励黑客，实现稳定且高质量的视频扩散模型对齐。

title: SafeLLM4SE: Statistical Evaluation and Reporting for LLM-based Software Engineering Systems
comment: This work has been submitted for possible publication. Copyright may be transferred without notice, after which this version may no longer be accessible
summary: Large language models (LLMs) are increasingly used for software engineering tasks, yet their stochastic behavior challenges the validity, reproducibility, and comparability of their evaluations. Conventional practices such as reporting a single output, an average score, best-of-N, or pass@k performance can obscure variability and estimation uncertainty, potentially leading to misleading conclusions about system reliability. This article presents SafeLLM4SE, a practical methodology and reporting standard for statistically principled evaluation of LLM-based software engineering systems. Rather than treating generated outputs as deterministic artifacts, SafeLLM4SE treats them as realizations of a stochastic process and distinguishes quality, stability, and estimation uncertainty. It combines adaptive sampling with confidence intervals, distribution-aware statistical comparisons, effect sizes, and a minimum reporting standard covering model configuration, reproducibility, evaluation procedures, and resource usage. SafeLLM4SE is also provided as an open-source software package available on PyPI, enabling researchers and practitioners to reproduce and extend the methodology. We illustrate its application by comparing two LLMs on HumanEval, a benchmark of programming problems assessed through functional tests.

AI.tldr: 本文提出SafeLLM4SE，一套针对LLM软件工程系统评估的统计学方法论与报告标准，将模型输出视为随机过程的实现，区分质量、稳定性与估计不确定性，并提供开源工具包。
AI.motivation: LLM广泛用于软件工程任务，但其随机性行为威胁评估的效度、可复现性与可比性。传统做法（单一输出、平均分、best-of-N、pass@k）会掩盖变异性和估计不确定性，可能导致关于系统可靠性的误导性结论。
AI.method: 提出SafeLLM4SE方法论，将生成输出视为随机过程的实现，而非确定性产物；区分质量、稳定性与估计不确定性；结合自适应采样与置信区间、分布感知的统计比较、效应量，并制定涵盖模型配置、可复现性、评估流程与资源使用的最低报告标准。该方法以开源软件包形式发布于PyPI。
AI.result: 通过在HumanEval（一个通过功能测试评估编程问题的基准）上比较两个LLM，展示了SafeLLM4SE的应用。摘要未给出具体定量比较结果。
AI.conclusion: SafeLLM4SE为基于LLM的软件工程系统提供了一套可复现、可扩展的统计评估与报告框架，有助于提升评估结论的可靠性。

title: The Decision Value of Perception Compute
summary: Adaptive perception spends extra computation on inputs where perception is expected to improve. When perception feeds a downstream decision system, a better perception output need not produce a better decision. We define the decision value of perception compute as the change in downstream loss from escalating an input from a cheap to an expensive perception mode. Because this value can be negative, the allocation of perception compute should be judged against a budget-constrained decision oracle, with uniform full-fidelity inference as a baseline rather than an upper bound. We introduce DEEP (Decision Evaluation for Escalated Perception), a benchmark that scores pre-escalation allocators against this oracle under selection, latency and energy budgets, charging each allocator for its own computation. With deployed monocular geometry on KITTI and nuScenes, we find that 34--54% of the escalations that change downstream loss make it worse; harmful escalations also occur for the published PDM-Closed planner, evaluated open-loop on nuPlan with real detector outcomes. On nuScenes, perception-level gain frequently disagrees in sign with decision value. This mismatch has practical consequences: choosing among fixed deployable signals by missed-object perception gain rather than by decision value reduces realized test decision gain by 7.4% of the all-cheap loss on average. Learned allocators recover part of the oracle's value by finding beneficial escalations but select nearly as much harm as random, and once their own computation is charged at a 20% latency budget, only the lightweight routers, at about 3.5\% of a full detector pass, still beat random.

AI.tldr: 论文提出"感知计算决策价值"概念并构建DEEP基准，发现在自适应感知中大量升级（escalation）反而使下游决策损失变差，感知增益与决策价值常不同号，且计入自身算力开销后多数学习型分配器难以优于随机。
AI.motivation: 自适应感知通常默认"更好的感知输出→更好的决策"，但感知服务于下游决策系统时该假设未必成立。作者希望以预算约束下的决策oracle为参照，重新定义并评估感知算力分配的价值，避免以全保真推理为上限的错误基准。
AI.method: 定义感知计算决策价值为输入从廉价模式升级到昂贵模式时下游损失的改变量，并以预算约束的决策oracle为评判标准（均匀全保真推理作为基线而非上限）。构建DEEP基准，在选择性、延迟与能耗预算下给预升级分配器打分，并计入分配器自身计算开销；在KITTI、nuScenes（单目几何）以及nuPlan（PDM-Closed规划器，开环、真实检测器输出）上评估。
AI.result: 34–54%改变下游损失的升级使损失变差；PDM-Closed规划器同样存在有害升级。nuScenes上感知级增益与决策价值符号常不一致。按漏检感知增益而非决策价值选择可部署信号，会使实际测试决策增益平均下降全cheap损失的7.4%。学习型分配器能恢复部分oracle价值但引入接近随机的伤害；在20%延迟预算计入自身开销后，仅轻量路由器（约一次完整检测器前向的3.5%）仍优于随机。
AI.conclusion: 感知质量的提升不必然转化为决策收益，感知算力分配应以决策价值和对齐的预算oracle来评估；该错配具有实际代价，且现有学习型分配器在计入自身开销后收益有限，凸显轻量路由与决策导向评估的必要性。

title: Towards Mitigating Deceptive Safety Alignment in Large Reasoning Models
summary: Large Reasoning Models (LRMs) are commonly trained with reinforcement learning (RL) to improve their generation of chain-of-thought (CoT) reasoning before producing final answers. However, RL rewards are typically assigned based on final answers, providing little or no direct supervision over intermediate reasoning. This can lead to deceptive safety alignment, where the reasoning trace and final answer convey inconsistent safety signals. To systematically investigate this phenomenon, we introduce DSAR (Deceptive Safety Alignment Rate), a metric that jointly assesses reasoning traces and final answers to quantify their safety inconsistency. Across multiple LRMs and benchmarks, we find that deceptive safety alignment is pervasive under standard prompting conditions and is substantially amplified under prefilling attacks. We further provide a hidden representation analysis showing that models exhibit stronger safety discrimination at the final-answer stage than during intermediate reasoning. To close this gap, we propose SARA (Safety-Aware Reasoning Alignment), an RL-based method that rewards both safety-aware reasoning and safe final answers, encouraging early harmful intent recognition and enforcing reasoning-answer consistency. Experiments show that SARA significantly mitigates deceptive safety alignment under both standard and adversarial settings while preserving helpfulness and utility. Code is available at https://github.com/xzhou98/SARA.

AI.tldr: 论文提出DSAR指标量化"欺骗性安全对齐"现象，并给出SARA方法通过RL同时奖励安全推理与安全答案，缓解该问题。
AI.motivation: LRM通常用RL训练以提升CoT推理，但RL奖励多基于最终答案，对中间推理缺乏直接监督，导致推理轨迹与最终答案的安全信号不一致，即"欺骗性安全对齐"。
AI.method: 1) 提出DSAR（Deceptive Safety Alignment Rate）指标，联合评估推理轨迹与最终答案以量化安全不一致性；2) 通过隐藏表示分析揭示模型在最终答案阶段的安全判别强于中间推理阶段；3) 提出SARA（Safety-Aware Reasoning Alignment），一种RL方法，同时奖励安全感知推理与安全最终答案，促进早期识别有害意图并强制推理-答案一致性。
AI.result: 在多个LRM与基准上，欺骗性安全对齐在标准提示下普遍存在，并在prefilling攻击下显著放大；SARA在标准与对抗设置下均显著缓解该问题，同时保持有用性与效用。
AI.conclusion: 仅基于最终答案的RL奖励不足以保障推理安全性，需对中间推理施加安全监督；SARA通过联合优化推理与答案的安全一致性有效缓解欺骗性安全对齐。

title: Do Agent Benchmarks Do What They Say? An Executable-Contract Audit of Tool-Using Agent Environments
comment: 10 pages. Submitted to IEEE BigData 2026, Intelligent Data Mining special session. Code, contracts and data: https://github.com/rohithreddybc/tool-contract-conformance
summary: Tool-using agents are entering settings where a wrong action carries real cost, and the benchmarks certifying them grade what each simulated tool call reports having done, assuming the tool did what its interface advertises. The audit taxonomies we survey publish no category for that assumption, and a defect beneath a score is present on every rerun. We treat a tool's advertised surfaces as an executable contract, check the implementation against it, and trace each score's provenance through the task files and evaluator code to the verdicts that derive from state a defective tool should have written. Across 34 audited mutating tools in four benchmarks we confirm seven tool defects and one evaluator property at pinned commits. On injected defects the checker raised no false positive in 25 flags, flagged 2 of 5 negative controls, and missed most: in 29 of 33 scored misses a clause covered the defect but no probe revealed it. The checker's own static half, run alone, flags 14 of 17 confirmed sites, so on these findings the dynamic half confirms and traces rather than discovers. Twelve further AgentDojo tools, with six held-out tools and the seven audited first, complete its 25-tool mutating surface, on which at least 5 tools diverge from their advertised surface as our contracts read it, a rate for AgentDojo alone. No gold trajectory reaches either tau2-bench defect; on 1,120 paths built to isolate the telecom defect, a number fixed by construction, the evaluator rewards a refuel of a suspended line and fails the repaired tool. The clearest case is a clinical benchmark whose tool tells the agent each write executed under a documented no-write design its interface does not disclose; its grader takes that message as evidence, so its action success rate records whether a request carried the expected payload, not whether any record changed.

AI.tldr: 该论文将工具（tool）的"对外宣称接口"视为可执行契约，通过静态与动态检查核对实现与契约是否一致，并沿任务文件与评测器代码追溯每条分数的来源。在四个基准的34个可变工具中确认7个工具缺陷与1个评测器属性；注入缺陷测试中检查器无假阳性（25次标记）、仅命中5个负对照中的2个，且多数缺陷未被探测到；AgentDojo的25个可变工具中至少5个偏离其宣称接口；tau2-bench缺陷无金标准轨迹可达，且在1,120条构造路径上评测器奖励对停用线路的"补缴"却判修复后的工具为失败；临床基准中工具在未披露的"无写入"设计下报告写入已执行，评测器据此计算的动作成功率实际只反映请求载荷是否匹配，而非是否有记录被改变。
AI.motivation: 随着工具使用型智能体进入错误操作代价高昂的场景，认证它们的基准却默认"工具接口宣称的行为即实际行为"，仅依据模拟工具调用的报告结果打分。现有审计分类法没有为这一假设设立类别，而这一底层缺陷会在每次重跑中持续存在，使分数失去可靠性。
AI.method: 将工具的宣称接口视为可执行契约，检查实现是否与之一致（静态分析）；并追踪每个分数的来源——从任务文件、评测器代码一直到由"缺陷工具本应写入的状态"所推导出的判定（动态验证与溯源）。在四个基准的34个可变工具（pinned commits）上进行审计，并通过注入缺陷、负对照与留出工具评估检查器的性能。
AI.result: 确认7个工具缺陷和1个评测器属性；注入缺陷下25次标记无假阳性，负对照仅命中2/5，33个计分漏报中29个有子句覆盖缺陷但无探针揭示；静态部分单独运行可在17个确认位点中标记14个，说明动态部分主要起确认与溯源而非发现作用；AgentDojo 25个可变工具中至少5个偏离宣称接口；tau2-bench缺陷无金标准轨迹可达，1,120条隔离路径上评测器奖励对停用线路补缴并判修复工具失败；临床基准中评测器的动作成功率仅反映载荷匹配而非记录变更。
AI.conclusion: 基准分数可能建立在对工具行为的错误假设之上，导致所报告的智能体能力与实际不符。动态检查在此主要表现为确认与溯源，发现能力不足；单靠静态检查即有较高覆盖率。建议在基准认证中显式审计工具契约合规性，并披露工具与评测器之间的信任假设，以避免系统性高估或错判智能体表现。

title: Learn Now, Use Next, Trust Later: Prequential Test-Time Learning for LLM Agents
summary: Adapting large language model agents during deployment requires not only retaining past experience, but also turning new observations into timely guidance. Many test-time learning methods, however, acquire knowledge from completed episodes. Feedback from an ongoing interaction may therefore not be distilled into knowledge soon enough to help the next decision. Acquiring knowledge at the granularity of individual transitions could reduce this delay, but raises a separate challenge: a rule that is useful within one episode may not be reliable enough to guide future episodes. Waiting for validation can forfeit immediate benefits, whereas unrestricted reuse can propagate accidental or misattributed guidance. We introduce StepLearn, a nonparametric framework that separates immediate use from persistent trust. It turns informative transitions into hypotheses that can guide the next step, while requiring prospective validation before reuse across episodes. Their predicted effects are checked against subsequent observations outside the source episodes, and only sufficiently supported hypotheses become available for persistent guidance. This process updates external knowledge while keeping all model parameters fixed. Over five rounds on WebArena-Lite and ALFWorld, StepLearn achieves average success rates of 59.9% and 84.0% with GPT-5-mini, and 57.8% and 88.1% with Qwen3.5-35B-A3B, respectively. It outperforms EvoTest, the strongest baseline, by 2.2-12.7 percentage points across the four settings. Learning dynamics further shows that these gains are not restricted to the final repetition, with advantages already present on first task attempts in most settings.

AI.tldr: 提出 StepLearn 非参数框架，将 LLM 智能体部署期的即时引导与跨情节持久信任分离，在不更新模型参数的情况下实现测试时学习。
AI.motivation: 部署期自适应需要保留过往经验并将新观测转化为及时引导，但现有测试时学习方法多从已完成情节中获取知识，反馈蒸馏滞后，难以帮助下一步决策。以单步转换粒度获取知识可缩短延迟，却带来新的矛盾：情节内有效的规则未必足够可靠地指导未来情节——等待验证会失去即时收益，而无限制复用会传播偶发或错误归因的引导。
AI.method: StepLearn 将即时使用与持久信任分离：把高信息量的转换转化为假设，用于指导下一步；跨情节复用前须经过前瞻性验证。假设的预测效果在源情节之外与后续观测比对，只有获得充分支持的假设才可用于持久引导。该过程仅更新外部知识，保持所有模型参数冻结（非参数化）。
AI.result: 在 WebArena-Lite 与 ALFWorld 上经过五轮实验，StepLearn 在 GPT-5-mini 下平均成功率为 59.9% 与 84.0%，在 Qwen3.5-35B-A3B 下为 57.8% 与 88.1%，在四个设置中均超过最强基线 EvoTest 2.2–12.7 个百分点。学习动态显示增益并非仅出现在最后一轮重复中，多数设置下首次尝试任务时已具备优势。
AI.conclusion: 通过区分即时引导与持久信任并引入前瞻性验证，StepLearn 在冻结模型参数的前提下实现了更及时的测试时学习，兼顾即时收益与跨情节可靠性，并在多个基准与模型上稳定优于强基线。

title: OTROPE: Optimal Transport-based Robust Off-policy Evaluation for Large Language Models
summary: Reliable evaluation of large language models (LLMs) is essential for their development and deployment, yet is often costly, risky, and difficult to perform safely online. We study off-policy evaluation for LLMs, where limited human-labeled data from a behavior model are used to evaluate a newer target LLM. This setting is challenging because labels are scarce, behavior--target distribution shift is common, and response likelihoods are often unavailable for black-box LLMs. We propose the Optimal Transport-based Robust Off-Policy Evaluation (OTROPE), a likelihood-free evaluation that performs distributional correction in a semantic space via optimal transport to align labeled behavior-policy samples with unlabeled target-policy samples. OTROPE combines corrected human-labeled residuals with proxy predictors, yielding a doubly robust-style evaluation without behavior-policy modeling or density-ratio estimation. We theoretically characterize why baseline evaluators fail under LLM distribution shift, and establish consistency and convergence rates for OTROPE when either the reweighted behavior distribution or the proxy predictor converges. Experiments on synthetic and real LLM evaluation tasks show that OTROPE consistently outperforms baselines while enabling ensembles of weaker LLM evaluators to approach and sometimes surpass stronger evaluators. Code is available at https://github.com/LinerXiang/OTROPE.

AI.tldr: 本文提出 OTROPE，一种基于最优传输的无似然离线策略评估方法，用于在仅有少量人类标注、且存在行为-目标分布偏移和黑盒 LLM 无响应概率的情况下，可靠评估新目标 LLM。OTROPE 在语义空间做分布校正，结合校正后的残差与代理预测器实现双重稳健式评估，无需行为策略建模或密度比估计，并给出理论一致性与收敛速率及实验验证。
AI.motivation: 可靠评估 LLM 对其开发与部署至关重要，但在线评估代价高、有风险且难以安全执行。离线策略评估场景中，仅有来自行为模型的有限人类标注，需评估更新的目标 LLM；该场景面临标签稀缺、行为-目标分布偏移普遍、黑盒 LLM 响应似然不可得等挑战，基线评估器易失效。
AI.method: 提出 Optimal Transport-based Robust Off-Policy Evaluation (OTROPE)：一种无似然评估方法，通过最优传输在语义空间进行分布校正，将已标注的行为策略样本与未标注的目标策略样本对齐；随后将校正后的人类标注残差与代理预测器结合，形成双重稳健式评估，无需行为策略建模或密度比估计。
AI.result: 理论上刻画了基线评估器在 LLM 分布偏移下失效的原因，并证明当重加权行为分布或代理预测器之一收敛时，OTROPE 具有一致性与收敛速率。在合成与真实 LLM 评估任务上，OTROPE 持续优于基线，并能通过集成较弱的 LLM 评估器接近甚至有时超越更强评估器。
AI.conclusion: OTROPE 为黑盒、标签稀缺且存在分布偏移的 LLM 离线评估提供了无似然、双重稳健的解决方案，兼具理论保证与实证优势，并已开源。

title: Complexity-Aware Evaluation of LLM Comprehension
summary: Large language models (LLMs) are increasingly used for software engineering tasks that require understanding existing source code, including behavior prediction, function explanation, debugging, and code review. However, aggregate benchmark accuracy can conceal how model reliability changes as source code becomes structurally more complex. This paper presents a complexity-aware framework for evaluating LLM code comprehension using cyclomatic complexity, nesting depth, branching factor, and Halstead volume. We evaluate DeepSeek-Coder-V2 and Llama through two complementary tasks: automatic input-output prediction over 300 Python functions and manually assessed semantic comprehension over a balanced subset of 60 functions. The functions are grouped into Low-, Medium-, and High-complexity bands. DeepSeek-Coder-V2 achieves an overall automatic accuracy of 78.33%, compared with 70.33% for Llama. However, accuracy decreases substantially from Low to High complexity, from 93.52% to 52.78% for DeepSeek-Coder-V2 and from 87.04% to 47.22% for Llama. Incorrect predictions are consistently associated with higher values of all four complexity metrics, and correlation and logistic-regression analyses confirm broadly comparable negative associations between structural complexity and correctness. Manual semantic comprehension shows the same degradation pattern, with accuracy decreasing from 100.00% to 75.00% for DeepSeek-Coder-V2 and from 90.00% to 60.00% for Llama. These findings demonstrate that complexity-aware evaluation provides a more diagnostic assessment of LLM code-comprehension reliability than aggregate accuracy alone.

AI.tldr: 本文提出复杂度感知的LLM代码理解评测框架，结合圈复杂度、嵌套深度、分支因子与Halstead体积，对DeepSeek-Coder-V2和Llama在Python函数上进行自动输入输出预测与人工语义理解评测。结果显示整体准确率尚可，但随复杂度从低到高显著下降，表明复杂度分级评测比总体准确率更具诊断性。
AI.motivation: LLM越来越多用于需要理解既有源码的软件工程任务（行为预测、函数解释、调试、代码审查）。然而，聚合基准准确率会掩盖模型可靠性随源码结构复杂度变化的情况，因此需要复杂度感知的评测以更真实反映模型可靠性的变化。
AI.method: 采用复杂度感知框架，以圈复杂度、嵌套深度、分支因子和Halstead体积度量代码结构复杂度。评估DeepSeek-Coder-V2与Llama，设计两个互补任务：对300个Python函数进行自动输入输出预测；对60个函数的平衡子集进行人工语义理解评估。函数按复杂度分为低、中、高三档，并进行相关性与逻辑回归分析。
AI.result: 自动任务上DeepSeek-Coder-V2总体准确率78.33%，Llama为70.33%；从低复杂度到高复杂度，DeepSeek-Coder-V2由93.52%降至52.78%，Llama由87.04%降至47.22%。错误预测始终与四项复杂度指标更高取值相关，相关性与逻辑回归分析证实结构复杂度与正确率呈显著负相关。人工语义理解呈相同退化模式：DeepSeek-Coder-V2由100.00%降至75.00%，Llama由90.00%降至60.00%。
AI.conclusion: 复杂度的提升会显著降低LLM代码理解的可靠性，且不同模型呈现一致的退化模式。复杂度感知评测能提供比单一聚合准确率更具诊断性的LLM代码理解可靠性评估。

title: Replication Failure and Trivial Baselines in Road-Level Crash Prediction
comment: 6 pages, 1 figure, 4 tables. Code and reproduction scripts: https://github.com/Maurya1112-sudo/greyspot
summary: Graph neural networks are increasingly applied to road-level crash prediction, but the stability of their reported gains has received little scrutiny. We independently reconstruct the data pipeline of a recent uncertainty-aware model and evaluate eleven of its design decisions across three London boroughs under an expanding-window protocol. Four survive replication on a second borough; seven do not, and four of those reverse sign rather than attenuate. Multi-seed evaluation is decisive: one effect reverses sign between random seeds within a single borough, and the reference architecture exhibits per-borough seed spreads of up to 35.7 points against 4 points for ours. We further compare both networks against a parameter-free baseline that ranks segments by cumulative past crash count. At matched history depth our model is statistically indistinguishable from that baseline ($-0.90$ points, $p=0.61$), and the reference architecture loses to it on 18 of 18 held-out windows ($-17.37$, $p<10^{-6}$). Sweeping the baseline's lookback horizon shows it spans 22.71% to 83.94% accuracy on that variable alone, and that every published figure in this line of work is matched by the baseline at a horizon of one to five years. We argue that the apparent margin of graph networks over historical baselines in this task is substantially an artefact of the short horizons those baselines were computed over, and recommend horizon-matched baselines and multi-seed reporting as minimum practice.

AI.tldr: 作者独立复现一篇近期"不确定性感知"图神经网络道路级事故预测模型的数据流程，在伦敦三个行政区、扩展窗口协议下检验其11项设计决策：仅4项可在第二个行政区复现，7项无法复现（其中4项符号反转）。多随机种子评估显示效应极不稳定。与"按历史累计事故数排序"的无参数基线相比，本文模型在匹配历史深度下无显著差异（-0.90分，p=0.61），而参考架构在18/18个留出窗口上均弱于基线（-17.37，p<10⁻⁶）。扫描基线回看窗口发现其准确率可在22.71%–83.94%间变动，且该领域所有已发表数值都可由1–5年窗口的基线匹配。作者认为图网络的"优势"主要是基线窗口过短造成的假象，建议采用窗口匹配基线与多种子报告。
AI.motivation: 图神经网络在道路级事故预测中的应用日益增多，但其报告的相对历史基线的性能增益缺乏稳定性审查。作者怀疑这些增益可能源于实验设计缺陷（尤其是基线回看窗口过短）而非模型本身的结构优势。
AI.method: 独立重构一篇近期不确定性感知GNN模型的数据流程；在伦敦三个行政区上采用扩展窗口（expanding-window）协议评估其11项设计决策；引入多随机种子评估以量化种子间波动；并设计一个无参数基线——按路段历史累计事故数排名——进行对照。进一步扫描该基线的回看时间窗口（lookback horizon），考查基线性能对该单一变量的敏感性。
AI.result: 11项设计决策中仅4项在第二个行政区复现成功，7项失败，其中4项符号反转。多种子评估具有决定性：某项效应在同一行政区内即随随机种子反转符号；参考架构的每行政区种子波动高达35.7个百分点，而本文模型仅约4个百分点。在匹配历史深度下，本文模型与无参数基线统计上不可区分（-0.90分，p=0.61）；参考架构则在18/18个留出窗口上均败于基线（-17.37，p<10⁻⁶）。基线回看窗口从1年至5年变化时，准确率在22.71%–83.94%间浮动，且该领域所有已发表数值都能被1–5年窗口的基线匹配。
AI.conclusion: 图网络在该任务上相对历史基线的表面优势，很大程度上是基线计算所用回看窗口过短所产生的假象，而非模型结构带来的真实增益。作者建议将"窗口匹配的基线对比"与"多种子报告"作为该领域的最低实践标准。

title: From Surfaces to Volumes: Registered Geometry for Protein Representation Learning
summary: Existing protein geometry models typically represent molecular surfaces using local geometric features such as sampled points, normals, and curvature. While effective for capturing exposed molecular shape, these representations do not explicitly model the volumetric organization beneath the surface or provide a consistent coordinate system for residue-wise volumetric structure. We introduce Protein-TetSphere, a registered residue-wise volumetric representation for proteins. Each protein chain is tetrahedralized to obtain local volumetric regions associated with individual residues, which are then registered to a shared fixed-topology tetrahedral reference and represented in a common Laplacian basis. This registration establishes consistent volumetric coordinates across residues, enabling local three-dimensional deformation to be integrated with surface and chemical information in a multimodal protein representation. We evaluate Protein-TetSphere on ligand-binding pocket classification, protein--protein interface prediction, and de novo protein binder design. Across the three tasks, Protein-TetSphere improves ligand-binding pocket balanced accuracy from $0.795$ to $0.826$, Pinder-Pair/Site AUROC from $0.914/0.852$ to $0.932/0.866$, and binder-design success from $14.95\%$ to $19.90\%$ on the BoltzGen Challenge Set and from $27.62\%$ to $32.19\%$ at the ProtDBench backbone level. These results show that registered volumetric geometry provides complementary spatial information beyond molecular surfaces across protein recognition, interaction, and design.

AI.tldr: 提出Protein-TetSphere，一种配准的残基级体积表示，通过四面体化和共享拉普拉斯基实现跨残基一致的体积坐标，在配体口袋分类、蛋白-蛋白界面预测和从头设计任务上均取得提升。
AI.motivation: 现有蛋白质几何模型多以采样点、法向量、曲率等局部表面特征表示分子表面，虽能捕捉暴露形状，但未显式建模表面下的体积组织，也缺乏残基级体积结构的一致坐标系。
AI.method: 对每条蛋白链做四面体剖分，得到与各残基关联的局部体积区域；将其配准到共享的固定拓扑四面体参考，并在公共拉普拉斯基中表示，从而建立跨残基一致的体积坐标，使局部三维形变能与表面及化学信息融合成多模态表示。
AI.result: 配体结合口袋平衡准确率由0.795升至0.826；Pinder-Pair/Site AUROC由0.914/0.852升至0.932/0.866；结合剂设计成功率在BoltzGen Challenge Set上由14.95%升至19.90%，在ProtDBench backbone层级由27.62%升至32.19%。
AI.conclusion: 配准的体积几何提供了超越分子表面的互补空间信息，可泛化应用于蛋白质识别、相互作用与设计任务。

title: Exploring Emotional Intelligence in Software Testing
summary:
Background: Emotional Intelligence (EI) is the ability to recognise, understand, and manage one's own and others' emotions. Software testers deliver judgements about colleagues' work under deadlines they do not control, and prior work on emotion in software engineering has mostly studied developers.
  Aims: To explore how software testers describe the part EI plays in their day-to-day work, in communication and conflict within the team, and in responding to requirements volatility.
  Method: Semi-structured interviews with 16 software testers in Sweden working in teams that use agile practices, across aviation, automotive, healthcare, IT services, administration, banking and pharmaceuticals, analysed with reflexive thematic analysis informed by Goleman's EI framework.
  Results: Three themes. Testers described regulating stress under deadline pressure and drawing motivation from recognition, clarity and autonomy; managing the daily delivery of critical findings to colleagues so that trust survives; and responding to requirements change with frustration that turned into decisions about what to leave untested, into advocacy for process change, or into workarounds. Read against developer-focused studies, the themes point to features of the testing role: the work product is a criticism of a colleague's work, success is invisible while failure is attributed, and the tester's window shrinks with every upstream delay.
  Conclusions: For testers, managing emotions is a constant job requirement. The results highlight that the importance of EI increases when the development process lacks an independent testing phase. The findings also inform implications for teams and, ultimately, for organisations and future research.

AI.tldr: 该论文通过访谈16名瑞典敏捷团队中的软件测试人员，基于Goleman情商框架的反思性主题分析，探讨情商在测试人员日常工作、团队沟通与冲突、以及需求变更应对中的作用，识别出三个主题并提出情商是测试岗位的常态化工作要求。
AI.motivation: 以往软件工程中的情绪研究主要聚焦开发者，而测试人员的工作具有特殊性：需要在无法控制的时间节点下对他人的工作成果做出评判。这种角色特征使情商可能在其工作中扮演独特且重要的角色，但缺乏针对性研究。
AI.method: 采用半结构化访谈法，对瑞典16名使用敏捷实践的软件测试人员进行访谈，覆盖航空、汽车、医疗、IT服务、行政、银行和制药等行业；以Goleman情商框架为理论基础，开展反思性主题分析。
AI.result: 提炼出三个主题：(1) 在截止日期压力下调节压力，并从认可、清晰度和自主性中获得动力；(2) 管理向同事传递关键发现的过程以维系信任；(3) 面对需求变更时，将挫败感转化为对未测内容的取舍决策、对流程改进的倡导或变通方案。与开发者研究对比，凸显测试角色的三个特征：工作产出是对同事工作的批评、成功不可见而失败被归因、上游每延迟一次其测试窗口就缩小一次。
AI.conclusion: 对测试人员而言，情绪管理是持续性的岗位要求；当开发流程缺乏独立测试阶段时，情商的重要性进一步上升。研究结果为团队实践提供启示，并为组织层面及未来研究指明方向。

title: Normative Loss Landscape Navigation: A Trajectory-Based Approach to Mitigating Forgetting in Incremental Learning
summary: Continual learning models suffer from catastrophic forgetting when trained sequentially on non-stationary data distributions. Previously, this has been addressed through weight regularization. While preconditioning gradients offer a promising alternative to mitigate forgetting, current approaches are myopic. Conversely, standard regularization methods apply rigid, scalar Euclidean penalties that entirely ignore the underlying Riemannian geometry of the parameter space. To overcome this gap, we propose TMLN (Trajectory-Modulatory Landscape Navigation), a normative navigation policy that formalizes continual learning as an optimal control problem over a curved loss landscape. TMLN utilizes a memory-efficient diagonal empirical Fisher Information Matrix (FIM) to define a localized Riemannian manifold. To compensate for the spatial limitations of the diagonal approximation, TMLN dynamically modulates a preconditioner using the normalized historical trajectory of the network's parameter values. By integrating this trajectory-based preconditioning directly into the gradient update, we actively shield historically critical parameter directions without relying on additive penalties. Empirical evaluations on class- and domain-incremental benchmarks demonstrate that our method significantly reduces the loss barrier between consecutive tasks.

AI.tldr: 提出TMLN，将持续学习建模为弯曲损失景观上的最优控制问题，用对角经验FIM定义局部黎曼流形，并结合参数历史轨迹动态调制预条件子，实现无加性惩罚的持续学习。
AI.motivation: 持续学习模型在非平稳数据分布上顺序训练时会产生灾难性遗忘。现有梯度预条件方法虽能缓解遗忘但目光短浅（myopic），而标准正则化方法采用刚性、标量欧氏惩罚，完全忽略了参数空间的黎曼几何结构。
AI.method: 提出TMLN（Trajectory-Modulatory Landscape Navigation），把持续学习形式化为弯曲损失景观上的最优控制问题，作为规范性导航策略。使用内存高效的对角经验Fisher信息矩阵（FIM）定义局部黎曼流形；为弥补对角近似的空间局限，利用网络参数值归一化后的历史轨迹动态调制预条件子；将该轨迹型预条件直接整合进梯度更新，主动保护历史关键参数方向，而非依赖加性惩罚。
AI.result: 在类增量与域增量基准上的实验表明，该方法显著降低相邻任务之间的损失障碍（loss barrier）。
AI.conclusion: TMLN通过融合黎曼几何与参数轨迹信息，以预条件梯度更新的方式缓解持续学习中的灾难性遗忘，为在弯曲损失景观上进行规范性导航提供了有效途径。

title: Illusory Truth or Mere Exposure? Model-Dependent Repetition Effects in LLM-Based Social Media Simulations
summary: Generative agent-based models (GABMs) are increasingly used to simulate social media dynamics, including misinformation spread. For such social simulations to be valid proxies of human behavior, LLM agents should replicate established human cognitive biases, among them the Illusory Truth Effect (ITE), where repeated exposure to a claim increases its perceived truth value. We investigate whether and how the ITE manifests across four LLMs (Gemma-3-4b-it, Qwen2.5-7B-Instruct, Llama-3.1-8B-Instruct, and GPT-5-nano) in a social media simulation context. We propose a two-phase within-context experimental design that embeds the repetition manipulation inside a realistic news feed interaction. Using this design, we collect 336,000 truth, importance, sentiment, and interest ratings across 100 statements, 10 feed variants, and 3 replications. The key comparison is between ratings assigned to repeated statements, seen throughout a simulation phase, and completely unseen ones, rated within the same experimental context window. We distinguish genuine ITE (truth-specific repetition boost) from mere exposure effects. We run an OLS regression followed by a Linear Mixed-Effect Model to account for differences across models and ratings. Our results reveal four qualitatively distinct patterns: Gemma-3 exhibits a genuine ITE; Qwen2.5 shows a mere exposure effect; GPT-5-nano displays no repetition effect on truth and mild skepticism toward repeated content; Llama-3.1 shows a small truth boost alongside decreases in evaluative dimensions. Crucially, temperature has no effect on these findings, and a variance decomposition highlights the high context-sensitivity of LLM rating behavior. Our findings caution against assuming uniform ITE replication across LLMs in social simulations, while suggesting that Gemma-3-4b-it may offer the most behaviorally realistic approximation for misinformation-related simulations.

AI.tldr: 研究考察四种LLM在社交媒体模拟中是否复现人类"错觉真相效应"(ITE)，发现模型间存在四种性质不同的重复暴露反应模式，且温度参数无影响。
AI.motivation: 生成式智能体模型(GABM)常被用于模拟社交媒体信息传播（含虚假信息扩散），但其作为人类行为代理的有效性取决于LLM智能体能否复现人类认知偏差，其中ITE（重复暴露提升主张被感知的真相度）是核心偏差之一。目前尚不清楚ITE在LLM中是否及如何表现，因此需要系统检验。
AI.method: 提出两阶段"情境内"(within-context)实验设计，将重复操作嵌入真实的新闻信息流交互中。对四种LLM（Gemma-3-4b-it、Qwen2.5-7B-Instruct、Llama-3.1-8B-Instruct、GPT-5-nano）采集336,000条评分（真实性、重要性、情感、兴趣），覆盖100条陈述、10种信息流变体、3次重复。关键对比为"模拟阶段反复出现的陈述"与"同一实验情境窗口内完全未见的陈述"之间的评分差异，以区分真正的ITE（真实性特异的重复增益）与单纯的暴露效应。分析采用OLS回归与线性混合效应模型(LMM)，以控制模型与评分类型间差异。
AI.result: 出现四种性质不同的模式：Gemma-3表现为真正的ITE；Qwen2.5仅表现为单纯暴露效应；GPT-5-nano对真实性无重复效应，且对重复内容表现出轻微怀疑；Llama-3.1表现为小幅真实性增益，同时评价维度下降。温度参数对结果无影响；方差分解显示LLM评分行为具有高度情境敏感性。
AI.conclusion: 不应假定ITE在不同LLM中能被一致复现；在虚假信息相关模拟中，Gemma-3-4b-it可能提供最具行为真实性的近似。研究提示GABM使用者在选择底层模型时须谨慎，并重视LLM评分行为的情境依赖性。

title: Profiling the Energy Consumption of Serverless Functions with Joule Profiler
summary: Cloud providers and customers have widely adopted serverless computing as a convenient paradigm for deploying and executing functions on demand. To do so, serverless platforms require provisioning an appropriate execution environment before a single line of the function's code runs. These environments consist of several layers, such as container engines, hypervisors, unikernels, and programming language runtimes. While the literature has investigated the performance of these serverless platforms, it treats functions as black boxes, and the community lacks key insights into the environmental impacts of packaging applications as serverless functions. This paper therefore empirically studies the energy efficiency of serverless functions deployable on serverless platforms. We design an experimental benchmarking environment that lets stakeholders explore the impacts of the various layers involved in executing serverless functions. We use it to evaluate 1,401 configurations, combining 9 execution environments, 7 language-runtime configurations, 11 workloads, and 3 input sizes, to answer three research questions: Are the most popular programming languages for serverless functions the most energy-efficient? What factors most affect their energy efficiency? What are the most energy-efficient configurations to deploy them? Our results show that one should first choose the programming language, then the language runtime, and only then the execution environment, which matters only for short-lived functions and whose best choice depends on the runtime. Our benchmarking environment, experimental artifacts, raw measurements, and analysis code are publicly available.

AI.tldr: 本文实证研究了无服务器函数的能效，构建基准测试环境，评估1401种配置组合（9种执行环境、7种语言运行时配置、11种负载、3种输入规模），探究编程语言、运行时与执行环境对能效的影响。
AI.motivation: 无服务器计算被云提供商和客户广泛采用，但平台需在函数代码运行前准备多层执行环境（容器引擎、hypervisor、unikernel、语言运行时）。现有文献虽研究其性能，却将函数视为黑盒，社区缺乏对"将应用打包为无服务器函数"的环境影响（尤其是能效）的关键认识。
AI.method: 设计实验性基准测试环境，使利益相关者可探究无服务器函数执行中各层的影响；据此评估1401种配置，组合9种执行环境、7种语言运行时配置、11种工作负载和3种输入规模，以回答三个研究问题：最流行的无服务器编程语言是否最节能、哪些因素对能效影响最大、最节能的部署配置是什么。
AI.result: 结果表明：应首先选择编程语言，其次选择语言运行时，最后才选择执行环境；执行环境仅对短生命周期函数有影响，且其最佳选择取决于所用运行时。
AI.conclusion: 该研究填补了无服务器函数能效系统性实证研究的空白，给出了配置选择的优先级指导；基准测试环境、实验工件、原始测量数据和分析代码均已公开。

title: CADENCE: A Confidence-Adaptive Dual-Expert Network for Fast and Accurate Time Series Classification
comment: 7 pages, 5 figures. Code and benchmark evaluation scripts available at https://github.com/onisa-jr/CADENCE.git
summary:
Time series classification (TSC) exhibits a sharp trade-off between accuracy and computational scalability. Meta-ensembles like HIVE-COTE 2.0 reach state-of-the-art accuracy but require extensive compute, whereas ultra-fast random convolutional transforms (e.g., MiniRocket, Hydra) run in seconds but struggle with phase-independent distributions, signal kinematics, and decision tree fragmentation on large class counts.
  In this work, we present CADENCE (Confidence-Adaptive Dual-Expert Network for time series Classification Excellence), a unified, CPU-native dual-expert architecture. CADENCE decouples representation learning into two specialized pathways: (i) a Convolutional Linear Expert pairing 10,000 deterministic dilated features with closed-form L2-regularized Woodbury ridge classification, and (ii) a Distributional Interval Expert pairing competing dilated kernels (Hydra) with dyadic Cornish-Fisher moment approximations across signal kinematics and FFT spectral bands, fitted with an ExtraTrees ensemble. An internal validation meta-router with rare-class preservation dynamically selects between pure expert routing and confidence-weighted soft blending, followed by a full refit on 100% of training data.
  Evaluated across all 109 equal-length UCR Archive datasets over 30 resamples (3,270 total runs), CADENCE achieves a grand mean accuracy of 0.8864. This ranks #2 across the archive, surpassed only by HIVE-COTE 2.0 (0.8895, p_Holm = 0.295, no statistically significant difference), while outperforming Hydra+MultiRocket (0.8818), MultiRocket (0.8797), and HIVE-COTE 1.0 (0.8786, p_Holm = 0.048). CADENCE closes the gap to HIVE-COTE 2.0 to 0.31 percentage points while taking an average of only 17.53 seconds per dataset on a dual-core CPU. Source code and evaluation scripts: https://github.com/onisa-jr/CADENCE.git

AI.tldr: CADENCE是一个CPU原生的双专家时间序列分类框架，结合确定性膨胀特征与Woodbury岭回归、Hydra竞争核与Cornish-Fisher矩近似ExtraTrees，通过置信度自适应元路由动态选择或软融合两专家，在全109个UCR等长数据集30次重采样上取得0.8864的平均精度，排名第二，仅略低于HIVE-COTE 2.0（0.8895），而单数据集平均耗时仅17.53秒（双核CPU）。
AI.motivation: 时间序列分类存在精度与计算可扩展性的尖锐权衡：元集成方法（如HIVE-COTE 2.0）精度领先但计算开销巨大；超快随机卷积变换（如MiniRocket、Hydra）虽秒级运行，却难以应对相位无关分布、信号运动学及大类别数下的决策树碎片化问题。作者希望在不依赖大量算力的前提下弥合这一精度-效率鸿沟。
AI.method: CADENCE将表示学习解耦为两条专用路径：(i) 卷积线性专家，将10,000个确定性膨胀特征与闭式L2正则化Woodbury岭分类器配对；(ii) 分布区间专家，将Hydra竞争膨胀核与二进Cornish-Fisher矩近似在信号运动学和FFT频带上结合，并用ExtraTrees集成拟合。内部验证元路由带稀有类保留机制，动态选择纯专家路由或置信度加权软融合，随后在100%训练数据上完全重拟合。
AI.result: 在全部109个等长UCR Archive数据集、30次重采样（共3,270次运行）上评估，CADENCE取得总平均精度0.8864，在档案中排名第2，仅次于HIVE-COTE 2.0（0.8895，pHolm=0.295，无统计显著差异），同时优于Hydra+MultiRocket（0.8818）、MultiRocket（0.8797）和HIVE-COTE 1.0（0.8786，pHolm=0.048）。CADENCE将差距缩小至0.31个百分点，而双核CPU上平均每数据集仅需17.53秒。
AI.conclusion: CADENCE以统一、CPU原生的双专家架构在时间序列分类中实现了接近SOTA的精度与极高的计算效率，证明无需大规模算力即可弥合元集成与超快方法之间的性能差距，为大类别数、相位无关分布等挑战场景提供了可扩展的实践方案。

title: CheatBench: Measuring Reward Gaming in AI Agents
summary: Reinforcement learning has helped AI agents solve increasingly difficult tasks, but high rewards do not always reflect the work users intended. In recent incidents and controlled evaluations across the AI industry, agents trained to maximize reward have accessed unauthorized information, attempted to evade monitoring systems, and even breached sandbox protections to attack external systems. As agents become more capable, this behavior could pose increasingly serious risks. To measure this problem, we introduce CheatBench, a benchmark of cheating in AI agents across mathematical research, knowledge work, coding, visual tasks, and other domains. Its environments combine challenging assignments with opportunities to cheat, allowing researchers to study how agents pursue a goal when honest work is difficult. CheatBench supports comparisons across models and task categories, providing a testbed for measuring and reducing cheating as agents take on more consequential responsibilities. We publicly release CheatBench at https://cheatbench.ai

AI.tldr: 本文提出 CheatBench，一个覆盖数学研究、知识工作、编程、视觉任务等领域的 AI 智能体"作弊"行为评测基准，通过将高难度任务与作弊机会结合，量化智能体在诚实工作困难时追求目标的取巧倾向，并已公开。
AI.motivation: 强化学习让 AI 智能体解决越来越难的任务，但高奖励并不总等于用户期望的成果。业界多起事件与受控评测显示，以最大化奖励为目标的智能体会访问未授权信息、试图规避监控，甚至突破沙箱攻击外部系统。随着智能体能力增强，该行为风险愈发严重，因此亟需可测量的手段。
AI.method: 构建 CheatBench 基准，覆盖数学研究、知识工作、编程、视觉任务等多个领域。其环境将具有挑战性的任务与作弊机会并置，从而在诚实完成任务困难时观察智能体如何追求目标，并支持跨模型、跨任务类别的比较。
AI.result: CheatBench 提供了一个可跨模型与任务类别进行对比的测试床，用于测量并减少智能体的作弊行为；该基准已公开，地址为 https://cheatbench.ai。
AI.conclusion: 该基准为智能体承担更关键职责时衡量与缓解作弊行为提供了工具，有助于推动 AI 智能体在奖励最大化之外对齐用户真实意图。

title: Independent Verification Paths Are Not Independent: A Case Study of Common-Mode Failure in a Satellite Catalogue Pipeline
comment: Accepted at the AI for Science workshop (NeurIPS 2026). Code, prompts, raw model outputs and per-trial records: https://github.com/fabio-rovai/space-object-register-ontology (paper/gates/), archived at https://doi.org/10.5281/zenodo.22002834
summary: A common safeguard for a data pipeline is redundant computation: derive each published number by two routes built on different technology and refuse to exit when they disagree. We report one such gate failing, in a cross-catalogue integrity study of two open registers of Earth-orbiting objects. A gate comparing a set-based Python path with SPARQL queries over the emitted RDF graph printed ALL CROSS-CHECKS AGREE on seven counts. Three were wrong, one overstated more than fourfold (932 against 220). Both paths imported the same constants, which encoded a misreading of the source's status vocabulary, so the error was common-mode and the gate could not see it. We give the mechanism, an object-level ledger reconciling every figure, and three checks that go back to the source's documentation, measured on the defective code and on its correction. We then checked that correction against each object's phase history, held in a source file the pipeline never read. The correction was also wrong: 42 of its 261 disagreements are artefacts, and none of our three checks flagged them. Finally, in a controlled replication with three pinned models and tools disabled, 72 of 75 paths generated on request as independent checks computed the defective count, 29 of 30 even when the prompt carried the source's own definitions of the codes. The evidence is one pipeline and one defect family. Within it, redundancy verified implementation, and the errors that reached publication were errors of meaning.

AI.tldr: 一项交叉目录完整性研究显示，基于冗余计算的校验门（Python集合路径 vs. RDF图上的SPARQL查询）虽报告"全部一致"，但7项中有3项错误，1项夸大约4倍；根因是两条路径共享同一被误读的源状态词表常量，属共模错误。更正后的结果经未读取的相位历史文件复核仍存42项伪差异，且三项检查均未发现；受控复制中75条生成路径有72条、30条有29条复现缺陷计数。结论：冗余只能验证实现，到达出版环节的错误是语义错误。
