We identify a low-dimensional subspace of early representation drift, which we call a scaffold, and test whether it is reused across subsequent tasks. Across four pretrained visual encoders and two datasets, later representational changes consistently favor this early-defined subspace over matched random alternatives. This reuse is history-dependent: when networks experience different early tasks but identical later training inputs, each network preferentially reuses the scaffold induced by its own learning history. The same preference appears in individual optimizer updates, even though the network's dominant local response directions shift away from the original scaffold. Finally, constraining motion within the scaffold slows new-task acquisition more than matched random constraints, while effects on old-task retention are less consistent. In summary, these results suggest that early experience leaves a persistent geometric imprint on how neural networks adapt to future tasks.

AI.tldr: 该研究报告了神经网络早期表征漂移形成的低维子空间（称为"scaffold"），后续任务的学习会持续复用这一早期几何结构。
AI.motivation: 探究表征在网络学习新任务过程中持续变化时，早期的表征变化是否自然形成某种几何结构，并持续影响后续学习。
AI.method: 定义早期表征漂移的低维子空间为scaffold，在4个预训练视觉编码器和2个数据集上，检验后续表征变化是否优先发生于该子空间（对比匹配的随机子空间）；并设计早期任务不同但后续训练输入相同的实验，以及单次优化器更新的分析，最后通过约束运动方向验证因果作用。
AI.result: 后续表征变化一致地偏好早期定义的子空间而非匹配随机替代；这种复用依赖历史——不同早期任务的网络各自偏好自身历史诱导的scaffold；单次优化器更新中同样出现该偏好，即使网络主导局部响应方向已偏离原scaffold；将运动约束在scaffold内比随机约束更明显减慢新任务习得，而对旧任务保持的影响不一致。
AI.conclusion: 早期经验在神经网络如何适应未来任务上留下持久的几何印记。

title: Learning to Harvest Without Collapse in a Regenerative Commons: A Lagrangian Framework
summary: The tragedy of the commons poses a multi-agent safety problem: reward-seeking agents can deplete a shared resource, and cooperation among its users does not itself specify how much must be preserved. We make preservation an explicit requirement by formulating a regenerative commons as a constrained Markov game or a constrained multi-agent MDP with a designer-specified depletion budget. We develop a nonstationary Lagrangian framework that constructs a policy sequence from solutions of unconstrained games or cooperative control problems. Extending earlier time-average constructions, we introduce average-epoch solution concepts for reset episodes with discounted rewards and terminal costs. We prove a reward-independent feasibility certificate, cooperative feasibility and approximate optimality against feasible policy mixtures, and an extension to unbiased sampled costs. For self-interested agents, a constrained Nash certificate quantifies the price-dispersion term introduced by deviations that redistribute budget across epochs. Under the stated assumptions on solver accuracy and multiplier updates, these results give constrained policy-sequence guarantees using solutions of unconstrained problems. Experiments with constrained IPPO and MAPPO in a Gordon-Schaefer fishery examine how depletion budgets shape stock retention, harvest rewards, and price adaptation.

AI.tldr: 本文将"再生性公地"形式化为带耗尽预算约束的约束马尔可夫博弈/约束多智能体MDP，提出非平稳拉格朗日框架，由无约束博弈解构造策略序列，并给出可行性证书、近似最优性及约束Nash证书，最后在渔业实验中验证。
AI.motivation: 公地悲剧是典型的多智能体安全问题：追求奖励的智能体会耗尽共享资源，而用户间的合作本身并不能明确应保留多少资源。作者希望通过引入设计者指定的耗尽预算，把"资源保护"变成显式的约束要求。
AI.method: 将再生性公地建模为带耗尽预算的约束马尔可夫博弈或约束多智能体MDP；构建非平稳拉格朗日框架，从无约束博弈或协作控制问题的解构造策略序列；扩展先前的时间平均构造，提出面向重置回合、含折扣奖励与终端成本的"平均回合"解概念；并扩展到无偏采样成本情形。
AI.result: 证明了与奖励无关的可行性证书、相对于可行策略混合的协作可行性与近似最优性、无偏采样成本的扩展；对自利智能体给出约束Nash证书，量化了跨回合重新分配预算的偏离所带来的价格分散项。在给定求解器精度与乘子更新假设下，这些结果用无约束问题的解提供了约束策略序列保证。在Gordon-Schaefer渔业中，用约束IPPO与MAPPO实验考察耗尽预算如何影响种群保留、收获奖励与价格适应。
AI.conclusion: 通过显式耗尽预算约束与非平稳拉格朗日方法，可在仅求解无约束问题的条件下获得约束策略序列的理论保证，并在多智能体渔业实验中体现了预算对资源保留与收益权衡的调控作用。

title: PHASE: A Physiology-Guided Hierarchical Foundation Model for Intracranial EEG
summary: Clinicians and neuroscientists have long analyzed intracranial electroencephalography (iEEG) through directly measurable physiological characteristics, which carry much of the information that downstream tasks depend on. Recent iEEG foundation models learn by reconstructing or predicting their inputs, which leaves the retention of these characteristics implicit. They are also evaluated mainly on cognitive decoding and a narrow clinical task, i.e., seizure detection. On a broad, clinically relevant benchmark such as Omni-iEEG, they remain below task-specific models when used frozen. We introduce PHASE, a physiology-guided foundation model that makes these characteristics explicit learning targets, pairing them with masked latent prediction in a temporal stage (PHASE-T) within each channel and a spatiotemporal stage (PHASE-ST) across synchronized channels. PHASE is pretrained on heterogeneous recordings from 222 participants at nine clinical sites. On all five Omni-iEEG clinical tasks, frozen PHASE-T outperforms every evaluated foundation model by up to 31\%, and fine-tuned PHASE-T surpasses the task-specific models, setting a new state of the art. PHASE-T benefits from physiological supervision, outperforming variants trained with latent prediction alone or auxiliary waveform reconstruction on every task in matched ablations. PHASE-T generalizes to unseen institutions, outperforming the compared models with few or no local labels. PHASE-ST further improves seizure-onset-zone identification over PHASE-T and, when frozen, decodes sound volume and pitch on BrainTreebank better than published models. Beyond task performance, PHASE learns to encapsulate the physiological characteristics clinicians recognize, from seizure onset and its propagation to anatomical region identity, even though its pretraining contains no ictal recordings or anatomical labels.

AI.tldr: PHASE：以生理特征为显式学习目标的iEEG基础模型，在Omni-iEEG五个临床任务上全面超越现有基础模型与任务专用模型。
AI.motivation: 现有iEEG基础模型多通过重构或预测输入进行自监督学习，导致可测量的生理特征保留是隐式的；评测也局限于认知解码和癫痫检测这一狭窄临床任务，在Omni-iEEG等广泛临床基准上以冻结方式使用时仍落后于任务专用模型。
AI.method: 提出PHASE生理引导基础模型，将生理特征作为显式学习目标，并与掩码潜在预测配对，分为通道内时间阶段（PHASE-T）与跨同步通道的时空阶段（PHASE-ST）。在9个临床站点222名参与者的异质记录上预训练。
AI.result: 在Omni-iEEG全部五个临床任务上，冻结的PHASE-T超越所有被评估基础模型最高达31%；微调后PHASE-T超过任务专用模型并刷新SOTA。匹配消融中，生理监督优于仅潜在预测或辅助波形重构的变体。PHASE-T可泛化到未见机构，在少量或无本地标签时优于对比模型。PHASE-ST在癫痫起始区识别上进一步提升，冻结时在BrainTreebank上对音量和音高的解码优于已发表模型。模型还能捕捉临床医生识别的生理特征（癫痫起始及传播、解剖区域身份），尽管预训练数据不含发作期记录或解剖标签。
AI.conclusion: 显式生理监督的PHASE在广泛临床基准上刷新SOTA，具备跨机构泛化能力与临床可解释性，证实生理引导预训练对iEEG基础模型的有效性。

title: Human-AI Collaboration: From Paradoxes to Patterns
comment: This is the author's version of the work. It is posted here for your personal use. Not for redistribution. The definitive Version of Record will be published in 33rd Conference on Pattern Languages of Programs (PLoP 2026)
summary: Evidence shows that humans and AI systems perform better together, by collaborating, than alone. This paper examines two key design dimensions of human-AI collaboration (autonomy and initiative) and explores the collaboration patterns that they generate. Documenting these patterns starts with identifying the underlying problems and solutions, followed by examining the internal tensions within the problems. The paper uses a paradox perspective to analyze those tensions. It describes a process for surfacing the tensions and mapping the underlying paradoxes. It also illustrates how the pattern descriptions can be derived from mapping these paradoxes. Finally, the paper documents four human-AI collaboration patterns: Instruction, Delegation, Assistance, and Co-creation.

AI.tldr: 本文从自主性与主动权两个设计维度出发，借助悖论视角识别人机协作中的内在张力，映射底层悖论并推导描述，最终归纳出指导（Instruction）、委托（Delegation）、辅助（Assistance）与共创（Co-creation）四种人机协作模式。
AI.motivation: 已有证据表明人类与AI系统协作时整体表现优于单独工作，但如何设计有效的人机协作尚缺乏系统性的模式归纳。本文关注自主性与主动权这两个关键设计维度，旨在揭示它们所生成的协作模式及其背后的内在矛盾。
AI.method: 采用悖论视角（paradox perspective）分析人机协作中的内在张力。研究首先识别底层的问题与解决方案，继而考察问题内部的张力；随后提出一套流程来显现张力并映射底层悖论，并说明如何由这些悖论的映射推导出模式描述。
AI.result: 通过上述映射过程，归纳出四种人机协作模式：指导（Instruction）、委托（Delegation）、辅助（Assistance）与共创（Co-creation），并给出各模式基于自主性与主动权组合的描述。
AI.conclusion: 该研究为理解和设计人机协作提供了以悖论为基础的分析框架与模式划分，说明自主性与主动权的不同配置会产生差异化的协作形态，为后续协作系统的设计提供了理论依据。

title: Data Unlearning via Inverse Distillation
summary: Multi-step matching models, including flow and diffusion models, produce high-quality outputs but incur substantial inference costs and may reproduce unwanted components of their training datasets. We introduce Inverse Distillation Unlearning (IDU), a unified framework that simultaneously distills a teacher multi-step matching model into an efficient one-step student generator and suppresses outputs corresponding to a designated training subset. We first formulate distillation as a min-max objective over a data distribution and then represent this distribution as a mixture of the forget-set and the generated distributions. This allows us to compare this mixture with the teacher's training distribution and recover only the retained data at the optimum. Our method requires only a pretrained full-data teacher and data from the forget set, without access to retained training examples, extra feature extractors or classifiers. Extensive experiments on MNIST and CIFAR-10 datasets under flow-matching and score-based diffusion settings demonstrate that IDU substantially reduces the generation frequency of forgotten classes while preserving generation quality on the retained classes. To the best of our knowledge, IDU is the first unified framework for simultaneous unlearning and distillation in unconditional flow-matching and score-based models.

AI.tldr: 提出 Inverse Distillation Unlearning (IDU) 统一框架，同时实现多步匹配模型（flow/diffusion）的一步蒸馏与遗忘集消除，无需保留集样本、额外特征提取器或分类器。
AI.motivation: 多步匹配模型（flow、diffusion）生成质量高但推理成本大，且可能复现训练数据中不希望出现的成分。现有方法通常将蒸馏与机器遗忘分开处理，缺乏统一的解决方案，且往往依赖保留训练样本或额外网络组件，存在数据与资源限制。
AI.method: 将蒸馏形式化为数据分布上的 min-max 目标；把该分布表示为遗忘集分布与生成分布的混合；通过将混合分布与教师训练分布对比，在最优解处仅恢复保留数据。方法仅需预训练的全数据教师模型与遗忘集数据，无需保留训练样本、额外特征提取器或分类器。
AI.result: 在 MNIST 与 CIFAR-10 数据集上，针对 flow-matching 与基于 score 的扩散设置进行大量实验，IDU 显著降低被遗忘类别的生成频率，同时在保留类别上维持生成质量。
AI.conclusion: IDU 是首个在无条件 flow-matching 与基于 score 的模型中同时实现遗忘与蒸馏的统一框架，兼顾推理效率与遗忘效果，且对数据与模型资源要求低。

title: AVIO: Learning to Add and Remove Sounding Objects in Audiovisual Scenes
summary: Adding or removing a sounding object requires coordinated changes to visual content and sound while preserving the surrounding scene. Yet paired supervision for localized non-speech audiovisual editing remains limited, as visual and acoustic edits must target the same object and isolate its sound from overlapping sources. To address this gap, we introduce \textit{AVIOBench}, a dataset comprising 37.9 hours of paired audiovisual examples spanning 1{,}878 target-object names. AVIOBench links the visual presence and acoustic contribution of each target object through a shared identity and visual mask. Our automated pipeline uses visual grounding and cross-modal consistency to select target-sound removal candidates, then jointly refines the audiovisual pairs to improve perceptual quality and cross-modal consistency. Building on this dataset, we propose \textit{AVIO}, which adapts a pretrained text-to audiovisual generation model through source-conditioned feature modulation to jointly learn object addition and removal. A reference-frame curriculum gradually reduces reference conditioning during training, enabling one model to perform instruction-only editing with optional visual guidance. Quantitative and qualitative evaluations demonstrate effective audiovisual object removal and addition, with optional reference guidance providing appearance and placement control for addition.

AI.tldr: 该论文提出AVIOBench数据集与AVIO模型，实现局部非语音视听对象的添加与移除编辑。
AI.motivation: 在视听编辑中，添加或移除一个发声对象需要同时协调视觉内容与声音，并保持周围场景不变。然而，针对局部非语音对象的配对监督数据稀缺，且视觉与声学编辑必须指向同一对象，还需将其声音从重叠声源中分离出来，这一直是难点。
AI.method: 1）构建AVIOBench数据集：包含37.9小时配对视听样本，覆盖1878个目标对象名称，通过共享身份标识与视觉掩码将目标对象的视觉存在与声学贡献关联；采用自动化流程，利用视觉定位与跨模态一致性筛选目标声音移除候选，并联合精炼视听对以提升感知质量与跨模态一致性。2）提出AVIO模型：基于预训练文本到视听生成模型，通过源条件特征调制联合学习对象添加与移除；采用参考帧课程学习，在训练中逐步减少参考条件，使单一模型既能进行仅指令编辑，也支持可选视觉引导。
AI.result: 定量与定性评估表明，模型能有效完成视听对象的移除与添加；可选的参考引导在添加任务中可控制对象的外观与放置位置。
AI.conclusion: AVIOBench弥补了局部非语音视听编辑配对监督的空白，AVIO以统一框架实现对象添加与移除，并支持可选参考引导，验证了该数据与方法的有效性。

title: LoopICL: Looping a single transformer block to solve tabular tasks
summary: Tabular foundation models using in-context learning have recently surpassed gradient-boosted trees on predictive tabular tasks. However, recent mechanistic insights suggest that parameters in these models are largely redundant. We introduce LoopICL, a looped transformer whose core design decouples parameter count from computational depth. LoopICL consists of a single block, processing data through two coupled streams: a cell stream capturing per-cell feature representations and a row stream capturing in-context example representations, jointly refined through within-column and cross-column attention. During pre-training, we vary loop counts, allowing the block to be unrolled for a varying number of iterations at test-time and use a learned exit-gate to automatically exit. In its standard setting, LoopICL performs competitively with TabICLv2 on TabArena and TALENT at the same computational cost (FLOPs), while using nearly 90% fewer parameters. Furthermore, its recurrent design enables users to also trade off inference cost and performance, providing a resource-aware TFM.

AI.tldr: LoopICL是一种循环Transformer表格基础模型，通过单块循环结构将参数量与计算深度解耦，参数减少近90%的同时性能与TabICLv2相当，并支持推理成本与性能的灵活权衡。
AI.motivation: 现有使用上下文学习（ICL）的表格基础模型虽已超越梯度提升树，但机理研究显示其参数存在大量冗余。作者希望将参数量与计算深度解耦，从而在降低参数规模的同时保持预测性能，并提供资源感知的灵活性。
AI.method: 提出LoopICL，一种循环式（looped）Transformer，核心为单个block。该block通过两条耦合的数据流处理数据：cell stream捕捉逐单元格特征表示，row stream捕捉上下文示例表示，二者通过列内（within-column）与跨列（cross-column）注意力联合精炼。预训练时变化loop次数，使block在测试时可展开为不同迭代次数，并采用学习到的exit-gate自动决定退出时机。
AI.result: 在标准设置下，LoopICL在相同计算成本（FLOPs）下于TabArena与TALENT基准上与TabICLv2表现相当，而参数量减少近90%。其循环设计还允许用户在推理成本与性能之间进行权衡。
AI.conclusion: LoopICL验证了通过循环结构解耦参数量与计算深度的可行性，实现了参数量大幅压缩下的竞争力性能，并提供资源感知的表格基础模型范式。

title: BRIDGE: Bilevel Retrieval-Credit-Aware Agentic Reinforcement Learning
summary: Agentic reinforcement learning (ARL) with verifiable rewards improves the ability of large language models (LLMs) to tackle knowledge-intensive tasks by learning to interleave search and reasoning. However, most existing ARL methods optimize only LLM-generated tokens and treat retrieved evidence as environment observations. This creates an information-credit gap: failures caused by missing or misleading evidence are attributed to the LLM policy rather than to the retriever, which motivates training the LLM and the retriever jointly. In this paper, we show that retrieval and LLM policy learning are order-sensitive: adapting the retriever before optimizing the policy yields a larger reward gain than the reverse order. To preserve this hierarchy while allowing both components to co-adapt, we formulate retrieval-augmented agentic RL as a bilevel optimization problem. To solve it efficiently, we introduce BRIDGE, a memory-efficient first-order bilevel method motivated by a loss-landscape analysis of the RL and retrieval objectives. Across seven open-domain QA benchmarks, BRIDGE achieves the highest average accuracy with both 3B and 7B backbones, improving the multi-hop average over the strongest baseline by 9.6 and 3.4 EM points, respectively. It also achieves the best averaged answer accuracy and reasoning quality across medical QA benchmarks.

AI.tldr: 该论文提出将检索增强的智能体强化学习（ARL）建模为双层优化问题，并给出高效的BRIDGE方法，实现LLM策略与检索器的联合优化。
AI.motivation: 现有ARL方法仅优化LLM生成的token，将检索到的证据视为环境观测，存在"信息信用缺口"：由缺失或误导性证据导致的失败被归咎于LLM策略而非检索器，因此需要联合训练LLM与检索器。此外，作者发现检索器与LLM策略的学习具有顺序敏感性，先适配检索器再优化策略能带来更大收益。
AI.method: 将检索增强的智能体RL形式化为双层优化问题，以保持"检索器优先"的层级结构同时允许两者协同适应。为高效求解，基于对RL目标与检索目标损失地形的分析，提出BRIDGE——一种内存高效的一阶双层优化方法。
AI.result: 在七个开放域QA基准上，BRIDGE在3B和7B骨干模型下均取得最高平均准确率，多跳平均较最强基线分别提升9.6和3.4 EM点；在医学QA基准上也取得最佳平均答案准确率和推理质量。
AI.conclusion: 检索与LLM策略学习具有顺序敏感性，将检索增强ARL建模为双层优化并采用BRIDGE求解，能够有效弥合信息信用缺口，在开放域与医学QA任务上全面超越基线。

title: Koa-action: Fast and Consistent Structured Decision Making with Generative LLMs
summary: Industry applications often demand low-latency classification, yet current large language model (LLM) approaches remain poorly suited for latency-critical applications. Existing prompting and constrained decoding produce verbose, multi-token outputs that require expensive token-by-token generation, while encoder-based models achieve faster inference but sacrifice task flexibility. We propose Koa-action, a framework for low-latency atomic actions -- fast, single-step decisions such as classification, semantic endpointing, Boolean checks, and scoring -- formulated as constrained generation with single-token outputs. By introducing atomic label tokens and applying supervised fine-tuning, our method reduces classification to a deterministic one-step decoding problem. Across standard benchmarks, Koa-action delivers competitive accuracy with consistently low and stable latency. On a production intent-routing benchmark, Koa-action reaches 85.5% accuracy -- competitive with the strongest frontier models (Claude-4.8-Opus, Gemini-Pro-3.1) and ahead of GPT-5 and Gemini-2.5-Pro -- while answering in about half a second, several-fold faster than every frontier model (up to ~7.5x at the median) under identical serving conditions. Against the dedicated single-token system Jev/TypeSafe, Koa-action is competitive on accuracy and faster at the median, while also handling multimodal inputs and multi-label outputs that single-label text systems do not.

AI.tldr: Koa-action 提出将分类、语义端点检测、布尔判断和打分等原子动作建模为单 token 约束生成，通过原子标签 token 与监督微调实现一步确定性解码，在保持竞争性精度的同时获得稳定低延迟。
AI.motivation: 工业场景要求低延迟分类，但现有 LLM 方法（提示工程与约束解码）产生多 token 冗长输出、需逐 token 生成，推理昂贵；而基于编码器的模型虽推理快却牺牲任务灵活性。因此需要兼顾低延迟与任务灵活性的方案。
AI.method: 提出 Koa-action 框架，将原子动作（分类、语义端点检测、布尔检查、打分）形式化为单 token 输出的约束生成。核心手段是引入原子标签 token（atomic label tokens）并进行监督微调，把分类简化为确定性的单步解码问题。支持多模态输入与多标签输出。
AI.result: 在标准基准上取得有竞争力的精度且延迟低而稳定。生产意图路由基准上达到 85.5% 准确率，与最强前沿模型（Claude-4.8-Opus、Gemini-Pro-3.1）相当，领先 GPT-5 与 Gemini-2.5-Pro；约半秒内响应，在相同服务条件下中位数最高快约 7.5 倍。相对专用单 token 系统 Jev/TypeSafe，精度相当且中位数更快，并额外支持多模态输入与多标签输出。
AI.conclusion: Koa-action 验证了以单 token 约束生成实现低延迟原子动作的可行性：在不牺牲精度的前提下显著降低并稳定延迟，兼具多模态与多标签能力，适用于延迟敏感的工业分类与路由任务。

title: MAADBench: The Refreshable Paradigm for Anomaly Detection in Multi-Agent Systems
summary: Recent studies report that LLM-based multi-agent systems (MAS) fail at rates of 41%-87%, yet to our knowledge, no benchmark to date supports systematic anomaly detection (AD) for them. Building MAS AD benchmarks is hard because they must remain fresh as LLM systems evolve: tasks may leak into training data and thus be memorized by LLMs, traces and anomaly patterns expire as backbones evolve, and labels must be provided reliably for each refresh. To address these challenges, we present MAADBench (MA: multi-agent; AD: anomaly detection), the first refreshable MAS AD benchmark designed for diverse, evolving LLM backbones underlying the agents. MAADBench combines (1) sampled-and-coupled generative tasks over an approximately 10^37-task space to mitigate task leakage, (2) refreshable trace generation under configurable LLM backbones, and (3) automated provision of cost-free, deterministic step-level labels for fine-grained AD evaluation. Beyond offering the paradigm itself, we run MAADBench with five state-of-the-art LLM backbones and release the MAADBench-Full dataset with 5,200 step-labeled traces. Benchmarking 25 AD methods on the MAADBench dataset reveals substantial limitations in current approaches: they rely heavily on supervision, struggle with subtle MAS-specific anomalies, and lack robustness across LLM backbones. These gaps point to a rich research agenda for MAS-specific anomaly detection, with MAADBench providing a systematic and refreshable testbed for method development and evaluation. We open-source MAADBench-Full at https://huggingface.co/datasets/hww123/MAADBench-full.

AI.tldr: 提出首个可刷新的多智能体系统异常检测基准 MAADBench，含约 10^37 任务空间、可刷新轨迹生成与自动化步级标签，并发布 5,200 条标注轨迹数据集及 25 种方法评测。
AI.motivation: LLM 多智能体系统失败率高达 41%-87%，但尚无基准支持系统化的异常检测。构建此类基准的难点在于需随 LLM 演进保持新鲜：任务可能泄漏进训练数据被记忆、轨迹与异常模式会随后续模型过期、每次刷新都需可靠标注。
AI.method: MAADBench 由三部分构成：(1) 采样-耦合的生成式任务，覆盖约 10^37 任务空间以缓解任务泄漏；(2) 在可配置 LLM 骨干下可刷新的轨迹生成；(3) 自动提供零成本、确定性的步级标签，用于细粒度异常检测评估。
AI.result: 在五种先进 LLM 骨干上运行并发布含 5,200 条步级标注轨迹的 MAADBench-Full 数据集；对 25 种异常检测方法评测显示当前方法存在明显局限：高度依赖监督、难以处理多智能体特有的细微异常、跨骨干鲁棒性不足。
AI.conclusion: 这些差距指向多智能体专用异常检测的研究议程，MAADBench 提供系统化、可刷新的测试平台，支持方法开发与评估，数据集已开源。

title: Dyad: Extending Large Language Models with Native Typed Decision-Making
summary: We study how to build more capable general-purpose agents by extending large language models (LLMs) with native typed decision-making. We introduce Dyad, an architecture that augments a pretrained LLM with an environment-conditioned action encoder that embeds each candidate action description in parallel, then scores these embeddings against the LLM's internal state to yield a distribution over typed actions. By factorizing decision-making into representations of the evolving interaction state and environment-specific action semantics, Dyad introduces an inductive bias for learning reusable representations while keeping action scoring efficient even as the action space grows. We investigate two complementary reinforcement learning settings driven by environment interaction. With the LLM frozen, training the action encoder alone achieves consistent gains across four unseen environments, enabling modular adaptation without modifying any LLM parameters. Jointly optimizing both components outperforms conventional RL post-training across diverse interactive tasks and model scales, including a 3.80% average absolute gain on ALFWorld with a 9B model, while improving general knowledge, reasoning, and coding.

AI.tldr: 提出 Dyad 架构，为预训练 LLM 增加环境条件化的动作编码器，实现原生类型化决策，通过环境交互强化学习提升通用智能体能力。
AI.motivation: 构建更具能力的通用智能体，需让 LLM 具备原生类型化决策能力；同时希望在不修改 LLM 参数的情况下实现模块化、可复用的决策表示学习，并保持动作空间扩展时的评分效率。
AI.method: Dyad 用环境条件化的动作编码器并行嵌入每个候选动作描述，并将其与 LLM 内部状态打分，得到类型化动作上的分布；将决策分解为交互状态表示与环境特定动作语义两部分，引入可复用表示的归纳偏置，并保证动作打分高效。研究两种由环境交互驱动的 RL 设置：冻结 LLM 仅训练动作编码器；或联合优化两部分。
AI.result: 冻结 LLM、仅训练动作编码器时，在四个未见环境中取得稳定提升，实现无需改动 LLM 参数的模块化适配；联合优化在多种交互任务与模型规模上优于常规 RL 后训练，9B 模型在 ALFWorld 上平均绝对提升 3.80%，并改善通用知识、推理与编码能力。
AI.conclusion: 将类型化决策与 LLM 表征解耦并通过环境交互学习，是提升通用智能体能力的有效途径，兼具模块化适配与联合优化的优势。

title: Visual sensitivity is not claim retractability: persistence-aware credit assignment for multimodal reinforcement learning
summary: Reinforcement Learning with Verifiable Rewards (RLVR) has been extended to Large Vision-Language Models (LVLMs), and perception-aware methods further encourage policies to rely on visual evidence. Yet relying on the image does not guarantee that visual claims are supported by it. Before RL training, 27.81% of the correctly answered responses of Qwen2.5-VL-7B on four multimodal reasoning benchmarks contain at least one direct visual claim that the image does not support. Since outcome-level RL rewards each response as a whole, these claims inherit the positive credit of the correct answer. We introduce a fixed-rollout counterfactual diagnostic that re-scores the same response under an intervened image to separate Evidence-Function Sensitivity (EFS), how strongly the model's predictions change, from claim persistence, whether the model keeps supporting the same claim rather than retracting it. The diagnostic reveals Sensitivity-Persistence Decoupling (SPD): under DAPO and VPPO, EFS increases and claims become more retractable overall, yet unsupported claims become significantly more persistent, whereas GRPO raises EFS without this deterioration. We therefore propose Persistence-Aware Credit Gating (PACG), which attenuates positive credit for unusually persistent visual claims and leaves all other credit unchanged. It requires no supported/unsupported labels and adds no inference cost. On Qwen2.5-VL-7B, PACG raises the nine-benchmark average over three seeds from 58.1% to 59.9% with DAPO and from 59.8% to 60.9% with VPPO, while making unsupported claims more retractable. The gains extend to a larger model, a newer backbone, and the accuracy of HallusionBench also improves consistently. These results suggest that visual sensitivity and claim retractability are complementary dimensions of multimodal credit assignment.

AI.tldr: 论文发现RLVR训练中模型正确答案里存在图像不支持却仍被正向奖励的视觉断言，提出固定回滚反事实诊断揭示“敏感性-坚持性解耦（SPD）”，并据此提出Persistence-Aware Credit Gating（PACG）修正信用分配，在多基准上提升性能并增强不支持断言的撤回性。
AI.motivation: 现有感知感知型RLVR方法虽鼓励LVLM依赖视觉证据，但“依赖图像”不等于“视觉断言被图像支持”。训练前Qwen2.5-VL-7B在四个多模态推理基准上，27.81%的正确回答包含至少一个图像不支持的直接视觉断言；而结果级RL对整条回答整体给奖励，使这些断言继承正确答案的正向信用，造成错误信用分配。
AI.method: 1) 固定回滚反事实诊断：在干预图像下重新评分同一回答，分离“证据-功能敏感性（EFS，预测变化强度）”与“断言坚持性（是否仍支持同一断言而非撤回）”；2) 诊断SPD现象：DAPO与VPPO下EFS升高、断言整体更可撤回，但不支持断言反而更顽固；GRPO仅提升EFS而无此恶化；3) 提出PACG，对异常顽固的视觉断言衰减正向信用，其余信用不变，无需支持/不支持标签且不增加推理成本。
AI.result: 在Qwen2.5-VL-7B上，PACG使九基准三随机种子平均值：DAPO从58.1%提升至59.9%，VPPO从59.8%提升至60.9%，同时使不支持断言更易撤回；增益可扩展至更大模型与新骨干网络，HallusionBench准确率也一致提升。
AI.conclusion: 视觉敏感性与断言可撤回性是多模态信用分配的两个互补维度；仅提升对图像的敏感性不足以消除图像不支持的断言，需在信用层面惩罚异常坚持的视觉断言。

title: Why Backdooring Neural Networks is so Easy?
summary: Securing modern AI systems against backdoor attacks remains an open challenge and requires fundamentally principled estimates of the adversary's budget -- the poison fraction $π$ and trigger strength $α$ needed to construct successful yet stealthy attacks. Motivated by recent empirical evidence that poisoning large language models can require a nearly constant number of malicious samples even as clean datasets grow, we derive an exact closed-form analysis of a quadratic neuron trained on a poisoned Gaussian mixture. We show, perhaps counterintuitively, that the same feature-learning dynamics that make neural networks powerful can also make them more vulnerable to backdoors. Specifically, with clean accuracy preserved to first order, $O(π)$, we demonstrate that lazy learning imposes the inverse-square-root scaling $α\propto π^{-1/2}$ for a successful attack, while feature learning induces a quadratic detector whose loss margin scales as $O(α^4)$, improving the attack budget to $α\propto π^{-1/4}$. Consequently, nonlinear feature learning substantially reduces the trigger strength required at small poison fractions, thereby in a sense making feature learners more backdoor vulnerable. These results provide a theoretical mechanism consistent with large-scale empirical observations and demonstrate that security audits based on linear heuristics can systematically underestimate backdoor vulnerability in the widely adopted feature-learning regimes.

AI.tldr: 本文对毒化高斯混合数据上的二次神经元进行精确闭式分析，揭示特征学习会改变后门攻击的毒化比例与触发强度的权衡关系：懒惰学习下 α∝π^{-1/2}，特征学习下 α∝π^{-1/4}。
AI.motivation: 后门攻击防御仍缺乏对攻击者预算（毒化比例 π 与触发强度 α）的原理性估计。近期经验证据显示，随着干净数据规模增长，毒化大语言模型所需的恶意样本数近乎恒定，亟需理论解释这一现象并刻画其机制。
AI.method: 对在毒化高斯混合分布上训练的二次神经元进行精确闭式分析，在保持一阶清洁精度 O(π) 的前提下，分别推导懒惰学习（lazy learning）与特征学习（feature learning）两种机制下的攻击预算标度律，并分析相应检测器的损失间隔。
AI.result: 懒惰学习要求成功攻击满足 α∝π^{-1/2} 的反平方根标度；特征学习诱导出损失间隔为 O(α^4) 的二次检测器，将攻击预算改善为 α∝π^{-1/4}。因此在小毒化比例下，非线性特征学习显著降低了所需触发强度。
AI.conclusion: 让神经网络强大的特征学习动力学也可能使其更易受后门攻击；该理论机制与大规模经验观察一致，并表明基于线性启发式的安全审计会系统性低估广泛采用的特征学习范式下的后门脆弱性。

title: Divide and Inject: Can Agents Reconstruct an Indirect Prompt Injection from Fragments?
summary: Agentic systems are now being widely used to orchestrate tools and reason over long contexts. However, the improving capabilities of the large language models powering these agents also create new attack surfaces for indirect prompt injection. In particular, an attacker may not need to place a complete malicious instruction in retrieved content if the agent can reconstruct the objective from incomplete fragments distributed across a long context. In this work, we introduce adaptive long-context prompt injection (AdaLCPI), which combines long-context fragmentation with adaptive search. AdaLCPI splits an attack objective into incomplete fragments, embeds them in external content retrieved through the agent's tools, and uses a reconstruction cue to prompt the agent to combine them. It then iteratively refines the fragments and cue with OpenEvolve using graded scoring and natural-language execution feedback from the target agent. Empirically, AdaLCPI achieves higher attack success than strong adaptive baselines, reaching 61.4\% macro-average ASR compared with 32.8\% for Trojan Hippo-style and 30.0\% for AgentVigil. Safety evaluations should therefore test whether agents remain robust when harmful objectives must be reconstructed from incomplete fragments.

AI.tldr: 本文提出AdaLCPI，一种结合长上下文碎片化与自适应搜索的间接提示注入攻击方法，将攻击目标拆分为不完整片段嵌入检索内容，并用重构线索引导智能体组合，再借助OpenEvolve迭代优化，攻击成功率显著高于基线。
AI.motivation: 智能体系统广泛用于编排工具和长上下文推理，但驱动智能体的大语言模型能力提升也带来间接提示注入的新攻击面：攻击者可能无需在检索内容中放入完整恶意指令，只要智能体能从长上下文里分布的碎片中重构出攻击目标即可。因此需要研究这种碎片化重构式攻击，并据此改进安全评估。
AI.method: 提出AdaLCPI（自适应长上下文提示注入），将攻击目标拆分为不完整片段，嵌入智能体工具检索到的外部内容中，并用重构线索促使智能体将其组合。随后使用带分级评分和目标智能体自然语言执行反馈的OpenEvolve，迭代优化片段与线索。
AI.result: 实验表明，AdaLCPI攻击成功率高于强自适应基线，宏平均ASR达61.4%，而Trojan Hippo-style为32.8%，AgentVigil为30.0%。
AI.conclusion: 安全评估应测试当有害目标必须从不完整片段中重构时，智能体是否仍保持鲁棒，即需将碎片化重构场景纳入提示注入防御评测。

title: ThinQuant: Scalable Rotation Learning for Weight and Activation Quantization of LLMs
summary: Learned rotations play an important role in enabling low-bit weight and activation quantization of large language models by smoothing outliers in the activation distribution. State-of-the-art approaches include gradient-based procedures such as SpinQuant and computationally friendlier gradient-free approaches such as DartQuant, but both remain hard to scale to the largest architectures. To address the computational bottlenecks in gradient-free rotation learning, we introduce two ideas for efficiency, (i) a data selection procedure which reduces the required number of calibration data points, and (ii) an exact reduction of the associated optimization on this reduced calibration set. Our data selection procedure exploits the geometric structure of the convex hull of the activations. Using this idea, we show that a carefully selected calibration set with several orders of magnitude fewer activations than state-of-the-art rotation-based methods can match their performance in low-bit quantization settings. Under this extreme data efficiency, the selected activations span an $r$-dimensional subspace with $r<d$, making optimization over a $d\times d$ rotation equivalent to optimizing a $d\times r$ matrix on the Stiefel manifold. We solve this reduced problem using an efficient ADMM algorithm that iteratively employs thin matrix updates at every step, hence the name ThinQuant. For Llama-3-70B with W4A4KV4 quantization, ThinQuant completes the entire rotation calibration in under 12 minutes and achieves a WikiText-2 perplexity of 5.63, compared with 7.55 for DartQuant, which requires 111 minutes. Unlike SpinQuant and DartQuant, ThinQuant also scales to Llama-3.1-405B on a single H200 GPU, completing rotation calibration in just over 2 hours and achieving WikiText-2 perplexity of 2.97 at W4A4, compared with 3.48 for GPTAQ+QuaRoT.

AI.tldr: ThinQuant通过凸包几何数据选择与Stiefel流形上的降维优化，实现大语言模型低比特量化旋转变换的高效标定，在Llama-3-70B与405B上以显著更低的时间达到更优困惑度。
AI.motivation: 旋转学习对LLM低比特权重与激活量化中的激活离群值平滑至关重要，但现有方法如SpinQuant（基于梯度）与DartQuant（无梯度但更轻量）都难以扩展到最大规模架构。核心瓶颈在于无梯度旋转学习所需的标定数据量与优化计算开销过大。
AI.method: 提出两项效率改进：(i) 利用激活凸包的几何结构进行数据选择，大幅减少所需标定点数；(ii) 在该缩减标定集上对相关优化进行精确降维。由于精选激活张成r维子空间（r<d），原d×d旋转优化等价于Stiefel流形上优化d×r矩阵，并采用高效ADMM算法以薄矩阵更新迭代求解，故名ThinQuant。
AI.result: Llama-3-70B W4A4KV4：ThinQuant 12分钟内完成旋转标定，WikiText-2困惑度5.63，对比DartQuant的111分钟与7.55。ThinQuant可单张H200 GPU扩展至Llama-3.1-405B，标定约2小时，W4A4下WikiText-2困惑度2.97，对比GPTAQ+QuaRoT的3.48。数据量比SOTA旋转方法少数个数量级仍匹配性能。
AI.conclusion: ThinQuant通过几何数据选择与降维精确优化，突破了无梯度旋转学习的计算瓶颈，在保持甚至超越SOTA精度的同时大幅降低标定成本，并使超大规模模型（405B）在单卡上的低比特量化标定成为可行。

title: SafeCoEvo: Co-Evolving Safety Harnesses and Guards for LLM Agents at Test-Time
summary: LLM agents deployed in real-world environments continually encounter new tasks and safety risks, while execution feedback typically becomes available only after each task is completed. However, existing self-evolving approaches commonly rely on multiple rounds of optimization over fixed and repeatedly accessible task distributions, fundamentally differing from test-time adaptation in real-world deployment, where only experience accumulated from past tasks can be used to improve safety decisions on future unseen tasks. To address this limitation, we propose SafeCoEvo, a test-time Harness-Guard co-evolution framework for LLM agent safety that enables the external safety system to continually adapt from accumulated runtime experience. SafeCoEvo jointly improves two complementary safety capabilities at different timescales: S-Harness rapidly externalizes recent runtime experience into updatable explicit safety knowledge that can promptly influence subsequent tasks, while GuardVPO internalizes accumulated runtime safety experience over a longer timescale into parametric risk-judgment capabilities. By combining short-term rapid adaptation with long-term capability consolidation, SafeCoEvo continually improves the agent's safety capabilities, reducing the unsafe outcome rate by 10.05% while improving the task success rate by 12.15% over the strongest baseline, thereby achieving simultaneous gains in safety and task utility.

AI.tldr: 提出 SafeCoEvo——一种面向 LLM 智能体的测试时"外挂-守卫"协同演化框架，通过短期显式安全知识更新与长期参数化风险判断能力固化，实现真实部署场景下从历史经验持续提升未来未见任务的安全性，不安全结果率降低 10.05%、任务成功率提升 12.15%。
AI.motivation: 真实环境中的 LLM 智能体不断遇到新任务与新安全风险，且执行反馈往往只在任务完成后才可得；而现有自演化方法依赖对固定、可反复访问的任务分布进行多轮优化，与真实部署中的测试时自适应设定存在根本差异——后者只能利用过往任务积累的经验来改进对未来未见任务的安全决策。
AI.method: SafeCoEvo 在不同时间尺度上协同提升两种互补的安全能力：(1) S-Harness 将近期运行时经验快速外化为可更新的显式安全知识，能够即时影响后续任务；(2) GuardVPO 在更长的时间尺度上将累积的运行时安全经验内化为参数化的风险判断能力。二者结合短期快速适应与长期能力固化。
AI.result: 相较于最强基线，不安全结果率降低 10.05%，任务成功率提升 12.15%，实现安全性与任务效用的同步提升。
AI.conclusion: SafeCoEvo 通过测试时的协同演化机制，使外部安全系统能够从累积的运行时经验中持续适应，在真实部署的测试时自适应设定下同时改善安全性与任务效用。

title: Reasoning with Neural Cellular Automata
summary: Modern AI architectures used to solve visual reasoning tasks typically rely heavily on global connectivity and synchronization. As biological systems demonstrate, though, sophisticated computation can be performed in a more decentralized fashion. In this work, we test the reasoning capabilities of Neural Cellular Automata (NCAs), networks of recurrent cells that use strictly local connectivity and asynchronous updates. NCAs have been extensively studied in artificial life experiments, but it is unclear whether they can perform complex multi-step reasoning. We show that NCAs produce spatio-temporal dynamics capable of solving challenging visual reasoning tasks, including large mazes, Sudoku, and ARC-AGI-1. Furthermore, we provide evidence that NCAs generalize out-of-distribution when running with larger grids, longer rollouts, or parallel trials; and that the latter can be made more efficient via pruning of redundant trajectories. We find that these generalization capabilities depend on training with sample replay and stochastic perturbations, and that stochasticity remains beneficial at test time. Finally, we show that NCAs are robust reasoners capable of dynamically modulating compute to recover efficiently from damage, and that they can scale to solve reasoning in raw pixel space.

AI.tldr: 该论文研究神经细胞自动机（NCA，局部连接、异步更新的循环单元网络）的推理能力，证明其能求解大型迷宫、数独和 ARC-AGI-1 等复杂视觉推理任务，并具备分布外泛化、损伤恢复与像素空间扩展能力。
AI.motivation: 主流视觉推理 AI 架构通常依赖全局连接与同步计算；而生物系统表明复杂计算可以更去中心化。NCA 虽在人工生命领域被广泛研究，但其能否完成复杂的多步推理尚不清楚，本文旨在检验这一问题。
AI.method: 采用严格局部连接、异步更新的循环细胞网络（NCA），将其用于视觉推理任务；通过训练中加入样本回放（sample replay）与随机扰动提升泛化；测试时保留随机性；并使用冗余轨迹剪枝提升并行试验效率。
AI.result: NCA 产生的时空动力学可求解大型迷宫、数独与 ARC-AGI-1；在更大网格、更长 rollout 或并行试验下能实现分布外泛化（并行试验经冗余轨迹剪枝可更高效）；泛化依赖样本回放与随机扰动训练，且测试时随机性仍有益；NCA 还能动态调节计算以从损伤中高效恢复，并可扩展至原始像素空间进行推理。
AI.conclusion: 去中心化、局部连接且异步更新的 NCA 具备复杂多步推理能力，是稳健的推理器，支持分布外泛化与损伤恢复，并可扩展至原始像素空间，为视觉推理提供了一条非全局连接的替代路径。

title: MemEvo: Automatic Discovery of Streaming Video Memory Mechanisms
summary: Query-agnostic streaming video understanding requires vision-language models to continuously compress an indefinitely growing visual stream into a bounded memory before future queries are known. The performance depends critically on the memory mechanism--what observations to preserve, how to represent and consolidate them, and what information to retrieve when a query eventually arrives. Rather than designing a single memory architecture by hand, we formulate memory design as a search problem over executable memory programs. We introduce a lightweight domain-specific language that expresses memory mechanisms through structured primitives for representation, admission, retention, consolidation, budgeting, and retrieval, while enforcing causal and bounded-memory constraints. Although structured, the derived program space remains large and contains heterogeneous, conditionally dependent design choices whose effects can only be assessed via downstream execution. We therefore propose MemEvo, an LLM-driven auto-research framework that uses pretrained LLM as a semantics-aware proposal model to iteratively generate and refine candidate memory programs based on accumulated experimental feedback. At runtime, a deterministic evaluation pipeline validates and evaluates each candidate, while the underlying vision-language model remains frozen throughout discovery. We finally produce a training-free, bounded-memory mechanism. Extensive experiments on StreamingBench and OVO-Bench demonstrate strong streaming video understanding performance together with substantial context and inference efficiency.

AI.tldr: 本文将流式视频理解中的记忆机制设计转化为对可执行记忆程序的搜索问题，提出领域特定语言与LLM驱动的自动研究框架MemEvo，自动发现免训练、有界内存的记忆机制，在StreamingBench和OVO-Bench上取得强性能与高效性。
AI.motivation: 查询无关的流式视频理解要求视觉语言模型在未知未来查询的情况下，持续将无限增长的视觉流压缩进有界内存。其性能关键取决于记忆机制：保留哪些观测、如何表示与整合、查询到来时检索什么信息。手工设计单一记忆架构难以应对，因此需要将记忆设计自动化。
AI.method: 1) 将记忆设计形式化为在可执行记忆程序上的搜索问题；2) 提出轻量领域特定语言（DSL），通过表示、准入、保留、整合、预算、检索等结构化原语表达记忆机制，并施加因果性与有界内存约束；3) 提出MemEvo：LLM驱动的自动研究框架，以预训练LLM作为语义感知的提议模型，基于累积的实验反馈迭代生成与优化候选记忆程序；4) 运行时采用确定性评估流水线验证并评估候选，视觉语言模型在发现过程中保持冻结；5) 最终产出免训练、有界内存的记忆机制。
AI.result: 在StreamingBench和OVO-Bench上的大量实验表明，该方法具备强流式视频理解性能，同时显著提升上下文与推理效率。
AI.conclusion: 通过将记忆机制设计抽象为程序搜索并借助LLM自动演化，可在冻结视觉语言模型的前提下自动获得免训练、有界内存的记忆机制，有效兼顾流式视频理解性能与效率。

title: Learning Continuous Patient Trajectories from Electronic Health Records
summary: Electronic health records provide irregular observations of latent patient states that evolve continuously over time. Recent autoregressive models condition on clinical histories to forecast future events as sequences of discrete observations. Conversely, multi-marginal flow matching provides a continuous-time formulation, but using multiple observations to supervise training paths does not itself give the learned dynamics access to preceding patient history. We introduce EHRFlow, a multi-marginal flow-matching framework that conditions on encoded patient history, thereby allowing future dynamics to depend on the patient's prior clinical trajectory. Our proposed framework accommodates irregular observation times and supports forecasting at arbitrary horizons. Across controlled synthetic benchmarks, EHRFlow improves clinical-code forecasting and latent-state recovery. On real-world clinical datasets comprising more than one million patients, including an independent external validation cohort, EHRFlow improves horizon-averaged top-5 clinical-code accuracy over autoregressive and history-independent flow-matching baselines. Finally, in a controlled counterfactual simulation, conditional guidance approximates the known effect of an antihypertensive intervention without training a task-specific outcome model.

AI.tldr: 提出EHRFlow，将多边际流匹配与患者病史条件化结合，实现不规则时间电子健康记录的未来事件预测。
AI.motivation: 电子健康记录对潜在患者状态的观测是不规则的，且状态随时间连续演化。现有自回归模型将预测建模为离散观测序列，而多边际流匹配虽提供连续时间建模，但使用多个观测监督训练路径并不能让学习到的动力学利用既往病史。因此需要一种既能连续建模又可条件化于患者历史轨迹的框架。
AI.method: EHRFlow是一个多边际流匹配框架，在编码的患者病史表示上进行条件化，使未来动力学依赖患者既往临床轨迹。该框架支持不规则观测时间，并可在任意时间跨度上进行预测。
AI.result: 在受控合成基准上，EHRFlow提升了临床编码预测与潜在状态恢复性能。在包含超百万患者的真实临床数据集（含独立外部验证队列）上，其时间跨度平均的top-5临床编码准确率优于自回归与不考虑病史的流匹配基线。在受控反事实模拟中，条件引导可在不训练任务特定结局模型的情况下近似已知降压干预效应。
AI.conclusion: EHRFlow将多边际流匹配与病史条件化有效结合，兼顾不规则采样与任意时间跨度预测，在合成与大规模真实数据上均优于基线，并展现出无需任务特定模型即可进行反事实干预推断的潜力。

title: Transformers Stop Thinking Too Early, and a Tiny LoRA Fixes It
summary: Pretrained transformers use little of their depth to follow references in context. Thirteen base models reliably follow only 1.4-3.6 lines, and extra pretrained loops add little. A task-trained rank-8 LoRA at one early layer extends this computation with all model weights frozen. Qwen3-8B improves from 15.5% to 99% exact accuracy on 24-line chains; a longer-trained LoRA reaches 50 lines. Ouro-1.4B reaches 60 lines after four loops and at least 160 after eight. The LoRA starts a relay: program lines pass on their chain identity through a short range of middle layers. Frozen heads read progressively further up the chain, and removing parent-line attention stops the relay. A frozen-model measurement locates the last useful intervention layer within tolerance in three of four held-out models. Task-specific LoRAs also improve MuSiQue. Default answers therefore understate the computation accessible through a tiny edit. Code and an interactive demo are available at https://lunamos.github.io/stop-thinking-too-early/

AI.tldr: 预训练Transformer在上下文引用链任务中仅利用很少的深度，通过早期单层rank-8 LoRA即可大幅扩展其链式计算能力，甚至达到100行以上。
AI.motivation: 作者发现预训练模型在跟随上下文引用链时仅使用极少的深度（仅能稳定跟随1.4-3.6行），额外预训练循环增益有限，因此希望探究模型默认答案是否低估了可通过微小编辑激发的计算潜力。
AI.method: 在冻结所有模型权重的前提下，于某一早期层训练rank-8 LoRA；通过消融父行注意力、定位最后有效干预层及在留出模型上验证，分析LoRA引发的"中继"机制（程序行通过中间层传递链身份）。
AI.result: Qwen3-8B在24行链上精确准确率从15.5%提升至99%；更长训练的LoRA可达50行。Ouro-1.4B在四次循环后达60行，八次后至少160行。冻结模型测量在四个留出模型中的三个能定位最后有效干预层。任务特定LoRA也改善MuSiQue表现。
AI.conclusion: 默认答案低估了通过微小编辑可访问的计算能力；单层小秩LoRA可激活预训练模型中未被利用的深层链式推理能力。

title: Encoder-Sharing Hierarchical Federated Multi-Task Learning for VANETs
summary: Most federated learning frameworks for vehicular ad hoc networks assume that all vehicles collaboratively train a single model for a common task. This assumption limits their applicability to practical vehicular environments, where vehicles may perform heterogeneous but related perception tasks with different output spaces. This paper proposes encoder-sharing hierarchical multi-task federated learning (EN-HMTFL), which integrates cluster-based hierarchical federated learning with a globally shared encoder and vehicle-local decoders. EN-HMTFL enables vehicles performing different tasks to collaboratively learn a transferable feature representation while preserving their task-specific models locally. Only the encoder is exchanged and aggregated through the hierarchy, whereas raw data and local decoder parameters remain at the vehicles. The proposed framework is evaluated on the MNIST and GTSRB datasets in different vehicular scenarios. Across the evaluated scenarios, EN-HMTFL improves accuracy by up to 24.0% relative to the compared representation-sharing benchmark. In scenarios where EN-HMTFL converges earlier, the reduction reaches up to 69 communication rounds (28.8%).

AI.tldr: 本文提出编码器共享的层次化多任务联邦学习框架 EN-HMTFL，使执行不同感知任务的车联网车辆协同学习共享特征表示，同时保留本地任务专属解码器。
AI.motivation: 现有车联网联邦学习框架多假设所有车辆协同训练单一任务的同一模型，难以适用于车辆执行异构但相关感知任务、输出空间不同的实际车载环境。
AI.method: EN-HMTFL 将基于聚类的层次化联邦学习与全局共享编码器、车辆本地解码器相结合：车辆协同学习可迁移特征表示，任务专属模型保留在本地；仅编码器通过层次结构进行交换与聚合，原始数据和本地解码器参数不出车辆。
AI.result: 在 MNIST 和 GTSRB 数据集的不同车联网场景下评估，EN-HMTFL 相比表示共享基线准确率最高提升 24.0%；在更早收敛的场景中，通信轮次最多减少 69 轮（28.8%）。
AI.conclusion: EN-HMTFL 能够支持车联网中异构多任务感知的协同学习，在提升精度的同时降低通信开销，为实际车载环境下的联邦学习提供了可行方案。

title: SAKI: Maximal-Coupling-Routed Teacher Supervision for On-Policy Distillation
summary: On-policy distillation (OPD) reduces train-test state mismatch by training a student on its own generated trajectories, but weak students may visit teacher-misaligned prefixes where supervision is less representative. We introduce SAKI (Supervision Allocation with KL-constrained Interpolation), which combines a KL-constrained teacher-guided rollout with maximal coupling and reuses realized accept/correction events to route token-level supervision. Accepted positions retain sampled-token reverse-KL supervision, while correction positions receive direct supervision on the teacher's highest-probability token. Under maximal coupling, the correction probability is exactly TV(p_t, q_t), so the same trust-region radius controls rollout deviation and upper-bounds intervention and specialized-supervision frequency. We further implement an engine-resident speculative verifier that preserves the exact-q trajectory distribution and coupling semantics while improving matched-workload rollout throughput by 4.22x. Across seven mathematical reasoning benchmarks, SAKI improves the matched teacher-guided baseline in Mean@8 and Pass@8 for both 1.7B and 0.6B students. Placement controls and fixed-prefix analysis further support correction-triggered routing as a conflict-adaptive supervision signal.

AI.tldr: 提出SAKI方法，通过KL约束的教师引导rollout与最大耦合，实现token级监督的路由分配，提升on-policy蒸馏效果。
AI.motivation: on-policy蒸馏通过让学生在自身生成的轨迹上训练来减少训练-测试状态不匹配，但弱学生可能访问教师不匹配的前缀，导致监督代表性不足。
AI.method: SAKI结合KL约束的教师引导rollout与最大耦合，复用已实现的接受/纠正事件进行token级监督路由：接受位置保留采样token的反向KL监督，纠正位置直接监督教师最高概率token；并实现引擎驻留的推测验证器以保持精确q轨迹分布与耦合语义。
AI.result: 在最大耦合下纠正概率恰为TV(p_t, q_t)，同一信任域半径控制rollout偏差并上界干预与专门监督频率；推测验证器在匹配工作负载下将rollout吞吐提升4.22倍；在七个数学推理基准上，SAKI在1.7B和0.6B学生的Mean@8与Pass@8上均优于匹配的教师引导基线。
AI.conclusion: 位置控制和固定前缀分析进一步支持纠正触发的路由作为一种冲突自适应的监督信号。

title: Draft in Parallel, Condition Through Depth: Adjacent Causal Injection for Speculative Decoding
summary: Parallel speculative drafting generates multiple candidates in one backbone pass, but independent token selection can produce inconsistent continuations that shorten the accepted prefix. Existing methods mostly leave conditional decoding to a lightweight module after the backbone, which limits the flow of predecessor information to successors. Our analysis of DFlash shows that early positions already form recoverable predictions in shallow layers, and that accurate adjacent predecessors help successors more when they enter earlier. We therefore propose DSpine, a drafter with causal conditioning injection throughout the backbone: at every layer, gated adjacent injection writes each predecessor's predicted feature into its successor, so the causal conditioning chain unfolds over network depth while all positions update in parallel. A unified transfer space built from the target model's output embeddings unifies layer-wise injection with predecessor-conditioned decoding, and layer-wise output-embedding supervision promotes the formation of predicted features in shallow layers. Fused kernels and a transition cache execute both efficiently in parallel within SGLang. Across seven math, code, and chat benchmarks, DSpine achieves the longest acceptance length at both temperatures on Qwen3-4B and Qwen3-8B. At temperature zero on Qwen3-8B, it raises the seven-benchmark mean from DFlash's 3.77 to 4.82 (+27.8%); in SGLang serving tests, it delivers 23.3% higher throughput than DFlash on average.

AI.tldr: 提出 DSpine，一种在骨干网络各层注入因果条件的并行推测式草稿器，通过门控相邻注入、统一迁移空间与逐层监督提升接受长度与吞吐。
AI.motivation: 并行推测式草稿能在一次骨干前向中生成多个候选，但独立选择词元会导致续写不一致，从而缩短被接受的猜测前缀。现有方法多将条件解码交给骨干之后的轻量模块，限制了前驱信息向后继的流动。对 DFlash 的分析显示：浅层中早期位置已形成可恢复的预测，且准确的相邻前驱在其更早进入时对后继帮助更大。
AI.method: DSpine 在骨干网络全深度进行因果条件注入：每一层通过门控相邻注入将每个前驱的预测特征写入其后继，使因果条件链沿网络深度展开，同时所有位置并行更新。基于目标模型输出嵌入构建统一迁移空间，统一逐层注入与前驱条件解码；采用逐层输出嵌入监督促进浅层预测特征的形成。结合融合算子与转移缓存，在 SGLang 中高效并行执行。
AI.result: 在七个数学、代码与对话基准上，DSpine 在 Qwen3-4B 与 Qwen3-8B 的两个温度下均取得最长接受长度。Qwen3-8B 温度为零时，七基准均值由 DFlash 的 3.77 提升至 4.82（+27.8%）；SGLang 服务测试中，平均吞吐较 DFlash 高 23.3%。
AI.conclusion: 将因果条件注入贯穿骨干各层、并以统一迁移空间与逐层监督加以支撑，可有效提升并行草稿的接受长度与服务吞吐，验证了深度方向逐步传递前驱信息的设计有效性。

title: Multi-Channel Mitigation of Source-Trust Shortcuts in Fact-Checking RL Agents
summary: Retrieval-augmented fact-checkers often receive a reliability label, such as HIGH or LOW trust, for each evidence source. These labels should adjust the model's confidence and its decision to search for more evidence, while the verdict should follow the evidence content. We introduce TrustSwap, a counterfactual test that swaps, lowers, or removes source labels while keeping every evidence text fixed, and measures its three output channels (the verdict, the confidence, and the search decision) separately. Across untrained and RL-trained models at two scales, three datasets, and two prompts, confidence and search respond to the labels as intended in 49 of 50 comparisons, yet a label change alone alters 4-23% of confident verdicts for Qwen3 models and up to 50% for an existing RL-trained fact-checker. Standard GRPO fine-tuning amplifies this shortcut at 8B in all six settings. To reduce it, we propose trust-swap augmentation (TSA), which trains GRPO on each claim with both its original and its label-swapped evidence under the same gold verdict. At 4B, TSA lowers the verdict flip rate by 7-35% (relative) in four of six settings, keeps accuracy and the intended confidence and search responses, outperforms reward-based alternatives in the main setting, and carries over to an unseen label-removal perturbation. An added consistency reward helps on the trained-on swap but not on unseen perturbations. At 8B, TSA's effect is not detectable, which makes scale the main open question.

AI.tldr: 该论文提出TrustSwap反事实测试，验证检索增强事实核查模型是否会被来源可靠性标签"走捷径"影响裁决，并探究其成因与缓解方法。
AI.motivation: 检索增强事实核查器通常为每个证据来源接收可靠性标签（如HIGH/LOW）。理想情况下，这些标签应只调节模型置信度与是否继续搜索证据的决策，而最终裁决应由证据内容决定。作者想检验模型是否真的遵循这一规范，还是会被标签"劫持"。
AI.method: 提出TrustSwap反事实测试：在保持所有证据文本不变的前提下，交换、降低或移除来源标签，并分别测量三个输出通道（裁决、置信度、搜索决策）。覆盖未训练与RL训练模型、两种规模、三个数据集、两种提示。为解决该捷径，提出trust-swap augmentation（TSA）：对每条claim用原始证据与标签交换后的证据、在同一gold裁决下进行GRPO训练；并提出一致性奖励作为对比方案。
AI.result: 置信度与搜索决策在50组比较中的49组按预期响应标签；但仅改变标签就使Qwen3模型的自信裁决翻转4-23%，已有RL事实核查器最高达50%。标准GRPO在8B的全部六种设置中放大该捷径。TSA在4B规模使裁决翻转率相对下降7-35%（六种设置中的四种），同时保持准确率及预期的置信度与搜索响应，在主设置中优于基于奖励的替代方案，并可迁移到未见的标签移除扰动。一致性奖励仅在被训练的交换上有效，对未见的扰动无效。8B规模上TSA效果无法检测。
AI.conclusion: 模型虽能正确用标签调节置信度与搜索，但裁决会被标签内容不当影响；标准GRPO会加剧该捷径；TSA在4B可有效缓解且不影响其他能力，但一致性奖励泛化差，且8B规模效果不明显。规模效应成为主要待解问题。

title: Fair Policy Optimization in Major-Minor Weakly Coupled Markov Decision Processes
summary: We consider fair resource allocation in sequential decision-making environments modeled as major-minor weakly coupled Markov decision processes (M2WCMDP). In this framework, resource constraints couple the action spaces of a major sub-Markov decision process (sub-MDP) and a population of minor sub-MDPs that would otherwise operate independently. Instead of using the traditional utilitarian (total-sum) objective, we optimize a general class of monotone, concave, permutation-invariant, normalized fairness functions. With homogeneous minor sub-MDPs, we prove that the problem under symmetry reduces to optimizing the platform-plus-mean-participant utilitarian objective over the class of \textit{permutation-invariant} policies, which allows us to exploit efficient algorithms that optimize the utilitarian-based objective to solve this fairness-aware problem. For more general settings, we introduce a count-proportion-based deep reinforcement learning approach with a priority-based sampler that generates feasible count actions. The generality of our framework means that the proposed algorithms and theoretical guarantees transfer to any domain with a symmetric M2WCMDP structure. We consider two applications: the machine replacement problem and the joint control of pricing and taxi relocation problem on a New York City-calibrated dataset. We validate our theoretical findings with comprehensive experiments, confirming the effectiveness of our proposed method in achieving strong fairness-aware performance while remaining scalable.

AI.tldr: 本文研究主-次弱耦合马尔可夫决策过程(M2WCMDP)中的公平资源分配，证明对称条件下公平优化可转化为平台加平均参与者效用目标，并提出基于计数比例的深度强化学习方法求解一般情形。
AI.motivation: 传统资源分配多采用功利主义(总和)目标，忽视了分配公平性。在序列决策环境中，资源约束耦合了主sub-MDP与大量次sub-MDP的动作空间，如何在保证可扩展性的同时优化公平目标尚缺乏系统方法。
AI.method: 将问题建模为M2WCMDP，优化一类单调、凹、置换不变且归一化的公平函数。对同质次sub-MDP，通过对称性证明问题可化简为在置换不变策略类上优化"平台+平均参与者"效用目标，从而复用高效的功利主义算法。对一般情形，提出基于计数比例的深度强化学习方法和基于优先级的采样器以生成可行计数动作。
AI.result: 理论上证明了对称条件下公平问题与效用目标的等价性；实验上在机器更换问题和基于纽约市数据的定价与出租车调度联合控制问题中验证了理论结论，表明方法在实现强公平性能的同时具备良好可扩展性。
AI.conclusion: 该框架具有通用性，所提算法与理论保证可迁移至任何具有对称M2WCMDP结构的领域，为序列决策中的公平资源分配提供了可扩展的解决方案。

title: Neural Structural Reasoner: A Brain-inspired Architecture for Reasoning over Structured Knowledge
summary: Structural reasoning, the ability to recognize and make inferences over the relational structure between objects and concepts, is a hallmark of human cognition, yet prevailing methods often collapse relational topology into flat embeddings, cannot discover hidden structure and lack interpretability. We introduce Neural Structural Reasoner (NSR), a brain-inspired network that preserves relational structure directly in the connectivity and dynamics of coupled neuronal populations. NSR draws inspiration from three biological mechanisms: multi-layered architecture for encoding hierarchical knowledge, stable representations of entity and concepts, and path integration for input-driven state inference. At query time, NSR parallelizes computation over candidate relational structures and leverages confidence-weighted scores to perform link prediction. Across standard knowledge-graph benchmarks, NSR achieves competitive accuracy without leading on every dataset, and has lower reported training times than several neural baselines. Because reasoning is implemented through sequences of human-readable neuron activations, NSR affords native interpretability by tracking intermediate inference steps. The model further extracts latent relational hierarchies and compositional rules, demonstrating the brain-inspired architecture as an effective, efficient, and highly interpretable substrate for structural reasoning.

AI.tldr: 提出类脑网络NSR，将关系结构直接保留在耦合神经元群体的连接与动力学中，在知识图谱基准上取得有竞争力的准确率、较低训练时间，并具备原生可解释性。
AI.motivation: 结构推理是人类认知的核心能力，但主流方法将关系拓扑压缩为扁平嵌入，无法发现隐藏结构且缺乏可解释性，因此需要一种能直接保留关系结构的推理架构。
AI.method: NSR受三种生物机制启发：多层架构编码层级知识、实体与概念的稳定表示、路径积分实现输入驱动的状态推断；查询时对候选关系结构并行计算，并用置信度加权分数进行链接预测。
AI.result: 在标准知识图谱基准上取得有竞争力的准确率（但并非每个数据集都领先），报告的训练时间低于若干神经基线；推理通过人类可读的神经元激活序列实现，可追踪中间推理步骤，并能提取潜在关系层级与组合规则。
AI.conclusion: 该工作表明类脑架构可作为高效、有效且高度可解释的结构推理基础。

title: EvoMO-SR: Multiobjective LLM-based Evolution of Symbolic Expressions with substructure guidance
summary: Symbolic Regression (SR) is a data-driven method for scientific discovery which searches for interpretable analytical relationships within data. Recently, Large Language Models (LLMs) have also had a significant impact on scientific discovery, enabling the automation of various stages of the process. For these reasons, the possibility of harnessing the embedded scientific knowledge and programming capabilities of LLMs to solve SR tasks has emerged, showing promising performance compared with traditional methods. We propose EvoMO-SR, a novel LLM-driven SR framework in which the LLM generates equation skeletons, with their coefficients fitted separately by an external optimizer. The framework includes a multi-objective survival selection which controls bloating by balancing accuracy and complexity, and a substructure guidance mechanism which mutates expressions with candidate reusable building blocks. EvoMO-SR achieves the best accuracy in seven of the eight in-domain and out-of-domain settings for LSR-Synth, using a small LLM model, i.e., Llama-3.1-8B-Instruct. We also evaluated structural recovery through two symbolic accuracy metrics based on canonicalized subtree overlap and term matching, showing that our method has a greater probability of recovering highly accurate symbolic structures.

AI.tldr: 提出EvoMO-SR：一种LLM驱动的符号回归框架，LLM生成方程骨架并由外部优化器拟合系数，含多目标生存选择与子结构引导机制。用小型Llama-3.1-8B-Instruct在LSR-Synth的8个设定中7个取得最佳精度，并在符号结构恢复上表现更优。
AI.motivation: 符号回归（SR）能从数据中搜索可解释的解析关系，是数据驱动的科学发现方法；近期大语言模型（LLM）在科学发现自动化中作用显著。由于LLM具备内嵌的科学知识与编程能力，将其用于SR任务成为可能，并在性能上展现出较传统方法的潜力。然而需要更有效地利用LLM生成结构并控制表达式膨胀、提升可恢复性。
AI.method: 提出EvoMO-SR：LLM驱动的SR框架。LLM负责生成方程骨架（equation skeletons），其系数由外部优化器单独拟合，从而将结构搜索与参数优化解耦。框架包含两个关键机制：（1）多目标生存选择（multi-objective survival selection），在精度与复杂度之间权衡以控制表达式膨胀（bloating）；（2）子结构引导机制（substructure guidance），利用候选可复用构建块（reusable building blocks）对表达式进行变异。
AI.result: 在LSR-Synth的8个域内与域外设定中，EvoMO-SR在7个设定上取得最佳精度，且仅使用小型LLM模型Llama-3.1-8B-Instruct。此外，通过基于规范化子树重叠（canonicalized subtree overlap）与项匹配（term matching）的两个符号精度指标评估结构恢复，结果显示该方法更有可能恢复出高精度的符号结构。
AI.conclusion: EvoMO-SR表明：通过让LLM生成方程骨架并用外部优化器拟合系数，结合多目标生存选择抑制膨胀、以及子结构引导的变异机制，即使采用小型LLM也能在符号回归任务上超越传统方法，并在域内/域外精度与符号结构恢复方面均具优势。

title: DualTrack: Synchronized speech-gesture generation via symmetric coupling of pretrained priors
summary: Joint speech-gesture synthesis must coordinate two modalities despite limited paired data. Existing approaches often lack bidirectional interaction, have limited language coverage, or simplify body and finger representations. We present DualTrack, which couples pretrained speech and motion priors on a shared 12.5 Hz timeline. Causal adapters exchange previous-packet information, while current-state fusion coordinates the streams before they separately complete sixteen-codebook packets. We evaluate 43 BEAT2 recordings in four languages, with speakers held out from joint training and validation. On the shared English/Spanish inputs, without speech or motion prefixes, DualTrack achieves lower word error rate and full-motion Fréchet Gesture Distance, higher beat consistency and speech naturalness than the evaluated GELINA baseline.

AI.tldr: 提出 DualTrack，在同一 12.5 Hz 时间轴上耦合预训练语音与动作先验，通过因果适配器交换历史包信息、当前状态融合协调双流，再各自生成 16 码本包，实现语音-手势联合合成。
AI.motivation: 语音-手势联合合成需协调两种模态，但配对数据有限；现有方法普遍缺乏双向交互、语言覆盖不足，或对躯干与手指表示过度简化。
AI.method: 在共享 12.5 Hz 时间线上耦合预训练语音与动作先验；因果适配器（causal adapters）交换前一包信息；当前状态融合（current-state fusion）在双流分别补全 16 码本包之前进行协调。
AI.result: 在 43 段 BEAT2 录音、四种语言上评测，说话人从联合训练与验证中留出。在共享英语/西班牙语输入、无语音或动作前缀条件下，DualTrack 相比 GELINA 基线取得更低词错误率、更低全动作 Fréchet 手势距离，并具有更高节拍一致性与语音自然度。
AI.conclusion: DualTrack 通过双向交互式双流架构与共享时间轴设计，在有限配对数据和跨语言设定下优于现有基线，验证了双模态协同建模的有效性。

title: Physical Cross-Modal Masked Autoencoding for Seismic-to-Well Representation Learning
summary: Learning from scientific measurements often requires aligning modalities with different spatial support and resolution. Subsurface characterization is an extreme dense-sparse problem in which 3D seismic provides volumetric but indirect measurements and well logs provide high-resolution 1D measurements at sparse borehole locations. We introduce a physically grounded cross-modal masked autoencoder (CM-MAE) for seismic-to-well representation learning. The model jointly tokenizes seismic volumes and well-log depth patches, embeds both modalities in continuous physical coordinates using four-axis rotary position embeddings, and reconstructs masked targets with a cross-modal decoder. Sparse Mixture-of-Experts layers provide modality-specific capacity while dense attention allows information exchange between modalities. Pretraining uses 23 seismic volumes covering approximately 178,000 square km across U.S. offshore and onshore basins, together with approximately 92,000 wells. Matched-mask ablations show strongly asymmetric information flow. Seismic context improves held-out well-log reconstruction by 9.73%, while well-log context improves seismic reconstruction by 0.65%. We evaluate seismic-only pseudo-log predictions against independent interpreter-drawn salt-geobody masks to determine whether they contain geologic signal. Across offshore U.S. surveys, compressional-slowness-derived salt scores reach an AUROC of 0.910. In onshore basins, predicted compressional slowness preserves formation-scale structure and partial relative organization in an unseen survey despite calibration drift. CM-MAE learns useful seismic-to-well representations under extreme modality asymmetry, although absolute pseudo-log calibration remains survey-dependent.

AI.tldr: 该论文提出CM-MAE，一个物理约束的跨模态掩码自编码器，用于地震-测井表示学习，在极度模态不对称条件下实现有效的跨模态信息融合与伪测井预测。
AI.motivation: 地下表征面临极端的稠密-稀疏问题：3D地震提供体积但间接的测量，测井提供高分辨率但稀疏的1D测量。如何在这种极端模态不对称下学习跨模态表示仍具挑战。
AI.method: CM-MAE联合tokenize地震体与测井深度patch，使用四轴旋转位置嵌入将两模态嵌入连续物理坐标，并通过跨模态解码器重建掩码目标。采用稀疏MoE层提供模态专属容量，同时用稠密注意力实现模态间信息交换。预训练数据含约23个地震体（覆盖美国近海与陆上盆地约178,000平方公里）与约92,000口井。
AI.result: 匹配掩码消融显示强烈的不对称信息流：地震上下文使留出测井重建提升9.73%，而测井上下文使地震重建仅提升0.65%。地震-only伪测井预测对美国近海调查的盐体评分AUROC达0.910；陆上盆地中预测的纵波慢度保留地层尺度结构，但在未见调查中存在标定漂移。
AI.conclusion: CM-MAE在极端模态不对称下能学习有用的地震-测井表示，但绝对伪测井标定仍依赖具体调查区域。

title: Semantic Projection for Continual Self-Evolution of Language Agents
summary: Language-model agents increasingly rely on persistent natural-language skills to adapt beyond their frozen model parameters. When a shared skill is repeatedly revised from a non-stationary, heterogeneous task stream, however, improvements for new tasks can overwrite procedures needed for earlier ones. In continual learning, Orthogonal Gradient Descent (OGD) addresses analogous interference by projecting a new-task gradient onto a subspace that locally preserves prior predictions. Natural-language skill revisions, however, have neither gradients nor a canonical vector space in which such a projection can be performed. We introduce \emph{Semantic-Scope Projected Evolution} (SSPE), which transfers the functional principle of gradient projection from parameter space to behavior space. SSPE treats an unconstrained skill revision as a proposed update, identifies acquired capabilities with which it may interfere, and uses the observed gains and regressions to construct a compatible revision rather than merely rejecting the update. This enables one shared skill to evolve across latent and recurring task contexts without exposing semantic domain identities to the evolution model. Across controlled synthetic streams and heterogeneous real-agent benchmarks, SSPE improves final cross-domain competence and mitigates forgetting relative to strong skill-evolution baselines. The evolved skill also retains the strongest average performance after transfer to a different executor model. These results establish semantic projection as a promising principle for stable and adaptive self evolution of language agents.

AI.tldr: 提出SSPE，将正交梯度下降的功能原理从参数空间迁移到行为空间，用观测到的增益与回退构造兼容的技能修订，实现语言模型技能在非平稳任务流上稳定演化。
AI.motivation: 语言模型智能体依赖持久化的自然语言技能来突破冻结参数的限制。但在非平稳、异构任务流中反复修订共享技能时，新任务的改进可能覆盖旧任务所需的流程。持续学习中的正交梯度下降（OGD）通过将新任务梯度投影到局部保持旧预测的子空间来缓解干扰，然而自然语言技能修订既无梯度，也无可执行该投影的规范向量空间。
AI.method: SSPE（Semantic-Scope Projected Evolution）将梯度投影的功能原理由参数空间转移至行为空间：把无约束的技能修订视为候选更新，识别可能与之冲突的已获能力，并依据观测到的性能增益与回退构造兼容的修订方案，而非简单拒绝该更新。该方法使单一共享技能可在潜在及循环出现的任务情境中演化，且不向演化模型暴露语义领域身份。
AI.result: 在受控合成任务流与异构真实智能体基准上，SSPE 相比强技能演化基线提升了最终跨域能力并缓解了遗忘；演化后的技能迁移到另一执行器模型后仍保持最高的平均性能。
AI.conclusion: 结果表明语义投影是语言智能体实现稳定且自适应自演化的一条有前景的原则。

title: Representable but Unlearned: Encoding Rank and the Interaction-Prediction Floor
summary: Input encodings can restrict which measured contrasts a predictor can jointly reproduce, even when no single contrast is forced to vanish. We compute the attainable contrast space from an encoder's equivalence classes and a fixed contrast design, without labels, loss, or a fitted model; projecting the recorded contrasts onto that space gives an empirical error floor for any unrestricted decoder on those classes. On a 140-rectangle siRNA interaction panel, a graph neural network's training-only feature mask merges 165 endpoint states into 90 classes and cuts the rank of the 140 interaction contrasts to 72. The resulting floor is 0.009980, which is 14.6% of the fitted model's interaction squared error; the fitted model reaches 0.068335, slightly worse than a control predicting no interaction at all. A minimum of three restored chemistry columns recovers full rank. Refitting without the mask removes the floor entirely, yet interaction MSE improves by only 0.000017 under the reported protocol, and the restored columns remain absent from every training input. On a released RNA-splicing predictor, whose encoding is injective on the measured states, the same computation returns the full design rank of 1,986 and a floor of exactly zero. These results separate what an encoding permits from what a fitted model achieves; they do not identify what limits the remaining error. The rank check needs no fits and bounds what any amount of training under a fixed encoding can recover. The project repository is available at https://github.com/shadi97kh/REPRESENTABLE-BUT-UNLEARNED.

AI.tldr: 输入编码在无标签、无损失、无拟合模型条件下会限制预测器可联合复现的对比量；通过从编码器等价类与固定对比设计计算可达对比空间，并对记录对比做投影得到经验误差下界。siRNA案例中下界占拟合模型交互平方误差的14.6%，且拟合模型还不如"无交互"基线；RNA剪接预测器因编码在测量态上单射，下界严格为零。
AI.motivation: 现有工作关注拟合模型能否复现对比量，但忽略了一个前置问题：编码本身（其等价类划分）在固定对比设计下可能已排除了某些可联合复现的对比，即便没有任何单个对比被强制为零。作者希望将"编码允许什么"与"模型实际学到什么"分离，并给出一个不依赖训练、不依赖标签的误差下界工具。
AI.method: 在不使用标签、损失或拟合模型的条件下，从编码器的等价类与固定对比设计出发计算可达对比空间；将已记录的对比投影到该空间，从而得到任何无限制解码器在这些类上必然承受的经验误差下界。以140个矩形的siRNA相互作用面板为对象，分析图神经网络训练专用特征掩码（将165个端点状态合并为90类、将140个相互作用对比的秩降至72）的影响；并用RNA剪接预测器的单射编码作为对照，验证下界为零的情形。
AI.result: siRNA面板上，可达空间给出的误差下界为0.009980，占拟合模型交互平方误差的14.6%；拟合模型达到0.068335，略差于"完全预测无交互"的对照。恢复至少三列化学特征即可恢复满秩；移除掩码重拟合后下界消失，但在报告协议下交互MSE仅改善0.000017，且恢复的列始终未出现在任何训练输入中。RNA剪接预测器编码在测量态上为单射，同一计算返回完整设计秩1,986，下界严格为零。
AI.conclusion: 结果区分了编码所允许的表达能力与拟合模型实际达到的性能，但并未识别限制剩余误差的具体来源。秩检查无需任何拟合，即可界定固定编码下任意训练量所能恢复的上限，为编码设计评估提供了独立于模型训练的诊断工具。

title: Distilling Agentic Systems: A Roadmap across Models, Artifacts, and Harnesses
summary: Modern agents increasingly rely on memories, tools, and execution logic, so their competence extends beyond model parameters. This shift exposes a limitation of conventional knowledge distillation, which asks how a student model imitates a teacher model. We define Agent Distillation as the persistent transfer of task-solving knowledge from a teacher agent to a student agent. Our study organizes the field by where transferred knowledge is retained: within the model, as artifacts, through the execution harness, or across substrates. This perspective separates transfer evidence from its outcome and clarifies how knowledge moves between agent components. We develop an evaluation framework that relates retention to causal contribution and deployed utility. Together, these contributions establish a foundation for the reliable, maintainable, and safe development of increasingly complex agentic systems.

AI.tldr: 论文提出"Agent Distillation"概念，即从教师智能体向学生智能体持久迁移任务求解知识，并按知识保留位置（模型内、制品、执行框架、跨基质）组织该领域，进而构建评估框架，将知识保留与因果贡献和部署效用关联。
AI.motivation: 现代智能体的能力依赖记忆、工具与执行逻辑，已超出模型参数范围，传统知识蒸馏（学生模型模仿教师模型）难以覆盖这种能力转移，因此需要重新定义和系统化智能体层面的知识迁移问题。
AI.method: 提出Agent Distillation的定义；按知识保留载体的四个维度对领域进行分类组织；开发评估框架，将"保留"与"因果贡献"及"部署效用"建立关联。
AI.result: 给出了一个领域组织视角，使迁移证据与其结果得以分离，并厘清知识如何在智能体各组件之间流动；同时提供了关联保留、因果贡献与部署效用的评估框架。
AI.conclusion: 该工作为日益复杂的智能体系统实现可靠、可维护和安全的开发奠定了基础。

title: On the spectral properties of generative denoiser Jacobians
summary: Generative denoising models, such as diffusion and flow-matching, learn to sample from complex distributions by training a deep neural network denoiser to recover clean data from noise-corrupted samples. While such models are typically compared on the quality of their synthesized samples, these metrics provide limited insight into how the underlying denoiser, which drives generation, differs. In this work, we propose to analyze the spectrum of the denoiser Jacobian as a tool to characterize these differences. Across pre-trained denoising models, we observe that better generative performance is associated with larger Jacobian eigenvalues. Motivated by this, we introduce a regularization scheme that controls the Jacobian spectrum by training the denoiser on perturbed inputs, with perturbations suppressing or amplifying Jacobian responses. On ImageNet, we test whether directly modifying the Jacobian spectral properties leads to improved generations. Our findings suggest that denoisers benefit from both strengthening responses along data-relevant principal eigen-directions and suppressing the noisy, data-irrelevant ones. This establishes the denoiser Jacobian as a useful tool for identifying differences between generative denoising models.

AI.tldr: 本文提出以去噪器Jacobian谱作为分析生成式去噪模型差异的工具，发现更好的生成性能与更大的Jacobian特征值相关，并通过在扰动输入上训练去噪器来正则化Jacobian谱，在ImageNet上验证了直接调控Jacobian谱属性可改进生成质量。
AI.motivation: 扩散、流匹配等生成式去噪模型通常仅通过合成样本质量进行比较，这类指标无法揭示驱动生成的底层去噪器之间的差异，缺乏对模型内在机制的刻画。
AI.method: 提出以去噪器Jacobian谱作为刻画模型差异的工具；基于"更优生成性能对应更大Jacobian特征值"的观察，设计正则化方案，通过在扰动输入上训练去噪器来抑制或放大Jacobian响应，从而直接控制Jacobian谱。
AI.result: 在预训练去噪模型上观察到更好生成性能与更大Jacobian特征值相关；在ImageNet上实验表明，沿数据相关主特征方向增强响应并抑制数据无关的噪声方向，可带来生成质量的提升。
AI.conclusion: 去噪器Jacobian可作为识别生成式去噪模型差异的有效工具，直接调控其谱属性有助于改进生成。

title: RankBuffer: Efficient Ranking-Based Rewards for Open-Ended Generation
summary: Open-ended generation lacks canonical answers, making pointwise rewards difficult to calibrate for group-based reinforcement learning. Directly ranking same-query rollouts provides a more suitable relative reward signal, but existing ranking-based reward methods can incur substantial judging cost. We introduce RankBuffer, which maintains an ordered, query-specific buffer of previously judged responses as a reusable quality scale. Each rollout is first inserted into an anchor interval through an independent coarse judgment, after which only rollouts assigned to the same interval undergo local fine ranking. The resulting complete order is converted into bounded rank rewards, while boundary expansion, local refinement, and inactive-anchor pruning adapt the buffer as the policy evolves. Across four open-ended benchmarks, RankBuffer consistently outperforms all pointwise baselines. It also achieves nearly on-par performance with the strongest ranking-based reward baseline while substantially reducing judging cost. Ablations demonstrate the importance of both local fine ranking and anchor response content, while buffer analyses show that rollout-derived anchors progressively extend and refine the covered quality scale. These results establish response reuse as an effective approach to efficient relative reward construction.

AI.tldr: RankBuffer 通过维护查询专属的有序响应缓冲区作为可复用的质量标尺，先粗判定位锚点区间、再对同区间内响应做局部精排，将完整排序转为有界秩奖励，在开放生成任务上性能优于逐点基线并大幅降低评判成本。
AI.motivation: 开放生成缺乏标准答案，逐点奖励难以校准，不适合基于组的强化学习；直接对同查询 rollout 排序可提供更合适的相对奖励信号，但现有基于排序的奖励方法评判成本高昂。
AI.method: 提出 RankBuffer：为每个查询维护一个有序、可复用的已评判响应缓冲区作为质量标尺。每个新 rollout 先经独立粗判插入某个锚点区间，仅同区间内响应进行局部精排；将所得完整顺序转换为有界秩奖励。同时通过边界扩展、局部精修与非活跃锚点剪枝，使缓冲区随策略演化自适应更新。
AI.result: 在四个开放生成基准上，RankBuffer 一致优于所有逐点基线；与最强排序式奖励基线性能几乎持平，同时显著降低评判成本。消融实验验证了局部精排与锚点响应内容的重要性；缓冲区分析表明 rollout 衍生锚点会逐步扩展并细化所覆盖的质量标尺。
AI.conclusion: 响应复用是构建高效相对奖励的有效途径。

title: EnergyEminence: Source-Aware Environmental Calibration and Evaluation in a Physics-Grounded Grid Digital Twin
summary: Power-grid digital twins must combine data-driven prediction with physically meaningful state evolution while preserving the provenance of environmental observations. This paper presents an early-stage EnergyEminence testbed that couples an IEEE 118-bus-style graph-temporal predictor, nonlinear AC cascade simulation, and operator-dashboard-like temporal replay. In addition, we introduce a shared bounded calibration that converts wildfire-detection confidence and spatial extent into source-comparable wildfire interpretable and explainable evidence. We then evaluate it with visually diverse fire and hard-negative videos. Sixteen synthetic environmental videos are curated to generate 160 source-tracked grid scenarios, and a source-video-disjoint test yields 10 true positives, 8 false positives, 22 true negatives, and no false negatives. The errors occur in stressed, non-cascading scenarios conditioned on an unseen growing-fire source. Our diagnostic then reveals environmental shortcut learning that is obscured by scenario-level random splitting. The paper therefore contributes a data-centric and inspectable evaluation workflow for multimodal grid-resilience models, together with evidence supporting separation of environmental alerting from electrical cascade inference

AI.tldr: 本文提出能量态势(E)早期测试平台，将图-时序预测、非线性AC级联仿真与类操作员仪表盘时间回放耦合，并引入共享有界校准把林火检测置信度与空间范围转为可溯源、可解释证据；在16段合成环境视频生成的160个源跟踪电网场景上评估，源视频不相交测试得到10 TP、8 FP、22 TN、0 FN，揭示被随机划分掩盖的环境捷径学习。
AI.motivation: 电网数字孪生需同时具备数据驱动预测与物理意义明确的状态演化，并保持环境观测的可溯源性与可解释性；现有评估常采用场景级随机划分，可能掩盖模型依赖环境捷径的问题。
AI.method: 构建早期EnergyEminence测试平台：IEEE 118节点风格图-时序预测器 + 非线性AC级联仿真 + 操作员仪表盘式时间回放；提出共享有界校准，将林火检测置信度与空间范围映射为源间可比的解释性证据；用视觉多样的火灾与难负样本视频构建16段合成环境视频，生成160个源跟踪电网场景，并进行源视频不相交测试。
AI.result: 源视频不相交测试：10个真阳性、8个假阳性、22个真阴性、0个假阴性；错误集中在受扰但未级联的场景，且条件为未见过的增长型火源；诊断显示场景级随机划分会掩盖环境捷径学习。
AI.conclusion: 贡献了一套数据中心、可检查的多模态电网韧性模型评估流程，并提供证据支持将环境告警与电力级联推断分离。

title: FineSID: Scalable and Efficient Semantic Identifier Learning for Generative Recommendation
summary: A critical prerequisite of generative recommendation is designing semantic identifiers (SIDs) that are both scalable to large item sets and efficiently learnable. Existing SID learning methods fundamentally rely on Top-1 hard assignment during vector quantization. While heuristic strategies -- such as clustering-based initialization or forced post-hoc collision resolution -- can artificially inflate codebook coverage, they often disrupt end-to-end semantic alignment and fail to address the underlying optimization bottleneck: sparse gradient propagation. In standard Top-1 assignment, gradients concentrate on a narrow subset of frequently selected codewords, leaving the majority inherently under-trained and causing severe SID collisions. To overcome this limitation natively without relying on complex initialization priors, we propose FineSID, a unified quantization framework that moves beyond Top-1 assignment by enabling fine-grained gradient propagation across the entire codebook. Instead of updating only a single selected codeword, FineSID distributes learning signals to all codewords in a soft, differentiable manner. This design promotes globally balanced codebook optimization while strictly preserving semantic consistency, effectively alleviating SID collisions and stabilizing training in large, high-dimensional codebooks. Extensive experiments on multiple public benchmarks demonstrate that FineSID is robust to initialization configurations and consistently improves both codebook utilization and recommendation accuracy. Our work provides a principled, initialization-agnostic solution for semantic identifier learning, advancing the practicality of generative recommendation.

AI.tldr: 本文提出 FineSID，一种通过细粒度梯度传播替代 Top-1 硬分配的语义标识符量化框架，缓解 SID 冲突并提升推荐性能。
AI.motivation: 生成式推荐要求 SID 兼具可扩展性与可学习性。现有 SID 学习方法依赖向量量化中的 Top-1 硬分配，梯度仅集中在少数高频码字上，导致大部分码字欠训练、SID 冲突严重。启发式策略（聚类初始化、事后强制消歧）虽能人为提升码本覆盖率，但破坏端到端语义对齐，未解决稀疏梯度传播这一根本优化瓶颈。
AI.method: FineSID 是一种统一的量化框架，摒弃 Top-1 分配，将学习信号以软性、可微分的方式分配到整个码本的所有码字上，而非仅更新单个被选码字。该设计在不依赖复杂初始化先验的前提下实现全局均衡的码本优化，同时严格保持语义一致性。
AI.result: 在多个公开基准上的大量实验表明，FineSID 对初始化配置具有鲁棒性，并能持续提升码本利用率与推荐准确率。
AI.conclusion: FineSID 为语义标识符学习提供了一种有原则、与初始化无关的解决方案，缓解 SID 冲突、稳定大规模高维码本训练，提升了生成式推荐的实用性。

title: FairDiff: Mitigating the Self-Reinforcing Matthew Effect in Diffusion Recommender Models
summary: While the "Matthew Effect" and filter bubbles are widely recognized outcome-level biases in recommender systems, we reveal that Diffusion Recommender Models (DRMs) uniquely compound this issue through their generative dynamics. Rather than merely inheriting data imbalances, DRMs trigger a self-reinforcing amplification of popularity bias. We identify that this phenomenon is driven by two compounding mechanisms. First, while optimization loss is universally dominated by high-frequency items across recommenders, DRMs suffer from a unique structural prior mismatch during generation. Because the forward terminal distribution of long-tailed data deviates significantly from the standard Gaussian prior, reverse sampling trajectories inherently collapse toward high-density popular items, fundamentally suppressing niche item generation. To dismantle this self-reinforcing loop, we propose FairDiff, a plug-and-play fairness-aware diffusion framework. To overcome the popularity-dominated loss, we introduce Popularity Condition Guidance (PCG). Rather than altering the training objective, PCG acts as an inference-time distributional reweighting mechanism, mathematically reshaping the score-based gradient field to penalize high-popularity regions and guide trajectories toward niche semantics. Furthermore, we design a Semantic Calibration (SC) Module to bridge the prior mismatch, aligning the forward and reverse distributions via one-step optimal transport. Comprehensive evaluations demonstrate that FairDiff achieves state-of-the-art performance while effectively mitigating the self-reinforcing Matthew Effect, highlighting its value as a general framework for DRMs.

AI.tldr: 本文揭示扩散推荐模型（DRMs）通过生成动态自我强化地放大流行度偏差，并提出即插即用框架FairDiff加以缓解。
AI.motivation: 推荐系统中的"马太效应"与过滤气泡已被广泛认可为结果层面的偏差，但作者发现DRMs并非仅继承数据不平衡，而是通过其生成机制独特地复合并自我强化流行度偏差，这一机制此前未被明确揭示。
AI.method: 论文指出两个复合机制：优化损失普遍由高频物品主导；DRMs在生成时存在结构性先验失配——长尾数据的前向终态分布显著偏离标准高斯先验，导致反向采样轨迹坍缩至高密度流行物品。为此提出FairDiff，包含Popularity Condition Guidance（PCG），作为推理时的分布重加权机制，重塑基于分数的梯度场以惩罚高流行区域并引导轨迹走向长尾语义；以及Semantic Calibration（SC）模块，通过一步最优传输对齐前向与反向分布，弥合先验失配。
AI.result: 综合评估表明，FairDiff在达到最先进性能的同时，有效缓解了自我强化的马太效应。
AI.conclusion: FairDiff是一个面向DRMs的通用公平性框架，既能保持推荐性能又能抑制流行度偏差的自我强化循环，具有广泛的适用价值。

title: How Language Models Differ in Redistributing Attention-Head Activity Under Serial Demand
summary: The way a model distributes activity over each layer's attention heads offers a coarse view of how it routes information through depth; how this changes with the task is part of what a mechanistic account must explain. Holding prompt length fixed, we vary how many serial steps a task demands and measure, in every layer of 17 open-weight models, whether activity concentrates on a few heads or spreads across many as demand rises. Both occur: in most models, layers just before mid-depth concentrate activity and later layers spread it. Models differ in where and how strongly this happens. The Qwen2.5 base models from 0.5B to 7B, for example, spread less than the average model in every task and concentrate activity in parts of their second half, where Llama models from 1B to 8B and OLMo-2 spread; the contrast largely holds between Llama-3.1-70B and Qwen2.5-72B, which have the same number of layers and heads. These differences are reproducible, and post-trained models keep much of their base model's pattern. An ablation study suggests that, within a task, models whose activity is more concentrated on their top heads also depend more on those heads for the answer. Concentration and spreading across layers thus offer a new way to compare models, by how they route information through depth. Code is available at https://github.com/johnnyjli/serial-demand-heads.

AI.tldr: 该论文研究了17个开源权重模型在各层注意力头上的活动分布如何随任务串联步骤数变化，发现大多数模型在中间深度前的层活动集中、后期层活动分散，且这种模式在模型家族间存在可复现的差异，并可作为比较模型信息路由方式的新维度。
AI.motivation: 作者希望从机制层面理解模型如何在深度方向上路由信息。模型各层注意力头的活动分布提供了粗粒度视角，但这一分布如何随任务变化尚不清楚，尤其缺乏对"任务串联步骤数"这一变量的受控研究，因此需要固定提示长度、操纵任务串联步骤数来刻画活动集中/分散的动态。
AI.method: 固定提示长度，改变任务所需的串行步骤数量；在17个开源权重模型的每一层测量注意力头活动是集中于少数头还是分散到许多头；对比不同模型家族（如Qwen2.5、Llama、OLMo-2）在相同层数/头数下的差异；并做消融实验检验活动集中度与模型对top heads依赖程度的关系。
AI.result: 两种现象同时存在：多数模型中，中层偏前的层活动趋于集中，后期层趋于分散。模型间在发生位置与强度上有差异。Qwen2.5 base（0.5B–7B）相比平均模型在每种任务上分散更少，并在后半部分某些层集中活动，而这些位置Llama（1B–8B）和OLMo-2则分散；该对比在层数与头数相同的Llama-3.1-70B与Qwen2.5-72B之间基本成立。这些差异可复现，后训练模型大体保留基座模型的模式。消融表明，任务内活动越集中于top heads的模型，其答案越依赖这些头。
AI.conclusion: 各层活动集中与分散程度可作为跨模型比较的新维度，揭示模型在深度方向上的信息路由差异；该指标可复现、受后训练影响较小，并与模型对关键注意力头的依赖相关。

title: MLToolBench: Learning Tool-Augmented Agents for Machine Learning Development
summary: Machine learning engineering (MLE) agents have made substantial progress, but learning through ML experimentation remains costly in time and computation. Synthetic environments reduce these costs while introducing variations in data and experimental settings that require task-specific diagnosis. Access to diagnostic tools alone does not ensure that agents learn when to use them or how to act on their findings. We introduce ToolMLBench, a suite of executable tools for data inspection, code verification, and experiment diagnosis, together with an SFT and RL pipeline for learning their use. Diagnostic calls acquire evidence whose value depends on subsequent decisions, so final outcomes provide limited guidance on which calls to reinforce.
