We address this challenge with SPICE, which measures how privileged context changes the likelihood of a sampled tool action and uses this difference as a turn-level reward alongside the final outcome. We train on 80 synthetic tasks and evaluate on 25 in-domain and 10 out-of-domain tasks. Providing tool interfaces and descriptions alone yields inconsistent gains across unadapted models. With the same diagnostic interface, our training pipeline raises in-domain success from 24.8% to 52.4% for Qwen3-8B and from 35.6% to 69.2% for Qwen3.5-35B-A3B. The latter also improves from 31% to 48% out-of-domain, supporting learned diagnostic tool use on held-out sources and targets.

AI.tldr: 提出ToolMLBench诊断工具套件与SPICE回合级奖励方法，通过SFT+RL训练使MLE智能体学会在实验中诊断性地调用工具，显著提升域内外任务成功率。
AI.motivation: MLE智能体通过机器学习实验学习成本高（时间与计算开销大）。合成环境可降低成本，但引入数据与实验设置的变异，需要针对具体任务进行诊断。仅有诊断工具并不保证智能体会在恰当时机使用、或正确依据发现采取行动。因此需要一套可执行诊断工具及配套训练流程，让智能体学会诊断性工具的使用。
AI.method: 1) ToolMLBench：面向数据检查、代码验证与实验诊断的可执行工具套件；2) SFT与RL训练流水线用于学习工具使用；3) SPICE：针对诊断调用价值依赖后续决策、最终结果反馈稀疏的问题，度量特权上下文如何改变采样工具动作的似然，将该差异作为回合级(turn-level)奖励，与最终结果奖励共同训练。
AI.result: 在80个合成任务上训练，25个域内和10个域外任务上评估。仅提供工具接口与描述在未适配模型上收益不稳定。相同诊断接口下，训练流水线将Qwen3-8B域内成功率从24.8%提升至52.4%，Qwen3.5-35B-A3B从35.6%提升至69.2%；后者域外也从31%提升至48%。
AI.conclusion: 结果表明学习式诊断工具使用可跨held-out数据源与目标泛化，SPICE的回合级奖励有效解决了诊断调用信用分配的难题，验证了工具+训练流程在MLE智能体中的价值。

title: BASE: Batch-Aware Selection of Experts Using Predicted Removal Error for Efficient MoE Decoding
summary: Large language models are increasingly expensive to serve. In large-scale serving systems, autoregressive decoding is often bottlenecked by transferring model weights from accelerator high-bandwidth memory into on-chip SRAM. Mixture-of-experts (MoE) models reduce computation by activating only a small subset of experts per token, but this sparsity does not translate directly to batched decoding. Different requests select different experts; therefore, the combined active set across many concurrent requests can span a substantial fraction of the expert pool and require significantly more expert weights to be transferred. Most expert-reduction techniques make retention decisions independently for each token and therefore do not address this batch-level expansion. More recently, batch-aware methods have attempted to coordinate expert use across concurrent requests and reuse experts already fetched for the batch. Yet their selection criteria are based primarily on router rankings or expert statistics collected during calibration. Consequently, these criteria are not directly tied to the output error caused by dropping an expert, nor do they capture how an expert's contribution changes across tokens at inference time. We instead rank experts according to how much their removal would change the MoE-layer output. To apply this criterion during serving, we train a lightweight linear predictor during calibration that estimates the expert removal cost for each incoming token, and develop custom GPU kernels for cost prediction and expert selection. Across three MoE architectures, BASE improves the quality-efficiency tradeoff without retraining. On Qwen3-30B-A3B, it improves average accuracy by 29.5 points over the strongest baseline at comparable throughput under a tight expert budget. At a higher expert budget, it is 60% faster than dense inference while remaining within 0.4 accuracy points.

AI.tldr: 提出BASE方法，按"移除专家对MoE层输出的影响"对专家排序，通过校准期训练的轻量线性预测器在线估计移除代价，并配以定制GPU内核，在不重训的前提下改善MoE推理的质量-效率权衡。
AI.motivation: 大模型服务成本高，自回归解码常受限于将模型权重从HBM搬运到片上SRAM的带宽瓶颈。MoE虽通过稀疏激活降低计算量，但在批量解码时不同请求选中的专家并集可能覆盖很大比例的专家池，导致需搬运的专家权重显著增加。现有专家削减方法多为逐token独立决策，无法应对这种批级专家集膨胀；较新的批感知方法虽复用已取专家，但其选择准则主要基于路由器排名或校准统计量，与"丢弃某专家造成的输出误差"不直接相关，也无法刻画该专家贡献在推理时随token的变化。
AI.method: 以"移除某专家对MoE层输出的改变量"作为专家排序准则（即专家移除代价）。为在服务时应用该准则，在校准阶段训练一个轻量线性预测器，对每个到来的token估计其专家移除代价；并开发用于代价预测与专家选择的定制GPU内核。方法无需重训练。
AI.result: 在三种MoE架构上，BASE在不重训练的情况下改善了质量-效率权衡。在Qwen3-30B-A3B上，在严格专家预算下，于相当吞吐量时相较最强基线平均准确率提升29.5个百分点；在更高专家预算下，比稠密推理快60%，同时准确率差距保持在0.4个百分点以内。
AI.conclusion: 以输出误差为导向（而非路由器排名或离线统计）的专家移除代价准则，结合轻量在线预测器与定制内核，能有效缓解批量解码中的专家权重搬运瓶颈，在无需重训练的条件下实现更优的精度-吞吐折衷，适用于多种MoE架构。

title: JudgeProfile: Understanding and Steering Subjectivity in LLM Judges
summary: LLM judges are inherently subjective, often favoring different responses in pairwise comparison when neither option is objectively wrong. To study this subjectivity, we introduce JudgeProfile, a framework that dissects LLM evaluation into perception (how a judge compares two responses across specific attributes like clarity, correctness, and detail) and prioritization (how much each attribute influences the final choice). We curate SubjectiveSet, a dataset of 50,013 response pairs from 17 public data sources, evaluated by 21 LLM judges across 87 attributes. We find a hidden consensus in perception: judges frequently agree on attribute judgments even when their overall choices diverge. Building on this separation, we first characterize each judge's prioritization using attribute weights estimated from its own overall choices. These weights differ across judges even when estimated from the same attribute judgments. We then learn new weights from reference labels to adapt their decisions to a target evaluation standard. Reweighting perceived attributes improves average held-out agreement with reference labels from 66.48% to 71.97%, outperforming fine-tuning and rubric prompting. Our findings show that understanding and steering the subjectivity of LLM judges requires attention not only to what they perceive, but also to how they prioritize it.

AI.tldr: 本文提出JudgeProfile框架，将LLM评判解耦为感知（属性层面比较）与优先级（属性对最终选择的影响权重）两个部分，构建SubjectiveSet数据集并发现评委在感知上存在隐性共识，通过重加权属性可将与参考标签的一致率从66.48%提升至71.97%。
AI.motivation: LLM评判具有内在主观性：当两个回复都不存在客观错误时，评委常在两两比较中偏好不同。这种主观性来源不明，且难以刻画与调控，因此需要将评判过程拆解，以理解主观性究竟来自"感知差异"还是"优先级差异"。
AI.method: 提出JudgeProfile框架，把LLM评判分解为感知（评委在清晰度、正确性、细节等具体属性上如何比较两个回复）与优先级（各属性对最终选择的权重影响）。构建SubjectiveSet数据集，包含来自17个公开数据源的50,013对回复，由21个LLM评委在87个属性上评判；先基于各评委自身的整体选择估计其属性权重以刻画优先级，再依据参考标签学习新权重，使决策对齐目标评价标准。
AI.result: 发现感知存在隐性共识：即使整体选择分歧，评委在属性判断上仍频繁一致；而即便基于相同的属性判断，估计出的属性权重在不同评委间也存在差异。用参考标签重新学习权重后，平均留出集与参考标签的一致率由66.48%提升至71.97%，优于微调与rubric prompting。
AI.conclusion: 理解并引导LLM评委的主观性，不仅需关注其"感知到什么"，还需关注其"如何对感知结果排序加权"；感知与优先级的分离为刻画、诊断和调控评委主观性提供了有效框架。

title: The Role of Feed-Forward Layers in Transformer Dynamics
summary: We study the dynamical behavior of tokens in transformers from a control-theoretic perspective. Our model includes the feed-forward layer present after the self-attention mechanism, with the self-attention mechanism interpreted as an interacting particle system and the feed-forward layer as an independent control. Our main theoretical result establishes that the feed-forward network can steer the tokens arbitrarily close to consensus regardless of the key, query, and value matrices. Our result are easily extended to convergence to many clusters and to multi-head attention. We conduct numerical experiments to verify our results, and compare thresholding behavior from our theory to real-world LLMs.

AI.tldr: 本文从控制论视角研究Transformer中token的动力学，将自注意力建模为交互粒子系统、前馈层建模为独立控制，证明前馈网络可将token任意逼近共识，并推广至多簇收敛与多头注意力。
AI.motivation: Transformer中token表征的演化机制缺乏系统性的动力学理论刻画，尤其自注意力与前馈层如何协同驱动token趋于聚集尚不清晰，作者希望用控制论框架给出可解释的收敛性保证。
AI.method: 将自注意力机制解释为交互粒子系统，前馈层视作对每个token的独立控制输入，构建控制论模型；利用控制理论分析该系统的可控性与收敛性，并推广至多簇收敛及多头注意力情形；辅以数值实验验证。
AI.result: 主要理论结果表明，无论键、查询、值矩阵如何取值，前馈网络都能将token引导至任意接近共识的状态；该结论可扩展至多簇收敛与多头注意力；数值实验验证了理论，并将理论中的阈值行为与真实LLM进行对比。
AI.conclusion: 前馈层是实现token共识的关键可控机制，为理解Transformer表征坍缩与聚类现象提供了控制论解释，并与实际LLM行为相印证。

title: Can AI Scientists Change Their Minds? Prior-Evidence Conflict in Synthetic Universes
summary: Can a scientific agent distinguish a law it inferred from evidence from one it merely recognizes? We introduce Synthetic Universes, a controlled benchmark that pairs canonical famous worlds with matched twisted twins governed by nearby noncanonical mechanisms. We evaluate each reported law twice: by executing it on held-out continuations and transfer settings, and by independently checking whether it recovers the generating mechanism. In the current checkpoint of a pre-specified 60-cell study, 22 trials were graded and one additional run ended in infrastructure failure. Among 20 twin trials, 8 pass predictive verification while 5 recover the generator. The dissociation is bidirectional: six parsable outputs predict successfully while missing the mechanism, whereas three recover the mechanism but fail predictive rollout. Drag exhibits the first pattern (5/5 predictive pass, 1/5 mechanism recovery); Gravity exhibits the second (1/5 predictive pass, 4/5 mechanism recovery). Because matched famous controls, the corrected identifiability sweep, and the Evidence Ladder remain incomplete, we do not claim a confirmatory causal prior-conflict effect. Instead, the completed runs establish a narrower verification result: predictive adequacy and mechanism recovery are distinct scientific claims and require distinct tests.

AI.tldr: 论文提出"合成宇宙"基准，将著名物理世界与受近似非典型机制支配的"镜像孪生世界"配对，对智能体推断出的定律同时做预测性验证与生成机制恢复检验，发现在20个孪生试验中存在预测成功与机制恢复的双向解离，因而二者是相互独立的科学主张。
AI.motivation: 科学智能体能否区分"从证据推断出的定律"与"仅凭识别套用的定律"这一核心问题尚未被有效检验。以往评估多只看预测表现，无法判断其是否真正恢复了生成机制。
AI.method: 提出 Synthetic Universes 受控基准：将典型著名世界与其"扭曲孪生"世界配对，孪生世界由邻近但非典型的机制支配。每条报告定律接受两种评估：一是将定律作用于留出续接与迁移设定上的执行检验，二是独立检验其是否恢复真实生成机制。采用预注册的60格研究设计，当前检查点中22个试验完成评分、另有1次运行因基础设施故障终止。
AI.result: 20个孪生试验中，8个通过预测验证，仅5个恢复生成机制；解离是双向的：6个可解析输出预测成功但未捕捉机制，3个恢复机制却预测展开失败。Drag呈前者模式（5/5预测通过、1/5机制恢复），Gravity呈后者模式（1/5预测通过、4/5机制恢复）。
AI.conclusion: 因匹配的著名对照、校正后的可辨识性扫描及"证据阶梯"尚未完成，作者不主张确证性的因果先验冲突效应；已完成运行支持一个更窄的结论——预测充分性与机制恢复是两种不同的科学主张，需要各自独立的检验。

title: Transversal Pooling Neural Networks
summary: Many learning tasks require stability to small transformations while retaining sensitivity to larger ones. We introduce \emph{transversal pooling neural networks}, which generalize spatial max pooling to affine group actions. We establish equivariance to a chosen subgroup and derive explicit stability bounds for individual pooled wavelet coefficients under affine perturbations of the input. Experimentally, we demonstrate the utility of our networks in low-data environments and for predicting tropical cyclone intensification.

AI.tldr: 提出横向池化神经网络（transversal pooling neural networks），将空间最大池化推广到仿射群作用，建立对所选取子群的等变性，并推导出单个池化小波系数在输入仿射扰动下的显式稳定性界；实验验证其在低数据环境与热带气旋增强预测中的有效性。
AI.motivation: 许多学习任务需要模型对小变换保持稳定，同时对较大变换保持敏感。传统空间最大池化仅针对平移，难以处理更一般的仿射变换，因此需要一种能统一刻画此类稳定性—敏感性权衡的池化机制。
AI.method: 提出横向池化神经网络，将空间最大池化推广至仿射群作用；通过选取特定子群实现等变性，并针对单个池化小波系数在输入仿射扰动下推导显式的稳定性界。
AI.result: 理论上给出了等变性与显式稳定性界；实验上展示了该网络在低数据环境下的优势，以及在热带气旋增强预测任务中的应用价值。
AI.conclusion: 横向池化神经网络为仿射群作用下的稳定性与敏感性平衡提供了统一框架，兼具理论保证与实际效用，适用于数据稀缺场景及特定科学预测任务。

title: Can Representation Learning Decouple from Loss Minimization? Polar Updates Have an Answer
summary: Does representation learning stop when the training loss stops improving? We study this question for matrix Muon, whose polar-normalised updates have a step length set by the gradient's rank rather than its norm. Near the edge of stability, full-batch Muon on teacher-student problems enters approximately period-2 loss oscillations that persist for thousands of steps: the cycle-mean loss stays flat or rises, yet the weights keep moving and the learned features continue to align with the teacher subspace. For linear teacher-student learning toys, we derive explicit cycle and alignment formulas and conditional plateau and decay bounds. For a population mean-field ReLU model, we prove that, under stated dimension, initialisation and small-head conditions, the leading eigenspace of the average gradient outer product (AGOP) recovers the teacher subspace exactly during a loss plateau, before the loss later drops. In all 33 ReLU, GELU and SiLU teacher configurations we study, direction-only alignment metrics show the student AGOP aligned with, or still aligning to, the teacher subspace during the period-2 oscillations; projected head refitting on selected configurations shows that the learned directions are useful for prediction, and further measurements distinguish AGOP alignment from weight-mass concentration. In deep residual ReLU students, freezing the downstream layers while the first layer trains with full-batch exact polar updates recreates a nearly flat cycle-mean loss with improving input-AGOP alignment; freezing and unfreezing switch between this plateau and loss decrease, and the effect is sensitive to momentum and to the choice of orthogonaliser.

AI.tldr: 本文研究Muon优化器下表示学习是否在训练损失停止改善时终止。发现全批量Muon在稳定边缘会出现持续数千步的周期-2损失振荡,期间损失均值持平或上升,但权重持续移动且学习到的特征继续与教师子空间对齐。
AI.motivation: 探究表示学习是否随训练损失改善的停止而终止,特别针对Muon优化器:其极坐标归一化更新步长由梯度秩而非范数决定,这使得损失与表示学习之间可能存在解耦现象。
AI.method: 1) 对线性教师-学生问题推导显式的周期与对齐公式及条件性平台与衰减界;2) 对总体平均场ReLU模型,证明在给定维度、初始化和小头部条件下,平均梯度外积(AGOP)的主特征空间在损失平台期精确恢复教师子空间;3) 在33个ReLU/GELU/SiLU教师配置中测量方向对齐指标;4) 对深度残差ReLU学生进行冻结下游层、仅首层全批量精确极坐标更新的实验。
AI.result: 约2周期损失振荡可持续数千步,周期均值损失持平或上升,但权重持续变化且AGOP持续对齐教师子空间;AGOP主特征空间在损失下降前即精确恢复教师子空间;33个配置中方向对齐指标显示学生AGOP与教师子空间对齐或持续对齐;投影头部重拟合表明所学方向具有预测价值;冻结/解冻可切换平台与损失下降,且效果对动量和正交化器选择敏感。
AI.conclusion: 表示学习并不随训练损失停止改善而终止。Muon的极坐标更新可在损失平台期持续进行特征对齐,损失与表示学习可解耦;AGOP对齐与权重质量集中是可区分的现象。

title: BiFE: Search-Efficient Discovery of CPU-Only Branching Policies via LLM-based Bi-Fidelity Evolution
summary: In branch-and-bound (B&B) for mixed-integer linear programming (MILP), branching variable selection critically impacts efficiency. Existing neural branching policies often require GPU inference, while CPU-efficient symbolic expressions lack the representational capacity for complex logic. Large Language Model (LLM)-generated code provides a flexible search space for designing lightweight branching rules with diverse algorithmic logic. To discover effective rules within LLM-based evolutionary frameworks, a core challenge arises: full B&B evaluation on real instances is prohibitively expensive, whereas offline imitation learning suffers from distribution shift. To address this, we introduce a Bi-Fidelity Evolutionary framework (BiFE). It employs low-fidelity imitation scores as a rapid pre-screener and selectively applies high-fidelity on-instance evaluation only to elite candidates, effectively balancing search efficiency with performance reliability. Experiments validate both the search efficiency of BiFE and the competitiveness of its discovered rules, which outperform the SCIP solver and other baselines on CPUs, and even surpass certain GPU-based neural policies.

AI.tldr: 提出BiFE双保真演化框架，利用低保真模仿分数快速筛选、仅对精英候选执行高保真B&B实例评估，搜索并发现高效CPU分支变量选择规则。
AI.motivation: 分支变量选择对MILP的B&B效率至关重要；现有神经分支策略依赖GPU推理，而CPU高效符号表达式表达能力不足；LLM生成代码提供了灵活搜索空间，但LLM演化框架中面临全B&B评估代价过高、离线模仿存在分布偏移的核心难题。
AI.method: BiFE（Bi-Fidelity Evolutionary）框架：以低保真模仿分数作为快速预筛选器，仅对精英候选选择性施加高保真真实实例上的B&B评估，从而平衡搜索效率与性能可靠性。
AI.result: 实验验证了BiFE的搜索效率及所发现规则的竞争力，在CPU上优于SCIP求解器及其他基线，甚至超越部分基于GPU的神经策略。
AI.conclusion: BiFE通过双保真演化在LLM生成代码空间中高效发现轻量级分支规则，兼顾搜索效率与性能可靠性，为CPU友好的MILP分支提供有效方案。

title: Action Chunking Proximal Policy Optimization with Feedback Correction
summary: Action chunking provides temporal abstraction in reinforcement learning by selecting short action sequences instead of individual actions, but many existing approaches face two limitations in high-dimensional robotic control. First, many rely on value functions over action chunks, which can be difficult to learn as action dimensionality and chunk length grow. Second, executing chunks open-loop removes within-chunk feedback, limiting reactivity in contact-rich tasks. We present Action Chunking PPO (ACPPO), a PPO extension that uses a chunked actor while retaining a standard state-value critic, thereby avoiding chunked Q-functions. We further propose ACPPO-Corr, which augments the chunk planner with a stepwise feedback corrector that adjusts planned actions online within each chunk. Across 25 simulated robotics tasks from IsaacGym and Bi-DexHands, spanning locomotion, arm manipulation, and dexterous hand-object interaction, ACPPO-Corr achieves the strongest aggregate performance among evaluated methods and performs best on both decision-frequency-sensitive and decision-frequency-neutral task subsets. Ablations show that moderate chunk lengths work best and that corrector regularization is important for balancing chunk-level planning with local feedback. These results suggest that action chunking can be effective in online PPO when chunk-level planning is paired with closed-loop correction. The code is available at: https://github.com/hshhahn/ACPPO.

AI.tldr: 本文提出ACPPO及ACPPO-Corr：用分块actor配合标准状态价值critic避免学习分块Q函数，并加入逐步反馈校正器实现块内闭环，在25个仿真机器人任务上取得最佳综合性能。
AI.motivation: 高维机器人控制中，动作分块虽能提供时间抽象，但现有方法存在两大局限：一是依赖动作块上的价值函数，随动作维度和块长增长难以学习；二是开环执行动作块，丧失块内反馈，在接触丰富任务中反应性受限。
AI.method: 提出ACPPO，作为PPO扩展，使用分块actor（chunked actor）同时保留标准状态价值critic，从而避免分块Q函数；进一步提出ACPPO-Corr，在块规划器上增加逐步反馈校正器，在每个块内在线调整规划动作。
AI.result: 在IsaacGym和Bi-DexHands的25个仿真机器人任务（涵盖运动、机械臂操作和灵巧手-物体交互）上，ACPPO-Corr在所评估方法中取得最强综合性能，并在决策频率敏感和决策频率中性两个任务子集上均表现最佳。消融实验表明，中等块长效果最好，校正器正则化对平衡块级规划与局部反馈很重要。
AI.conclusion: 结果表明，当块级规划与闭环校正相结合时，动作分块在在线PPO中可以有效发挥作用。代码已开源。

title: Distinguish or Homogenize: Last-Chance Policy Identification and Risk-Budgeted Recovery under Irreversible Resource Depletion
summary: Under irreversible resource depletion, an agent can spend resources to distinguish among latent fault models, or to change the system state so that the remaining models admit a common acceptable continuation--at which point further diagnosis becomes unnecessary. This distinguish-or-homogenize principle identifies a path that existing frameworks for identification, planning, and diagnosis do not make explicit: prior formulations treat the mapping from fault models to acceptable policies as a given, whereas LCPI makes it a function of the agent's own actions. We formalize this principle through Last-Chance Policy Identification (LCPI), where correctness is evaluated at the state the agent reaches rather than at the initial state. The Last Identifiable Margin (LIM) marks the feasibility boundary between distinguishing and homogenizing. For deterministic diagnostic graphs we provide the Exact-LIM recursion; for noisy finite-horizon recovery we propose Risk-Budgeted Compatibility Planning (RBCP), which searches a compatibility-aware frontier under a hard worst-case failure constraint. Across incident recovery on abstract microservice topologies and latent-damage navigation in MiniGrid, RBCP improves risk-feasible recovery while satisfying the failure budget. A sham control--cost-matched actions that preserve model incompatibility--eliminates the gain entirely, confirming that the benefit comes from changing which policies are acceptable for which models, not from extra search or additional budget.

AI.tldr: 本文提出"区分或同化"原则及LCPI框架，将故障模型到可接受策略的映射视为智能体自身动作的函数，并以LIM刻画可行性边界，配套Exact-LIM递归与RBCP算法。
AI.motivation: 在不可逆资源消耗下，智能体既可通过消耗资源区分潜在故障模型，也可改变系统状态使剩余模型共享一个可接受的延续，从而无需进一步诊断。既有识别、规划与诊断框架均将此映射视为给定，未显式刻画该路径。
AI.method: 形式化Last-Chance Policy Identification (LCPI)，正确性在智能体到达的状态而非初始状态处评估；用Last Identifiable Margin (LIM)标记区分与同化的可行性边界。针对确定性诊断图给出Exact-LIM递归；针对噪声有限时域恢复提出Risk-Budgeted Compatibility Planning (RBCP)，在硬性最坏情况失败约束下搜索兼容性感知前沿。
AI.result: 在抽象微服务拓扑的事件恢复与MiniGrid潜在损伤导航任务中，RBCP在满足失败预算的同时提升了风险可行恢复率；成本匹配的sham对照（保持模型不兼容）完全消除增益，表明收益来自改变"哪些策略对哪些模型可接受"，而非额外搜索或预算。
AI.conclusion: "区分或同化"原则与LCPI为资源受限下的故障处理提供了新范式：通过动作主动改变可接受策略集合，可将诊断转化为非必要，Lim与RBCP分别给出确定性与噪声场景下的可计算解法。

title: The Signed Geometry of One-Shot Recourse: On-Path Validity and the Signed-Curvature Criterion
comment: Main text 8 pages; 57 pages including appendix and checklist
summary:
Closed-form recourse moves a rejected user along the unit gradient $\hat g$ of the classifier score $f$ by the promised distance $d_p=|f(x)|/\|
abla f(x)\|$, at which the linearized score reaches zero. We ask when this one-shot step succeeds and what additional model queries change. To leading order the step ends on the favorable side exactly when the path curvature $κ=\hat g^	op
abla^2 f(x)\,\hat g$ is nonnegative. Across 80 shallow models, the fraction of rejected users whose step ends there and the fraction with $κ\ge0$ correlate at $r=0.985$, although on Fashion-MNIST the first falls below the second by 8.2 points on average. No rule that uses only the score value and gradient can be valid for every score with path curvature bounded by $K$ without overshooting some by order $Kd_p^2/\|
abla f(x)\|$. When the curvature is also Lipschitz and the step is short, one evaluation of $f$ at the promised point attains the minimax rate among deterministic one-query rules that know the curvature bound and its Lipschitz constant, and split-conformal calibration makes such a rule reach the first crossing or abstain with probability at least $1-δ$. Training with an asymmetric curvature penalty lets 99-100% of paths cross within the promised step on undershoot-prone shallow data, at about 4-22 times the overshoot of symmetric penalties (Fashion-MNIST, COMPAS). Because $κ$ and $d_p$ depend on how the score is scaled, part of this gain can be a longer promised step, and at matched validity a smaller audit of briefly trained models finds no uniform advantage over tuned inflation. Where a per-user line search along the ray is affordable, it is exact to grid resolution and preferable.

AI.tldr: 本文分析分类器"闭式补救"（沿梯度一步移动承诺距离$d_p$）的成败条件：领头阶成败由路径曲率$\kappa$符号决定（与经验相关性$r=0.985$），并给出仅用分数与梯度的规则无法通用、增加一次查询可达极小极大最优、非对称曲率惩罚可提升覆盖率但收益部分源于尺度效应等结论。
AI.motivation: 实践中对"被拒用户"的补救常采用闭式一步移动：沿分类器得分$f$的单位梯度方向移动承诺距离$d_p=|f(x)|/\|\nabla f(x)\|$，使线性化得分归零。作者希望厘清：这一单步何时真正成功、额外查询能带来什么改进、以及如何在理论上刻画最优规则与校准有效性。
AI.method: 1) 对单步终点做二阶展开，推导领头阶成功条件即路径曲率$\kappa=\hat g^\top\nabla^2 f(x)\,\hat g\ge0$；2) 在80个浅层模型上做经验验证，比较"成功比例"与"$\kappa\ge0$比例"的相关性；3) 证明仅依赖分数值与梯度的规则在曲率有界$K$时无法对所有分数成立，存在$O(Kd_p^2/\|\nabla f(x)\|)$量级的过冲；4) 在曲率Lipschitz且步长较短时，设计在承诺点做一次$f$求值的确定性单查询规则，并证明其达到极小极大率；5) 用split-conformal校准赋予"到达首次穿越或弃权"的概率保证$1-\delta$；6) 用非对称曲率惩罚训练，并与对称惩罚在过冲上对比。
AI.result: 80个浅层模型上，单步落于有利侧的比例与$\kappa\ge0$的比例相关系数$r=0.985$；但在Fashion-MNIST上前者平均比后者低8.2个百分点。仅用分数与梯度的规则在曲率上界$K$下必然对部分样本过冲$O(Kd_p^2/\|\nabla f(x)\|)$。曲率Lipschitz且步短时，于承诺点求值一次可实现确定性单查询规则的极小极大率，配合split-conformal校准可达到至少$1-\delta$的成功或弃权概率。非对称曲率惩罚使欠冲倾向的浅层数据上99-100%路径在承诺步内穿越，但过冲约为对称惩罚的4-22倍（Fashion-MNIST、COMPAS）。
AI.conclusion: $\kappa$与$d_p$依赖分数尺度，故非对称惩罚带来的覆盖率收益部分来自更长的承诺步；在匹配有效性下，对训练较少模型的审计未发现其相对调优膨胀（tuned inflation）具有一致优势。若允许沿射线的逐用户线搜索且成本可接受，则线搜索在网格精度上精确且更可取。

title: SIPO: Unifying Reinforcement Learning with On-Policy Self-Distillation
summary: Reinforcement learning with verifiable rewards (RLVR) has become a standard paradigm for improving large language models (LLMs) on various tasks, yet its sparse outcome rewards lack token-level credit assignment for intermediate steps. To address this, on-policy self-distillation (OPSD) leverages a self-teacher with privileged context to provide additional dense learning signals. However, because the self-teacher is often overconfident and imposes excessive penalties on long reasoning trajectories, OPSD frequently struggles in practice. To mitigate this, we propose self-instructing policy optimization (SIPO) with a contrastive self-teacher to provide dense credit. At each iteration, SIPO samples multiple rollouts per prompt from the current policy, scores them with environment rewards, and constructs two teacher contexts for each rollout by pairing the reference answer with mistakes made within the group. The model then re-evaluates its own responses under both contexts, using the difference between the two teacher log-probabilities as token-level feedback, so that biases shared by both contexts are expected to largely cancel. The resulting objective yields a token-level advantage for every rollout: the reward still sets the main direction of each update while the self-teacher redistributes credit across tokens. Even in groups where every rollout fails and group-relative advantages vanish, SIPO still provides a learning signal. By preserving direct optimization of the task reward while providing dense, token-level feedback, this approach bridges reinforcement learning and on-policy self-distillation. Extensive experiments across multiple reasoning and code-generation benchmarks demonstrate that SIPO outperforms both RLVR and OPSD baselines without an external teacher or additional generation.

AI.tldr: 提出 SIPO（自指导策略优化），用对比式自教师提供密集的 token 级信用分配，在推理与代码生成任务上优于 RLVR 与 OPSD。
AI.motivation: RLVR 依赖稀疏的结果奖励，缺乏对中间步骤的 token 级信用分配；OPSD 虽引入带特权上下文的自教师提供密集信号，但自教师往往过度自信，对长推理轨迹施加过度惩罚，实践中效果不佳。
AI.method: SIPO 在每次迭代对同一 prompt 采样多条 rollout，用环境奖励打分，并基于组内错误与参考答案为每条 rollout 构造两个教师上下文；模型在两上下文下重新评估自身回答，以两者对数概率之差作为 token 级反馈，使共有偏见相互抵消。所得目标为每条 rollout 给出 token 级优势：奖励决定更新主方向，自教师在各 token 间重新分配信用；即使组内全部失败、组相对优势消失，仍能提供学习信号。无需外部教师或额外生成。
AI.result: 在多个推理与代码生成基准上，SIPO 优于 RLVR 和 OPSD 基线。
AI.conclusion: 通过保留任务奖励的直接优化并引入密集 token 级反馈，SIPO 弥合了强化学习与 on-policy 自蒸馏，是一种有效且无需外部教师或额外生成的 RLVR 改进方案。

title: CyFA: Linear Sequence Modeling with Relative-Time-Partitioned Memory
summary: Linear RNNs offer linear-time sequence processing and constant-memory decoding, but their fixed-size recurrent states must accommodate all past key--value associations. Existing forgetting mechanisms and Delta Rule updates reduce interference by selectively clearing or correcting the state, yet earlier associations can still become difficult to retrieve. We introduce CyFA (Cyclic Flow Attention), a Linear RNN with relative-time-partitioned memory. At each step, a learned clock controls the cyclic transport applied jointly to the key and value states before the current key--value pair enters the age-zero slot, thereby organizing stored associations across relative-time slots. We further derive an exact change to absolute-clock coordinates that expresses CyFA as two scalar-decay linear attention recurrences and enables efficient chunk-wise training. Across 400M--1.4B pretraining experiments with matched recurrent-state sizes, CyFA improves recall-intensive performance while maintaining competitive language modeling and high computational efficiency. At 400M, CyFA outperforms KDA on FDA (42.60 vs. 26.07) while requiring only 46.7% and 48.3% of KDA's forward and backward core-operator execution times, respectively. Our code is publicly available at \href{https://github.com/Chyxx/CyclicFlowAttention}{this https URL}.

AI.tldr: 提出CyFA（Cyclic Flow Attention），一种具有相对时间分区记忆的线性RNN，通过可学习时钟对键值状态进行循环传输，将关联组织到相对时间槽中，并推导出可高效分块训练的绝对时钟坐标表达，在回忆密集型任务上优于KDA且计算效率更高。
AI.motivation: 线性RNN具有线性时间处理和常数内存解码的优势，但其固定大小的循环状态需容纳所有过去的键值关联。现有遗忘机制和Delta Rule更新虽通过选择性清除或修正状态来减少干扰，但早期关联仍难以检索。因此需要一种能更好组织存储关联、缓解干扰的记忆机制。
AI.method: 提出CyFA（Cyclic Flow Attention）：在每个时间步，由一个可学习时钟控制对键状态和值状态联合施加的循环传输，在当前键值对进入"年龄为零"槽位之前进行组织，从而将存储的关联分配到不同的相对时间槽中。此外推导出一种精确的绝对时钟坐标变换，将CyFA表示为两个标量衰减的线性注意力递归，从而实现高效的分块训练。
AI.result: 在400M至1.4B规模的预训练实验中，在匹配循环状态大小的情况下，CyFA提升了回忆密集型性能，同时保持有竞争力的语言建模能力和高计算效率。在400M规模下，CyFA在FDA上优于KDA（42.60 vs. 26.07），且前向和后向核心算子执行时间分别仅为KDA的46.7%和48.3%。代码已公开。
AI.conclusion: CyFA通过相对时间分区记忆和循环传输机制，有效缓解了线性RNN中早期关联难以检索的问题，在回忆密集型任务上显著超越KDA，同时兼具高计算效率和竞争力强的语言建模性能，为线性RNN的记忆组织提供了新思路。

title: EASE: Behavior-Adaptive Skill Curation for Self-Evolving Agents
summary: Agent skills provide a lightweight mechanism for self-evolving agents to accumulate reusable procedural knowledge without updating model parameters. However, existing learned skill curators typically optimize curation without explicitly modeling downstream executor behavior. We show that this can cause systematic cross-executor degradation: curators trained with different executors perform best when paired with their own training executor, indicating that effective skill curation is executor-dependent. We formulate behavior-adaptive skill curation and introduce EASE, a framework that learns a single curator that adapts its decisions to different executor behaviors. EASE maintains an online behavioral profile of recent execution patterns and conditions the curator on this profile, the current trajectory, and retrieved skills to add, modify, or remove skills from an evolving repository. We train the shared curator jointly across multiple frozen executors with reinforcement learning, using retrieval-aware and behavior-aware temporal attribution to focus optimization on curation actions with observable downstream influence. Across ALFWorld, ScienceWorld, and WebShop, with executors ranging from Qwen3-8B/32B and GPT-OSS-120B to unseen Kimi K2.6, DeepSeek V4 Flash, and Gemini 3.5 Flash, EASE outperforms strong skill- and memory-based baselines without per-executor finetuning. EASE also maintains 34.5--41.0% fewer skills, improves skill retrieval by 36.3--38.7% and measured edit utility by 51.8--60.0%, and reduces deployment-time inference tokens by 9.1--14.5%. These results establish behavior-adaptive skill curation as an effective principle for building self-evolving agents.

AI.tldr: 论文提出"行为自适应技能策划"问题并给出 EASE 框架：用强化学习训练一个共享策划器，根据执行器在线行为画像动态增删改技能，在多执行器、多环境上无需逐执行器微调即显著优于基线。
AI.motivation: 现有自演化智能体的技能策划器（skill curator）在优化时未显式建模下游执行器（executor）的行为，导致跨执行器系统性退化：用某执行器训练出的策划器只有配对该执行器时表现最好，说明有效技能策划是"执行器依赖"的。因此需要让策划器能自适应不同执行器的行为。
AI.method: 形式化定义 behavior-adaptive skill curation，并提出 EASE 框架：1) 维护近期执行模式的在线行为画像（online behavioral profile）；2) 以该画像、当前轨迹和检索到的技能为条件，决定对不断演化的技能库进行 add/modify/remove 操作；3) 在多个冻结执行器上联合训练共享策划器，采用强化学习，并使用检索感知与行为感知的时间归因（retrieval-aware / behavior-aware temporal attribution），将优化聚焦于对下游有可观测影响的策划动作。
AI.result: 在 ALFWorld、ScienceWorld、WebShop 上，执行器覆盖 Qwen3-8B/32B、GPT-OSS-120B 以及未见过的 Kimi K2.6、DeepSeek V4 Flash、Gemini 3.5 Flash，EASE 在无逐执行器微调下优于强技能/记忆类基线；技能数量减少 34.5–41.0%，技能检索提升 36.3–38.7%，编辑效用提升 51.8–60.0%，部署期推理 token 降低 9.1–14.5%。
AI.conclusion: 行为自适应技能策划是构建自演化智能体的有效原则：单一共享策划器可跨异构、含未见执行器泛化，同时更省技能、更省 token。

title: Understanding LLM Parameter Update Sparsity through the Lens of Fisher
summary: Recent studies have observed that parameter changes during language-model post-training can be concentrated in a small subset of coordinates. This phenomenon has been reported in reinforcement learning, on-policy distillation, and supervised fine-tuning on near-policy data. Its recurrence across different post-training paradigms suggests shared structure in training dynamics. In this paper, we examine this pattern through the diagonal model Fisher, which measures the sensitivity of the model's output distribution to individual parameters and is independent of any particular reward or teacher signal. Theoretically, we show that small diagonal Fisher leads to small expected gradients across a range of training objectives, providing a common explanation for sparse gradient updates. Empirically, we test this connection in RL and OPD. We find that Fisher identifies where gradients are concentrated, and fixed sparse masks selected from the initial Fisher retain a large proportion of the improvement from full training. Finally, we investigate the mechanisms underlying low Fisher in on-policy training. Our results show that high-probability next tokens tend to have similar parameter sensitivities, contributing to low Fisher. Together, these results establish the diagonal model Fisher as a unifying perspective linking update sparsity to on-policy training dynamics in LLM post-training.

AI.tldr: 该论文研究语言模型后训练中参数变化集中于少数坐标的稀疏更新现象，从对角模型Fisher信息的角度给出统一解释，并验证其与on-policy训练动态的联系。
AI.motivation: 近期在强化学习、on-policy蒸馏和监督微调等多种后训练范式中都观察到参数变化集中于少数坐标的稀疏更新现象，这种跨范式的重复出现暗示训练动态存在共享结构，但缺乏统一解释。作者希望找到独立于具体奖励或教师信号的解释机制。
AI.method: 理论方面，作者使用对角模型Fisher（衡量输出分布对单个参数的敏感度，独立于奖励或教师信号），证明小的对角Fisher会导致多种训练目标的期望梯度较小，从而解释稀疏梯度更新。实证方面，在强化学习和on-policy蒸馏中检验该联系，使用从初始Fisher选出的固定稀疏掩码进行实验；并进一步分析on-policy训练中低Fisher的机制。
AI.result: 在RL和OPD中，Fisher能够识别梯度集中的位置；从初始Fisher选取的固定稀疏掩码保留了完整训练改进的很大比例。机制研究表明，高概率的下一个token往往具有相似的参数敏感度，从而导致低Fisher。
AI.conclusion: 对角模型Fisher为LLM后训练中更新稀疏性与on-policy训练动态之间的关联提供了统一视角。

title: Generalizable Lifelong Model Editing via Preference Optimization
summary: Knowledge editing enables rapid updates of specific factual knowledge in large language models (LLMs) without full retraining. However, more realistic scenarios call for a lifelong framework that handles continual updates rather than one-off modifications. In such settings, existing editing methods often overfit to target prompts, significantly degrading both the generalization of the edited knowledge and the model's general capabilities. To address this issue, we propose GLIME (Generalizable Lifelong Model Editing), which combines knowledge editing with preference optimization over generation behavior. GLIME further incorporates replay-based editing and a gradient constraint to preserve previously edited knowledge. Experimental results show that GLIME significantly improves knowledge generalization in lifelong editing settings while maintaining both editing performance and general capabilities.

AI.tldr: GLIME：将知识编辑与偏好优化相结合，并引入重放编辑与梯度约束，实现可泛化的终身模型编辑。
AI.motivation: 现实场景需要终身（持续更新）的模型编辑框架，而非一次性修改。现有编辑方法在持续编辑下常过拟合目标提示，导致编辑知识的泛化能力和模型通用能力显著退化。
AI.method: 提出GLIME（Generalizable Lifelong Model Editing），将知识编辑与针对生成行为的偏好优化相结合；并引入基于重放的编辑与梯度约束，以保留先前已编辑的知识。
AI.result: 实验表明，GLIME在终身编辑设置下显著提升知识泛化能力，同时保持编辑性能和模型通用能力。
AI.conclusion: GLIME通过偏好优化、重放编辑与梯度约束的协同，有效缓解终身编辑中的过拟合问题，在泛化性、编辑效果与通用能力间取得平衡。

title: Paired Multimodal Scaling Laws
summary: Existing multimodal scaling laws fit multimodality terms empirically after testing and never vary how much data is multimodally paired at fixed data budgets. We investigate how, under the same total data per modality, changing the number of paired data affects loss curves in multimodal classification tasks. We train models in three different environments and run experiment sweeps varying data sizes and pairing budget. Pairing ratios have a dramatic impact on loss and this impact is directly tied to how much information synergy the task contains. Only paired data is able to reduce synergistic loss, while unpaired data can reduce redundant or unimodal information up until unimodal floors. Unlike traditional scaling laws where loss drops immediately in power law decay, synergy acquisition is gated, requiring a critical threshold of paired data before synergistic loss falls at all. We introduce a new family of multimodal scaling laws where total data-attributable loss is the sum of four individual power laws corresponding to the four different information channels of redundancy, a unique channel per modality, and synergy, and show how this law is both more theoretically sound and empirically valid across our experiments. This law predicts multimodal loss in our experiments more accurately than existing laws, with 3.2% error on fit tests versus 10.4% error for the best pairing extension of published laws.

AI.tldr: 本文研究在固定总数据预算下改变多模态配对数据比例对分类任务损失曲线的影响，提出将总损失分解为冗余、各模态独有信息与协同四个信息通道的幂律之和的新型多模态缩放律。
AI.motivation: 现有多模态缩放律仅在测试后经验性地拟合多模态项，且在固定数据预算下从不改变多模态配对数据量，无法刻画配对比例对损失的影响，缺乏理论依据。
AI.method: 在三种不同环境中训练模型，开展数据规模与配对预算的扫描实验，在每种模态总数据量固定的条件下改变配对数据数量，观察损失曲线变化并据此建模。
AI.result: 配对比例对损失影响显著，且与任务所含信息协同程度直接相关；仅配对数据能降低协同损失，未配对数据可降低冗余或单模态信息直至单模态下限；协同获取存在门槛效应，需达到配对数据临界阈值协同损失才下降。新缩放律拟合测试误差3.2%，优于已发表规律最佳配对扩展的10.4%。
AI.conclusion: 总数据可归因损失为冗余、各模态独有通道与协同四个信息通道的幂律之和，该规律在理论上更合理、实验上更准确，且相比传统幂律即时衰减，协同获取是门控的。

title: Emergent Specialization in Populations of Self-Supervised Collaborative Vision Experts Without a Shared Gate or Cross-Agent Gradients
summary: Can a population of neural networks develop a useful division of labor without a shared gate or gradients between agents? We study a setting where each network has its own weights, trains independently on the same heterogeneous data, and can ask another agent for help through a forward pass. Unlike mixtures of experts, where a jointly trained gate assigns inputs to experts, specialization here must emerge without central control. We test this in a small scale proxy for predictive visual pretraining. Initially identical agents are finetuned on an unlabeled mixture of six visual domains using masked prediction of frozen DINOv3 features. We measure specialization by asking whether the best agent for an input aligns with its latent domain, and utilization by asking whether responsibility is distributed across agents. We progressively remove central control, ending with DISCO (DIStributed COllaboration) where each agent locally selects a helper, reads its internal state through a gradient free channel, and rewards its router only for the improvement that help provides. Specialization emerges and is useful. Randomly routed populations underperform a single generalist, while semantically routed populations outperform it, showing that specialization rather than population size drives the gain. Specialization persists without a central router, and gradient free communication lets nonexperts exploit emergent expertise. In DISCO, a random agent helped by the expert matches the solo generalist, while experts surpass it, including on data outside the specialization mixture. Local routers select the emergent expert for 98% of inputs. These effects persist across population size, model capacity, data imbalance, and finetuning seeds, providing measurable evidence for the dynamics needed by decentralized predictive pretraining.

AI.tldr: 该论文研究无共享门控、无梯度通信条件下神经网络群体能否自发形成有用的分工，并提出DISCO（分布式协作）机制，在视觉预训练代理任务中验证专业化可自发涌现并提升性能。
AI.motivation: 混合专家（MoE）依赖联合训练的门控将输入分配给专家，需要中心化控制。作者希望探究：若每个网络拥有独立权重、在相同异构数据上独立训练、仅通过前向传播请求同伴帮助，专业化分工是否仍能涌现，从而为去中心化预测式预训练提供依据。
AI.method: 在六个视觉域的无标签混合数据上，以冻结DINOv3特征的掩码预测为任务，对初始相同的智能体进行微调。逐步移除中心化控制，最终形成DISCO：每个智能体本地选择帮手，通过无梯度通道读取其内部状态，路由器仅按帮助带来的性能提升获得奖励。以"最优智能体是否与输入潜在域一致"衡量专业化，以"责任是否分散于多个智能体"衡量利用率。
AI.result: 专业化能够涌现且有效。随机路由的群体不如单一通才，而语义路由的群体优于通才，说明增益来自专业化而非群体规模。专业化在无中心路由器时依然持续，无梯度通信使非专家能利用涌现的专长。在DISCO中，被专家帮助的随机智能体可匹敌单独通才，专家则超越通才，且在专业化混合数据之外的数据上同样成立。本地路由器对98%的输入选择涌现出的专家。上述效应在群体规模、模型容量、数据不平衡和微调随机种子下均稳健。
AI.conclusion: 结果表明，无需共享门控或梯度通信，神经网络群体即可自发形成可测量且有用的专业化分工，为去中心化预测式预训练所需的动态机制提供了实证支持。

title: In-Context Learning Amplifies a Latent Symbolic Circuit
comment: Accepted to the Mechanistic Interpretability Workshop at ICML 2026
summary: Large language models can learn abstract rules from just a few in-context examples, but how their internal mechanisms activate as examples accumulate is not well understood. We trace a three-stage symbolic reasoning circuit (abstraction, induction, retrieval) across shot counts in three model families and find it is detectable and functional well before the model achieves high accuracy. Per-head causal contribution grows up to 8x from 1- to 10-shot, and cross-shot activation patching raises accuracy from 1% to 56% at 0-shot and 17% to 88% at 1-shot. Function vectors scaled and injected at 0-shot rescue accuracy up to 86%, largely substituting for the induction stage but depending critically on an intact downstream retrieval stage. The infrastructure for abstract rule-following is present in the weights before any demonstrations; in-context examples, function vectors, and related interventions appear to supply input to the same latent circuit.

AI.tldr: 大模型在少样本上下文示例下即可学习抽象规则，但其内部机制如何随示例累积被激活尚不清楚。本文追踪了一个三阶段符号推理电路（抽象、归纳、检索），发现其在模型达到高准确率之前即可被检测且具有功能。
AI.motivation: 大语言模型能从少量上下文示例中学习抽象规则，但示例累积过程中内部机制如何被激活尚缺乏理解，作者希望揭示抽象规则遵循的内部电路与激活动态。
AI.method: 在三个模型家族中，跨不同示例数（shot counts）追踪一个三阶段符号推理电路（抽象、归纳、检索）；采用逐头因果贡献度量、跨示例激活修补（cross-shot activation patching）、以及函数向量（function vectors）缩放与注入等干预手段。
AI.result: 该电路在模型达到高准确率之前即已被检测并具功能性；从1-shot到10-shot，逐头因果贡献增长最高达8倍；跨示例激活修补将0-shot准确率从1%提升至56%，将1-shot从17%提升至88%；在0-shot注入缩放后的函数向量可将准确率恢复至最高86%，基本可替代归纳阶段，但关键依赖于未受损的下游检索阶段。
AI.conclusion: 抽象规则遵循的基础设施在没有任何示例前就已存在于模型权重中；上下文示例、函数向量及相关干预似乎都为同一个潜在电路提供输入。

title: Code4Scene: Benchmarking Coding Agents for Constructing and Editing 3D Scenes
summary: Frontier coding agents can now write and execute code that authors 3D environments, but whether they reliably understand 3D structure and precisely control scene state remains unclear. The generated 3D scene is a persistent, executable artifact: a convincing render can hide incorrect spatial relations, intersecting objects, or unintended modifications. We introduce Code4Scene, a benchmark of 190 Unreal Engine cases built from human-assembled scenes that evaluates coding agents on two complementary settings under a shared execution interface. Construction tests scene-level spatial reasoning from open-ended language specifications, where many realizations are valid; editing tests precise control of scene state, where the agent must recover the target scene from reference images while preserving everything else. Rather than scoring code or rendered views, Code4Scene evaluates the generated engine-native scene for task fulfillment, artifact integrity, and static physical validity, with edits additionally compared against withheld ground truth. Across 14 coding-agent configurations on the 95-case public set, construction and editing performance are strongly correlated but not interchangeable (Spearman $ρ= 0.78$): Claude Fable 5.1 leads construction, Gemini 3.8 Flash leads editing, and GPT-6 Astra narrowly leads overall. Spatial Composition is the weakest construction category for every agent, while editing remains imprecise: the best Repair F1 is only 0.527, and 35.8% of edits that fully recover the target still introduce unintended changes elsewhere in the scene. These results expose a gap between plausible 3D generation and reliable spatial reasoning and state control.

AI.tldr: 本文提出 Code4Scene 基准，包含 190 个基于 Unreal Engine 的人工搭建场景案例，用于评测编码智能体在开放式语言驱动的场景构建与基于参考图像的精确场景编辑两类任务中的表现，并通过对生成引擎原生场景的任务完成度、完整性及静态物理有效性进行评估，揭示当前智能体在三维空间推理与状态控制方面的不足。
AI.motivation: 前沿编码智能体已能编写并执行代码生成 3D 环境，但其是否真正理解三维结构、能否精确控制场景状态仍不明确。由于生成的 3D 场景是持久化、可执行的人工产物，仅凭渲染观感可能掩盖空间关系错误、物体相交或非预期修改等问题，因此需要一个面向引擎原生场景、同时考察空间推理与状态控制的评测基准。
AI.method: 作者构建 Code4Scene 基准，含 190 个来自人工搭建场景的 Unreal Engine 案例，在统一执行接口下设置两类互补任务：Construction 依据开放式自然语言规格考察场景级空间推理（允许多种合法实现）；Editing 要求智能体从参考图像恢复目标场景并保持其余部分不变，考察对场景状态的精确控制。评测不以代码或渲染图为评分对象，而是评估生成的引擎原生场景在任务完成度、人工产物完整性、静态物理有效性三方面的表现，编辑任务还与保留的 ground truth 对比。
AI.result: 在 95 个案例公开集上评测 14 种编码智能体配置：构建与编辑性能强相关但不可互换（Spearman ρ=0.78）；Claude Fable 5.1 在构建上领先，Gemini 3.8 Flash 在编辑上领先，GPT-6 Astra 总体略优。Spatial Composition 是所有智能体最弱的构建类别；编辑仍不精确，最佳 Repair F1 仅为 0.527，且 35.8% 完全恢复目标的编辑会在场景其他位置引入非预期改动。
AI.conclusion: 结果表明，当前编码智能体在看似合理的 3D 生成能力与可靠的空间推理和状态控制之间仍存在明显差距，Code4Scene 为衡量并推动弥合这一差距提供了诊断性基准。

title: Stochastic Optimization Under Power-Law Spectra: Tight Bounds and Shuffling Analysis
summary: Recent work has established that power-law spectral conditions on data enable tight convergence bounds for deterministic gradient descent, resolving the conflict between classical exponential bounds and observed power-law learning curves. In this work, we extend this result to the stochastic regime of high-dimensional machine learning. We provide two main contributions: (1) We generalize the power-law spectral theory to Stochastic Gradient Descent (SGD), showing that the same spectral exponents govern stochastic dynamics; (2) For the fundamental case of isotropic Gaussian data, we provide a precise analysis of data shuffling, deriving exact constants that prove Single Shuffle is strictly superior to Flip-Flop and IID sampling. Our results bridge the gap between abstract spectral theory and practical stochastic training choices, offering a unified picture of how data geometry drives optimization speed.

AI.tldr: 该工作将确定性格点下降的幂律谱条件理论推广到随机梯度下降，并针对各向同性高斯数据精确分析数据洗牌策略，证明单次洗牌严格优于翻转交替与独立同分布采样。
AI.motivation: 经典指数收敛界与实践中观测到的幂律学习曲线存在冲突；已有研究用数据上的幂律谱条件在确定性格点下降中解决了该冲突，但尚未覆盖高维机器学习的随机训练情形，且缺少对实际数据洗牌策略的理论刻画。
AI.method: 将幂律谱理论从确定性格点下降推广到随机梯度下降，论证相同的谱指数控制随机动力学；针对各向同性高斯数据这一基本情形，对数据洗牌进行精确分析，推导出精确常数以比较不同采样策略。
AI.result: 相同的谱指数同样支配随机梯度下降的动力学；在各向同性高斯数据下，通过精确常数证明单次洗牌严格优于翻转交替采样和独立同分布采样。
AI.conclusion: 研究在抽象谱理论与实际随机训练选择之间建立联系，给出数据几何如何驱动优化速度的统一图景，并为数据洗牌策略的优越性提供理论依据。

title: Aperture: Merge-Consistent Rotary States for Compressed Tokens
summary: Token compression combines content from several positions, yet rotary position embeddings usually assign the merged token one coordinate. We ask what positional information must survive later merges. Aperture stores Fourier moments of the token's weighted support at the model's rotary frequencies. We prove that these moments have minimal real dimension among continuous states sufficient for the selected expected rotary interactions. Represented mass makes updates additive; attention normalisation remains a separate readout choice. Uniform intervals give a centre rotation times a sinc gain. We characterise when centres determine interval widths and construct matched examples where they do not. Numerical checks verify the weighted-support implementation. In trained temporal readers, compression transfer varies with gain calibration and feature placement. In a prespecified native video question-answering comparison, stored support reaches $65.63\%$ accuracy versus $67.12\%$ for the deployed merging rule. These results separate exact positional preservation under compression from downstream benefit.

AI.tldr: 本文研究token压缩中的位置信息保留问题，提出Aperture方法，在旋转频率上存储token加权支撑的傅里叶矩，证明其维度最小性，并通过实验区分"精确位置保持"与"下游收益"。
AI.motivation: Token压缩会将多个位置的内容合并为一个token，但旋转位置嵌入通常只给合并后的token分配单一坐标，导致位置信息丢失。作者追问：在后续合并中，哪些位置信息必须保留才能维持旋转交互的正确性。
AI.method: 提出Aperture方法，在模型旋转频率上存储token加权支撑的傅里叶矩。利用加权支撑的表示质量使更新具有可加性；关注归一化作为独立的读出选择。对均匀区间情形，导出"中心旋转×sinc增益"形式，并刻画中心能确定区间宽度的条件，构造中心无法确定宽度的配对例子。通过数值验证加权支撑实现，并在训练好的时间读取器和预设的原生视频问答任务上测试。
AI.result: 理论上证明这些矩在满足选定期望旋转交互的连续状态中具有最小实维度。数值检查验证了加权支撑实现。在训练好的时间读取器中，压缩迁移随增益校准和特征放置而变化。在预设的原生视频问答对比中，存储支撑达到65.63%准确率，而部署的合并规则为67.12%。
AI.conclusion: 结果将"压缩下精确的位置保持"与"下游收益"区分开来：Aperture在理论上以最小维度实现精确位置保持，但下游性能不一定优于现有合并规则，说明位置保真度与任务收益并非等价。

title: GNA: Granular Neighbor Assembly for Retrieval-Augmented Multivariate Time-Series Forecasting
summary: Deep forecasters predict from a fixed-length lookback window, and lengthening it gives diminishing returns at a growing cost. Retrieval augmentation instead shows the model how similar past situations continued. Retrieving a whole past window gives every variate the continuation of the same past moment. In multivariate series, however, the best past match differs from variate to variate. We present GNA (Granular Neighbor Assembly), a retrieval layer for forecasting backbones that assembles neighbors at two granularities: whole past windows, which keep the variates coherent, and per-variate neighbors, in which each variate takes its future from its own best-matching past. A learned gate decides, per forecast step and variate, how much to trust these futures against a persistence forecast, next to the backbone's own forecast. Candidates come from an embedding trained to predict each window's future, and retrieval is strictly causal: a past window is used only once its future has been observed. With the same lookback for every model and the same retrieval constants for all datasets, GNA improves two Transformer backbones in 85 of 96 dataset-horizon settings, gives the lowest MSE on 8 of 12 standard benchmarks and beats its backbone in every seed on 10 of them. Both granularities are needed, and neighbors of mismatched queries are worse than none. Retrieval helps most where the lookback says least: the gate shifts trust to retrieved futures further ahead. Where it fails, on hourly non-stationary series at long horizons, the loss is consistent with a drifting level of the retrieved futures.

AI.tldr: 提出检索增强预测层 GNA，在整体窗口与逐变量两种粒度上组装邻居，并用学习门控在骨干预测与持续预测之间权衡，显著提升 Transformer 骨干的预测性能。
AI.motivation: 固定长度回看窗口的预测器延长窗口收益递减且成本上升；检索增强能让模型看到相似历史情境的后续走向，但以整个历史窗口检索会让所有变量共享同一历史时刻的延续，而多变量序列中每个变量的最佳历史匹配各不相同。
AI.method: GNA（Granular Neighbor Assembly）是一个用于预测骨干的检索层，在两种粒度组装邻居：整体历史窗口（保持变量间一致性）与逐变量邻居（每个变量取自身最佳匹配历史的未来）。使用学习门控，在每个预测步与变量上决定对两类检索未来、以及持续预测的信任权重，并与骨干自身预测并列。候选来自一个以预测每个窗口未来为训练目标的嵌入，检索严格因果：历史窗口仅在其未来已被观测后才可使用。
AI.result: 在相同回看长度与相同检索超参下，GNA 在 96 个数据集-预测步设置中的 85 个上提升两个 Transformer 骨干；在 12 个标准基准中的 8 个取得最低 MSE，并在其中 10 个上于所有随机种子中优于骨干。两种粒度均为必需，查询不匹配的邻居比没有邻居更差。回看信息最少时检索收益最大：门控在更远的预测步上把信任转向检索到的未来。失败情形出现在长预测步的非平稳小时序列上，损失与检索未来的水平漂移一致。
AI.conclusion: 检索增强应同时考虑整体窗口与逐变量两种粒度，并通过门控自适应调节信任；GNA 在多数设置下稳定提升骨干性能，且检索在回看信息不足时最有用，其失败模式与非平稳序列中检索未来的水平漂移相关。

title: AI as a Compiler: Compiling Triton kernels without the Triton compiler
summary: Compiler backends are expensive to build and maintain as programming models, workloads, and accelerators evolve. We investigate whether large language models can replace the conventional optimizing and lowering pipeline, a process that we call AI lowering. We study AI lowering from Triton to NVIDIA PTX: an LLM agent translates Triton kernels directly into PTX. We build an environment that evaluates candidate PTX, and an agentic harness in which an LLM translates Triton kernels into PTX. Across twelve common kernels on Ada, Hopper, and Blackwell GPUs and ten kernels from recent ML papers, AI lowering achieves 0.83x-3.34x the performance of autotuned Triton. The largest gains come from transformations that Triton's lowering pipeline does not perform, such as decoding packed binary weights directly into Tensor Core operands (3.34x on BitDelta), assigning each thread a complete softmax row in tensor memory (1.37x on FlashAttention), and reusing overlapping convolution windows (up to 2.23x). These results rely on a robust evaluation harness with comprehensive verification support. We build on Volta, an existing PTX verifier, and substantially extend it to support modern GPU architectures by introducing support for Blackwell's tcgen05 Tensor Core interface. This requires modeling three architectural features: managed tensor memory, descriptor-based operand layouts, and asynchronous execution coordinated through commits, waits, memory barriers, and proxy fences. We discuss the challenges involved in formalizing them, as well as the current limitations. Our results suggest an emerging future in which AI compilers replace custom-written intermediate representations and checkers, reducing the time and engineering effort required to bring up software for new general-purpose and custom chips.

AI.tldr: 该论文提出"AI lowering"：用LLM智能体将Triton内核直接翻译为NVIDIA PTX，绕过传统编译器优化与降级流水线，并在多代GPU上验证了性能与可验证性。
AI.motivation: 编译器后端构建与维护成本高昂，且需随编程模型、工作负载与加速器的演进而不断适配。作者探究LLM能否取代传统优化与降级流水线，从而降低新硬件软件栈的适配成本。
AI.method: 以Triton到NVIDIA PTX的AI lowering为研究对象，构建可评估候选PTX的执行环境与LLM智能体框架，使LLM将Triton内核直接翻译为PTX；同时基于Volta（既有PTX验证器）大幅扩展，新增对Blackwell tcgen05 Tensor Core接口的支持，建模托管张量内存、基于描述符的操作数布局，以及由commit、wait、内存屏障与proxy fence协调的异步执行。
AI.result: 在Ada、Hopper和Blackwell GPU上的12个常见内核及10个来自近期ML论文的内核中，AI lowering达到自动调优Triton性能的0.83x–3.34x。最大收益来自Triton降级流水线未执行的变换，例如将打包二值权重直接解码为Tensor Core操作数（BitDelta上3.34x）、在张量内存中为每线程分配完整softmax行（FlashAttention上1.37x）、以及复用重叠卷积窗口（最高2.23x）。验证方面依赖具备全面验证支持的评估框架，并扩展了Volta以支持现代GPU架构。
AI.conclusion: 结果表明AI编译器有望取代手工编写的中间表示与检查器，减少为新通用及定制芯片引入软件支持所需的时间和工程投入；同时论文也讨论了相关形式化挑战与当前局限。这一方向预示了"AI lowering"在编译器后端的应用前景。

title: Representational and Functional Robustness to Electrode Montages in EEG Foundation Models
summary: EEG foundation models (EEG-FMs) are intended to generalize across different datasets by learning representations that, ideally, are invariant to dataset-specific EEG configurations such as electrode montages. However, EEG-FMs that accept different montages as input do not guarantee that representations and predictions remain stable across different electrode configurations, especially outside the training setting. In this work, we investigate the effects of different electrode montages through a joint functional and representational analysis of four EEG foundation models selected to span distinct montage-handling designs. We evaluate embeddings on cross-subject resting-state eyes-open/closed and within-subject motor-imagery classification under spatially informed channel reduction. Functional robustness is tested through the generalizability of linear probes across channel counts, while representational robustness is assessed through within-subject similarity and preservation of between-subject geometry. The four models show distinct robustness profiles, and the two axes dissociate: large changes in embedding similarity need not come with comparable probe degradation, and stable embeddings can still lose downstream performance. Comparing two readouts of the same encoder further shows that aggregation, not the encoder alone, determines functional robustness: pooling into anatomically aligned regions degrades less than a learned global readout, despite being montage-invariant by construction. Montage robustness is therefore a joint property of the encoder and its aggregation, and characterizing it requires both a representational and a functional axis. Input compatibility alone is evidence for neither.

AI.tldr: 本文对四种采用不同导联处理设计的EEG基础模型进行功能与表征双重分析，发现功能鲁棒性与表征鲁棒性可分离，且导联鲁棒性是编码器与聚合方式的联合属性。
AI.motivation: EEG基础模型声称可跨数据集泛化，但接受不同导联输入并不等于表征与预测在不同电极配置下保持稳定，尤其缺乏在训练设置之外的验证。
AI.method: 选取四种代表不同导联处理设计的EEG基础模型，在跨被试静息态睁眼/闭眼与单被试运动想象任务下进行空间感知的通道缩减评估；通过线性探针的跨通道数泛化衡量功能鲁棒性，通过被试内相似性与被试间几何结构保持衡量表征鲁棒性。
AI.result: 四种模型呈现不同的鲁棒性分布，功能与表征两轴相互解离：嵌入相似度的大幅变化未必带来相应的探针性能下降，而稳定的嵌入也可能损失下游性能。同一编码器的两种读出方式对比显示，聚合方式而非编码器决定功能鲁棒性，按解剖区域池化比学习式全局读出退化更小。
AI.conclusion: 导联鲁棒性是编码器与其聚合方式的联合属性，需同时从表征与功能两个维度刻画；仅凭输入兼容性不足以作为鲁棒性的证据。

title: UpliftMem: Learning Set-Level Uplift for Agent Memory Retrieval
summary: Large language model (LLM) agents reuse external memory to guide new tasks, but effective retrieval requires learning which memory sets improve execution. Such learning relies on costly outcome feedback: ordinary retrieval observes only executed sets, while evaluating alternatives requires additional rollouts. We introduce \textsc{UpliftMem}, which learns memory retrieval from set-level execution uplift relative to the same executor without memory. A theoretical analysis of how retrieval preferences restrict feedback coverage motivates targeted probing of alternative memory sets. Probe selection follows an expected value of sample information (EVSI) criterion, derived in closed form under a correlated Gaussian model, to allocate limited training rollouts according to their expected improvement in local retrieval decisions. The shared scorer is trained with a frozen executor and selects memory sets without test-time probes. Across ALFWorld, WebShop, and BigCodeBench, \textsc{UpliftMem} achieves the best success rates among evaluated baselines on the main evaluation sets. Controlled fixed-store and matched probe budget evaluations further demonstrate improved memory-use decisions and more effective use of execution feedback.

AI.tldr: 本文提出 UpliftMem，通过集合级“执行增益”学习 LLM 智能体的记忆检索，并用 EVSI 准则指导探测，提升记忆使用决策与成功率。
AI.motivation: LLM 智能体复用外部记忆以指导新任务，但有效检索需学习“哪些记忆集能提升执行效果”。该学习依赖代价高昂的结果反馈：普通检索仅能观测到已执行集合，评估备选集合则需额外 rollout，导致反馈覆盖受限。
AI.method: 1) 以同一执行器在无记忆条件下的表现作为参照，学习集合级执行增益（uplift）来训练记忆检索；2) 通过理论分析揭示检索偏好对反馈覆盖的限制，据此对候选记忆集进行定向探测；3) 采用期望样本信息价值（EVSI）准则筛选探测，并在相关高斯模型下给出闭式解，以按局部检索决策的预期改进分配有限训练 rollout；4) 共享 scorer 在冻结执行器下训练，测试时无需探测即可选择记忆集。
AI.result: 在 ALFWorld、WebShop 与 BigCodeBench 上，UpliftMem 在主评测集上取得所评估基线中的最佳成功率。固定记忆库与匹配探测预算的受控评测进一步表明其记忆使用决策更优、对执行反馈的利用更有效。
AI.conclusion: 以集合级执行增益为监督信号并结合 EVSI 定向探测，可在有限反馈预算下有效学习记忆检索策略，且推理阶段无需额外探测。

title: When Trees Are Not Enough: Learning Mixed-Topology Feature Graphs with Adaptive Graph Sparse Autoencoders
summary: Sparse autoencoders (SAEs) expose interpretable features in large language model activations, yet existing structured SAEs impose single-parent trees or forests, while post-hoc graphs permit multiple parents but neither guide feature learning nor ensure reliable relation recovery. We introduce the Adaptive Graph Sparse Autoencoder (AG-SAE), a structure-guided training paradigm that treats each feature's complete parent set as an atomic structural hypothesis and lets evidence select zero, one, or multiple parents. By competing complete parent sets against null, subset, and alternative explanations, AG-SAE identifies jointly necessary multi-parent relations while rejecting redundant or spurious alternatives and verifying that each child contributes beyond its parents. The induced topology over SAE features then defines a differentiable structural loss that guides SAE training, while topology-guided refinement mitigates feature absorption and uses persistent reconstruction gaps exposed by the learned structure to initialize new features. The entire graph is then induced again from the revised dictionary by reassessing every feature's complete parent set, closing the dictionary-graph self-consistency cycle. Experiments demonstrate exact mixed-topology recovery in a controlled toy model, greater relational reliability and semantic validity than structured and post-hoc baselines on real LLM activations, and stronger feature-level causal interventions than conventional SAE features. AG-SAE thereby turns recovered mixed-topology feature structure into an unsupervised training signal that improves the dictionary, enables reliable feature organization beyond the topological limitations of trees, and exhibits stronger causal control beyond reconstruction.

AI.tldr: 提出AG-SAE，以"完整父集"为原子结构假设、由证据选择0/1/多父节点，将诱导出的混合拓扑作为可微结构损失引导SAE训练，并迭代闭合字典-图自一致循环，实现可靠的混合拓扑特征恢复与更强因果控制。
AI.motivation: 现有结构化SAE只允许单父树或森林，表达能力受限；事后构图的图方法虽允许多父，但不参与特征学习，也无法保证关系恢复的可靠性。因此需要一个既能引导特征学习、又能可靠恢复多父关系的结构感知SAE训练范式。
AI.method: 1) 将每个特征的完整父集作为原子结构假设，与空集、子集及替代解释竞争，选出零/单/多父；2) 识别联合必要的多父关系，拒绝冗余或伪相关，并验证子节点在父节点之外仍有额外贡献；3) 由SAE特征上的诱导拓扑构造可微结构损失，指导SAE训练；4) 拓扑引导的细化缓解特征吸收，并利用学到的结构暴露的持续重构缺口初始化新特征；5) 从修订后的字典重新诱导整图，闭合字典-图自一致循环。
AI.result: 在受控玩具模型上实现精确的混合拓扑恢复；在真实LLM激活上，关系可靠性与语义有效性均优于结构化及事后构图基线；特征级因果干预效果强于常规SAE特征。
AI.conclusion: AG-SAE把恢复出的混合拓扑特征结构转化为无监督训练信号，既改进字典质量，又突破树的拓扑局限实现可靠特征组织，并在重构之外提供更强的因果控制能力。

title: CAD-Native Transformer Operators for AI-Aided Engineering
summary: Modern engineering systems, from automobiles to aircraft, are designed by using precise, continuous parametric computer-aided design (CAD) models. Evaluating design changes through numerical simulation requires meshing the continuous geometry, a computationally expensive and often brittle process that can require manual intervention and replaces the continuous representation with a discrete approximation. Most neural surrogates accelerate the simulation, but inherit this representation gap by relying on meshes, point clouds, voxels, or other sampled approximations of geometry. We introduce CANTO, a transformer neural operator that maps directly from continuous CAD geometry to physical fields, without meshing the input geometry. We develop a theoretical framework for learning operators from geometric manifolds to function spaces of physical fields, representing geometry through sequences of parametric patches. CANTO instantiates this framework by directly tokenizing non-uniform rational B-spline (NURBS) patches from their control points, knot vectors, and weights, and predicts continuous surface and volume fields at arbitrary query locations. We evaluate CANTO on four automotive and aircraft aerodynamics industry benchmarks: AhmedML, WindsorML, DrivAerML, and HiLiftAeroML. CANTO achieves state-of-the-art accuracy on most evaluated surface and volume prediction tasks, including a 19.8% reduction in surface-pressure relative $L_2$ error compared with AB-UPT on HiLiftAeroML. Differentiability with respect to CAD parameters further enables gradient-based inverse design of designs. On AhmedML, CANTO identifies designs with 4.4 to 20.4% lower drag than the best dataset designs satisfying the same volume and lift constraints, with the improvements verified using the same CFD setup used to generate the original dataset.

AI.tldr: CANTO是一种直接以连续CAD几何（NURBS）为输入的Transformer神经算子，无需网格化即可预测物理场，在多个气动基准上取得最优精度并支持梯度反设计。
AI.motivation: 现有神经代理模型虽能加速仿真，但依赖网格、点云、体素等离散近似，继承了CAD连续几何与离散表示之间的表示鸿沟；而网格化本身计算昂贵、易出错且常需人工干预。
AI.method: 提出从几何流形到物理场函数空间的学习算子理论框架，通过参数化面片序列表示几何；CANTO实例化该框架，直接对NURBS面片的控制点、节点向量与权重进行token化，并在任意查询位置预测连续曲面与体场。
AI.result: 在AhmedML、WindsorML、DrivAerML、HiLiftAeroML四个汽车与航空气动基准上，多数表面与体预测任务达到SOTA；在HiLiftAeroML上表面压力相对L2误差较AB-UPT降低19.8%；在AhmedML上找到比同体积与升力约束下最优数据集设计阻力低4.4%–20.4%的设计，并经原始CFD验证。
AI.conclusion: CANTO消除了仿真中的网格化表示鸿沟，可直接从连续CAD几何预测物理场；对CAD参数的可微性支持基于梯度的反设计，展示了在工业气动场景中的精度与设计优化价值。

title: MoRE: Scaling mixture of experts with hardware-aware low-rank routing
summary: Mixture-of-Experts (MoE) layers are central to frontier language models, and recent architectures push toward more and smaller experts. In this regime, the standard linear router becomes a bottleneck: with $M$ experts and hidden dimension $h$, its per-token cost $Θ(Mh)$ dominates the MoE layer once $M$ is large. We introduce MoRE (Mixture of Rank-reduced-routed Experts), which factorizes the router weight matrix at rank $r$ and reduces the routing cost to $O((h + M)r)$. We prove that rank logarithmic in $M$ suffices for routing expressivity when the number of active experts is fixed, and is necessary up to precision factors. We also prove that logarithmic rank preserves load balance in a Gaussian memorization model, and training on a synthetic phonebook task shows that low rank does not hurt memorization. At matched active FLOPs, the factorization allows a factor of $Θ(h/r)$ more experts. To realize this gain in wall-clock time, we design a fused Triton kernel at inference that avoids expensive memory operations on HBM. Empirically, MoRE improves memorization on the phonebook task and performance on knowledge-intensive Q\&A benchmarks after pretraining, while matching reasoning ability. Code available at https://github.com/Matheart/MoRE_code.

AI.tldr: 提出MoRE，通过对路由器权重矩阵进行秩r分解，将MoE路由成本从Θ(Mh)降至O((h+M)r)，并理论证明对数秩足够保持表达性与负载均衡，配合定制Triton核在墙钟时间上实现增益。
AI.motivation: 前沿语言模型中MoE层趋向于使用更多、更小的专家，此时标准线性路由器的每token成本Θ(Mh)（M为专家数，h为隐藏维度）成为瓶颈。
AI.method: MoRE将路由器权重矩阵做秩r分解，把路由成本降为O((h+M)r)；理论上证明当激活专家数固定时，关于M的对数秩足以保证路由表达性且（差精度因子下）是必要的，并证明对数秩在高斯记忆模型中保持负载均衡。此外设计推理期融合Triton核，避免HBM上昂贵的访存操作。
AI.result: 在匹配激活FLOPs下，该分解允许增加Θ(h/r)倍的专家数；合成phonebook任务训练显示低秩不损害记忆；墙钟时间上实现了增益；预训练后在phonebook任务记忆和知识密集型Q&A基准上均有提升，推理能力相当。
AI.conclusion: MoRE通过低秩路由分解缓解线性路由器瓶颈，在保持表达性、负载均衡与推理能力的同时，提升记忆与知识型任务表现，代码已开源。

title: Geometry-Conditioned Fixed-Scaffold Encoders for Time-Warp Robust Sequence Retrieval
summary: Embedding-based retrieval is attractive for long sequence collections because each item can be encoded once and searched by nearest-neighbor ranking. The difficulty is that the objects being indexed are often observed under a noncanonical clock: cardiac cycles stretch with rate, speech changes with tempo, and sensor traces reach comparable states at different speeds. This paper studies a specific source of instability in patch-based encoders for this regime. If patch boundaries are chosen from signal geometry, then the tokenization can change under the same temporal deformation that the representation is expected to tolerate. We propose GeoPatch, a fixed-scaffold patch encoder that keeps token support independent of geometry and uses slope, curvature, acceleration, affine-residual, and confidence descriptors only as continuous conditioning variables. The design turns boundary variation into feature modulation: geometry can change the embedding through a controlled pathway, but it cannot change the number, order, or support of local tokens. We formalize this distinction through a mechanism-level stability analysis that separates boundary drift, affine timing variation, confidence-weighted geometry perturbation, and retrieval-margin effects. The same local tokens support global embedding retrieval and late-interaction scoring, so the scoring rule can be matched to the evaluation protocol. Across ECG, speech, and multivariate time-series retrieval tasks, GeoPatch improves early-rank retrieval under timing variation while exposing a clear trade-off between local surface matching and strict non-overlap retrieval.

AI.tldr: 本文提出 GeoPatch，一种固定支架（fixed-scaffold）的 patch 编码器，使 token 支撑集独立于信号几何，几何信息仅通过连续条件变量调制特征，从而在非规范时钟下提升检索稳定性。
AI.motivation: 基于嵌入的检索在长序列中很具吸引力（每项只需编码一次，再用最近邻排序即可搜索），但被索引对象常在“非规范时钟”下观测：心搏随心率拉伸、语音随语速变化、传感器轨迹以不同速度到达相似状态。在 patch 编码器中，若 patch 边界由信号几何决定，那么同样的时间形变会使 tokenization 发生改变，而表示本身却理应容忍这种形变——这构成了不稳定的来源。
AI.method: 提出 GeoPatch：保持 token 支撑集与几何无关的固定支架 patch 编码器，将斜率、曲率、加速度、仿射残差与置信度描述子仅用作连续条件变量。该设计把边界变化转化为特征调制——几何只能通过受控路径影响嵌入，而不能改变局部 token 的数量、顺序或支撑集。作者用机制层面的稳定性分析形式化这一区别，分离出边界漂移、仿射时序变化、置信度加权几何扰动与检索间隔效应。同一套局部 token 同时支持全局嵌入检索与后交互（late-interaction）打分，使打分规则可与评测协议匹配。
AI.result: 在 ECG、语音与多变量时间序列检索任务上，GeoPatch 在时序变化下提升了早段排名（early-rank）检索性能，同时揭示出局部表面匹配与严格非重叠检索之间的明显权衡。
AI.conclusion: 通过将几何影响从 token 边界解耦为受控的特征调制，GeoPatch 在非规范时钟下实现了更稳定的嵌入检索；其代价是局部表面匹配与严格非重叠检索之间存在需要权衡的取舍。

title: The Universal Classifier for Graph Learning
summary: While foundation models have revolutionized natural language processing and computer vision by leveraging universal vocabularies, Graph Machine Learning (GML) remains fractured due to the absence of a unified feature and structural representation across diverse domains. Existing works claiming to be Graph Foundation Models (GFMs) are typically restricted to node-level predictions or require fixed feature dimensions, failing to provide a truly task-agnostic backbone for the full spectrum of graph learning applications. In this paper, we introduce the Universal Classifier (UC), which supports arbitrary feature and class cardinalities, unifying node-, edge-, and graph-level objectives under a single similarity-based classification objective. The UC reformulates all node-, edge-, and graph-level prediction tasks as maximizing similarity in the latent space: by lifting heterogeneous features and labels into 3D latent tensors, the model learns transferable features independent of specific input schemas. This architecture allows a single pre-trained model to generalize to node classification, node regression, and link prediction across unseen graphs with varying feature semantics. Experiments show strong zero-shot transfer performance across node-, link-, and graph-level tasks.

AI.tldr: 本文提出 Universal Classifier (UC)，支持任意特征与类别基数，将节点、边、图层级任务统一为隐空间相似度最大化问题，实现跨图零样本迁移。
AI.motivation: 图机器学习缺乏跨域统一的特征与结构表示，现有自称图基础模型的工作多局限于节点级预测或固定特征维度，无法为全谱图学习任务提供真正任务无关的骨干网络。
AI.method: UC 通过将异构特征与标签提升为 3D 隐张量，支持任意特征与类别基数，将节点、边、图层级预测任务统一重构为隐空间相似度最大化的分类目标，从而学习与具体输入模式无关的可迁移特征。
AI.result: 实验表明，单一预训练模型在节点分类、节点回归、链接预测及图级任务上均展现出较强的零样本迁移性能。
AI.conclusion: UC 为跨域、任务无关的图基础模型提供了统一框架，证明相似度学习范式可支撑多种图学习任务的零样本泛化。

title: Calibrate the Decisions That Change the Future: On-Policy Post-Training Quantization for Multimodal Large Language Models
summary: Post-training quantization (PTQ) lowers deployment cost for multimodal large language models, but calibration typically reconstructs fixed sequences with local objectives. This overlooks autoregressive feedback: a quantization-induced token change redirects the prefix and changes future states. Yet on-policy coverage alone is insufficient because many decision mismatches barely affect future generation. We propose OnPTQ, an on-policy framework that calibrates on trajectories visited by the current quantized policy. On shared prefixes, OnPTQ identifies quantization-eroded boundaries, evaluates competing tokens through short counterfactual rollouts, and combines current discrepancy with branch consequence into a Decision--Consequence risk. The risk prioritizes critical states, while context anchoring and trajectory refresh preserve multimodal behavior and keep calibration aligned with the updated policy. We further derive a Decision--Consequence bound linking behavioral deviation to current policy discrepancy and action-conditioned future-value span. Across vision--language and omni-modal Qwen models under multiple low-bit settings, OnPTQ improves downstream performance and yields fewer correctness flips against the corresponding Dense/FP16 references, without changing the deployed inference graph.

AI.tldr: 提出 OnPTQ——一种面向多模态大语言模型的在线策略（on-policy）训练后量化框架，通过在当前量化策略访问的轨迹上校准，并引入"决策—后果"风险度量来优先处理关键状态，在多种低比特设置下提升下游性能并减少正确性翻转。
AI.motivation: 现有 PTQ 校准通常基于固定序列和局部目标，忽视了自回归反馈：量化引起的 token 变化会改变前缀，进而改变未来状态。而仅使用 on-policy 覆盖并不充分，因为许多决策不匹配对未来生成影响甚微，需要区分状态的重要性。
AI.method: OnPTQ 在当前量化策略访问的轨迹上校准。在共享前缀上识别"量化侵蚀边界"，通过短程反事实 rollout 评估竞争 token，将当前离散差异与分支后果结合为 Decision–Consequence 风险，用以优先关键状态；同时使用上下文锚定与轨迹刷新来保持多模态行为并与更新后的策略对齐。理论方面推导了连接行为偏差、当前策略差异与动作条件未来价值跨度的 Decision–Consequence 界。
AI.result: 在视觉—语言与全模态 Qwen 模型的多种低比特设置下，OnPTQ 提升了多模态 MLLM 的下游性能，相对 Dense/FP16 参考模型产生更少的正确性翻转，且不改变部署时的推理图。
AI.conclusion: 面向自回归多模态大模型的 PTQ 应在量化策略自身轨迹上进行校准，并以"决策—后果"风险聚焦关键状态；该方法在保持部署推理图不变的前提下，实现了更优的低比特性能并抑制正确性退化。

title: Cheap and Powerful Tests for Supervised Subspaces: Per-Component Inference for PLS
comment: 41 pages, 5 figures, 28 tables. Accepted at NeurIPS 2026. Code and results: https://doi.org/10.5281/zenodo.23004298
summary: Partial Least Squares (PLS) regression extracts a few outcome-aligned directions in a high-dimensional X and is widely used across applied science, but inference on the resulting fit is either expensive, biased and discouraged, or absent. We reduce inference to held-out OLS refits of the supervised subspace, a primitive shared by PLS, supervised PCA, and linear probes, and supply two tests using held-out correlations: a Nadeau-Bengio corrected asymptotic t-test as a fast approximation, and a permutation test with comparable power, finite-sample valid under outcome-predictor independence and iid rows. Held-out predictions are unchanged under any orthogonal rebasing of the supervised span, so an interpretable basis such as varimax inherits the joint claim but not a per-axis p-value; per-component claims come from a fixed-sequence test on the PLS extraction order. We validate on synthetic geometries, two NIR chemometric datasets, and cross-lingual word-embedding regressions; the exact test also transfers to supervised PCA and a ridge probe. The proposed tests have more power than CV-permutation-Q^2, at a fraction of its cost. A pre-run check on n and the spectrum of X says when the approximation is safe. We release a Rust library with Python, R, and Julia bindings, plus a Python text pipeline.

AI.tldr: 该文针对PLS回归拟合的推断昂贵或缺失问题，将其化归为监督子空间上的留出OLS重拟合，提出两种基于留出相关性的检验，并提供高效开源实现。
AI.motivation: PLS在高维X中提取与结果对齐的少数方向，应用广泛，但其拟合的推断要么计算昂贵，要么有偏而不可取，或根本缺失；同时PLS、监督PCA与线性探针共享同一推断原语，缺乏统一且廉价的检验手段。
AI.method: 将推断化归为对监督子空间的留出OLS重拟合；基于留出相关性构造两种检验：Nadeau-Bengio校正的渐近t检验（快速近似）与置换检验（在结果-预测变量独立且行iid下有限样本有效）；由于留出预测在监督张成的任意正交重整基下不变，可解释基（如varimax）继承联合结论而非逐轴p值，逐成分结论由PLS提取顺序上的固定序列检验给出；并给出基于n与X谱的预检以判断近似是否安全。
AI.result: 在合成几何、两个NIR化学计量数据集与跨语言词嵌入回归上验证；精确检验亦可迁移至监督PCA与岭探针；所提检验相比CV-permutation-Q²功效更高且成本仅为其中一小部分。
AI.conclusion: 留出OLS重拟合为PLS类监督降维提供了统一、廉价且有效的推断框架，配套预检条件与开源工具（Rust库及Python/R/Julia绑定、Python文本流程）便于实际应用。

title: The Default Trap: Rethinking Plan Evaluation in Tool-Using LLM Agents
summary: An executor can respond strongly to a change in a supplied plan's priority while showing a small change in the same information-selection probability when a default-aligned whole plan is removed. We call the risk of interpreting the latter as weak responsiveness to alternative priorities the default trap. We compare paired plans that prioritize different information targets with a shared no-plan reference. An accounting identity relates these distinct behavioral contrasts. Across 3,200 decision windows on 160 selected Retail, Airline, and AgentDojo tasks, switching priorities strongly redirects two models' choices, while the two plan-versus-default contrasts differ. In 2,160 additional windows, reversing account-list order shifts default target selection by 63.3-98.3 percentage points; priority-switching effects remain 96.7-100.0 points in either order. A separate 3,240-window component study finds strong control under single priority sentences, with effects of additional text varying by group and direction. Finally, 1,080 full-task episodes yield observed success differences of -19.4 to +8.3 points relative to no plan. All Retail and Airline success intervals include zero; AgentDojo results describe four fixed application worlds. These findings support joint reporting of priority responsiveness, presentation-dependent defaults, and task success and cost.

AI.tldr: 论文提出"默认陷阱(default trap)"概念:执行者对明确优先级变化的响应很强,但在移除"默认对齐的整体计划"时信息选择概率变化很小,若把后者误读为对替代优先级响应弱即为默认陷阱。通过配对计划设计与会计恒等式,在Retail、Airline、AgentDojo多任务上系统比较优先级切换与计划-默认对比,证明两者行为含义不同,应联合报告。
AI.motivation: 执行者(executor)对计划优先级的响应性(responsiveness)是评估其是否真正遵循意图的关键。但现有评测通常只观察"有默认计划 vs 无计划"的对比,忽略了这种对比可能受默认呈现方式(如账户列表顺序)驱动,而非反映对替代优先级的真实敏感度。作者将这种误判风险命名为"默认陷阱",主张需要区分"对优先级变化的响应"和"对默认设置的依赖"两类行为对比。
AI.method: 1) 设计配对计划:对同一任务给予优先不同信息目标的计划,并共享一个"无计划"参照;2) 用会计恒等式(accounting identity)刻画这些行为对比之间的代数关系;3) 主实验:在160个Retail、Airline、AgentDojo任务上共3,200个决策窗口,测试优先级切换对两个模型选择的影响,并比较两种"计划vs默认"对比;4) 顺序扰动实验:额外2,160个窗口,反转账户列表顺序,测默认目标选择漂移与优先级切换效应的稳定性;5) 组件研究:3,240个窗口,单句优先级下的控制强度及附加文本的分组/方向效应;6) 全任务实验:1,080个完整任务回合,比较有无计划下的实际成功率。
AI.result: 优先级切换在两个模型上强烈改变选择(效应96.7-100.0个百分点,顺序无关);反转账户列表顺序会使默认目标选择漂移63.3-98.3个百分点,说明"计划vs默认"对比容易被呈现方式混淆。组件研究中,单句优先级控制很强,附加文本效应随组别与方向变化。全任务成功率相对无计划的差异为-19.4至+8.3个百分点;Retail与Airline的成功率区间均包含零,AgentDojo结果仅代表四个固定应用环境。
AI.conclusion: "计划vs默认"对比不能等同于"对替代优先级的响应性",二者可显著分离,存在默认陷阱。评测应联合报告三项指标:优先级响应性、呈现依赖的默认行为、任务成功与成本,以避免仅凭默认对比得出关于执行者优先级敏感度的错误结论。

title: Learning Samples Importance: Parameterizing Dual Variables in Everywhere Learning
summary: Everywhere learning provides a principled framework for training AI models under constraints that must hold throughout the data distribution. In the dual domain, these pointwise constraints give rise to functional dual variables. In this work, we propose to learn these dual variables, motivated by the fact that their values encode useful information about the underlying constrained problem. By representing the dual variable as a parametric function of each sample, we enable the learned multiplier to be evaluated on new, unseen samples. This contrasts with standard empirical dual formulations, which assign an independent multiplier to each training sample. We characterize the error in the recovered primal solution induced by restricting the dual variable to a parametric function class and show that it is controlled by how well this class approximates the optimal statistical multiplier. Moreover, we show that the learned parametric multiplier retains the sensitivity interpretation of the optimal statistical multiplier, yielding approximate sensitivity guarantees that extend beyond the samples used for training. We empirically validate our theory across a variety of everywhere learning tasks, showing that the resulting constrained problems can be solved efficiently and that the learned dual variables provide meaningful representations of sample-level sensitivity.

AI.tldr: 本文提出用参数化函数学习"处处学习"问题中的对偶变量，使其可泛化到未见样本，并从理论上刻画了由此带来的原始解误差与灵敏度保证，实验验证了方法的有效性和对偶变量的样本级灵敏度表征能力。
AI.motivation: 处处学习要求在数据分布上处处满足约束，其对偶问题中的对偶变量是函数型的。然而标准的经验对偶方法为每个训练样本分配独立乘子，无法泛化到新样本，且未利用对偶变量值所蕴含的关于原约束问题的信息。因此作者希望通过学习对偶变量来获得可在新样本上求值的、有意义的乘子表示。
AI.method: 将函数型对偶变量表示为每个样本的参数化函数（而非每样本独立参数），从而得到可泛化的学习乘子。在此基础上，理论分析将原问题解限制在参数化函数类中所引入的误差，证明该误差受该函数类对最优统计乘子的逼近能力控制；同时证明学习到的参数化乘子保留了最优统计乘子的灵敏度解释。
AI.result: 理论上，恢复的原始解误差由参数化函数类逼近最优统计乘子的程度所界定，且学习乘子具有近似灵敏度保证，可推广到训练样本之外。实验上，在多种处处学习任务中，约束问题可被高效求解，且学习到的对偶变量能提供有意义的样本级灵敏度表示。
AI.conclusion: 通过对偶变量的参数化学习，本文在保持灵敏度解释的同时实现了对未见样本的泛化，为处处学习提供了可行的求解与解释框架，理论与实验均验证了其有效性。

title: Where Does Staleness Accumulate? Pool Aware Effective Staleness Control for Asynchronous RL in LLM Post-Training
summary: Fully asynchronous reinforcement learning (RL) improves resource utilization in large language model post-training by overlapping rollout generation with policy optimization, but it also introduces policy lag as trajectories are generated and queued while the trainer continues to update. We study how this lag accumulates over a trajectory's lifetime and how it can be controlled without sacrificing the wall-clock benefits of asynchronous execution. We decompose trajectory staleness into Generation Staleness, accumulated before rollout completion, and Waiting Staleness, accumulated after a completed trajectory enters the pool. Motivated by this decomposition, we introduce PACE (Pool-Aware Control of Effective Staleness). PACE converts excess pool occupancy into an adaptive rejection budget and ranks completed trajectories using an effective-staleness score that combines Waiting Staleness with prefix-aware Generation Staleness. This avoids penalizing long or interrupted rollouts solely because they span multiple policy versions. In single-turn mathematical reasoning, PACE improves the six-benchmark average validation accuracy by 18.7\% over unfiltered asynchronous RL at the same wall-clock budget and matches synchronous RL performance with 47.1\% less GPU time. PACE also improves validation performance in multi-turn tool-integrated reasoning, outperforming both synchronous and unfiltered asynchronous RL. Further experiments with the mixture-of-experts model and an alternative RL algorithm support its applicability across model architectures and training algorithms.

AI.tldr: 本文提出PACE方法，将异步强化学习中的轨迹陈旧度分解为生成陈旧度与等待陈旧度，并通过池感知的自适应拒绝预算与有效陈旧度打分来控制策略滞后。在单轮数学推理中将六基准平均验证准确率提升18.7%，并以少47.1%的GPU时间达到同步RL水平，在多轮工具集成推理及MoE模型、不同RL算法上亦有效。
AI.motivation: 全异步强化学习通过重叠轨迹生成与策略优化提升大语言模型后训练的资源利用率，但会引入策略滞后：轨迹在生成与排队期间训练器仍在更新策略。作者希望在不牺牲异步执行墙钟时间收益的前提下，研究滞后如何在轨迹生命周期中累积并加以控制。
AI.method: 作者将轨迹陈旧度分解为两部分：Rollout完成前累积的Generation Staleness，以及完成轨迹进入池后累积的Waiting Staleness。基于该分解提出PACE（Pool-Aware Control of Effective Staleness）：将池占用超出量转化为自适应拒绝预算，并用有效陈旧度分数对已完成轨迹排序，该分数结合等待陈旧度与前缀感知的生成陈旧度，从而避免仅因长或被中断的rollout跨越多个策略版本而受到惩罚。
AI.result: 在单轮数学推理中，相同墙钟预算下PACE相比未过滤异步RL将六基准平均验证准确率提升18.7%，并以少47.1%的GPU时间达到同步RL性能。在多轮工具集成推理中，PACE的验证性能优于同步与未过滤异步RL。使用混合专家模型及另一种RL算法的实验进一步验证了其跨模型架构与训练算法的适用性。
AI.conclusion: 通过对轨迹陈旧度进行细粒度分解并采用池感知的自适应控制，PACE有效缓解了异步RL的策略滞后问题，在保持异步训练墙钟效率的同时显著提升验证性能，并具有跨模型架构与算法的一般性。

title: Fractional State Space Transition for Long Sequence Modeling
summary: State Space Models (SSMs) compress sequence history into a bounded recurrent state, making the resulting memory law a central architectural choice for long-context performance. Most modern SSMs rely on ODE-based dynamics that lead to exponential forgetting, limiting their ability to retain information over broad temporal ranges. We introduce FRAC, a selective SSM architecture derived from fractional dynamics that replaces this exponential decay with power-law long memory. To make fractional dynamics practical, FRAC approximates the heavy-tailed target kernel with a finite-state, log-spaced sum of exponential modes. This construction turns fractional memory into an efficient recurrent module with parallel training and prefill, while retaining bounded-state autoregressive decoding. Extensive experiments, including 1.3B-parameter language modeling, demonstrate that FRAC consistently improves long-context performance over state-of-the-art SSM baselines while staying competitive on short-context. These results show that fractional dynamics provide a practical and effective prior for long-context SSMs.

AI.tldr: 论文提出FRAC，一种基于分数阶动力学的选择性SSM架构，用幂律长记忆替代指数遗忘，并通过有限状态、对数间隔的指数模态和近似重尾核，实现高效并行训练与有界状态自回归解码。
AI.motivation: 现有SSM将序列历史压缩到有界递归状态，内存法则决定长上下文性能。多数现代SSM依赖ODE动力学，导致指数遗忘，难以在宽时间范围保留信息，因此需要引入具有长记忆特性的动力学先验。
AI.method: FRAC从分数阶动力学推导，将指数衰减替换为幂律长记忆。为便于实现，用有限状态、对数间隔的指数模态之和近似重尾目标核，从而把分数阶记忆转化为高效递归模块，支持并行训练与prefill，同时保持有界状态的自回归解码。
AI.result: 在广泛实验中，包括1.3B参数语言建模，FRAC在长上下文性能上持续优于最先进SSM基线，同时在短上下文上保持竞争力。
AI.conclusion: 结果表明分数阶动力学为长上下文SSM提供了实用且有效的先验，能够在保持效率的同时改善长程记忆保持能力。

title: ARC-KV: Amortizing Anchor Search for Reconstruction-Based KV Cache Compaction
summary: Long-context large language model inference is bottlenecked by KV caches that grow linearly with sequence length. This burden is especially severe for long, reusable context prefixes, whose cache must serve many downstream queries. Reconstruction-based methods such as Attention Matching achieve strong downstream task performance with compact KV caches. However, iterative anchor search dominates the compaction cost of OMP-based Attention Matching. This motivates our selective amortization principle of learning a reusable anchor-selection policy across contexts while retaining context-specific reconstruction. In this work, we propose ARC-KV, a novel reconstruction-based KV cache compaction method that follows this principle. To this end, we first train a value-aware indexer to select real-key anchors in a single scoring pass. ARC-KV then applies convex-hull-constrained key merging and fits an attention-mass bias and compact values against the full cache.
