At inference time, ARC-KV builds the compact cache once per context using the frozen indexer and reuses it for all subsequent queries. Extensive experiments demonstrate that ARC-KV outperforms reported compaction methods in most settings across QuALITY, RULER, and LongBench on Llama-3.1-8B-Instruct. In particular, at 10% KV retention on QuALITY, ARC-KV improves accuracy from 0.6409 to 0.6474 over Attention Matching while reducing compaction time by a factor of 25.73, from 959.8 s to 37.3 s.

AI.tldr: ARC-KV 是一种基于重建的 KV 缓存压缩方法，通过学习可复用的锚点选择策略替代逐上下文的迭代锚点搜索，在提升下游任务精度的同时将压缩时间降低约 25 倍。
AI.motivation: 长上下文 LLM 推理受 KV 缓存随序列长度线性增长的瓶颈制约，尤其是需服务大量下游查询的长可复用前缀。基于重建的 Attention Matching 精度强但 OMP 迭代锚点搜索主导了压缩开销，效率低下。因此需要在不牺牲上下文特定重建质量的前提下，分摊锚点搜索成本。
AI.method: 提出选择性分摊原则：跨上下文学习可复用的锚点选择策略，同时保留上下文特定的重建过程。具体地，ARC-KV 先训练一个 value-aware 索引器，通过单次评分即可选出真实键锚点；随后施加凸包约束的键合并，并针对完整缓存拟合注意力质量偏置与紧凑 value。推理时，对每个上下文用冻结的索引器一次性构建紧凑缓存，并复用于后续所有查询。
AI.result: 在 Llama-3.1-8B-Instruct 上，跨 QuALITY、RULER、LongBench 的多数设置中，ARC-KV 优于已有压缩方法。在 QuALITY 上 10% KV 保留率时，精度从 Attention Matching 的 0.6409 提升至 0.6474，同时压缩时间从 959.8 s 降至 37.3 s，加速 25.73 倍。
AI.conclusion: 通过把锚点选择从逐上下文迭代搜索转为可学习、可复用的单遍索引器，ARC-KV 在保持甚至提升重建质量的同时显著降低压缩开销，为长可复用前缀场景提供了高效实用的 KV 缓存压缩方案。

title: PyroStack: A Multi-Band Spatio-Temporal Sub-Daily Dataset for Wildfires in the United States
summary: Wildfires are an increasing hazard to ecosystems, air quality, and human systems, creating a growing need for datasets that support systematic development and evaluation of models for predicting fire spread across diverse landscapes. Effective prediction requires integrating meteorological conditions, fuels, vegetation, and topography at spatial and temporal resolutions suitable for both physical simulation and data-driven approaches. However, existing datasets often lack the resolution and coverage needed to capture these interacting controls. The PyroStack dataset addresses this gap by providing a harmonized, event-based collection of wildfire and environmental data across the contiguous United States and Alaska. It integrates satellite-derived fire observations with atmospheric reanalysis, vegetation, fuel characteristics, and topographic information into a unified framework spanning 6994 wildfires that occurred between 2012 and 2024 across a wide range of ecosystems and climate conditions. PyroStack offers spatial resolutions ranging from 30 m to 9 km and hourly temporal resolution, along with fire progression data at 12-hour intervals to support model initialization and evaluation. By combining broad spatial coverage with fine spatial and temporal detail, the dataset enables systematic analysis of wildfire dynamics and supports both physics-based and machine learning approaches, providing a foundation for benchmarking and improving fire spread models, with future extensions aimed at incorporating additional regions and fire suppression data streams to further advance wildfire prediction.

AI.tldr: PyroStack是一个覆盖美国本土及阿拉斯加的野火数据集，整合6994场野火（2012-2024）的卫星观测、大气再分析、植被、燃料和地形数据，空间分辨率30 m–9 km，时间分辨率小时级，火情演进数据为12小时间隔，支持物理模拟与机器学习模型开发及基准测试。
AI.motivation: 野火对生态系统、空气质量和人类系统构成日益严重的威胁，亟需支持火蔓延预测模型开发与评估的数据集。有效预测需在适配物理模拟和数据驱动方法的时空分辨率下整合气象条件、燃料、植被和地形。然而现有数据集往往缺乏捕捉这些相互作用控制因素所需的覆盖范围与分辨率。
AI.method: 构建PyroStack数据集，将卫星火观测数据与大气再分析资料、植被、燃料特征及地形信息整合到统一框架中，形成基于事件的协调化野火与环境数据集合，覆盖美国本土和阿拉斯加。
AI.result: 数据集涵盖2012至2024年间发生的6994场野火，跨越多种生态系统与气候条件；空间分辨率30 m至9 km，时间分辨率小时级，火情演进数据为12小时间隔，支持模型初始化与评估。
AI.conclusion: 通过广泛空间覆盖与精细时空细节的结合，该数据集支持野火动态的系统性分析，适用于物理驱动和机器学习方法，为基准测试与改进火蔓延模型奠定基础；未来将扩展至更多区域并纳入灭火数据流。

title: Automated Screw Planning for Reduced Pelvic Fractures Based on Statistical Shape Models and Deep Learning
summary: Percutaneous iliosacral screw fixation is an important minimally invasive treatment for unstable pelvic fractures. Because the sacroiliac region has complex anatomy and narrow screw corridors, the accuracy and safety of screw placement directly affect surgical outcomes. Accurate and reliable preoperative screw planning is therefore essential to improve surgical success and reduce intraoperative risks. Conventional preoperative planning typically requires surgeons to determine screw trajectories through manual measurements, a labor-intensive process that depends on subjective clinical experience. To address these challenges, we propose a fully automated pipeline for preoperative iliosacral screw planning in patients with pelvic fractures. Using patient-specific three-dimensional anatomy, the pipeline automatically identifies safe screw corridors and generates individualized insertion trajectories to support clinical preoperative planning. We evaluated the proposed pipeline on 200 clinical cases of pelvic fractures. Compared with conventional manual measurements, the safety margin of the safe insertion corridors increased by 2% across the four screw types, the mean planning time decreased by more than 90%, and the clinical acceptance rate reached 95%.

AI.tldr: 提出面向骨盆骨折患者的全自动骶髂螺钉术前规划流程，基于个体化三维解剖自动识别安全骨通道并生成置钉轨迹；200例临床评估显示安全余量提升2%、规划时间减少超90%、临床接受率达95%。
AI.motivation: 经皮骶髂螺钉固定是骨盆不稳定骨折的重要微创治疗手段，但骶髂区解剖复杂、螺钉通道狭窄，置钉精度与安全性直接影响手术效果。传统术前规划依赖人工测量，耗时且依赖主观临床经验，故需自动化、可靠的术前规划方法。
AI.method: 提出全自动术前规划流程：利用患者个体化三维解剖模型，自动识别安全螺钉骨通道，并生成个体化进钉轨迹以支持临床术前规划。
AI.result: 在200例骨盆骨折临床病例上评估：相较传统人工测量，四类螺钉的安全置入通道安全余量平均提升2%，平均规划时间减少90%以上，临床接受率达95%。
AI.conclusion: 该全自动流程可有效提升骶髂螺钉术前规划的安全性、效率与临床可用性，具有临床推广价值。

title: Periodic Weak Spots: Phase Sensitivity from Chunked KV-Cache Compression
summary:
Chunked KV-cache compression reduces the memory and attention costs of long-context inference by compressing windows of consecutive tokens into fewer cache entries at a fixed stride. Such compression also introduces a new positional coordinate: a token's phase, or its position relative to compression-window boundaries. We uncover a systematic asymmetry in models using such compression: the same information can be easy to retrieve at one phase and difficult at another. We call this periodic variation in retrieval performance phase sensitivity. In large open-weight models with such compression, long-context retrieval accuracy can differ by up to 40 percentage points across phases, revealing periodic weak spots that average benchmark scores can conceal.
  To investigate this behavior, we pretrain a family of transformers from scratch across multiple KV-compression designs, reproducing phase sensitivity across the variants. Mechanistic analysis using causal interventions in these models reveals phase specialization: different attention components contribute asymmetrically to retrieving information at different source phases. We further analyze idealized retrieval models, showing how gradient flow dynamics may favor sharp phase specialization. Evaluating models with chunked KV-cache compression thus requires measuring across compression phases: high average accuracy can coexist with systematic positional failures.

AI.tldr: 该论文揭示了分块KV缓存压缩引入的"相位敏感性"现象：同一信息在不同压缩窗口相位下的检索难度呈周期性差异，大模型上检索准确率跨相位可相差高达40个百分点，平均基准分数会掩盖这种周期性弱点。
AI.motivation: 分块KV缓存压缩通过将连续token窗口按固定步长压缩为更少的缓存条目，降低长上下文推理的内存与注意力开销，但同时引入了新的位置坐标——相位（token相对于压缩窗口边界的位置）。作者发现现有评估用平均基准分数衡量模型，会掩盖由相位导致的检索性能周期性波动，因此需要系统研究这一现象及其成因。
AI.method: 1) 在带分块KV压缩的大型开放权重模型上测量跨相位的长上下文检索准确率，量化相位敏感性；2) 从零预训练一族Transformer，覆盖多种KV压缩设计，以复现该现象；3) 使用因果干预进行机制分析，考察不同注意力组件对不同源相位的贡献；4) 分析理想化检索模型，探究梯度流动力学为何可能促成尖锐的相位特化。
AI.result: 在带此类压缩的大型开放权重模型中，长上下文检索准确率跨相位差异最高可达40个百分点，暴露出被平均分数掩盖的周期性弱相位；从零预训练的多种压缩变体可复现相位敏感性；因果干预显示存在相位特化，不同注意力组件在不同源相位检索上贡献不对称；理想化检索模型分析表明梯度流动力学可能倾向于形成尖锐的相位特化。
AI.conclusion: 相位敏感性是分块KV缓存压缩的内生属性，评估此类模型必须跨压缩相位进行测量，因为高平均准确率可能与系统性的位置性失败并存。这提示未来压缩方案设计与基准评测都应将相位维度纳入考量。

title: When Upstream Messages Override Correct Answers: A Controlled Study of Multi-Agent LLM Collaboration
summary: Multi-agent LLM systems rely on message passing among specialized agents to accomplish complex tasks. However, an upstream agent may provide useful information or an incorrect answer that causes a downstream agent to override a correct answer supported by its own evidence. Prior work has not clearly separated the benefits of communication from the damage caused by incorrect messages. We study this problem with controlled experiments across five benchmarks and five receivers, keeping the downstream task and evidence fixed while comparing answers under three conditions: no message, the upstream agent's original message, or a message with the opposite conclusion. Our experiments reveal three key findings. First, messages often help when the downstream agent would otherwise answer incorrectly. Second, messages can also hurt: when the downstream agent would answer correctly without a message, an incorrect upstream message changes the answer in up to 32% of cases. Third, in 94% of audited harmful cases, the downstream agent copies the upstream's specific wrong answer--a pattern we term answer substitution. Removing unreliable messages recovers part of the lost accuracy, suggesting that communication should be selective based on upstream reliability and the evidence already available to the downstream agent.

AI.tldr: 该研究通过控制实验分离多智能体LLM系统中消息传递的收益与损害，发现消息既能在下游原本错误时提供帮助，也会诱使原本正确的下游智能体采纳错误答案（答案替换），因此通信应基于上游可靠性进行选择性过滤。
AI.motivation: 多智能体LLM系统依赖智能体间消息传递完成复杂任务，但上游可能传递有用信息或错误答案，导致下游智能体推翻自身证据支持的正确答案。既有工作未清晰区分通信收益与错误消息造成的损害，本文旨在对此进行可控分离研究。
AI.method: 在五个基准和五个接收方上做控制实验：固定下游任务与证据，比较三种条件下的答案——无消息、上游原始消息、结论相反的消息。
AI.result: 三项发现：一，当下游原本会答错时，消息常能起到帮助；二，消息也会有害，当下游无消息时本可答对，错误上游消息最多在32%的情况下改变其答案；三，在审计的有害案例中，94%的下游智能体直接复制上游的具体错误答案，称为“答案替换”。
AI.conclusion: 移除不可靠消息可部分恢复损失的准确率，说明通信应依据上游可靠性以及下游已有证据进行选择性接收。

title: Reducing the Adaptation Gap Through Reachable Fisher Geometry
summary: Parameter-efficient fine-tuning (PEFT) determines not only how many parameters are trained, but also which local directions a model can move in, so similar adapters can affect subgroup losses differently. Since curvature matrices are infeasible to form at adapter scale, scalar summaries such as the Fisher trace are often used instead. We study what the trace reveals and what it loses through the reachable Fisher: each subgroup's full-model Fisher pulled back through the adapter Jacobian. Under likelihood losses, it represents the Gauss-Newton curvature accessible to the adapter, and its trace can be computed from score-gradient norms without forming the full matrix. Under matched subgroup gradients, a positive-definite reachable-Fisher difference, with a margin exceeding the Hessian-Fisher defect, implies that every sufficiently small nonzero model-changing update increases the signed gap. In contrast, the restricted operator norm determines worst-case quadratic change, while a matrix-free Frobenius discrepancy bounds its reachable-Fisher component. Trace alone cannot certify definiteness or control matrix mismatch. Equal traces rule out a positive-definite difference but can still hide large operator discrepancies. Across 306 single-seed models, higher trace accompanies greater subgroup difficulty in 75.7 percent of 1,218 eligible evaluations, while trace matching reduces the best-worst subgroup gap in all 30 dataset-encoder-adapter combinations. However, held-out audits show that operator discrepancy decreases in 23 of 30 combinations, while the unbiased squared-Frobenius statistic decreases in only 16 of 30. Fisher trace is therefore a scalable diagnostic and training heuristic, but not a certificate of local gap behavior or matrix alignment.

AI.tldr: 本文提出“可达Fisher”刻画PEFT适配器可实现的曲率方向，指出Fisher迹仅是可扩展诊断和训练启发式，既不构成子群差距行为的证书，也不保证矩阵对齐。
AI.motivation: PEFT不仅决定训练参数量，还决定模型可移动的局部方向，因此相似适配器会以不同方式影响子群损失；而适配器规模下无法构造完整曲率矩阵，常用Fisher迹等标量摘要替代，故需厘清其揭示与丢失的信息。
AI.method: 定义可达Fisher，即各子群的全模型Fisher经适配器Jacobian拉回；在似然损失下刻画适配器可访问的Gauss-Newton曲率，并用score梯度范数计算其迹（无需构造完整矩阵）。理论分析正定差、Hessian-Fisher缺陷边界、受限算子范数、Frobenius差异等量的含义，并在306个单种子模型、1218次评估及30个数据集-编码器-适配器组合上做实证与留出审计。
AI.result: 匹配子群梯度下，迹差正定且边际超过Hessian-Fisher缺陷时，足够小的非零更新会增大符号差距；受限算子范数决定最坏二次变化，Frobenius差异约束可达Fisher分量。迹无法单独证明正定性或控制矩阵失配，等迹可掩盖巨大算子差异。实证中75.7%的评估显示更高迹伴随更大子群难度；迹匹配在全部30个组合中降低最优-最差子群差距，但留出审计显示算子差异仅在23/30组合下降，无偏平方Frobenius统计仅在16/30下降。
AI.conclusion: Fisher迹是可扩展的诊断工具与训练启发式，但不是局部差距行为或矩阵对齐的证书。

title: IronLLM: Forging Compact Edge-Native Language Models for Real-Time Embodied Intelligence
summary: We present IronLLM-0.6B, a 654M-parameter language model designed for efficient on-device inference. IronLLM-0.6B combines a hybrid attention architecture with X-MTP, a lightweight shared-KV multi-token prediction design that eliminates per-depth KV-cache replay and employs a lightweight verification head for rollback-free drafting, achieving a 1.48x decoding speedup. The model is pretrained on approximately 6.2 trillion tokens using a quality-oriented data pipeline and is further post-trained with Multi-Domain On-Policy Distillation to integrate capabilities from domain-specialized teachers. To better meet the low-latency requirements of on-device scenarios, IronLLM-0.6B adopts an Instruct-Only design. Evaluations show that IronLLM-0.6B achieves competitive performance relative to larger models such as Qwen3.5-0.8B and MiniCPM5-1B, while producing more concise responses on many tasks. We further present IronLLM-0.6B-Light, which replaces RMSNorm with Dynamic Tanh and simplifies several computationally expensive components to improve inference and quantization efficiency. Together, the IronLLM models provide an effective performance-efficiency trade-off for resource-constrained deployment.

AI.tldr: IronLLM-0.6B 是一个 654M 参数、面向端侧高效推理的语言模型，采用混合注意力架构与 X-MTP 多 token 预测加速方案，在约 6.2T token 上预训练并经多领域在线策略蒸馏后训练，性能对标 Qwen3.5-0.8B 与 MiniCPM5-1B；另推出 IronLLM-0.6B-Light 以 Dynamic Tanh 替代 RMSNorm 等简化设计提升推理与量化效率。
AI.motivation: 端侧部署受限于算力、内存与延迟，需要在有限参数规模下兼顾性能与推理效率。现有小模型在低延迟场景（如首 token 延迟、解码速度）与量化效率方面仍有优化空间，因此需要针对端侧资源约束专门设计模型架构与训练流程。
AI.method: 1) 架构：混合注意力（hybrid attention）搭配 X-MTP——轻量级共享 KV 多 token 预测，消除逐层 KV-cache 重放，并用轻量验证头实现无回滚（rollback-free）草拟；2) 预训练：采用质量导向数据流水线，约 6.2T token；3) 后训练：多领域在线策略蒸馏（Multi-Domain On-Policy Distillation），融合领域专家教师模型能力；4) 设计取向：Instruct-Only，满足端侧低延迟需求；5) 变体 IronLLM-0.6B-Light 用 Dynamic Tanh 替代 RMSNorm，并简化若干高计算量组件以提升推理与量化效率。
AI.result: X-MTP 带来 1.48x 解码加速；IronLLM-0.6B 性能相对 Qwen3.5-0.8B、MiniCPM5-1B 等更大模型具竞争力，且在多项任务上输出更简洁；IronLLM-0.6B-Light 提升推理与量化效率；二者共同在资源受限部署下提供有效的性能—效率权衡。
AI.conclusion: 通过混合注意力 + X-MTP 加速、大规模质量导向预训练与多领域在线策略蒸馏，并以 Instruct-Only 与 Dynamic Tanh 等简化设计优化端侧推理与量化，IronLLM 系列在资源受限场景下实现了具竞争力的性能与效率折中。

title: Adapting Linear-Time Architectures for Tabular In-Context Learning
comment: 31 pages, 13 figures, 10 tables. Code available at https://github.com/schnurrd/ICL-Architectures
summary: Tabular foundation models achieve strong performance by conditioning on labelled examples in context, but softmax attention limits their use on large datasets. Existing linear-time alternatives, however, are mostly causal, and their potential for tabular in-context learning (ICL) remains underexplored. To address this, we (1) revisit causal training setups, (2) compare linear sequence mixers, and (3) investigate their ICL generalisation beyond the pretraining context length. First, we show that the best training setup for causal models resembles next-token prediction. Then, perhaps surprisingly, the most promising linear sequence mixer is causal: DeltaNet outperforms even non-causal linear attention. However, it degrades beyond $2$-$4\times$ the pretraining context length, and existing mitigation strategies such as bidirectionality defer the problem at best. A hidden-state oracle shows that this is not a capacity problem. Instead, our analysis points to an instability in the recurrent state, which drifts in deeper layers of causal models. Since DeltaNet's learned write rates overfit to the pretraining regime, we modulate them with a time-dependent decay schedule intervention to stabilise length generalisation. Finally, re-introducing non-causality by reading out from the final state allows us to closely match a controlled softmax attention baseline on OpenML-CC18 and TabArena.

AI.tldr: 该论文研究表格基础模型的上下文学习（ICL）中的线性序列混合器。作者发现最佳因果训练设置类似下一token预测，DeltaNet在因果线性混合器中表现最优（甚至超过非因果线性注意力），但在超出预训练上下文长度2–4倍时性能下降。隐藏状态诊断表明这不是容量问题，而是因果模型深层递归状态漂移导致的不稳定性。作者通过时间依赖的衰减调度干预调制DeltaNet的学习写入率，并通过从最终状态读出以重新引入非因果性，从而在OpenML-CC18和TabArena上接近受控softmax注意力基线。
AI.motivation: 表格基础模型通过在上下文中以标注样本为条件实现了强性能，但softmax注意力的二次复杂度限制了其在大数据集上的使用。已有线性时间替代方案多为因果结构，其在表格ICL中的潜力尚未被充分探索。因此作者希望系统比较因果训练设置、线性序列混合器及其在预训练上下文长度之外的ICL泛化能力。
AI.method: 1）重新审视因果训练设置；2）比较不同线性序列混合器；3）研究超出预训练上下文长度后的ICL泛化。通过隐藏状态oracle分析性能下降原因，发现因果模型深层递归状态存在漂移不稳定。针对DeltaNet的学习写入率过拟合预训练域的问题，引入时间依赖的衰减调度干预以稳定长度泛化，并通过从最终状态读出重新引入非因果性。
AI.result: 最佳因果训练设置类似下一token预测；DeltaNet在因果线性混合器中最有前景，甚至优于非因果线性注意力。但其在超出预训练上下文长度2–4倍后性能下降，现有缓解策略（如双向性）最多只能延缓问题。隐藏状态oracle表明并非容量问题，而是递归状态不稳定性。时间依赖衰减调度干预能稳定长度泛化；从最终状态读出恢复非因果性后，在OpenML-CC18和TabArena上接近受控softmax注意力基线。
AI.conclusion: 因果线性序列混合器（尤其是DeltaNet）在表格ICL中具有潜力，但受限于递归状态漂移导致的长度泛化问题。通过调节写入率的时间依赖衰减调度可缓解该问题，而结合最终状态读出的非因果读出头能够在保持线性效率的同时接近softmax注意力性能。

title: State Trace Rationale As Auxiliary Task in Reinforcement Learning
comment: Under review as a conference paper at ICLR 2027
summary: We propose STRAT, an auxiliary task that trains deep reinforcement learning (RL) agents to predict a short textual trace of their own state. Inspired by human spatial navigation, the description combines landmark, route, and survey knowledge, tracking the agent's position, inventory, goals, and immediate progress. Environment rules generate this text online without human labelling. Our method adds a single auxiliary head to a standard policy. Across 60 sparse-reward XLand-MiniGrid tasks, STRAT solves complex environments where standard RL fails outright, while compacting state representations and preventing rank collapse. Beyond performance gains, the predicted trace provides a readable account of agent beliefs at every step for no extra cost.

AI.tldr: 本文提出STRAT，一种辅助任务：训练深度强化学习智能体预测自身状态的简短文本轨迹。该描述融合地标、路线与勘测知识，跟踪智能体的位置、物品、目标与即时进展，环境规则在线生成文本无需人工标注。方法仅在标准策略上增加一个辅助头。在60个稀疏奖励的XLand-MiniGrid任务上，STRAT能解决标准RL完全失败的复杂环境，同时压缩状态表示并防止秩崩溃。此外，预测轨迹可零成本提供每一步智能体信念的可读解释。
AI.motivation: 标准深度强化学习在稀疏奖励的复杂环境中往往失败，且所学状态表示可能存在冗余与秩崩溃问题。受人类空间导航的启发，作者希望利用融合地标、路线与勘测知识的文本描述作为辅助监督信号，在不依赖人工标注的情况下改善智能体的表示学习与探索能力，并提升可解释性。
AI.method: STRAT在标准策略网络上仅添加一个辅助预测头，训练智能体预测自身状态的简短文本轨迹。该文本由环境规则在线生成，融合landmark、route和survey三类知识，追踪智能体的位置、物品、目标与即时进展，无需人工标注。该辅助任务与主策略联合训练，作为表示学习的正则化与增强手段。
AI.result: 在60个稀疏奖励的XLand-MiniGrid任务上，STRAT能够解决标准RL完全失败的复杂环境；同时压缩了状态表示并防止了秩崩溃。此外，预测的文本轨迹在无额外成本的情况下，为每一步的智能体信念提供了可读的解释。
AI.conclusion: STRAT通过预测自身状态的文本轨迹这一辅助任务，显著提升了深度RL在稀疏奖励复杂任务中的表现，并改善了状态表示的紧凑性与稳定性，同时提供了零成本的可解释性，说明自然语言式的自监督信号可作为强化学习的有效辅助手段。

title: Explainability from Training with Applications to TCR-Epitope Prediction
summary: Deep learning models have achieved strong performance in artificial intelligence for science, yet their black-box nature limits our understanding of how they learn scientific tasks. Existing methods for interpretability provide limited insight into how models organize evidence and evolve during learning. We introduce explainability from training (EFT), a model-agnostic paradigm that traces model interpretation during training to explain why models rely on specific features and how they organize these features as predictive evidence. We apply EFT to four state-of-the-art T cell receptor (TCR)-epitope prediction models, TCR-SRIM, TULIP, MixTCRpred, and NetTCR-2.2, spanning post-hoc and interpret-by-design approaches as well as transformers and CNNs. To investigate how structural information affects model explanations, we introduce a benchmark, TCR-XAI2, containing 388 unique experimentally resolved TCR-epitope structures, complemented by structures predicted using AlphaFold3, Boltz-2, TCRModel2, tFold-TCR, and OpenFold3. Using EFT with TCR-XAI2, we demonstrate that (1) CNN and transformer models exhibit distinct learning trajectories; (2) TCR $α$ and $β$ evidence can conflict during learning, limiting the benefits of jointly modeling both chains, while MHC information mitigates this; and (3) real versus predicted structural data for TCR-epitope prediction exhibits distinct TCR and peptide feature preferences as well as differing trajectories of model certainty.

AI.tldr: 本文提出一种模型无关的可解释性范式EFT（解释源于训练），通过追踪模型训练过程中解释的演化，揭示模型依赖特定特征的原因及证据组织方式；并结合新基准TCR-XAI2，对四个TCR-表位预测模型进行分析。
AI.motivation: 深度学习在科学人工智能任务中表现优异，但其黑箱特性限制了对模型如何学习科学任务的理解。现有可解释性方法难以揭示模型如何组织证据以及在训练过程中如何演化。
AI.method: 提出EFT（explainability from training）模型无关范式，追踪训练过程中的模型解释；将其应用于四个先进TCR-表位预测模型（TCR-SRIM、TULIP、MixTCRpred、NetTCR-2.2），涵盖事后解释与设计可解释方法及Transformer与CNN架构；并构建基准TCR-XAI2，包含388个独特实验解析的TCR-表位结构及AlphaFold3、Boltz-2、TCRModel2、tFold-TCR、OpenFold3预测结构。
AI.result: (1) CNN与Transformer模型呈现不同的学习轨迹；(2) TCR α与β链证据在学习中可能冲突，限制联合建模两条链的收益，而MHC信息可缓解该问题；(3) 真实与预测结构数据在TCR-表位预测中表现出不同的TCR与肽段特征偏好以及模型确定性轨迹差异。
AI.conclusion: EFT能够追溯模型训练中解释的形成过程，揭示特征依赖与证据组织的动态机制；结合TCR-XAI2基准，为TCR-表位预测模型的可解释性与结构信息影响提供了新的分析视角。

title: WEFT: Scaling Tool-Use Post-Training for General-Purpose Agents
summary: Recent efforts to scale tool-use post-training have largely centered on the synthesis of executable environments, which constitute only one component of a broader agentic interaction system comprising the environment, task, agent harness, and evaluator. Scaling environments in isolation, however, does not guarantee commensurate gains in model performance, because reliable learning signals depend on coherent interactions among all components of the agentic interaction system. To address this problem, we introduce WEFT (Whole-system Evolution For Tool-use Post-training), which couples scalable agentic interaction system construction, execution-driven self-evolution, and stable post-training. WEFT scales agentic interaction system construction across environment breadth, task complexity, and interaction diversity. Execution-driven self-evolution iteratively uses execution traces and state evidence to attribute failures and revise the responsible components, with fresh rollouts evaluating the changes and providing evidence for subsequent evolution rounds. For stable post-training at scale, WEFT addresses both optimization and execution reliability: prefix-preserving sampling retains verified progress and atomic-turn credit assignment localizes learning signals, while MegaMCP maintains isolated, recoverable state across concurrent rollouts over shared tool services. Extensive experiments across various models and benchmarks demonstrate the effectiveness of WEFT for tool-use post-training. WEFT-8B and WEFT-14B outperform all evaluated matched-size environment-scaling baselines on BFCL V4, $τ^2$-Bench, and Claw-Eval. In particular, WEFT-14B improves over Agent-World-14B by 6.41, 2.23, and 12.27 percentage points. WEFT-35B-A3B further extends these gains to more challenging long-horizon workflow benchmarks, including Toolathlon-Verified and AutomationBench.

AI.tldr: 提出WEFT（Whole-system Evolution For Tool-use Post-training），将可扩展的智能体交互系统构建、执行驱动的自进化与稳定后训练耦合起来，用于工具使用后训练。
AI.motivation: 现有工具使用后训练工作主要聚焦于可执行环境的合成，而环境只是智能体交互系统（环境、任务、智能体harness、评估器）的一个组成部分；仅孤立地扩展环境规模无法保证模型性能同步提升，因为可靠的学习信号依赖各组件间的协同交互。
AI.method: WEFT包含三部分：(1) 在环境广度、任务复杂度和交互多样性三个维度上扩展智能体交互系统构建；(2) 执行驱动的自进化，利用执行轨迹与状态证据归因失败并修订相应组件，再通过新的rollout评估改动并为下一轮进化提供证据；(3) 稳定后训练，包括保留前缀的采样（prefix-preserving sampling）保留已验证进展、原子轮次信用分配（atomic-turn credit assignment）定位学习信号，以及MegaMCP在共享工具服务上维持并发rollout的隔离、可恢复状态。
AI.result: 在多种模型与基准上验证有效。WEFT-8B和WEFT-14B在BFCL V4、τ²-Bench和Claw-Eval上优于所有参数量匹配的环境扩展基线；WEFT-14B相比Agent-World-14B分别提升6.41、2.23和12.27个百分点。WEFT-35B-A3B进一步将增益扩展到更具挑战的长时程工作流基准Toolathlon-Verified和AutomationBench。
AI.conclusion: 扩展工具使用后训练不应仅局限于环境合成，而应面向整个智能体交互系统；WEFT通过系统构建、自进化与稳定后训练的统一框架，在多个模型规模和基准上取得了优于环境扩展基线的效果。

title: AdaKerNet: Neural Kernel Decoding for Task-Adaptive Prediction with Multimodal Large Models
summary: Large foundation models have been introduced with the promise of efficient adaptation to downstream tasks. Yet, under limited supervision, MLLMs, an important class of large foundation models, remain challenging to adapt to various downstream tasks. Adaptation typically relies either on MLLM parameter fine-tuning or on training neural-based decoders. Both approaches struggle under limited supervision, while fine-tuning additionally requires access to model parameters, which is often unavailable for closed-source models. We introduce AdaKerNet, a novel learnable task-adaptive neural kernel decoder. AdaKerNet is fully agnostic to the parameters of the underlying MLLM and operates solely on its (frozen) rich representations obtained from the diverse available modalities. AdaKerNet relies on (i) a set of learnable, Lipschitz-controlled multimodal features derived from these MLLM representations; (ii) a reference kernel that provides a soft structural prior on those features; and (iii) a lightweight nonlinear neural predictor that adaptively deforms that structure. Learning the kernel representation and the neural predictor jointly within a unified optimization framework allows AdaKerNet to capture features and geometric relationships relevant to the downstream task. Numerical tests across four MLLMs: BLIP-2, LLaVA-1.5, Qwen2.5-VL, and Gemini Embedding 2, and multimodal inputs spanning text, audio, images, and tabular measurements demonstrate significant and consistent improvements over direct MLP, attention-, autoencoder- and kernel-based decoders, across a range of scarce-label budgets, with average error reduction of up to 41% across baselines. These results establish AdaKerNet as an effective approach for prediction from frozen multimodal representations in the scarce label regime. Additional structural ablations highlight the complementary contributions of AdaKerNet's components.

AI.tldr: 提出AdaKerNet——一种可学习的任务自适应神经核解码器，在冻结MLLM表示上实现少标签场景下的多模态下游适配，平均误差较基线最多降低41%。
AI.motivation: 多模态大模型（MLLM）在有限监督下难以适配下游任务：参数微调需访问模型参数（闭源模型不可得）且样本稀缺时易过拟合，训练神经解码器同样在少标签下表现不佳。
AI.method: AdaKerNet对MLLM参数完全不可知，仅作用于其冻结的多模态表示，包含三部分：(i) 从MLLM表示导出的可学习、Lipschitz控制的多模态特征；(ii) 提供软结构先验的参考核；(iii) 自适应变形该结构的轻量非线性神经预测器；二者在统一优化框架中联合学习核表示与预测器。
AI.result: 在BLIP-2、LLaVA-1.5、Qwen2.5-VL、Gemini Embedding 2四个MLLM，以及文本、音频、图像、表格数据等多模态输入上，跨多种稀缺标签预算一致优于MLP、注意力、自编码器及核方法解码器，平均误差最多降低41%；结构消融验证各组件互补贡献。
AI.conclusion: AdaKerNet是冻结多模态表示在少标签场景下进行预测的有效方案。

title: Beyond Sub-Gaussian Detector Scores: Robust Weighted Profile-Loss Change Point Detection for Human-LLM Text Segmentation
summary: Mixed human-LLM documents require locating authorship transitions from detector scores whose reliability varies across text units. Existing weighted mean contrasts are vulnerable to extreme scores, while directly replacing means with robust centers obscures how a misplaced boundary changes the population objective. We propose Robust Weighted Profile-Loss Change Point Detection (RWCP), which combines capped reliability weights, Huber profile gains, and narrowest-over-threshold search in reliability coordinates. Our key analysis expresses the population gap between a true and a displaced split as a merge cost, avoiding a closed-form solution for the nonlinear center of a mixed segment. Under explicit curvature, spacing, and dependence conditions, core RWCP recovers the number of changes and localizes their boundaries; its quadratic-loss limit recovers squared weighted CUSUM. We also study RWCP-R, a separately evaluated decoder that shares source centers across nonadjacent passages. Across five retrospective cached-score benchmark families, core RWCP reduces family-macro WindowDiff by 17.6\% relative to weighted change-point detection, and RWCP-R lowers it further. Boundary recovery improves most clearly for isolated changes, while both fixed configurations miss changes in collaborative and densely alternating text.

AI.tldr: 本文提出 RWCP，一种面向混合人机文档的作者身份转换检测方法，通过截断可靠权重、Huber 剖面增益与最窄超阈值搜索实现稳健变点定位，并给出理论保证与基准验证。
AI.motivation: 混合人类-LLM 文档需要从检测器分数中定位作者身份的转换点，但检测器可靠性在不同文本单元间波动。现有加权均值对比易受极端分数影响，而直接用稳健中心替换均值又会掩盖边界错位如何改变总体目标。
AI.method: 提出 RWCP：结合截断可靠权重、Huber 剖面增益，并在可靠性坐标中进行最窄超阈值搜索。关键分析将真实划分与错位划分之间的总体差距表示为合并代价，从而避免对混合段非线性中心求闭式解。另研究 RWCP-R，一个独立评估的解码器，在非相邻段落间共享源中心。
AI.result: 在明确的曲率、间距和依赖条件下，核心 RWCP 能恢复变点数量并定位边界；其二次损失极限可退化为平方加权 CUSUM。在五个回溯性缓存分数基准族上，核心 RWCP 相对加权变点检测将 family-macro WindowDiff 降低 17.6%，RWCP-R 进一步降低。
AI.conclusion: RWCP 在孤立变点上边界恢复效果最明显；但两种固定配置在协作性和密集交替文本中均会漏检变点。

title: Neural Succession: A Mesoscopic Theory of Invasion, Coexistence, and Stabilization in Continual Learning
comment: 20 pages, 10 figures, 7 tables. Code available at https://github.com/shoaibdipu/Neural_Succession/
summary: Continual learning is usually studied through mechanisms that preserve old knowledge. We develop Successional Learning Theory (SLT), a mesoscopic account in which the current representation is a resident community, the incoming task is an invader, forgetting is resident displacement, joint retention is coexistence, replay is resident reinforcement, and training moves from establishment toward stabilization. Its empirical coordinate is directional pre-invasion compatibility, measured on the resident model before the incoming task is learned. Across eight experiments, compatibility orders later forgetting on the 20 directed Split-CIFAR-10 transitions (three-repeat r=-0.789, incoming-task cluster 95% CI [-0.90,-0.72], every repeat alone r<=-0.67), forecasts held-out forgetting with 24% lower error than a no-information baseline, and reproduces under controlled MNIST permutations and CIFAR-10 rotations (r=-0.804, -0.718). On an 84-transition suite, compatibility separates coexistence from exclusion at every retention threshold (AUC 0.93-0.97). Replay repairs every transition with at most 325 stored examples and is most efficient where displacement is largest. Compatibility reaches |r|=0.720, while activation, representation, Jacobian, and fixed-coefficient Lotka-Volterra specializations do not. Plasticity and feature turnover fall reliably from early to late training (15/15 and 14/15 runs). We formalize a minimum habitat-modification bound, a displacement floor, a sufficient coexistence condition, an identifiability law with a range-restriction corollary, successional stabilization, and local reinforcement. The identifiability law also predicts where the coordinate loses leverage, and the prediction matches three CIFAR-100 partitions and five optimizer regimes. SLT is a pre-adaptation diagnostic that complements replay, regularization, and projection methods.

AI.tldr: 该论文提出"演替学习理论"（SLT），以生态学中的"居民群落—入侵者"隐喻描述持续学习，并用"定向入侵前兼容性"作为可测坐标，在大量迁移实验中预测与解释遗忘、共存与重放效率。
AI.motivation: 持续学习通常以"保存旧知识"的机制为研究视角，缺乏一个既能统一刻画遗忘、联合保持与重放、又能提供可测预测量的中层（mesoscopic）理论框架。作者希望找到一个在学习新任务之前即可测得的量，用以预判后续遗忘与共存情况，从而把持续学习从"事后修复"转向"事前诊断"。
AI.method: 提出演替学习理论（SLT）：将当前表征视为"居民群落"，新任务视为"入侵者"，遗忘为"居民被置换"，联合保持为"共存"，重放为"居民强化"，训练过程为"定殖—稳定化"演替。核心经验坐标是定向入侵前兼容性（directional pre-invasion compatibility），在学新任务之前于居民模型上测量。在 Split-CIFAR-10 的 20 个有向迁移、MNIST 置换与 CIFAR-10 旋转、84 迁移套件及 CIFAR-100 分区、多种优化器设定下验证；并与激活、表征、Jacobian 及固定系数 Lotka-Volterra 等特化方法对比，同时形式化若干理论结果（最小栖息地修改界、置换下界、充分共存条件、可识别性定律及范围限制推论、演替稳定化、局部强化）。
AI.result: 兼容性可预测后续遗忘：20 个有向 Split-CIFAR-10 迁移上三次重复 r=-0.789，单次重复 r<=-0.67，对留出遗忘的预测误差比无信息基线低 24%；在 MNIST 置换与 CIFAR-10 旋转上复现（r=-0.804、-0.718）。在 84 迁移套件中，兼容性在各保留阈值下均可区分共存与排挤（AUC 0.93-0.97）。重放仅用至多 325 个存储样本即可修复全部迁移，且在置换最严重处效率最高。兼容性达到 |r|=0.720，而激活、表征、Jacobian 与固定系数 Lotka-Volterra 特化均未达到。可塑性与特征更新率从训练早期到晚期可靠下降（分别为 15/15 与 14/15 次运行）。可识别性定律对"坐标失效位置"的预测与三个 CIFAR-100 分区及五种优化器设定一致。
AI.conclusion: SLT 提供了一个中层、可量化的持续学习理论框架，其"入侵前兼容性"是一种事前可测的诊断指标，能预测遗忘、判别共存与排挤、指导重放资源配置，并解释了坐标在何处失效。作者将其定位为对重放、正则化与投影等方法的补充性"预适应诊断"工具。

title: Harness Evolution as Learning: Approximation, Generalization, and Optimization Limits of Self-Improving Personal Agents
summary: As the capabilities of large language models (LLMs) continue to advance, increasing attention is turning to how to translate their abilities into useful behavior. Personal agents bring this question into everyday settings, where models are expected to serve individual users and continually adapt to their preferences. With the underlying model held fixed, such adaptation relies on harness engineering: designing and evolving the surrounding layer that manages context, memory, tools, and execution. Despite rapid progress, the factors governing effective harness evolution remain insufficiently understood. To narrow this gap, we investigate three central questions concerning harness architecture, harness scale, and self-evolution algorithms through complementary empirical and theoretical analyses. Empirically, we introduce a preference-oriented benchmark and systematically characterize the capabilities and limitations of personal agents associated with these three dimensions. Theoretically, we formulate harness evolution as a learning problem and explain these phenomena through approximation, generalization, and optimization errors. Analyses of reachable policies, capacity under finite interaction evidence, and biased update dynamics provide theoretical accounts of the observed phenomena. Together, these results offer a unified perspective on the limits of personalization through harness evolution and inform future harness design.

AI.tldr: 本文研究个人智能体的"外壳工程"（harness engineering）：在底层大模型固定的前提下，聚焦外壳架构、外壳规模与自演化算法三个问题，通过偏好导向的基准与理论学习问题共同刻画个性化能力的边界。
AI.motivation: LLM能力不断增强，如何将其转化为日常场景中的有用行为成为关键问题。个人智能体需持续适应用户偏好，而当底层模型固定时，这种适应只能依赖外壳工程，即管理上下文、记忆、工具与执行的外围层。然而，决定外壳演化有效性的因素尚缺乏充分理解，这构成研究动因。
AI.method: 研究采用实证与理论互补的方法。实证上，提出面向偏好的基准，系统刻画个人智能体在外壳架构、外壳规模、自演化算法三个维度上的能力与局限。理论上，将外壳演化形式化为一个学习问题，并从近似误差、泛化误差与优化误差的角度解释上述现象，进一步通过可达策略、有限交互证据下的容量以及有偏更新动力学的分析给出理论解释。
AI.result: 在所提偏好基准上，系统揭示了个人智能体于架构、规模与自演化算法三维度上的能力与局限；理论分析指出可达策略集合受限、有限交互证据下的容量约束，以及有偏更新动态，分别对应近似、泛化与优化误差，为观测到的经验现象提供了理论说明。
AI.conclusion: 研究给出了关于外壳演化实现个性化的统一视角，阐明其能力上限，并为未来的外壳设计提供指导。

title: Reward-rate Policy Gradient for Efficient Machine Learning Engineering Agents
summary: Traditional reinforcement learning (RL) techniques focus on maximizing expected cumulative reward, where each action assumes to take a constant unit of time. However, this assumption does not hold for agentic RL tasks such as machine learning engineering (MLE) agents, where actions involve data loading, feature engineering, and model training that take variable durations. Efficiency matters in modern agentic RL where actions are costly. To address this limitation, we adapt from continuous-time RL and Semi-Markov Decision Process (SMDP) formulation and propose Reward-rate Policy Gradient (RPG), where we focus on optimizing the reward rate -- the long-term reward per unit of time. RPG estimates the reward rate from off-policy samples, then charges each action for the time it consumes at that rate. We first conduct theoretical analysis in the bandit setting to establish that RPG approximates the optimal reward rate and empirically demonstrate it outperforms baselines while avoiding enumeration over the policy space, a known issue for an existing method. We then further apply RPG on a small language model (Qwen3.5-4B) with self-improvement loops and empirically show it obtains higher rewards within a fixed time budget than vanilla RL on MLE-Bench and NanoGPT, with a 19.2% and 85.7% margin, respectively. Our method provides a practical solution for optimizing performance under wait time considerations in modern agentic RL tasks, where actions interact with external environments and cost time.

AI.tldr: 本文提出Reward-rate Policy Gradient (RPG)，通过从off-policy样本估计奖励率并对每个动作按耗时计费，优化单位时间长期回报，在bandit与MLE任务中超越基线及vanilla RL。
AI.motivation: 传统RL以最大化期望累积奖励为目标，且假设每个动作耗时恒定。但在MLE等agentic RL任务中，动作（数据加载、特征工程、模型训练）耗时差异巨大，效率至关重要，该假设不成立。
AI.method: 借鉴连续时间RL与半马尔可夫决策过程(SMDP)建模，提出Reward-rate Policy Gradient (RPG)：从off-policy样本估计奖励率（长期回报/单位时间），并按该率为每个动作的时间消耗计费；先在bandit设定下进行理论分析，再将其用于小型语言模型(Qwen3.5-4B)的自改进循环。
AI.result: 理论上证明RPG可逼近最优奖励率；实验显示在bandit中优于基线且避免了对策略空间的枚举（已有方法的已知缺陷）；在MLE-Bench和NanoGPT上，固定时间预算内RPG比vanilla RL分别获得19.2%和85.7%的奖励提升。
AI.conclusion: RPG为动作需与外部环境交互且消耗时间的现代agentic RL任务提供了一种在等待时间约束下优化性能的实用方案。

title: HorizonFlow: Variable-Length Planning for Offline Goal-Conditioned RL
summary: Recent advances in generative planning have made trajectory inpainting a promising approach to offline goal-conditioned reinforcement learning. However, these methods typically specify the planning horizon before generating plan content, even though the appropriate horizon depends on the route itself. A horizon that is too short can force infeasible transitions, whereas one that is too long can introduce redundant motion. We introduce HorizonFlow, a hierarchical planner that treats plan length as an output of generation rather than a prescribed input. Its subgoal route planner guides its action-prefix controller through a sequence of latent subgoals. Both components combine insertion-based generation with flow matching to jointly generate continuous plan content and length, using the partially generated plan to guide token insertion. HorizonFlow reuses the resulting length information to select candidates and steer generation toward shorter plans without a separate learned value model. Across Maze2D, Multi2D, and OGBench navigation and visual manipulation benchmarks, HorizonFlow achieves the highest average performance among the compared methods.

AI.tldr: HorizonFlow将离线目标条件强化学习中的规划长度视为生成输出而非预设输入，通过分层规划器联合生成规划内容与长度，在多个导航与操作基准上取得最佳平均性能。
AI.motivation: 现有生成式规划的轨迹补全方法通常在生成规划内容之前就预设规划视界，但合适的视界取决于路线本身。视界过短会强制产生不可行转移，过长则会引入冗余运动。因此需要一种将规划长度作为生成输出的方法。
AI.method: 提出HorizonFlow，一种分层规划器。其子目标路线规划器通过一系列潜在子目标引导动作前缀控制器。两个组件都结合基于插入的生成与流匹配，联合生成连续规划内容与长度，并利用部分生成的规划引导token插入。此外，复用所得长度信息进行候选选择，引导生成偏向更短规划，无需单独学习价值模型。
AI.result: 在Maze2D、Multi2D以及OGBench的导航与视觉操作基准上，HorizonFlow在对比方法中取得最高的平均性能。
AI.conclusion: 将规划长度作为生成输出而非预设输入，并结合基于插入的生成与流匹配的分层规划框架，能有效提升离线目标条件强化学习在导航与操作任务中的表现。

title: Longer Records, Broader Invariance: The Hidden Scaling Problem in Longitudinal Contrastive Learning
summary: Longitudinal data are valuable because people change. Yet the objectives used to learn from these data can inadvertently erase that change. In person-level contrastive learning, observations from the same person are treated as positives; as records grow, those positives can span increasingly distant---and increasingly different---behavioral states. More history can therefore produce not only more data, but broader invariance. We show that this distinction is fundamental. We separate \emph{record span}, how much history the learner sees, from \emph{supervision span}, how far across that history positive-pair supervision reaches. Across in-home sensing records spanning up to 2.7 years, broader supervision systematically suppresses recoverable changing-state information, even when the available history is held fixed. At the broadest span, less than 10\% of the information recoverable from an untrained encoder remains. Yet keeping positives local is not sufficient: as records grow, even distant states that are never paired become increasingly similar. Explicitly contrasting other observations from the same person reverses this loss without shortening the record, revealing a second route by which longitudinal scale can broaden invariance. Finally, we prospectively reproduce the supervision-span effect in 199 GLOBEM participants. Longitudinal scale therefore presents a choice: more history need not mean more invariance. By controlling what is held invariant as records grow, we can preserve the change that made the longitudinal data valuable in the first place.

AI.tldr: 纵向数据的价值在于捕捉人的变化，但人物级对比学习可能无意中抹除这种变化。作者区分"记录跨度"（看到多少历史）与"监督跨度"（正样本对跨越多远的历史），证明监督跨度越大，可恢复的变化状态信息被系统性抑制；即便保持记录固定，随时间增长，未配对的状态也趋于相似。通过显式对比同一人的其他观测可逆转损失，并在199名GLOBEM参与者中前瞻性复现该效应。
AI.motivation: 纵向数据本应刻画个体的动态变化，但常用于学习此类数据的对比学习目标（人物级对比）将同一人所有观测视为正样本。随着记录增长，正样本对可能跨越越来越远、越来越不同的行为状态，导致学习器学到过宽的不变性，从而抹除了数据中本应保留的"变化"信息。作者希望厘清"更多历史"何时等同于"更强不变性"，以及如何控制不变性以保留变化。
AI.method: 提出记录跨度（record span，学习器可见的历史量）与监督跨度（supervision span，正样本对监督跨越历史的范围）的区分。在最长2.7年的居家传感记录上，保持可用历史固定、仅改变监督跨度进行实验，测量可恢复的变化状态信息（以未训练编码器可恢复信息为参照）。进一步分析记录增长导致的"远端状态趋同"现象，并采用显式对比同一人其他观测的策略；最后在199名GLOBEM参与者中进行前瞻性验证。
AI.result: 更宽的监督跨度会系统性地压制可恢复的变化状态信息，即使可用历史保持不变；在最宽的监督跨度下，未训练编码器可恢复的信息保留不足10%。将正样本局部化并不足够：随记录增长，从未配对的远端状态也变得越来越相似。显式对比同一人的其他观测能在不缩短记录的情况下逆转这一信息损失，揭示纵向规模扩大不变性的第二条路径。监督跨度效应在199名GLOBEM参与者中得到前瞻性复现。
AI.conclusion: 纵向规模带来的是选择而非必然：更多历史不一定意味着更强不变性。通过控制随记录增长而被保持不变的内容（即约束监督跨度、显式对比同人其他观测），可以保留使纵向数据有价值的变化信息。

title: STAR-GRPO: Canonical Anchoring and Reliability-First Advantages against Representation-Dependent Reward Hacking
summary: Reward hacking occurs when policy optimization exploits a brittle reward interface or an overly permissive proxy objective, improving the training score without improving the underlying response quality. This phenomenon is amplified in group-relative policy optimization: an unsupported reward can shift the group baseline and alter the updates of other rollouts, while post-hoc or purely relative weighting cannot represent group-wide uncertainty. We propose \emph{Self-Tuned Anchored Reliability Group-Relative Policy Optimization} (STAR-GRPO), a reliability-first advantage estimator based on paired assessments of the same rollout. STAR separates the quality signal from its learning influence: score disagreement determines rollout reliability, relative reliability enters a self-tuned robust location--scale fit before group normalization, and absolute group reliability attenuates the resulting bounded advantage. The analysis establishes coordinate and second-moment bounds, characterizes exact centering through the weighted location equation, and gives reliability-dependent attenuation guarantees for outlying rewards. We evaluate STAR-GRPO in two complementary reward-hacking regimes. In token-interface exploitation, STAR prevents runaway optimization of the deployed-interface score while improving the canonical quality signal. In rubric-proxy overoptimization for medical reasoning, STAR improves independent semantic evaluation, narrows the proxy--judge discrepancy, and reduces overclaim while optimizing the same task proxy. Together, these results show that reliability-first normalization offers a principled way to limit unsupported reward influence on both group baselines and policy updates, while retaining the task reward as the optimization target.

AI.tldr: 该论文提出STAR-GRPO，一种基于同一rollout配对评估的可靠性优先优势估计器，通过分离质量信号与学习影响来缓解GRPO中的reward hacking。
AI.motivation: 奖励黑客（reward hacking）指策略优化利用脆弱的奖励接口或过于宽松的代理目标，在提升训练分数时并未真正改善底层响应质量。该现象在组相对策略优化（GRPO）中被放大：不受支持的奖励会偏移组基线并影响其他rollout的更新，而事后加权或纯相对加权无法表示组级不确定性。
AI.method: 提出STAR-GRPO（Self-Tuned Anchored Reliability Group-Relative Policy Optimization）。其核心是基于同一rollout配对评估的可靠性优先优势估计器，将质量信号与学习影响分离：分数分歧决定rollout可靠性；相对可靠性进入自调优的鲁棒位置-尺度拟合后再做组归一化；绝对组可靠性对所得有界优势进行衰减。理论上建立了坐标与二阶矩界、通过加权位置方程刻画精确中心化，并给出针对离群奖励的可靠性相关衰减保证。
AI.result: 在两种互补的reward hacking场景中评估：(1) token接口利用——STAR阻止对部署接口分数的失控优化，同时提升标准质量信号；(2) 医学推理的评分标准代理过度优化——STAR提升独立语义评估，缩小代理与评判者的差距，减少过度声称，同时优化同一任务代理。
AI.conclusion: 可靠性优先的归一化为限制不受支持奖励对组基线和策略更新的影响提供了原则性方法，同时保留任务奖励作为优化目标。

title: Theory on Attention Dynamics for Out-of-Distribution In-Context Learning
summary: Transformers have demonstrated remarkable in-context learning (ICL) capabilities, enabling them to perform new tasks without additional fine-tuning. However, their performance often deteriorates when encountering out-of-distribution (OOD) inputs that deviate from the training distribution, and the underlying theory remains poorly understood. To fill this gap, we characterize the OOD error under the input distribution shift through the interplay between the dynamics of the so-called $α$-type and $β$-type attention weights, which represent the transformer's confidence in identifying the correct and incorrect features, respectively. Our results indicate that the OOD error for each feature depends on all pairwise interactions between the training features and OOD features, and under certain cases the transformer performs no better than random guessing. To improve the OOD generalization performance, we next investigate the impact of model finetuning with the OOD data, and particularly, characterize the model forgetting performance on the source domain. Interestingly, the performance on the source domain may not always degrade after finetuning, which highly depends on the nature of the feature shift: finetuning on OOD domain keeps enhancing the confidence of identifying correct features from the original distribution, while the interference from other incorrect features may either increase or decrease. Extensive experiments on both synthetic and real data are conducted to corroborate the theoretical insights.

AI.tldr: 本文从理论上刻画了Transformer在输入分布偏移下的上下文学习OOD误差，并分析了用OOD数据微调时的源域遗忘性能。
AI.motivation: Transformer的上下文学习（ICL）能力突出，但面对偏离训练分布的OOD输入时性能常下降，且缺乏理论解释。作者希望填补这一理论空白，并进一步理解用OOD数据微调对OOD泛化与源域性能的影响。
AI.method: 通过刻画α型与β型注意力权重的动态交互（分别表示识别正确与错误特征的置信度）来分析输入分布偏移下的OOD误差；随后研究使用OOD数据微调的效果，重点刻画源域上的模型遗忘行为。
AI.result: OOD误差对每个特征取决于训练特征与OOD特征之间的所有成对交互，某些情形下Transformer表现不优于随机猜测。微调分析显示源域性能并非总是下降，取决于特征偏移性质：在OOD域微调会持续提升对原分布正确特征的识别置信度，而来自其他错误特征的干扰可能增强或减弱。合成与真实数据实验验证了理论。
AI.conclusion: 该工作为Transformer的ICL在分布偏移下的行为提供了理论刻画，揭示了OOD误差与注意力权重动态的关联，并阐明了OOD微调对源域遗忘的非单调影响。

title: PrecogUI: Proactive GUI Agents via Pre-cognitive Simulation and Experience Retrieval
summary: Existing reactive Graphical User Interface (GUI) agents often fail in long-horizon, dynamic scenarios, where unexpected disturbances trigger attention-diverting and cascading failures. To address this, we propose PrecogUI, a pre-cognitive architecture that shifts the paradigm from reactive execution to proactive decision-making. Specifically, we design a Proactive Experience Pool (PEP), which caches recurring anomaly and success patterns as "state-action-result" tuples in a dual-memory repository. Furthermore, we introduce a Proactive Simulation Executor (PSE) that learns to forecast the next symbolic UI layout given a candidate action, enabling early anomaly avoidance and ranking candidate actions by predicted reliability. Finally, a Pre-cognitive Execution Controller (PEC) fuses these priors and predictions, prioritizes handling of foreseen anomalies, and ensures execution robustness through a closed-loop error correction mechanism. For robust evaluation, we develop AutoTraj, an automatic data-generation engine, to construct InterfereBench, a benchmark for long-horizon tasks with strong disturbances. Experiments demonstrate that PrecogUI surpasses state-of-the-art methods on InterfereBench while maintaining competitive performance on public benchmarks. The code will be publicly available.

AI.tldr: 本文提出PrecogUI，一种预认知架构，将GUI智能体从反应式执行转变为主动决策，通过经验池、仿真执行器与预认知控制器提升长时程动态场景下的鲁棒性，并构建InterfereBench基准进行评估。
AI.motivation: 现有反应式GUI智能体在长时程、动态场景中易失败，突发扰动会引发注意力转移和级联失败。因此需要从被动响应转向主动预判，以提前规避异常。
AI.method: 提出PrecogUI预认知架构，包含三部分：Proactive Experience Pool (PEP) 以"状态-动作-结果"元组在双记忆库中缓存反复出现的异常与成功模式；Proactive Simulation Executor (PSE) 学习在给定候选动作下预测下一步符号化UI布局，实现早期异常规避并按预测可靠性对候选动作排序；Pre-cognitive Execution Controller (PEC) 融合先验与预测，优先处理可预见的异常，并通过闭环纠错机制保障执行鲁棒性。另构建AutoTraj自动数据生成引擎，用于搭建InterfereBench基准。
AI.result: 在InterfereBench上，PrecogUI超越当前最先进方法，同时在公开基准上保持有竞争力的性能。
AI.conclusion: PrecogUI验证了预认知/主动决策范式在GUI智能体中的有效性，能够应对强扰动的长时程任务，代码将公开。

title: Invariant Atoms: Sparse Coordinates of Local Semantic Geometry in Language Model Representations
summary: Large language models often preserve meaning despite substantial changes in wording, style, and syntax, while small semantic edits can systematically alter their hidden representations. This suggests that semantic variation may be organized along recurring local directions. We propose the Invariant Atom Hypothesis: local semantic motion admits preferred sparse coordinates along directions that remain stable under meaning-preserving transformations. We learn a shared semantic frame and sparse coordinates that reconstruct semantic displacements while suppressing nuisance variation, with anchor-dependent diagonal modulation adjusting atom strengths without sample-specific rotations. Empirically, the atoms exhibit strong semantic--nuisance separation, sparse reconstruction, reproducible directions, and causal effects on model predictions. The learned geometry generalizes to unseen semantic neighborhoods and nuisance families, while local reweighting improves semantic selectivity and preserves a consistent global-to-local structure. Atom signatures also remain stable under model modification. These findings support reusable invariant directions as a sparse coordinate system for local semantic geometry in language models.

AI.tldr: 论文提出"不变原子假说"：局部语义变化可由一组在保义变换下稳定的稀疏方向表示，并通过学习共享语义框架与稀疏坐标验证该假设。
AI.motivation: 大语言模型在措辞、风格、句法大幅变化时仍能保持语义，而细微的语义编辑却会系统性改变其隐藏表示。这暗示语义变化可能沿重复出现的局部方向组织，但该结构是否存在稳定的稀疏坐标系统尚不明确。
AI.method: 提出不变原子假说，认为局部语义运动存在优选稀疏坐标，其方向在保义变换下保持稳定。学习一个共享语义框架及稀疏坐标，用以重构语义位移并抑制干扰变化；采用依赖锚点的对角调制调整原子强度，而不引入样本特定的旋转。
AI.result: 原子表现出强语义—干扰分离、稀疏重构、方向可复现以及对模型预测的因果效应；所学几何结构可泛化到未见语义邻域与干扰族；局部重加权提升语义选择性并保持一致的全局—局部结构；原子签名在模型修改下保持稳定。
AI.conclusion: 这些发现支持可复用的不变方向作为语言模型局部语义几何的稀疏坐标系。

title: Neuro-Symbolic Computer Use: Learning Reusable Policies for Reliable and Efficient Execution
summary: Many computer tasks recur: the same workflow runs many times, with new inputs and from different starting states. Current computer-use agents re-plan every step of every run, which makes them costly and unreliable on such tasks. We introduce neuro-symbolic computer use, in which a recurring workflow is executed by a learned policy rather than re-derived by an agent on each run. The policy fixes the decisions that are stable across runs (ordering, variables, loops, and branches) in executable code, and delegates observation-dependent decisions, such as grounding and state checks, to neural models. We learn these policies with neuro-symbolic policy iteration: starting from one agent trajectory, it executes the policy, diagnoses failures with task-completion and step-level judges, and revises the code with a coding model informed by an agent's continuation from the point of failure, without access to the benchmark evaluator. Iterating on generated parameter and initial-state variants makes the policy reusable, and a pre-action verifier guards each state-mutating step at deployment. On OSWorld-Verified and ScienceBoard, the learned policies achieve the highest Pass^3 of all methods in all four settings, 3.6-15.8 points above the base agent, while cutting per-run cost by 15-217$\times$ and latency by 3.4-5.1$\times$. On OSWorld-Verified, policies built only on variants transfer to the held-out original tasks, exceeding AutoRPA by 8.6-17.5 points in Pass^3.

AI.tldr: 提出"神经符号计算机使用"框架，将重复性工作流固化为可执行策略代码，仅把依赖观测的决策交给神经模型，通过神经符号策略迭代学习，在OSWorld-Verified与ScienceBoard上取得最高Pass^3并大幅降低成本与延迟。
AI.motivation: 许多计算机任务具有重复性：同一工作流会以新输入、从不同初始状态反复执行。现有计算机使用智能体每次运行都逐步重新规划，导致成本高、可靠性差。作者希望用学习得到的策略替代每次重新推导，从而提升可复用性、稳定性与效率。
AI.method: 提出神经符号计算机使用：用学习到的策略执行重复工作流。策略以可执行代码固定跨运行稳定的决策（顺序、变量、循环、分支），把依赖观测的决策（如grounding与状态检查）委托给神经模型。采用神经符号策略迭代学习：从一条智能体轨迹出发，执行策略，用任务完成与步骤级评判器诊断失败，并由编码模型结合故障点处智能体的后续行为修订代码，全程不访问基准评测器。通过在生成的参数与初始状态变体上迭代使策略可复用，并在部署时用动作前验证器守护每个改变状态的步骤。
AI.result: 在OSWorld-Verified和ScienceBoard上，学习到的策略在全部四种设置中取得最高Pass^3，比基础智能体高3.6–15.8分，同时将单次运行成本降低15–217倍、延迟降低3.4–5.1倍。在OSWorld-Verified上，仅基于变体构建的策略可迁移到留出的原始任务，Pass^3比AutoRPA高8.6–17.5分。
AI.conclusion: 将重复性工作流编译为神经符号策略，能显著提升计算机使用智能体的可靠性与效率，并具备从变体到原始任务的迁移能力，为可复用、低成本的自动化提供新范式。

title: Channel-Dependent State Space Model for Multivariate Time Series Forecasting
summary: Multivariate time series forecasting (MTSF) is critical across many real-world domains. Existing deep learning approaches fall into two paradigms with distinct limitations: channel-independent (CI) methods unconditionally ignore cross-variable dependencies and model only temporal dynamics, while channel-dependent (CD) methods consider both but typically rely on architectural compromises to mitigate overfitting and computational overhead. We therefore propose Chameleon, a specialized CD state space model (SSM) that enables data-dependent, fine-grained interactions across variables while scaling linearly with their number. By connecting selective SSMs with the Kalman filter, we leverage the missing measurement update in the former for cross-variable modeling while preserving the SSM backbone for robust temporal modeling. We further identify favorable inductive biases of GatedDeltaNet for time series, adapt it as our backbone, and improve generalization through additional techniques, including a previously unexplored stochastic perturbation of reversible instance normalization. On strongly dependent ODE and PEMS datasets, Chameleon achieves the best MSE and MAE across all settings, while its CI ablation and prior CD methods incur 61-178% higher MSE on average. Across 28 standard benchmark settings, Chameleon also achieves better MSE and MAE than each baseline in at least 27 and 22 cases, respectively. Training-time and peak-memory analyses on Traffic and ETT further demonstrate competitive efficiency and favorable memory scalability across different variable counts.

AI.tldr: 提出 Chameleon——一种专用的通道相关（CD）状态空间模型，可实现数据依赖的变量间细粒度交互并随变量数线性扩展，在强依赖数据集与28个标准基准设置上取得领先的MSE/MAE，并保持竞争性的效率与内存可扩展性。
AI.motivation: 现有深度学习方法分为两类且各有局限：通道独立（CI）方法无条件忽略跨变量依赖，仅建模时间动态；通道相关（CD）方法虽同时考虑两者，但通常依赖架构上的折衷来缓解过拟合与计算开销。因此需要一个既能建模细粒度跨变量交互、又能线性扩展的CD模型。
AI.method: 提出 Chameleon，一种专用CD状态空间模型（SSM）。通过将选择性SSM与卡尔曼滤波相联系，利用前者中缺失的测量更新（missing measurement update）进行跨变量建模，同时保留SSM骨干以稳健建模时间动态；识别GatedDeltaNet在时间序列上的有利归纳偏置并将其适配为骨干；并引入额外技术提升泛化，包括对可逆实例归一化（RevIN）的随机扰动（此前未被探索）。
AI.result: 在强依赖的ODE和PEMS数据集上，Chameleon在所有设置下取得最优MSE与MAE，其CI消融版本与已有CD方法的平均MSE高出61–178%。在28个标准基准设置中，Chameleon在至少27个（MSE）和22个（MAE）情形下优于各基线。在Traffic与ETT上的训练时间与峰值内存分析显示其具有竞争性的效率和良好的内存可扩展性。
AI.conclusion: Chameleon通过将选择性SSM与卡尔曼滤波结合实现线性复杂度的数据依赖跨变量交互，在强依赖与标准基准上均表现优异，同时在效率与内存扩展性上具备优势，为MTSF中CD范式提供了一种有效且可扩展的解决方案。

title: Learn from the Gap: Differential-Aware Advantage Pruning with Adaptive Rollout Sampling for GRPO
summary: Recently, Group Relative Policy Optimization (GRPO) and its variants have been developed for policy optimization and demonstrated notable performance gains. However, these methods usually incur substantial computational overhead due to per-question multi-rollout sampling and repeated per-token probability evaluation across rollouts. Furthermore, low-information or highly homogeneous trajectories can degrade downstream learning signal efficiency, hindering model optimization and limiting final performance. To address these issues, we propose FastRL, a novel plug-and-play reinforcement learning framework that simultaneously improves training efficiency and the effectiveness of policy learning. Specifically, 1) We introduce an advantage-aware pruning strategy to selectively preserve high-advantage trajectories while maximizing inter-trajectory gradient diversity. 2) Then, we design an adaptive rollout sampling mechanism to dynamically adjust the sampling scale across different training stages based on historical pruning distributions, balancing exploration adequacy and computational efficiency. Experiments demonstrate that FastRL can be seamlessly integrated into GRPO, DAPO, and GSPO variants, achieving an average 2.07$\times$ training speedup on Geometry3K and GeoQA8K-R1V, along with an approximately 1.64\% improvement in average accuracy on visual reasoning benchmarks. Source codes will be available at https://github.com/Nicozwy/FastRL.

AI.tldr: 提出即插即用的强化学习框架 FastRL，通过优势感知剪枝与自适应 rollout 采样，同时提升 GRPO 类方法的训练效率与策略学习效果。
AI.motivation: GRPO 及其变体虽在策略优化上取得显著性能提升，但每问题多 rollout 采样与跨 rollout 的逐 token 概率重复计算带来巨大计算开销；同时低信息量或高度同质的轨迹会降低下游学习信号效率，阻碍模型优化并限制最终性能。
AI.method: FastRL 包含两个核心组件：1）优势感知剪枝策略，选择性保留高优势轨迹，同时最大化轨迹间梯度多样性；2）自适应 rollout 采样机制，基于历史剪枝分布动态调整不同训练阶段的采样规模，以平衡探索充分性与计算效率。
AI.result: FastRL 可无缝集成到 GRPO、DAPO 和 GSPO 变体中，在 Geometry3K 与 GeoQA8K-R1V 上平均实现 2.07 倍训练加速，并在视觉推理基准上平均准确率提升约 1.64%。
AI.conclusion: FastRL 作为一种即插即用框架，能够同时改善训练效率与策略学习有效性，并具备良好的通用性与可迁移性。

title: Emergent phases of superposition: from partial to full representation
summary: Large language models are thought to represent features by vectors in a hidden space of dimension given by the model's width. Superposition, in which more features are represented than the width by letting representation vectors overlap, is a leading account of how representation vectors are organized. However, how model width and data statistics determine the configuration of representation vectors and the resulting loss when the number of features and the width are large remains less understood. Here we show, in Anthropic's toy model of superposition, that increasing the width drives a continuous phase transition from a partial-representation phase, where only a subset of features receives appreciable representation vectors while the rest vanish, to a full-representation phase, where every feature is represented. Our theory via a partial random projection approximation predicts, and experiments confirm, that the critical width grows linearly with the number of active features up to a logarithmic factor. The loss scaling changes across the transition: below the critical width, the loss grows linearly with the number of active features and depends weakly on the width in a form set by data statistics; above it, the loss grows approximately quadratically with the number of active features and decays inversely with the width. Non-uniform firing probabilities delay the transition and lower the loss, as more frequent features occupy more space. Our results provide an account of how model width and data statistics jointly shape representations and loss, a step toward understanding representation scaling in large models.

AI.tldr: 该文研究Anthropic叠加玩具模型中模型宽度与数据统计如何决定表征向量配置与损失，发现宽度增加会驱动从部分表征相到全表征相的连续相变。
AI.motivation: 大语言模型被认为以隐空间向量表征特征，叠加现象允许表征数超过宽度，但宽度与数据统计如何共同决定表征向量配置及大尺度下的损失仍不清楚，需要理论刻画。
AI.method: 在Anthropic叠加玩具模型中，采用部分随机投影近似建立理论，并通过实验验证临界宽度、损失缩放规律及非均匀激活概率的影响。
AI.result: 增加宽度驱动连续相变：从仅有部分特征获得有效表征的部分表征相，转为所有特征均被表征的全表征相。临界宽度随活跃特征数线性增长，至多差一个对数因子。低于临界宽度时，损失随活跃特征数线性增长且弱依赖宽度，形式由数据统计决定；高于临界宽度时，损失近似随活跃特征数二次增长，并随宽度反比衰减。非均匀激活概率会推迟相变并降低损失，高频特征占据更多空间。
AI.conclusion: 模型宽度与数据统计共同塑造表征与损失，为理解大模型中的表征缩放提供了理论起点。

title: VLALight: A Vision-Language-Action Model for Traffic Signal Control
summary: Traffic signal control (TSC) is essential for improving urban mobility and reducing congestion. Although roadside cameras are widely deployed at signalized intersections and provide rich visual observations of evolving traffic, existing TSC methods typically rely on manually engineered traffic states or separate perception modules, creating a gap between physical observations and control decisions. We present VLALight, the first vision-language-action (VLA) model for end-to-end traffic signal control from multi-view roadside videos. VLALight directly maps visual observations to coordinated signal actions through multi-target spatiotemporal traffic reasoning and topology-aware cooperative perception across intersections. To establish this capability, we develop a two-stage supervised cold-start training strategy for visual traffic understanding and signal decision-making, followed by cooperative agentic reinforcement learning that jointly optimizes local control and network-wide traffic efficiency. Furthermore, VLALight introduces adaptive fast and slow reasoning modes, enabling the policy to allocate deeper reasoning only when additional deliberation provides sufficient control benefits. Through balanced mode-aware rollouts and relative advantage optimization, VLALight learns to trade off decision quality and inference cost. Extensive experiments on seven real-world traffic-flow datasets across three urban networks demonstrate that VLALight consistently outperforms transportation-based, RL-based, and LLM/VLM-based baselines. Ablation studies validate the effectiveness of cooperative perception, network-level optimization, and adaptive reasoning. These results demonstrate the potential of VLA models for real-world physical traffic control. Our project is available at https://github.com/usail-hkust/VLALight.git.

AI.tldr: 本文提出VLALight，首个基于多视角路侧视频的端到端交通信号控制视觉-语言-动作（VLA）模型，通过多目标时空推理、拓扑感知协同感知、两阶段监督冷启动与协同智能体强化学习，并引入自适应快慢推理模式，在三个城市路网七个真实流量数据集上超越交通、RL与LLM/VLM基线。
AI.motivation: 现有交通信号控制方法多依赖人工设计的交通状态或独立感知模块，造成物理观测与控制决策之间的脱节；而路侧摄像头虽已广泛部署并能提供丰富视觉观测，却未被端到端地用于信号控制。
AI.method: 提出VLALight，将多视角路侧视频直接映射为协同信号动作。核心包括：跨交叉口的多目标时空交通推理与拓扑感知协同感知；两阶段监督冷启动训练（视觉交通理解与信号决策）；协同智能体强化学习，联合优化局部控制与全网效率；自适应快慢推理模式，通过平衡的模式感知rollout与相对优势优化权衡决策质量与推理成本。
AI.result: 在三个城市路网的七个真实交通流数据集上，VLALight持续优于基于交通工程、强化学习以及LLM/VLM的基线方法；消融实验验证了协同感知、网络级优化与自适应推理的有效性。
AI.conclusion: 结果表明VLA模型在真实物理交通控制中具有应用潜力，为视觉观测到控制决策的端到端闭环提供了新范式。项目开源地址：https://github.com/usail-hkust/VLALight.git。

title: Fisher-IRG: Fisher-Induced Local Invariant Representation Geometry across Language and Vision Models
summary: Semantic-preserving transformations can induce substantial motion in learned representations, while small changes may strongly affect model predictions, raising a basic question: what local metric best captures semantically consequential variation? We propose Fisher-induced invariant representation geometry (Fisher-IRG), which measures local representation directions through their predictive sensitivity. Around each representation, we construct semantic-preserving and semantic-changing neighborhoods, aggregate their local Fisher information, and recover invariant directions through a contrastive generalized eigenvalue problem. Controlled displacement analyses first show that comparable Euclidean motion can have substantially different predictive consequences, supporting the need for a predictive geometry. Across language and vision models, Fisher-IRG yields stronger semantic-versus-nuisance predictive selectivity and generally more reproducible subspaces than covariance-based geometry, while recovering systematically distinct local directions. Representation interventions further localize semantic effects to the Fisher-derived subspace, and held-out separation and retrieval show that the recovered geometry generalizes beyond the discovery neighborhoods. These results support Fisher-IRG as a principled framework for characterizing local invariant representation geometry.

AI.tldr: 论文提出 Fisher 诱导不变表示几何（Fisher-IRG），通过预测敏感性度量局部表示方向，并以对比广义特征值问题恢复不变子空间，在语言与视觉模型上优于协方差几何。
AI.motivation: 语义保持变换可在学习表示中引发显著移动，而微小变化又可能强烈影响模型预测，因此需要一个基本问题的答案：何种局部度量最能刻画具有语义重要性的变化。既有基于协方差的几何无法反映预测后果，故需要一种"预测几何"。
AI.method: 围绕每个表示构造语义保持与语义改变两类邻域，聚合其局部 Fisher 信息，通过对比广义特征值问题恢复不变方向，从而以预测敏感性度量局部表示方向。
AI.result: 受控位移分析显示，相当的欧氏移动可带来显著不同的预测后果，支持预测几何的必要性；在语言与视觉模型上，Fisher-IRG 相比协方差几何具有更强的语义-噪声预测选择性、通常更可复现的子空间，并恢复出系统性不同的局部方向；表示干预将语义效应定位到 Fisher 子空间，留出集分离与检索表明该几何可泛化到发现邻域之外。
AI.conclusion: 结果支持 Fisher-IRG 作为刻画局部不变表示几何的原则性框架。

title: CoEM: Empowering Long-Context Reasoning with Commit-on-Evidence Memory
summary: Long-context reasoning is essential for complex and long-horizon tasks, yet the performance of large language models (LLMs) degrades as context length increases. Recent approaches address this by processing input chunk by chunk while maintaining a bounded textual memory in model context. However, premature information compression can discard critical details essential for subsequent reasoning. In this paper, we introduce Commit-on-Evidence Memory (CoEM), which learns when to convert source evidence into compact memory facts. Specifically, under a fixed context-memory budget, CoEM preserves potentially useful source excerpts verbatim in a pending set, allowing subsequent context to clarify their relevance before irreversible compression. As new context arrives, a learned policy revisits each pending excerpt and decides whether to promote it to the committed memory, retain it for further consideration, or discard it. A frozen verifier ensures proposed facts are accepted only if supported by retained excerpts and current context. To further guide effective memory management, we train this policy using reinforcement learning by combining fine-grained, step-level evidence rewards with final answer rewards. Extensive experiments demonstrate that CoEM consistently improves long-context reasoning. When evaluated on 6,400 documents long-context input, CoEM outperforms the strongest memory baseline by 10.4-11.4 F1 points on Qwen3.5-9B. Code repository: https://github.com/benmagnifico/CoEM.

AI.tldr: CoEM（Commit-on-Evidence Memory）提出一种"先暂存、后提交"的长文本记忆机制：将潜在有用的原文证据逐字保留在待定集合中，由学习到的策略在后续上下文到来时决定升级为已提交记忆、继续保留或丢弃，并用冻结验证器保证事实有据可依；以强化学习结合步骤级证据奖励与最终答案奖励训练该策略，在6,400篇文档规模输入下于Qwen3.5-9B上较最强记忆基线提升10.4–11.4 F1。
AI.motivation: 长上下文推理对复杂、长程任务至关重要，但LLM性能随上下文变长而下降。现有"分块处理+有界文本记忆"方案存在过早压缩问题：一旦在信息尚未充分澄清时就把内容压缩成记忆，会丢失后续推理所需的关键细节。因此需要一种能延迟不可逆压缩、依据证据决定何时提交记忆的机制。
AI.method: 1）在固定上下文—记忆预算下，将可能有用的源片段逐字保留在pending set中，等待后续上下文澄清其相关性，避免不可逆压缩；2）随新上下文到达，学习到的策略对每个待定片段重新审视，并做出三种决策：升级为committed memory、保留待定、或丢弃；3）引入冻结验证器（frozen verifier），仅当提出的事实被保留片段与当前上下文支持时才被接受；4）用强化学习训练该策略，奖励由细粒度步骤级证据奖励与最终答案奖励组合而成。
AI.result: 大量实验表明CoEM能持续提升长上下文推理性能。在6,400篇文档的长上下文输入评测中，CoEM在Qwen3.5-9B上相比最强记忆基线提升10.4–11.4 F1点。代码已开源。
AI.conclusion: CoEM通过"证据驱动提交"的延迟压缩范式与RL训练，缓解了长上下文场景中过早压缩导致的信息损失，在长文本推理任务上取得了显著且一致的改进，说明"何时压缩"本身应作为可学习决策而非固定规则。

title: DisCoMBO: Steering Expert-in-the-Loop Black Box Optimization via Distributional Conformance
summary: Sequential Model-Based Optimization (SMBO) traditionally relies on Bayesian or ensembling surrogates for uncertainty quantification. While historically treated as fully data-driven, SMBO increasingly integrates external domain expertise to accelerate discovery. To overcome the opaque guidance and diminished integration fidelity of standard acquisition re-weighting, Probabilistic Circuits (PCs) have emerged as a generative surrogate alternative, enabling direct knowledge injection via conditional sampling. However, these generative routines lack the formal exploration-exploitation semantics required for rigorous optimization. We introduce the Distributional Conformance Score (DisCo), a novel metric that unifies the flexibility and efficiency of PCs with a formal uncertainty framework. DisCo provides a bounded, $[0, 1]$-normalized measure of model "surprise" that (1) recovers properties comparable to kernel-based uncertainty known from, e.g., Gaussian Processes, while maintaining linear-time inference, and (2) enables accurate assessment of conformance of external knowledge w.r.t. model evidence. We then present DisCoMBO, a framework leveraging these properties for robust, knowledge-aware optimization. We prove that DisCoMBO is a zero-regret algorithm and demonstrate its effectiveness across diverse benchmarks from AutoML, material optimization, and wind park optimization.

AI.tldr: 本文提出DisCo（分布一致性得分），将概率电路（PC）的生成式代理与形式化不确定性框架统一，并基于此构建零遗憾的DisCoMBO优化框架，在AutoML、材料优化和风电场优化等基准上验证有效性。
AI.motivation: SMBO传统依赖贝叶斯或集成代理进行不确定性量化，虽越来越多地融入外部领域知识，但标准采集函数重加权方式引导不透明、知识融入保真度低。概率电路作为生成式代理可通过条件采样直接注入知识，却缺乏严格的探索-利用语义，无法支撑严谨优化。因此需要一种既能保持PC灵活高效、又具备形式化不确定性框架的方法。
AI.method: 提出DisCo（Distributional Conformance Score），一种有界的[0,1]归一化模型“惊讶度”度量，保持线性时间推理，可恢复类高斯过程的核式不确定性性质，并能准确评估外部知识相对模型证据的一致性。在此基础上构建DisCoMBO知识感知优化框架，并证明其为零遗憾算法。
AI.result: DisCo在保持线性时间推理的同时，恢复与高斯过程等核方法相当的不确定性性质，并实现对外部知识一致性的准确评估；DisCoMBO被证明为零遗憾算法，并在AutoML、材料优化与风电场优化等多样化基准上展现有效性。
AI.conclusion: DisCo将概率电路的生成式效率与形式化不确定性框架相结合，为知识注入式优化提供了度量基础；DisCoMBO实现了稳健的知识感知优化并具备理论保证，在多个领域基准上均表现有效。

title: SCA: Spatial Credit Assignment for Reinforcement Learning of GUI Agents
summary: GUI agents automate tasks on digital devices by grounding language instructions in visual interfaces. Existing group-relative reinforcement learning improves GUI action prediction by comparing the rewards of multiple responses sampled from the same GUI state. However, binary evaluation treats spatially different failed clicks as identical and provides no relative signal when all sampled clicks fail. To address these limitations, we propose Spatial Credit Assignment (SCA), which uses the screen coordinates of sampled clicks to refine group-relative credit. Specifically, SCA predicts each held-out response's reward from the other responses in groups containing both successes and failures, then uses the prediction residual to adjust credit. When all sampled clicks fail, SCA instead orders them by distance to the annotated target. These spatial references are used only to construct the training update; the deployed policy remains unchanged. We evaluate whether this correction improves the policy update itself by comparing its error and directional alignment with the exact return gradient in a controlled synthetic study. Across GUI grounding and offline action-prediction benchmarks, SCA improves grounding across professional domains and achieves the strongest results among reinforcement-fine-tuned models on most action-prediction metrics, with consistent gains across the reported GUI suites.

AI.tldr: 本文提出空间信用分配（SCA），利用采样点击的屏幕坐标细化组相对信用分配，解决二值评估无法区分空间上不同失败点击、且全失败组无相对信号的问题。
AI.motivation: 现有基于组相对强化学习的GUI智能体将同一界面状态下多个响应按奖励二值比较，但二值评估把空间上不同的失败点击视作等同，且当所有采样点击均失败时无法提供相对信号。作者希望改进策略更新的信用分配，而不是改变部署策略本身。
AI.method: SCA用采样点击的屏幕坐标细化组相对信用。对于同时包含成功与失败的组，用组内其他响应预测每个留出响应的奖励，并以预测残差调整信用；当所有采样点击均失败时，则按点击与标注目标之间的距离对其排序。这些空间参考仅用于构建训练更新，部署策略保持不变。作者通过受控合成研究，将SCA与精确回报梯度在误差和方向对齐上进行比较来评估其是否改善策略更新。
AI.result: 在受控合成研究中，SCA相对精确回报梯度表现出更低的误差和更好的方向对齐。在GUI grounding与离线动作预测基准上，SCA提升了跨专业领域的grounding，并在多数动作预测指标上取得强化微调模型中的最佳结果，在所报告的GUI套件上有一致增益。
AI.conclusion: 利用空间坐标进行信用分配可在不改变部署策略的情况下改善策略更新质量，在GUI定位与动作预测任务上获得一致提升，为GUI智能体的强化学习训练提供了有效的空间信用细化方法。

title: Guard Models Are Overconfident Where Base Models Are Uncertain
summary: Guard models are used as safety classifiers, with confidence scores driving downstream moderation decisions. We evaluate five guard models for prompt classification and find that although several are nearly calibrated on clean inputs, adversarial attacks degrade their calibration by an order of magnitude, turning false negatives into high-confidence errors indistinguishable from correct detections. Comparing each guard with its corresponding base LM, we find that uncertainty signals often remain available, with the base model typically expressing uncertainty on the same inputs where the guard fails. Layer-wise analyses localize this guard-base divergence to later layers, where guard models exhibit sharper safe/unsafe separation and lower-rank representations, while adversarial harmful inputs lie closer to the clean-safe region. These findings highlight a mismatch between guard confidence and base model uncertainty under attack.

AI.tldr: 该论文评估了五个guard模型的校准性，发现对抗攻击使其校准性下降一个数量级，将假阴性变成高置信度错误；而基座模型在相同输入上往往仍保留不确定性信号。
AI.motivation: Guard模型作为安全分类器，其置信度分数直接驱动下游审核决策。若置信度在校准上失真，尤其在被对抗攻击时，会导致高置信度的漏判，因此有必要系统评估guard模型在clean与对抗输入下的校准表现，并考察其与基座模型不确定性之间的错配。
AI.method: 评估五个guard模型用于prompt分类；对比每个guard模型与其对应的基座LM的不确定性信号；进行layer-wise分析，定位guard与base divergence出现的层，并考察safe/unsafe分离度、表示秩以及对抗性有害输入相对clean-safe区域的位置。
AI.result: 若干guard模型在clean输入上接近校准，但对抗攻击使其校准性下降约一个数量级，假阴性变成高置信度错误，且与正确检测难以区分。基座模型通常在guard失效的同一批输入上仍表达不确定性。层级分析显示guard-base divergence出现在较靠后的层，guard模型在这些层呈现更锐利的safe/unsafe分离和更低秩的表示，而对抗性有害输入更接近clean-safe区域。
AI.conclusion: 论文揭示了对抗攻击下guard模型置信度与基座模型不确定性之间的错配，说明guard模型的置信度在攻击下不可靠，而基座模型的不确定性信号或可作为补充线索，层级差异为理解该错配提供了机制性解释。

title: Dual-Channel Robust Group-Relative Policy Optimization via Advantage and Sequence-Weight Estimation
summary: Group-relative policy optimization relies on reward-derived advantages and sequence-level likelihood weights, both of which can be sensitive to localized outliers. Extreme rewards can collapse the contrast among clean responses after group normalization, while token-level log-ratio perturbations can alter sequence weights and clipping decisions. We introduce RoVR-GSPO, a dual-channel robust optimizer that addresses these failure modes separately. Its reward channel combines robust reference estimation with bounded residual credit, while its ratio channel uses differentiable SoftRoVR aggregation to construct robust sequence weights. We provide stability and efficiency analyses for both channels. Experiments on mathematical reasoning, long-context summarization, and tool-call annotation show consistent improvements over GSPO, while controlled perturbation studies demonstrate stronger robustness to reward contamination and token-ratio anomalies.

AI.tldr: 本文提出 RoVR-GSPO，一种双通道鲁棒优化器，分别处理组相对策略优化中奖励通道与序列权重通道的离群点敏感问题，在多项任务上稳定优于 GSPO 并提升鲁棒性。
AI.motivation: 组相对策略优化依赖奖励导出的优势值和序列级似然权重，两者对局部离群值敏感：极端奖励经组归一化后会压缩干净响应间的对比度；token 级对数比扰动会改变序列权重与裁剪决策，导致优化不稳定。
AI.method: RoVR-GSPO 采用双通道设计：奖励通道结合鲁棒参考估计与有界残差信用分配；比率通道使用可微的 SoftRoVR 聚合来构造鲁棒序列权重。文中对两个通道分别给出了稳定性与效率分析。
AI.result: 在数学推理、长上下文摘要和工具调用标注任务上，RoVR-GSPO 相较 GSPO 取得一致提升；受控扰动实验表明其对奖励污染和 token 比率异常具有更强的鲁棒性。
AI.conclusion: 通过将奖励与比率两类失效模式解耦并分别施加鲁棒处理，RoVR-GSPO 在保持效率的同时提升了策略优化的稳定性与抗污染能力。

title: The Teacher Is a Direction, Not a Destination: Extrapolating RL-Induced Representation Residuals in On-Policy Distillation
summary: On-policy distillation (OPD) trains a student to match the teacher's next-token distributions on the student's own trajectories and has yielded substantial empirical gains. Generalized variants allow the student to surpass the teacher by extrapolating an implicit reward in output space. The language-model head, however, attenuates this change anisotropically: much of the change encoded in the teacher's hidden states reaches the logits at a small fraction of its weight, and the sampled-token log-probability ratios on which output-space extrapolation relies inject noise that the extrapolation amplifies, making training unstable. We observe that reinforcement learning (RL) shifts a model's internal representations relative to its base checkpoint, and that the direction of this shift can be measured at every layer. Motivated by this observation, we propose RIDE (RL-Induced Direction Extrapolation), which extrapolates the RL-induced change directly in representation space: at every layer and token position, RIDE computes the residual between the teacher and its pre-RL checkpoint and regresses the student's hidden states toward targets displaced beyond the teacher along this residual. Conditioned on a sampled trajectory, this regression is equivalent to maximizing a linear directional reward defined by the residual under a quadratic penalty centered at the teacher, which makes explicit how the objective moves the student along the RL-induced direction while limiting its deviation from the teacher. Across four base/RL-teacher pairs spanning different scales, architectures, and pre-training lineages, RIDE approaches or exceeds the RL-trained teacher on every pair and is the only method whose mean does so, and it consistently outperforms output-space extrapolation, which degrades the student whenever the teacher is close to its base. Project page: https://github.com/xixixixixxxx/RIDE.

AI.tldr: RIDE通过表征空间外推RL诱导的变化方向，克服输出空间外推的不稳定性，使学生模型逼近或超越RL教师模型。
AI.motivation: 在策略蒸馏中，语言模型头会各向异性地衰减隐状态变化，且基于采样token对数概率比的外推会注入被放大的噪声，导致训练不稳定；同时观察到RL会相对基座检查点改变模型内部表征，且该偏移方向可在每层测量。
AI.method: 提出RIDE方法：在每层与每个token位置计算RL教师与其RL前检查点的残差，将学生隐状态回归至沿该残差方向超出教师的目标点；该回归等价于在二次惩罚下最大化由残差定义的线性方向奖励。
AI.result: 在四组不同规模、架构与预训练谱系的基座/RL教师配对上，RIDE均逼近或超越RL教师，且是唯一在均值上做到这一点的方法，并持续优于输出空间外推。
AI.conclusion: 直接在表征空间外推RL诱导的变化，比输出空间外推更稳定有效，能使学生在教师接近其基座时仍获得提升。

title: REALHOP: Rethinking Multi-Hop Reasoning Evaluation via Behavioral Auditing
summary: Complex questions often require multi-hop reasoning that connects facts distributed across sources or distant regions of a long context through intermediate steps. Benchmarks commonly evaluate this ability with questions built around predefined reasoning chains, treating a correct answer as evidence that the intended composition was used. Yet answer correctness alone leaves open whether success depends on the evidence associated with each intended step: models may instead rely on memorized associations, shorter paths, or partial evidence. We examine this dependence using the Behavioral Necessity Rate (BNR), which measures how often targeted evidence removal prevents answer recovery on initially correct instances. Across five existing benchmarks, panel-mean BNR ranges from 16.6% to 48.9%, exposing a substantial gap between annotated structure and observed dependence. Guided by this diagnosis, we introduce REALHOP, a diagnose-construct-verify framework that rebinds entities, factorizes selected relations, adds complete competing paths, and places evidence at traceable locations. Structural and semantic checks precede freezing; behavioral interventions follow. On 790 paired MuSiQue questions, REALHOP raises panel-mean BNR from 27.4% to 94.4% while retaining high Full accuracy. It also yields high BNR on REALHOP-FRAMES and REALHOP-LONGBENCH. On 216 long-context questions, the matched multiple-choice spread across 16 models grows from 13.9 to 59.2 points and persists under repeated open-ended evaluation. Together, these results show that a conceptually coherent chain and a correct final answer do not by themselves establish multi-hop reasoning. Verifying that success depends on every intended hop is therefore as fundamental to multi-hop evaluation as measuring answer accuracy itself.

AI.tldr: 论文指出仅凭答案正确无法证明模型真正进行了多跳推理，提出行为必要性率（BNR）度量证据依赖，并构建REALHOP框架大幅提升基准的BNR。
AI.motivation: 现有多跳推理基准以预定义推理链构造问题，并把答案正确视为使用了预期推理组合的证据。然而答案正确并不能说明成功是否依赖每一步对应的证据，模型可能依赖记忆关联、更短路径或部分证据，因此需要引入证据依赖性的定量诊断。
AI.method: 提出行为必要性率（BNR）：在初始答对的实例上移除目标证据后，统计答案无法恢复的频率。基于诊断结果，构建REALHOP的"诊断-构造-验证"框架：重绑定实体、因式分解选定关系、加入完整竞争路径、将证据放在可追踪位置；先做结构与语义检查再冻结，随后进行行为干预验证。
AI.result: 在五个现有基准上，面板平均BNR仅16.6%–48.9%，远低于标注结构所暗示的水平。在790道配对MuSiQue问题上，REALHOP将面板平均BNR从27.4%提升至94.4%，同时保持较高完整准确率；在REALHOP-FRAMES与REALHOP-LONGBENCH上也得到高BNR。在216道长上下文问题上，16个模型间的匹配多选题差距从13.9分扩大到59.2分，且在重复开放式评测中依然稳定。
AI.conclusion: 概念上连贯的推理链与正确的最终答案本身并不能确立多跳推理。验证成功是否依赖每一个预期跳步，与测量答案准确率同样是多跳评测的根本要素。

title: Optimal Multi-Reward Reinforcement Learning
summary: We study an unknown-transition finite-horizon Markov decision process (MDP) with a finite collection of known reward functions $\{r^1, r^2, \ldots, r^M\}$. The goal is to output an $ε$-optimal policy for every reward using online episodic interaction only. Performance is measured by the policy error $V_{0}^{*, m} - V_{0}^{\widehatπ^{m}, m}$ where $m\in [M]$ represents the reward function and $V_{0}^{*, m}=\mathbb{E}_{s_1\sim μ}[V_{1}^{*, m}(s_1)]$. Under this setting, we design a provably efficient algorithm to establish a minimax sample complexity bound of $$ O\left(\frac{SAH^3}{ε^2}\log M \mathrm{polylog}\left(\frac{SAH\log M}{\min\left\{ε, 1\right\}δ}\right)\right)$$ episodes, with no additional burn-in cost. This matches the information-theoretic lower bound up to a factor of $ \mathrm{polylog}(SAH\log M/(\min\left\{ε, 1\right\}δ))$. Our method combines three technical ingredients. First, we adapt MVP to reward-switching learning to construct optimistic value estimates. Second, we use fresh replay samples to conservatively evaluate the candidate policies. Third, gap-based multiplicative weights updates adjust the reward-sampling distribution using the differences between these estimates, converting weighted learning progress into simultaneous guarantees for all rewards.

AI.tldr: 本文研究未知转移、有限时域MDP下含M个已知奖励函数的场景，目标是仅通过在线回合交互，为每个奖励输出ε-最优策略。作者提出一种可证明高效的算法，样本复杂度达到O((SAH^3/ε^2)logM·polylog(...))，无额外burn-in开销，匹配信息论下界并对数因子内最优。
AI.motivation: 在多奖励（多任务）MDP中，希望在线交互条件下同时对M个奖励函数都能学得ε-最优策略。已有方法可能存在额外的burn-in成本或无法同时保证所有奖励的效率，因此需要设计无额外启动代价且样本高效、可证明的算法。
AI.method: 方法包含三个技术要素：(1) 将MVP适配到奖励切换学习中，构造乐观值估计；(2) 使用新的回放样本对候选策略进行保守评估；(3) 基于间隙的乘法权重更新，利用估计差调整奖励采样分布，从而将加权学习进展转化为对所有奖励的同时保证。
AI.result: 算法实现了O((SAH^3/ε^2)logM·polylog(SAH logM/(min{ε,1}δ)))回合的minimax样本复杂度上界，且无额外burn-in成本；与信息论下界相比仅相差polylog(SAH logM/(min{ε,1}δ))因子。
AI.conclusion: 该工作为未知转移、多已知奖励的有限时域MDP提供了一种在线、无额外burn-in的可证明高效算法，在minimax意义下达到近乎最优的样本复杂度，并通过对数因子匹配下界，适用于需要同时对多个奖励函数学习ε-最优策略的场景。

title: CF-LoRA: Decoupled Factor Aggregation and Adaptation-Aware Client Clustering for Federated LoRA Fine-Tuning
summary: Federated LoRA fine-tuning enables parameter-efficient adaptation of pre-trained models without sharing private data, but suffers from two fundamental mismatches under heterogeneous client data: a structural aggregation mismatch caused by independently averaging LoRA factors, and a statistical collaboration mismatch caused by enforcing a single global adapter across divergent clients.
