We first provide a theoretical analysis establishing a fundamental separation between output suppression and representational erasure. Specifically, we show that the decoder can be made arbitrarily insensitive to sensitive directions, driving output-level leakage to zero, while the hidden representations retain the underlying information. To empirically validate this phenomenon, we train generative probe decoders on hidden states across transformer layers, enabling layer-wise measurement of information leakage. Across three widely used benchmarks, TOFU, MUSE, and WMDP, and state-of-the-art unlearning methods, we find that substantial sensitive information remains recoverable from hidden representations, even when standard output-level metrics indicate successful unlearning. To address this gap, we propose Probe-Adversarial Representation Suppression (PARS), an unlearning objective that adversarially minimizes the extractable information from hidden representations. PARS directly targets representational leakage and provides significantly stronger guarantees of erasure under adversarial probing and relearning attacks, outperforming all evaluated baselines. Our results highlight a fundamental limitation of existing unlearning paradigms and suggest that true forgetting in LLMs requires controlling not only model outputs, but also the information encoded in hidden representations. Codes are available at https://github.com/OptimAI-Lab/HiddenStateUnlearning.

AI.tldr: 该论文揭示现有LLM遗忘评估的"遗忘幻觉"：即便输出层泄漏归零，敏感信息仍编码于隐藏表示中被探针解码恢复；理论证明了输出抑制与表示擦除的分离，并提出对抗性表示抑制目标PARS。
AI.motivation: 现有LLM遗忘（unlearning）研究主要在输出层评估，模型看似抑制了敏感或不良内容。作者怀疑这种评估会造成"遗忘幻觉"：输出泄漏被消除并不等于信息被真正擦除，敏感信息可能仍存留于隐藏表示中，从而构成潜在的安全与隐私风险。
AI.method: 1）理论分析：证明输出抑制与表示擦除之间存在根本性分离，解码器可对敏感方向变得任意不敏感使输出泄漏趋零，而隐藏表示仍保留底层信息。2）实证验证：在Transformer各层隐藏状态上训练生成式探针解码器（generative probe decoders），实现逐层信息泄漏度量。3）提出PARS（Probe-Adversarial Representation Suppression）：一种对抗性最小化隐藏表示中可提取信息的遗忘目标，直接针对表示层泄漏。
AI.result: 在TOFU、MUSE、WMDP三个常用基准及多个最先进遗忘方法上，即使标准输出级指标显示遗忘成功，隐藏表示中仍可恢复出大量敏感信息。PARS在对抗性探针与再学习（relearning）攻击下提供了显著更强的擦除保证，优于所有评估基线。
AI.conclusion: 现有遗忘范式存在根本性局限：真正的LLM遗忘不能仅控制模型输出，还必须控制隐藏表示中编码的信息。代码开源于https://github.com/OptimAI-Lab/HiddenStateUnlearning。

title: From Learner Behavior to Reusable Skills for Effective and Efficient Learner Simulation
summary: Learner simulation aims to reproduce how a particular learner behaves on new tasks. Although Large Language Models (LLMs) can generate increasingly fine-grained learning behaviors, existing approaches often need to repeatedly process a growing interaction history to reconstruct the learner. This introduces additional context and inference costs and makes the acquired learner-specific simulation capability difficult to reuse across different LLMs. We therefore propose Learner2Skill, which externalizes the simulation capability acquired from historical interactions into a persistent and reusable Simulation Skill. The Skill captures the learner's current learning state and recurring response patterns, evolves as new real interactions arrive, and can be adapted to a new LLM through lightweight executor calibration without reconstructing the learner from scratch. Experiments show that Learner2Skill more faithfully reproduces fine-grained learner behavior while reducing overall token cost, and that the same constructed Skills can be effectively reused across different LLM executors.

AI.tldr: 本文提出Learner2Skill，将学习者的模拟能力外化为持久、可复用的"Simulation Skill"，该技能随交互演化，并可通过轻量级校准迁移到新LLM，无需重复重建学习者。
AI.motivation: 现有基于LLM的学习者模拟方法需反复处理不断增长的交互历史来重建学习者，导致额外上下文与推理成本，且习得的模拟能力难以在不同LLM间复用。
AI.method: 提出Learner2Skill：将历史交互中习得的模拟能力外化为持久的Simulation Skill。该Skill捕获学习者当前学习状态与重复出现的响应模式，随真实交互持续演化，并通过轻量级executor calibration适配新LLM，无需从头重建学习者。
AI.result: 实验表明，Learner2Skill更忠实地复现细粒度学习者行为，同时降低总体token成本；同一构建的Skill可在不同LLM执行器间有效复用。
AI.conclusion: 通过将学习者模拟能力外化为可复用技能，Learner2Skill在提升模拟保真度的同时降低成本并实现跨LLM复用，为学习者模拟提供了更高效可扩展的范式。

title: Selective Elicitation as a Commercial Influence Channel: A Reproducible Synthetic Shopping-Agent Stress Test
comment: 7 pages, 1 table; synthetic data and reproduction code in ancillary files; substantial AI-tool use disclosed in the manuscript
summary: A commercial incentive need not enter the final ranking algorithm to affect a shopping assistant's recommendation: it may instead influence which preference question the assistant asks. We make this distinction experimentally observable in a deliberately small, synthetic setting. Each task has two products, three verified numerical attributes, a price limit, and a private fixed preference vector. An honest simulated user answers one pairwise question. A separate recommender receives the products and this answer but not the sponsorship assignment. We contrast a neutral question, a soft commercial instruction, and an explicitly adversarial instruction to ask about the sponsor's advantage while omitting the rival's advantage. Across 40 held-out sponsorship-assignment cases (20 distinct catalog-preference contexts), the soft instruction changes no selections. The targeted instruction raises sponsored selection by 0.30 and reduces mean synthetic utility by 0.0547 relative to neutral questioning (95% context-bootstrap interval [-0.0828, -0.0291]) for one language-model recommender. A fixed Bayesian recommender shows a similar effect; a second model makes the same choices on all 120 frozen question-answer inputs. A terminal-answer consistency judge rates all 20 sampled targeted answers consistent, although five have synthetic regret above 0.05; a separate question-coverage dimension flags their one-sided elicitation. A robust partial-preference certificate remains valid under the stipulated synthetic utility but certifies only 16 of 40 targeted cases and is not better than asking a neutral question directly. These results establish neither typical behavior under advertising incentives nor effects on actual consumers.

AI.tldr: 在一个刻意设计的小型合成实验中，商业激励可通过影响推荐助手"问哪个偏好问题"来影响推荐结果，而无需进入最终排序算法；定向提问显著提高赞助品选择率并降低合成效用，但结论不适用于真实广告环境或消费者。
AI.motivation: 商业激励影响推荐系统的方式通常被理解为直接进入排序/评分算法。本文指出另一条被忽视的通道：激励可能改变助手询问哪个偏好问题（问题选择），从而间接影响推荐。作者希望让这种"提问层面的操纵"在实验中可观测、可区分。
AI.method: 构建刻意小型化的合成实验：每个任务含两个产品、三个可验证数值属性、一个价格上限和一个私有固定偏好向量。诚实的模拟用户回答一次成对偏好问题；独立推荐器接收产品与该回答，但不知道赞助分配。对比三种提问条件：中性问题、软性商业指令、明确对抗性指令（只问赞助方优势、省略对手优势）。共40个留出赞助分配案例（20个不同的目录-偏好情境），并测试语言模型推荐器、固定贝叶斯推荐器及第二个模型；另设终端答案一致性评判与问题覆盖维度评判，并检验一种稳健部分偏好证书。
AI.result: 40个留出案例中，软性指令未改变任何选择；定向指令使赞助品选择率提高0.30，平均合成效用相对中性提问下降0.0547（95%情境自助区间[-0.0828, -0.0291]）——针对一个语言模型推荐器。固定贝叶斯推荐器效果类似；第二个模型在全部120个冻结问答输入上做出相同选择。终端答案一致性评判认为20个抽样定向答案全部一致，尽管其中5个合成后悔值高于0.05；独立的问题覆盖维度标记出其一-sided（单边）提问。稳健部分偏好证书在设定合成效用下仍有效，但仅对40个定向案例中的16个给出认证，且并不优于直接问中性问题。
AI.conclusion: 结果仅在规定的合成设定下成立，既不能确立广告激励下的典型行为，也不能说明对真实消费者的影响。作者强调其贡献在于方法学上使"提问层面"的商业影响可被实验观测，而非对现实广告效果的推断。

title: SimpleEvol: An Agent-Loop Framework for LLM-Driven Automated Heuristic Design with Minimal Human Priors
summary: Large language models (LLMs) have emerged as powerful tools for automated heuristic design (AHD), enabling iterative generation and refinement of heuristics. However, the dominant paradigm embeds LLMs as narrow, fixed components, such as crossover or mutation, within heavily hand-engineered evolutionary frameworks. We argue this misapprehends LLMs. It treats them as specialized tools rather than general reasoners, constrains them to low-level operations, and underutilizes their autonomy. Moreover, the extensive human priors in these frameworks violate the bitter lesson principle that general methods scaling with computation surpass hand-crafted solutions. This raises a key question: which AHD framework designs best convert stronger LLM capabilities into better heuristics? To address this, we propose metrics for LLM-driven AHD framework handcraftedness (AHI) and intelligence conversion efficiency (ICE). Evaluating ten LLMs across three challenging combinatorial optimization problems, we obtain a notable finding that frameworks with fewer human priors consistently yield higher ICE. Based on this finding, we propose SimpleEvol, an agent-loop framework for AHD which removes nearly all human priors and allows the LLM to operate autonomously. SimpleEvol consistently achieves the highest ICE, often by a large margin. Our results challenge the trend toward complex AHD pipelines and point to a lighter and more model-centric alternative, suggesting that reducing human priors is a more effective strategy to scale up with model intelligence. The source code is available at https://github.com/HenryZhu1029/SimpleEvol-Master.

AI.tldr: 论文提出以人类先验程度（AHI）与智能转换效率（ICE）为指标，发现先验越少ICE越高，并提出去除几乎全部先验的SimpleEvol智能体循环框架，取得最高ICE。
AI.motivation: 当前主流自动启发式设计（AHD）范式将LLM作为进化框架中交叉、变异等狭窄固定组件，把LLM当作专用工具而非通用推理器，限制其自主性，且框架中大量人工先验违背"苦教训"原则。核心问题：何种AHD框架设计能最好地将更强的LLM能力转化为更好的启发式。
AI.method: 提出两个度量指标：AHD框架的人工先验程度（AHI）与智能转换效率（ICE）。在三个具有挑战性的组合优化问题上评估十种LLM，据此提出SimpleEvol——一种去除几乎全部人工先验、让LLM自主运行的智能体循环（agent-loop）框架。
AI.result: 关键发现：人工先验越少的框架，ICE持续越高。SimpleEvol在所有设置中取得最高ICE，且常大幅领先。
AI.conclusion: 研究结果挑战了AHD流水线日益复杂化的趋势，指向更轻量、更以模型为中心的替代方案，表明减少人工先验是随模型智能扩展的更有效策略。

title: SemPSG: A Semantic Channel-Aware Foundation Model for Polysomnography Analysis
summary: Polysomnography (PSG) integrates multiple physiological signals to provide a comprehensive characterization of human sleep, yet its heterogeneous channel configurations across centers pose substantial challenges for transferable representation learning. Existing foundation models mainly focus on physiological modeling or temporal learning, while channel identity is often treated as a fixed structural index, overlooking the physiological semantics encoded by signal modality and reference configuration. To this end, we propose SemPSG, a Semantic channel-aware foundation model for heterogeneous PSG analysis. SemPSG explicitly represents the physiological semantics of channel identity and incorporates them into both signal representation learning and channel aggregation, enabling flexible modeling across diverse data configurations. Specifically, a semantic-conditioned time-series encoder captures signal-specific temporal dynamics and cross-signal interactions, while a multi-view image encoder extracts complementary time-frequency and morphological patterns from the same physiological recordings. We evaluate SemPSG on sleep and health-related tasks, including sleep staging, sleep-disorder breathing analysis, disease prediction, cognition and emotion recognition, and demographic estimation. Extensive experiments demonstrate consistent improvements over both general-purpose time series foundation models and PSG-specific foundation models, together with generalization across heterogeneous datasets across diverse channel configurations.

AI.tldr: SemPSG：面向异构PSG分析的语义通道感知基础模型，通过显式建模通道语义实现跨中心迁移表征学习。
AI.motivation: PSG整合多生理信号可全面刻画睡眠，但各中心通道配置异质，给可迁移表征学习带来挑战；现有基础模型侧重生理建模或时序学习，将通道身份视为固定结构索引，忽略了信号模态与参考配置所编码的生理语义。
AI.method: 提出SemPSG，显式表征通道身份的生理语义并注入信号表征学习与通道聚合：语义条件化时间序列编码器捕捉信号特定时序动态与跨信号交互；多视图图像编码器从同一生理记录中提取互补的时频与形态学模式。
AI.result: 在睡眠与健康相关任务（睡眠分期、睡眠呼吸障碍分析、疾病预测、认知与情绪识别、人口学估计）上评估，一致优于通用时序基础模型与PSG专用基础模型，并在多种通道配置的异构数据集间展现泛化能力。
AI.conclusion: 以生理语义驱动的通道建模可有效应对PSG异构性，为跨中心可迁移的睡眠与健康分析提供统一基础模型框架。

title: Absorbed in Inertia: Activation Analysis for Computer-Use Agents
summary: Computer-use agents have become increasingly capable of executing tasks on live desktops through natural-language instructions, based on trajectories of screenshots, actions, and reasoning. We discover that they can stealthily exhibit inertia, in which they repeat fruitless actions despite recognizing that these actions are ineffective. We hypothesize that inertia is reflected in the agent's internal state, i.e., the activation values of the agent's underlying model, and propose a protocol to measure the relationship between the two. Extensive analysis of high-dimensional activation states shows that inertia corresponds to an absorbing region of activation space, where activation values become stale across actions and even after attempts to steer them. We conjecture that drastically changing the agents' activations by re-initializing them is necessary to escape inertia. Specifically, we propose R$^3$ (Reset, Reroute, Restore), which temporarily resets the agent's context trajectory to escape the absorbing region and then restores the historical context to effectively complete the task. Our approach yields 17-55% lower measured inertia across models relative to unmodified agents. These results suggest that changing the context can interrupt recurrence more effectively than directly steering the resulting activations. Our code is available at https://anonymous.4open.science/r/vlm-agent-defense-D076

AI.tldr: 本文发现计算机操作智能体存在"惯性"现象——即使识别出无效动作仍会重复执行，并证明惯性对应激活空间中的吸收区域，据此提出R³方法摆脱惯性。
AI.motivation: 基于截图、动作与推理轨迹在真实桌面上执行任务的计算机操作智能体能力日益增强，但作者发现它们会隐蔽地表现出惯性：在已识别出某些动作无效的情况下仍重复这些无成效动作。作者希望探明惯性的内在机制并加以缓解。
AI.method: 作者假设惯性反映在智能体底层模型的内部状态（即激活值）中，设计了测量二者关系的协议；通过高维激活状态分析定位惯性对应的激活空间吸收区域，并据此提出R³（Reset, Reroute, Restore）方法：临时重置智能体的上下文轨迹以逃离吸收区域，随后恢复历史上下文以有效完成任务。
AI.result: 相较于未修改的智能体，该方法在多个模型上使测得惯性降低17%–55%。
AI.conclusion: 惯性对应于激活空间中的吸收区域，其中激活值在跨动作乃至尝试引导后仍保持陈旧；只有通过重置来剧烈改变激活值才能逃离。结果表明，改变上下文比直接引导因惯性产生的激活值更能有效中断重复行为。

title: Physics-Aware Machine Unlearning for Cyber-Physical Systems
summary: This paper proposes a physics-guided gradient-ascent-based machine unlearning method that couples the forgetting signal with the physical residual of the target cyber-physical systems, ensuring that weight updates during unlearning are steered toward physically feasible regions of the weight space. The physics residual acts as a safety fence during gradient ascent: the model is steered away from the poisoned behavioral basin and simultaneously toward physics-compliant territory, rather than toward an arbitrary alternative that may still violate domain constraints. We evaluate the proposed method against four baselines: naive gradient ascent, exact unlearning, SISA, and full retraining on an IEEE 34-bus distribution system, driven by two physics-informed neural network-based distribution energy resource controllers and validated through high-fidelity OpenDSS power-flow co-simulation. From the evaluation, we found that our proposed physics-guided model simultaneously removes poison and restores physical compliance, which are essential for the safe deployment of safety-critical cyber-physical systems

AI.tldr: 提出一种物理引导的梯度上升机器遗忘方法，将遗忘信号与目标信息物理系统的物理残差耦合，使遗忘过程中的权重更新被引导至物理可行的权重空间区域，在IEEE 34节点配电系统上验证其能同时去除投毒并恢复物理合规性。
AI.motivation: 安全关键的信息物理系统（CPS）中，模型遗忘不仅要移除投毒/有害知识，还必须保证更新后的模型符合物理约束。传统梯度上升会将模型推向任意替代解，可能仍违反域约束，因此需要一种能兼顾遗忘与物理合规的遗忘机制。
AI.method: 提出物理引导的梯度上升机器遗忘方法，将遗忘信号与目标CPS的物理残差耦合；物理残差充当梯度上升过程中的"安全围栏"，使模型远离被投毒的行为盆地，同时被引导至物理合规区域，而非任意可能违反域约束的替代解。实验设置：以IEEE 34节点配电系统为对象，两个基于物理信息神经网络（PINN）的分布式能源资源控制器，并通过高保真OpenDSS潮流协同仿真进行验证；对比四个基线：朴素梯度上升、精确遗忘（exact unlearning）、SISA、完全重训练。
AI.result: 评估表明，所提出的物理引导模型能够同时移除投毒并恢复物理合规性，优于朴素梯度上升、精确遗忘、SISA和完全重训练四个基线。
AI.conclusion: 物理引导的机器遗忘对安全关键信息物理系统的安全部署至关重要，能够在实现遗忘的同时维持物理合规性。

title: Accelerated surrogate dynamics for dynamical, stochastic system evolution
summary: Dynamic simulations are an entrenched way of gaining insight into the evolution of system dynamics. Their computational cost however is often prohibitively high, especially in cases of stochastic frameworks. Machine learning algorithms are especially suited as simulation surrogates. Nevertheless, they face some very distinct limitations. Firstly, the sheer dimensionality of these systems, however, precludes the use of traditional time series models who struggle with high dimensional feature spaces. Additionally, traditional time series focus exclusively on either long or short range effects, causing local or global drift given enough time. In this paper, we propose a framework that addresses those limitations. Our framework combines a Variational Autoencoder, with a convolutional or graph basis that reduces the dimensionality of the system. This latent vector is propagated in time using a Temporal Fusion Transformer model, which includes both long range and short range effect encoding, as well as static covariate support. We test our framework on three distinct cases, to prove its robustness and in all three we have achieved practically identical to the simulation results at a fraction of the time. Further, our framework is flexible enough to be adapted to any new system and provides an inbuilt uncertainty quantification for targeted experiment design.

AI.tldr: 本文提出一种模拟代理框架：用VAE（卷积或图基）降维，再用Temporal Fusion Transformer在潜空间进行时间推演，兼顾长/短程效应与静态协变量，在三个案例中达到与仿真几乎一致的结果且耗时大幅缩短，并内建不确定性量化。
AI.motivation: 动态仿真计算成本极高，尤其在随机框架下；机器学习代理虽适合，但面临两大限制：一是系统维度高，传统时间序列模型在高维特征空间中表现不佳；二是传统时间序列只关注长程或短程效应之一，时间一长会产生局部或全局漂移。
AI.method: 框架分两步：1）用变分自编码器（VAE），配合卷积基或图基，降低系统维度，得到潜向量；2）用Temporal Fusion Transformer（TFT）在时间上传播该潜向量，TFT同时编码长程与短程效应，并支持静态协变量。
AI.result: 在三个不同案例上验证了框架的鲁棒性，三者均取得与仿真几乎相同的结果，但计算时间仅为仿真的一小部分；框架还具备可迁移性（可适配任意新系统）并内建不确定性量化，用于目标导向的实验设计。
AI.conclusion: 该工作通过“降维+长短期建模”的组合，克服了传统时间序列代理在高维、长时程与漂移方面的局限，提供了一种高效、通用且可量化不确定性的仿真替代方案。

title: What Makes Recurrence Effective in Looped Language Models?
summary: Looped language models (LoopLMs) increase computational depth through parameter sharing, offering a path to scale inference computation without adding parameters. However, it remains unclear when additional recurrence is beneficial and how architectural choices affect its effectiveness. Through controlled experiments, we systematically examine (1) when recurrence helps, (2) where it should be applied, and (3) how its conditioning affects performance. Our evaluation covers inference budgets below, within, and beyond the training horizon under knowledge and reasoning tasks. (1) We find that recurrence can improve reasoning beyond the training horizon while degrading knowledge performance, but harder reasoning instances do not consistently benefit more. (2) Performance also depends on how distinct layers and recurrent iterations are allocated, showing that effective depth alone is insufficient to predict behavior. Non-recurrent output layers improve robustness to under-unrolling, while the preferred placement of input and output layers varies with inference budget. (3) Finally, we find that conventional initial-state injection offers limited robustness to varying recurrence depth. We therefore propose history-state injection as an alternative, and show that channel-wise history-state injection combined with timestep conditioning offers a low-cost and more effective design, better preserving knowledge under extended unrolling while improving robustness across inference budgets. Overall, our results clarify when recurrent computation helps, where it fails, and offer practical guidelines for designing LoopLMs across variable inference budgets.

AI.tldr: 该论文系统研究了循环语言模型（LoopLM）中额外循环何时有利、应施加于何处、以及条件注入方式如何影响性能，并提出历史状态注入（history-state injection）作为更优设计。
AI.motivation: 循环语言模型通过参数共享增加计算深度，可在不增加参数的情况下扩展推理计算，但额外循环何时有益、架构选择如何影响其有效性尚不明确，因此需要系统性的受控实验加以澄清。
AI.method: 通过受控实验，在低于、处于和超出训练时界的推理预算下，评测知识类与推理类任务，分别考察三个问题：(1) 循环何时有帮助；(2) 循环应施加于何处（不同层与循环迭代的分配）；(3) 循环的条件注入方式如何影响性能。并据此提出历史状态注入，特别是通道级历史状态注入结合时间步条件化的设计。
AI.result: (1) 循环可提升超出训练时界的推理表现，但会损害知识性能，且更难推理样本并未一致受益；(2) 性能取决于不同层与循环迭代的分配方式，有效深度本身不足以预测行为；非循环输出层提升了对循环不足（under-unrolling）的鲁棒性，输入与输出层的最佳位置随推理预算变化；(3) 常规初始状态注入对循环深度变化的鲁棒性有限，通道级历史状态注入结合时间步条件化能以低成本更好保留知识并提升跨推理预算的鲁棒性。
AI.conclusion: 研究澄清了循环计算何时有益、何处失效，并为在可变推理预算下设计 LoopLM 提供了实用设计准则。

title: V-Engram: Trigger-Indexed External Memory for Modular Text-to-Image Personalization
summary: Pretrained text-to-image models contain broad visual knowledge, yet they cannot reliably acquire or refine a specific visual identity from only a few references while preserving compositional control. Token-embedding methods are compact but often underfit identity, whereas adapter-based methods improve fidelity through persistent weight updates that can be costly to store and interfere when concepts are composed. We introduce V-Engram, a trigger-indexed external memory mechanism for Stable Diffusion 3.5. Each concept is assigned an explicit trigger that retrieves concept-specific memory, whose gated directions enter frozen text-encoder and MMDiT context states as relative residuals. Separating this memory from backbone adaptation enables prompt-selective and multi-concept access without merging model updates. Experiments show that V-Engram broadly matches DreamBooth-LoRA in overall subject fidelity while showing advantages in settings such as contextual subject preservation. Prompt-matched loading retrieves only matched entries, reducing most additional adaptation-state loading for a single-concept query. Qualitative results further demonstrate paired-trigger composition and same-class separation, while prompts without registered entries retain the frozen model's base behavior. Together, these results establish trigger-indexed memory as a modular interface for adding targeted visual evidence without rewriting the generator.

AI.tldr: 提出V-Engram，一种为Stable Diffusion 3.5设计的触发器索引外部记忆机制，通过显式触发器检索概念专属记忆，以门控相对残差注入冻结的文本编码器与MMDiT上下文，无需合并模型权重即可实现多概念组合与选择性访问，在整体主体保真度上接近DreamBooth-LoRA。
AI.motivation: 预训练文生图模型虽具备广泛视觉知识，但难以仅凭少量参考图可靠地获取或精炼特定视觉身份，同时保持构图控制能力。现有方法存在两难：token-embedding方法紧凑但常欠拟合身份；adapter类方法通过持久权重更新提升保真度，却带来存储成本高、概念组合时相互干扰的问题。因此需要一种模块化、可组合且不重写生成器的身份注入接口。
AI.method: V-Engram为每个概念分配一个显式触发器，用于检索概念专属的外部记忆；记忆的门控方向以相对残差形式注入冻结的文本编码器状态与MMDiT上下文状态。由于记忆与主干适配相分离，可支持提示选择性与多概念访问，而无需合并模型更新；同时采用提示匹配加载，仅检索匹配条目以减少额外适配状态的加载。
AI.result: 实验显示V-Engram在整体主体保真度上大致匹配DreamBooth-LoRA，并在上下文主体保持等场景中具备优势；提示匹配加载对单概念查询仅检索匹配条目，减少了大部分额外适配状态加载；定性结果展示了配对触发器组合与同类分离效果，未注册条目的提示则保持冻结模型的基础行为。
AI.conclusion: 触发器索引记忆可作为模块化接口，在不重写生成器的前提下为模型添加定向视觉证据，兼顾身份保真、构图控制与多概念组合能力。

title: PE-OPSD: Internalizing Prompt Enhancement into Flow-matching Models via On-Policy Self-Distillation
summary: Text-to-image users often provide concise and underspecified prompts, whereas generative models benefit from detailed textual conditions for reliable instruction following. Existing systems bridge this gap with Prompt Enhancers (PEs) that rewrite raw prompts at inference time, introducing additional latency and leaving prompt elaboration external to the generator. We instead view enhanced prompts as privileged training information and ask whether their benefits can be internalized. We propose Prompt-Enhanced On-Policy Self-Distillation (PE-OPSD) for text-to-image flow-matching models. During training, a raw-prompt student follows its own generation trajectory, while an enhanced-prompt teacher provides vector-field targets at the states visited by the student. This on-policy supervision distills the behavior induced by enhanced prompts into the raw-prompt student without requiring additional text--image pairs. At inference, both the PE and teacher are removed, and the student generates directly from raw prompts. Across multiple model families, PEs, and benchmarks, PE-OPSD achieves the strongest aggregate prompt fidelity among the evaluated baselines, yields positive aggregate visual appeal gains, and retains the base-model inference efficiency.

AI.tldr: 提出 PE-OPSD，将增强提示作为特权训练信息，通过在线策略自蒸馏把增强提示带来的行为内化到原始提示学生模型中，推理时无需额外模块且保持效率。
AI.motivation: 文本到图像用户常给出简短、欠明确的提示，而生成模型需要详细文本条件才能可靠遵循指令。现有方案用提示增强器（PE）在推理时重写原始提示，但会引入额外延迟，且提示细化仍外置于生成器。本文希望探究增强提示的收益能否被内化。
AI.method: 提出 Prompt-Enhanced On-Policy Self-Distillation（PE-OPSD），面向文本到图像流匹配模型。训练时，原始提示学生模型沿自身生成轨迹采样；增强提示教师模型在学生访问到的状态上提供向量场目标。该在线策略监督将增强提示诱导的行为蒸馏进原始提示学生模型，且无需额外文本—图像配对数据。推理时移除 PE 与教师，学生直接由原始提示生成。
AI.result: 在多种模型族、PE 和基准上，PE-OPSD 在评估基线中取得最强的综合提示保真度，带来正向的综合视觉吸引力增益，并保持基座模型的推理效率。
AI.conclusion: PE-OPSD 表明增强提示可作为特权训练信息被有效内化，在提升提示保真度与视觉吸引力的同时避免推理期额外开销，为文本到图像生成提供高效的无 PE 推理方案。

title: Learning to Prove, Not Just to Answer: Reinforcement Learning from Formal Verification for Natural-Language Logical Reasoning
summary: Large language models (LLMs) are increasingly deployed for natural-language logical reasoning, where the final answer is easy to check but the proof behind it is not. In natural-language logical reasoning, an intermediate conclusion should follow from its premises, and the resulting derivation should support the final answer. Existing methods lack machine-checkable verification of intermediate conclusions and answer-supporting proof dependencies, so they may assign credit to invalid or answer-irrelevant steps. We propose Proof-R1, an RL framework from formal verification that trains LLMs to construct verifiable proofs for natural-language logical reasoning. Proof-R1 admits a generated conclusion into the verified proof state only when the corresponding reasoning action satisfies the proof obligations through UNSAT-based machine-checkable formal verification. Proof-R1 also recovers the answer-supporting dependency closure to trace the proof structure of the final answer and align outcome credit with the proof dependencies. Experiments demonstrate that Proof-R1 improves answer accuracy across three logical reasoning benchmarks and four backbone models and outperforms training-free agents and training-based methods in terms of reasoning-process verifiability.

AI.tldr: Proof-R1是一个基于强化学习与形式化验证的框架，训练LLM为自然语言逻辑推理构建可机器检验的证明，仅在推理动作满足证明义务（基于UNSAT验证）时才接纳中间结论，并追踪支持答案的依赖闭包以对齐信用分配。
AI.motivation: 现有自然语言逻辑推理方法缺乏对中间结论及支撑答案的证明依赖的机器可检验验证，导致可能将信用分配给无效或与答案无关的推理步骤。
AI.method: 提出Proof-R1：借助形式化验证的RL框架。当推理动作通过基于UNSAT的机器可检验形式化验证满足证明义务时，才将生成的结论接纳进已验证的证明状态；同时恢复支撑答案的依赖闭包，以追踪最终答案的证明结构并使结果信用与证明依赖对齐。
AI.result: 在三个逻辑推理基准和四个骨干模型上，Proof-R1提升了答案准确率；在推理过程可验证性方面，优于免训练智能体方法与基于训练的方法。
AI.conclusion: 通过将强化学习与形式化验证结合，Proof-R1实现了对自然语言逻辑推理中间步骤与答案依赖的可验证监督，同时提升准确率与过程可验证性。

title: A Digital Simulation Toolkit for Physics-Based Generation of Realistic Experimental Scanning Tunneling Microscopy Images
comment: 17 pages, 6 figures in main text and 2 supplementary figures
summary: Scanning Tunneling Microscopy (STM) is a widely used tool for characterizing surfaces of materials at the atomic scale, playing a crucial role in discoveries across condensed matter physics and materials science. Despite its extreme spatial resolution, STM is one of the most sensitive microscopy techniques and is highly prone to noise. While existing unsupervised denoising methods are very cheap to train, these are primarily focused on removing the noise with minimal recovery of key physical information. While supervised methods can offer superior performance, the major bottleneck is that a large amount of paired clean-noisy experimental images is required which are impractical to obtain. Thus, we developed a low-cost physics-driven digital toolkit to rapidly generate large volume of realistic STM images. Firstly, we simulate clean images from a chosen material system. Then, with prior knowledge of the physical characteristics of the artifacts and noise present in STM experiments, we formulate several artifact-noise functions such as Gaussian electronic noise, 1/f flicker noise, scan-line noise, background tilt and mechanical drift. These physically informed noise components are then added to the simulated clean images to generate realistic STM images. We demonstrated the capability of the proposed digital toolkit to generate AI-ready data for denoising images of the (111) surfaces of copper and lead, while preserving atoms, defects, and electron waves. We also validated the quality of the downstream image analysis of learning electron wave patterns induced by quantum interference from Cu(111) images. Results show that the supervised models trained on digitally generated AI-ready data can more effectively denoise and learn electron wave patterns on Cu(111) images than benchmarked unsupervised approaches, indicating that the proposed toolkit facilitate scientific discovery.

AI.tldr: 提出一种低成本、物理驱动的数字工具箱，用于批量生成逼真的STM图像，为监督式去噪模型提供AI-ready数据。
AI.motivation: STM具有原子级空间分辨率，但极易受噪声干扰。无监督去噪方法虽训练成本低，但主要目的是去噪，难以有效恢复关键物理信息；监督式方法性能更优，却受限于难以获取大量成对的干净—含噪实验图像。
AI.method: 构建物理驱动的数字工具箱：先模拟选定材料体系的干净图像；再依据STM实验中伪影与噪声的物理特征，构建高斯电子噪声、1/f闪烁噪声、扫描线噪声、背景倾斜和机械漂移等伪影—噪声函数；将其叠加到模拟干净图像上，生成逼真的STM图像。
AI.result: 该工具箱可为铜和铅(111)表面去噪任务生成AI-ready数据，并保持原子、缺陷和电子波等关键信息；同时通过对Cu(111)图像中量子干涉诱导电子波图样的下游分析验证了数据质量。基于该数字生成数据训练的监督模型，在去噪与学习Cu(111)电子波图样方面优于基准无监督方法。
AI.conclusion: 所提出的物理驱动数字工具箱能低成本生成逼真STM数据，显著提升监督式去噪与下游物理分析性能，有助于促进科学发现。

title: Information Bottleneck-Guided Adaptive Hypergraph Transformer for Brain Disease Diagnosis
summary: Exploring high-order correlations and long-range dependencies in brain networks holds significant value for both neuroscience research and clinical diagnosis. However, previous studies have lacked a unified integration of high-order and long-range dependency information in brain networks, and there is substantial redundancy behind various types of information. These issues limit their effectiveness in the diagnosis of brain diseases. To address this, we propose an Information Bottleneck-Guided Adaptive HyperGraph Transformer (IBAHGT). By incorporating the information bottleneck (IB) principle, this approach enables adaptive learning of high-order correlations and both short- and long-range dependencies within a unified framework for brain network analysis, achieving high-precision brain disease diagnosis. IBAHGT consists of three key components: an information bottleneck-guided adaptive hypergraph convolution, which introduces a novel hypergraph information bottleneck (HIB) principle to adaptively learn hypergraph message-passing weights between nodes and hyperedges, optimizes information flow and captures high-order information in brain networks that is maximally informative and minimally redundant (MIMR). The Transformer encoder captures global information within brain networks through the attention mechanism, specifically modeling short- and long-range dependencies. An information bottleneck-guided node-level adaptive fusion employs the IB principle to learn independent weights for each node, facilitating the fine-grained integration of high-order information and global information to obtain an efficient representation for downstream tasks. Extensive experiments demonstrate that the proposed method outperforms current state-of-the-art methods and can identify biomarkers for clinical applications.

AI.tldr: 该论文提出信息瓶颈引导的自适应超图Transformer（IBAHGT），在统一框架内自适应学习脑网络的高阶关联与短/长程依赖，实现高精度脑疾病诊断。
AI.motivation: 脑网络中高阶关联与长程依赖具有重要价值，但以往研究缺乏统一整合，且各类信息存在大量冗余，限制了脑疾病诊断效果。为解决该问题，作者引入信息瓶颈（IB）原则。
AI.method: IBAHGT包含三个关键组件：1）信息瓶颈引导的自适应超图卷积，提出新的超图信息瓶颈（HIB）原则，自适应学习节点与超边间的消息传递权重，优化信息流，捕获最大信息量最小冗余（MIMR）的高阶信息；2）Transformer编码器，通过注意力机制建模短程与长程依赖，捕获全局信息；3）信息瓶颈引导的节点级自适应融合，利用IB原则为每个节点学习独立权重，实现高阶信息与全局信息的细粒度整合，获得高效表示用于下游任务。
AI.result: 大量实验表明，所提方法优于当前最先进方法，并能够识别可用于临床的生物标志物。
AI.conclusion: IBAHGT通过信息瓶颈引导的统一框架，有效整合脑网络高阶关联与长/短程依赖并抑制冗余，提升脑疾病诊断精度，具有临床生物标志物发现的潜力。

title: Inducing Process Supervision from Outcome-Only Reinforcement Learning
summary: Process reward models (PRMs) have become a key component for LLMs, as their step-level feedback supports both post-training and test-time reasoning. However, training strong PRMs remains costly: human step annotation is difficult to scale, while Monte Carlo estimation is computationally expensive and can drift from the intrinsic correctness of steps. To get effective PRMs at low cost, we introduce TIPS (Thinking-Induced Process Supervision), an outcome-only reinforcement learning (RL) framework for training generative PRMs. In TIPS, the model generates a chain-of-thought (CoT) followed by step-level labels and an outcome label. The reward depends solely on whether the predicted outcome matches the ground truth, and the resulting group-relative advantage is used to optimize the entire generated response. Intuitively, when checking intermediate steps helps determine the outcome, more accurate checks can lead to better outcome judgments and higher rewards. Outcome-only RL can therefore reinforce step-level verification without explicit process supervision. We validate the effectiveness of TIPS across math and agent benchmarks and four backbone families. Notably, TIPS-Qwen3-4B-Thinking-2507 reaches 85.2 F1 on ProcessBench with only 3.2K outcome-labeled trajectories, surpassing all evaluated trained PRMs and strong prompt-only judges such as GPT-5.4-Instruct and Claude-4.7-Opus, while still trailing o1-mini. Code and data are available at https://github.com/RUCBM/TIPS.

AI.tldr: 本文提出 TIPS，一种仅依赖结果标签的强化学习框架，用于低成本训练生成式过程奖励模型（PRM），通过让模型生成思维链与步骤级/结果级标签，仅用结果正确性作为奖励，从而在无显式过程监督下强化步骤级验证能力。
AI.motivation: 训练强 PRM 成本高：人工步骤标注难以扩展，蒙特卡洛估计计算昂贵且易偏离步骤的内在正确性。因此需要一种低成本、能获得有效 PRM 的方法。
AI.method: 提出 TIPS（Thinking-Induced Process Supervision），一种仅结果监督的强化学习框架，用于训练生成式 PRM。模型生成思维链（CoT），随后输出步骤级标签和结果标签；奖励仅取决于预测结果是否与真实答案一致，再用组相对优势优化整条生成响应。核心直觉是：当检查中间步骤有助于判断结果时，更准确的步骤检查会带来更好的结果判断与更高奖励，因此仅结果 RL 可隐式强化步骤级验证。在数学与 agent 基准及四个骨干模型家族上验证。
AI.result: TIPS-Qwen3-4B-Thinking-2507 仅用 3.2K 结果标注轨迹即在 ProcessBench 上达到 85.2 F1，超过所有评估过的已训练 PRM 以及 GPT-5.4-Instruct、Claude-4.7-Opus 等强提示式评判模型，但仍落后于 o1-mini。
AI.conclusion: TIPS 证明仅需结果级标签的强化学习即可有效训练生成式 PRM，在低标注成本下获得强步骤级验证能力，为 PRM 训练提供了一种可扩展、低成本的替代方案。代码与数据已开源。

title: OptiCom : A Unified Framework for State-Conditioned Composition in LLM-Driven Optimization
summary: Large language models (LLMs) are increasingly deployed to solve complex scientific and practical problems via iterative optimization. However, dynamically coordinating diverse search mechanisms as candidate quality, failure modes, and resource budgets evolve remains a critical open challenge. Targeted empirical diagnostics reveal that mechanism effectiveness is highly state-dependent. Motivated by this, we analyze how individual decisions drive final outcomes, decomposing the expected terminal improvement under a shared budget into cumulative decision opportunities minus cumulative selection losses. Guided by this opportunity-loss theoretical foundation, we propose OptiCom, a unified framework that represents LLM-driven optimizers within a shared configuration space: C=(A,Q,O,E,M,S), corresponding to artifact, query, operator, evaluation, memory, and strategy. Operating within this space, a fast LLM-based Optimization Controller dynamically composes immediate mechanisms through structured Action Packages, while a slower Strategy Adapter refines long-term selection preferences, operator weights, and templates based on accumulated trajectory feedback. Comprehensive evaluations across 32 benchmark groups demonstrate the superiority of framework: OptiCom achieves an average Max-score rank of 1.72 among 14 evaluated configurations, securing the top score in 23 groups. Ultimately, these results highlight the broad applicability and high extensibility of OptiCom as a general-purpose paradigm for robust LLM test-time scaling.

AI.tldr: 该论文提出OptiCom统一框架，通过机会-损失理论分解与双控制器（快速优化控制器+慢速策略适配器）动态协调多种搜索机制，在32个基准组上平均Max-score排名1.72，23组夺冠。
AI.motivation: LLM被日益用于通过迭代优化求解复杂科学与实际问题，但候选质量、失败模式和资源预算动态演化时，如何动态协调多样化的搜索机制仍是关键开放挑战。实证诊断显示机制有效性高度依赖状态，因此需要一种统一且可动态调度的方法。
AI.method: 提出机会-损失理论：将共享预算下的期望终端改进分解为累计决策机会减去累计选择损失；据此构建OptiCom，用共享配置空间C=(A,Q,O,E,M,S)（表示artifact、query、operator、evaluation、memory、strategy）统一刻画LLM驱动的优化器。框架内包含快速LLM优化控制器，通过结构化Action Packages动态组合即时机制；以及较慢的策略适配器，基于累积轨迹反馈优化长期选择偏好、算子权重与模板。
AI.result: 在32个基准组上全面评测，OptiCom在14种被评估配置中取得平均Max-score排名1.72，并在23个组中夺得最高分，展现出优越性。
AI.conclusion: 结果凸显OptiCom作为健壮LLM测试时扩展的通用范式具备广泛适用性与高可扩展性。

title: PR-OPD: Privileged Representation On-policy Self-Distillation for Agentic Reinforcement Learning
summary: Language-model agents are usually trained by reinforcement learning from one reward per episode, and privileged self-distillation enriches it by letting the same policy, given a skill, teach its skill-free self through token probabilities. However, we identify two phenomena that question this channel. Invisible Advantage: a skill in context lifts WebShop success from 42.2% to 56.2%, yet changes the probabilities of fewer than a quarter of the sampled tokens. Much to Align: a skill changes the hidden states of over 80% of response tokens, in a way that linear probes can trace back to the specific skill. To exploit this, we propose Privileged Representation On-policy Self-Distillation (PR-OPD). After a GRPO warm start, the policy writes a hindsight skill for each trajectory, re-reads its own responses with that skill as a stop-gradient teacher, and aligns its projected hidden states to the teacher's at every layer alongside the reward objective, with no external skill library, separate teacher, or inference overhead. On ALFWorld and WebShop with two backbones, PR-OPD achieves the best overall results in every setting, improving over GRPO by up to 4.7 points in ALFWorld success and 14.0 points in WebShop accuracy. Code is available at https://github.com/balibata/PR-OPD.

AI.tldr: 论文提出PR-OPD方法，通过特权表征的在线自蒸馏对齐隐藏状态，解决奖励自蒸馏中的"隐形优势"与"高度对齐"现象，在ALFWorld和WebShop上取得最佳结果。
AI.motivation: 现有语言模型智能体通常依赖每回合单一奖励的强化学习，或通过特权自蒸馏（让同一策略在给定技能时以token概率教导无技能自身）来增强。但作者发现两个挑战该通道的现象：1）隐形优势（Invisible Advantage）：上下文中加入技能可将WebShop成功率从42.2%提升至56.2%，却只改变不到四分之一采样token的概率；2）高度对齐（Much to Align）：技能会改变超过80%响应token的隐藏状态，且线性探针能追溯到具体技能。这表明技能信息主要体现在隐藏状态而非token概率上。
AI.method: 提出特权表征在线自蒸馏（PR-OPD）。在GRPO热启动后，策略为每条轨迹撰写事后技能（hindsight skill），并以该技能重新阅读自身响应作为停止梯度的教师，在每一层将其投影后的隐藏状态与教师的进行对齐，同时结合奖励目标。无需外部技能库、独立教师或推理开销。
AI.result: 在ALFWorld和WebShop上，使用两种骨干模型，PR-OPD在所有设置中均取得最佳整体结果。相较GRPO，ALFWorld成功率最高提升4.7个百分点，WebShop准确率最高提升14.0个百分点。代码已开源。
AI.conclusion: PR-OPD通过对齐隐藏状态而非token概率来利用技能信息，验证了表征层面自蒸馏的有效性，为语言模型智能体训练提供了无需额外教师或推理成本的改进方案。

title: Asking for What Was Never Requested: Horizontal and Vertical Proactivity in Agents
summary: An agent that uses tools typically responds to what the user explicitly asks, yet completing the task may require information the user never requested. Work on proactive agents mainly studies whether and when an agent should act on its own, not what information it should pursue. We study a distinct axis of proactivity: its content. Horizontal proactivity pursues unstated information that the current context already identifies, and vertical proactivity pursues needs that only earlier evidence reveals. A need graph, recovered from a benchmark's own decomposition, records which needs depend on which, so both forms, and whether the agent stops at the right time, can be scored from a transcript without a model judge. To learn this behavior, we propose Q&D (questioner and drafter), which trains a questioner to prefer the question whose continuation retrieves more of the required evidence, with no reward model or judge. On held-out splits of three multi-hop question-answering benchmarks, at equal retrieval spend, the trained questioner improves both forms of proactivity over the same model, prompted, and outperforms a prompted model $15\times$ larger in the same role on two of the three, and the gain persists after controlling for question volume and length. Without further training, we place the questioner in an interactive customer-service agent with a simulated customer, where it completes more tasks while asking fewer questions, and in retail it outperforms the $15\times$ larger model with fewer follow-up turns from the customer. These results show that proactivity depends not only on whether an agent acts without being asked, but also on what it chooses to pursue and when it stops.

AI.tldr: 论文研究主动式智能体的"内容"维度（主动性内容），提出水平主动性与垂直主动性两种形式，用需求图无模型评判地打分，并训练Q&D（提问者-起草者）使提问者偏好能检索更多所需证据的问题，在三个多跳问答基准和客服/零售场景中均取得提升。
AI.motivation: 现有主动式智能体研究主要关注智能体"是否"以及"何时"应当自主行动，而忽略了"应当追寻什么信息"这一内容维度。然而智能体完成任务往往需要用户从未明确请求的信息，因此主动性的内容同样关键。
AI.method: 提出主动性的两种形式：水平主动性（追寻当前上下文已隐含指出的未陈述信息）与垂直主动性（追寻只有早期证据才能揭示的需求）。从基准自身的分解中恢复"需求图"，记录需求之间的依赖关系，从而无需模型评判即可从对话记录中为两种形式及"是否适时停止"打分。提出Q&D方法，训练提问者偏好那些其后续能检索到更多所需证据的问题，无需奖励模型或评判器。
AI.result: 在三个多跳问答基准的留出划分上，相同检索开销下，训练后的提问者相比同一模型的提示版本在两种主动性上均有提升，并在三个基准中的两个上超过同角色、规模大15倍的提示模型；控制提问数量与长度后增益依然存在。无需额外训练，将提问者用于模拟客户的交互式客服场景中，完成任务更多且提问更少；在零售场景中优于大15倍模型且客户追问轮次更少。
AI.conclusion: 研究表明，主动性不仅取决于智能体是否在未被要求的情况下行动，还取决于它选择追寻什么信息以及何时停止，说明"主动性内容"是独立且重要的一维。

title: Scheduling Recursive Reasoning in Looped Transformers
summary: Recurrent reasoning models have attracted growing attention for scaling test-time computation, typically by iteratively refining latent states with shared parameters. However, these models apply each learned update with a fixed unit scale, which can be conservative when updates make persistent progress and overly aggressive when they fluctuate, limiting the benefit of additional loops. To understand how the scale should vary along the trajectory, we first analyze the sensitivity of terminal loss to recurrent update scale. We show that its temporal average admits an exact decomposition into persistent-progress and centered-fluctuation contributions. Based on this, we introduce the Trajectory Adaptive Progress-Fluctuation Scheduler (TAPS), which tracks their balance across recurrent updates and adapts the step size online. Theoretically, we establish sufficient conditions under which TAPS reduces expected terminal loss and reaches a target quality in fewer recurrent loops. Empirically, we show that TAPS improves terminal accuracy across structured reasoning tasks without retraining. By further incorporating the progress-fluctuation principle into training, TAPS yields additional accuracy gains with up to 1.56 times wall-clock speedup at matched baseline accuracy. The broad applicability of TAPS is supported by its effectiveness across diverse recurrent architectures and inference strategies. Together, these results establish update scale as complementary control axis of recurrent inference alongside architecture and depth.

AI.tldr: 本文提出轨迹自适应进展-波动调度器（TAPS），通过在线调节递归推理中每次更新的步长尺度来降低终端损失并加速收敛。
AI.motivation: 递归推理模型通常用共享参数迭代精炼隐状态以扩展测试时计算，但每次更新采用固定的单位尺度：当更新持续产生进展时过于保守，当更新波动时又过于激进，从而限制了额外循环带来的收益。作者希望理解更新尺度应如何随轨迹变化。
AI.method: 首先分析终端损失对递归更新尺度的敏感性，证明其时间平均可精确分解为“持续进展”与“中心化波动”两部分贡献。据此提出TAPS，在递归更新过程中跟踪两者的平衡并在线自适应调整步长；并进一步将该进展-波动原则引入训练过程。
AI.result: 理论上给出充分条件，说明TAPS可降低期望终端损失并在更少递归循环内达到目标质量。实验上，TAPS在结构化推理任务上无需重训练即提升终端准确率；将进展-波动原则纳入训练后进一步获得精度增益，在匹配基线准确率时实现最高1.56倍的墙钟加速，并在多种递归架构与推理策略上均有效。
AI.conclusion: 结果表明，更新尺度可作为与架构和深度并列的递归推理互补控制轴。

title: Foundations of Proactive Agents: Principles, Technical Layers, and Proactivity-Gym
summary: Proactive LLM agents can turn idle compute into useful support before users ask. Yet even correct work can misread user context, impose review costs, or undermine trust. This work proposes foundations for designing, realizing, and evaluating proactive LLM agents around three joint principles (3T): Task Capability, anticipating relevant needs and correctly performing useful work; Temporal Allocation, allocating compute according to resource availability and when results are needed; and Trust, sustaining users' confidence and appropriate reliance on the agent. We connect these objectives to a design space organized around five dimensions: task scope, anticipation horizon, activation trigger, processing timing, and intervention depth, and specify the situation and system modeling needed to support its choices, including user and environment representations, backbone LLMs, and agent harnesses. Lastly, we propose PROACTIVITY-GYM, a simulation-based evaluation testbed including multi-day scenarios, stateful environments, and persona-conditioned simulated users that can evaluate the consequences of proactive assistance across interactions. Evaluations across 23 model-harness configurations uncover substantial performance gaps across 3T and reveal that LLM judges often conflate task capability and trust. A human study with 30 participants demonstrates the importance of the joint 3T optimization: participants show sharp trust declines after intervention misalignment despite correct outcomes, and prefer sleep-time assistance, even when imperfect, to preserve ongoing focus. Together, these findings support designing and evaluating proactive agents through the joint consideration of useful work, compute allocation, and evolving user trust.

AI.tldr: 该论文提出以3T原则（任务能力、时间分配、信任）为核心的主动式LLM智能体设计、实现与评估框架，给出五维设计空间、所需情境与系统建模要素，以及仿真评测平台PROACTIVITY-GYM，并验证了联合优化3T的必要性。
AI.motivation: 主动式LLM智能体可在用户提出需求前利用闲置算力提供支持，但即便输出正确，也可能误读用户情境、增加审阅成本或损害信任。因此需要一套统一的设计与评估基础，兼顾有用性、算力分配与用户信任。
AI.method: 提出3T联合原则与五维设计空间（任务范围、预判视野、激活触发、处理时机、干预深度），并说明支撑设计选择所需的情境与系统建模（用户与环境表征、基座LLM、智能体执行框架）；构建仿真评测平台PROACTIVITY-GYM，包含多日场景、有状态环境和人格条件化的模拟用户，用于评估主动辅助在多次交互中的后果。评测覆盖23种模型-执行框架配置，并进行30人的人类被试研究。
AI.result: 在23种模型-执行框架配置上发现3T各维度存在显著性能差距，且LLM评判者常将任务能力与信任混同；30人人类研究显示，即使结果正确，干预错配后信任会急剧下降，且用户偏好睡眠时段辅助（即便不完美）以维持当前专注。
AI.conclusion: 主动式智能体的设计与评估应联合考虑有用工作、算力分配与用户信任的动态演化；3T框架与PROACTIVITY-GYM为后续研究提供了可操作的设计与评测基础。

title: Replay the Curvature: Accurate and Scalable NVFP4 Quantization for Large Language Model Inference
summary: Large language models make weight storage and memory traffic major inference costs, motivating low-precision formats that represent each weight with only a few bits. Such formats use a scale to map floating-point values into a small codebook; NVFP4 improves local range utilization by letting every 16 E2M1 weights share an E4M3 block scale. Choosing that scale is difficult in GPTQ because quantizing one column updates those that follow, so evaluating a block independently can misestimate its final reconstruction error. Large models pose a second challenge: full-precision weights, calibration activations, and second-order state cannot all remain on one accelerator, while assigning complete layers to devices leaves each time-consuming layer solve serial. We introduce \emph{Schur Replay}, a scale-selection algorithm that reproduces the GPTQ updates caused by each block scale and scores the resulting block error after accounting for compensation from unquantized columns. Separately, our execution infrastructure keeps only the active layer resident, tiers activations across device, host, and disk, retires full-precision layers after export, and distributes independent output rows across tensor-parallel ranks. Together, the algorithm and infrastructure attain $99.35\%$ and $100.84\%$ question-weighted recovery from BF16 across seven benchmarks on Qwen3.5-397B-A17B and Llama-3.3-70B-Instruct. On the 397B model, the infrastructure reduces measured per-layer time by $15.17\times$ over ModelOpt and $23.14\times$ over LLM Compressor, with lower memory used per GPU.

AI.tldr: 本文提出 Schur Replay 分块尺度选择算法与分布式执行基础设施，实现 NVFP4 低精度量化，使 GPTQ 误差估计更准确并支持超大规模模型跨设备执行。
AI.motivation: 大语言模型的权重存储与访存成为推理主要开销，NVFP4 等低精度格式需为每个权重块选择尺度，但 GPTQ 中逐列量化会更新后续列，独立评估块误差会误估最终重建误差；同时大模型的全精度权重、校准激活与二阶状态无法共存于单一加速器，按整层分配又导致层内求解串行。
AI.method: 算法上提出 Schur Replay，复现每个块尺度引起的 GPTQ 更新，并在计入未量化列补偿后对块误差打分；系统上将激活分层存放于设备、主机与磁盘，仅保留当前活动层驻留，导出后释放全精度层，并把独立输出行分发到张量并行 rank。
AI.result: 在 Qwen3.5-397B-A17B 与 Llama-3.3-70B-Instruct 上，七个基准的 BF16 问题加权恢复率分别达 99.35% 与 100.84%；在 397B 模型上，每层耗时相比 ModelOpt 降低 15.17 倍、相比 LLM Compressor 降低 23.14 倍，且每 GPU 显存占用更低。
AI.conclusion: 尺度选择算法与执行基础设施协同设计，可在保持近乎无损精度的同时显著提升超大模型低精度量化的效率与可扩展性。

title: Task-Relevant Null-Space Residuals for Non-Injective Neural Mappings
summary: Non-injective mappings in neural networks map distinct inputs to the same representation, thereby implicitly inducing equivalence relations in the input space. However, the input differences eliminated by these mappings may still be required by downstream tasks, creating a mismatch between operator-induced indistinguishability and task-required distinctions. For non-injective linear operators realized in the current forward pass, their null spaces exactly characterize these invisible input variations. We propose Task-Relevant Null-Space Residuals (NSR), a general residual framework for non-injective linear mappings. NSR combines null-space component extraction from pre-mapping representations, member-level encoding and gating, and application-specific integration to exploit potentially task-relevant information under downstream supervision while preserving the original aggregation or merging rules. We evaluate NSR in two structurally different settings: token merging and graph aggregation. In token merging, NSR achieves higher semantic segmentation performance than the corresponding compressed baselines in 34 out of 36 evaluated configurations, with a maximum observed gain of 31.51 mIoU points under strong compression. In graph aggregation, NSR achieves 100% training accuracy on Tree-NeighborsMatch at depths d=2--6 across three backbones, alongside gains on heterophilic node classification and molecular graph regression. Together, these results support null-space residuals as a practical complement to non-injective linear mappings, enabling downstream models to learn from input distinctions invisible in the original operator's output.

AI.tldr: 提出任务相关零空间残差（NSR）通用框架，用于非单射线性映射，在下游监督下恢复被映射消除但任务相关的输入差异信息。
AI.motivation: 神经网络中的非单射映射会将不同输入映射到同一表示，隐含地在输入空间诱导等价关系，但被这类映射消除的输入差异仍可能是下游任务所需的，从而造成"算子诱导的不可区分性"与"任务所需的区分性"之间的失配。对于当前前向传播中的非单射线性算子，其零空间恰好刻画了这些不可见的输入变化。
AI.method: NSR 是一个针对非单射线性映射的通用残差框架，包含三部分：从映射前表示中提取零空间分量、成员级编码与门控、以及面向具体应用的集成，在保留原始聚合/合并规则的前提下，利用下游监督挖掘潜在的任务相关信息。
AI.result: 在两种结构不同的场景中评估：token 合并与图聚合。token 合并中，在 36 个配置里有 34 个取得优于对应压缩基线的语义分割性能，强压缩下最大增益达 31.51 mIoU；图聚合中，在 Tree-NeighborsMatch（深度 d=2--6）上于三种骨干网络下均达到 100% 训练准确率，并在异配节点分类与分子图回归上取得提升。
AI.conclusion: 零空间残差是非单射线性映射的实用补充，使下游模型能够从原算子输出中不可见的输入差异中学习。

title: Constitutional adapters: Inference-time interventions for misalignment and misuse
summary: Training models to act in accordance with an explicitly defined set of principles, or "constitution," has shown promise as a robust and transparent mechanism for AI alignment. However, the generality and flexibility of such methods remain unclear. Here, we show that constitution-consistent behavior can be distilled from synthetic corpora into lightweight objects (low-rank adapters and steering vectors). Despite never seeing a harmful request or jailbreak during training, such objects increase jailbreak defense success and measured alignment -- particularly at long context lengths and against multi-turn attacks, where they outperform both prompted and steered baselines. Subtracting control-trained from constitution-trained objects further accentuates these effects, yielding defenses we call "constitutional adapters" (CAs). CAs can be trained on a base model, transferred zero-shot to its post-trained checkpoint, and scaled at inference time to predictably trade off defense for benign compliance. Taken together, these results recommend CAs as a lightweight, portable, and tunable lever for mitigating misalignment and misuse in API deployments.

AI.tldr: 该论文提出"宪法适配器"（CAs）：从合成语料中蒸馏出低秩适配器与转向向量等轻量对象，可提升越狱防御与对齐度，并支持零样本迁移与推理时可调节的防御-合规权衡。
AI.motivation: 基于明文"宪法"（原则集合）训练模型以对齐是稳健透明的机制，但其泛化性与灵活性尚不明确，需要验证该方法能否以可移植、可调的形式广泛适用。
AI.method: 从合成语料中将"符合宪法"的行为蒸馏为轻量对象（低秩适配器与转向向量）；用"宪法训练对象"减去"对照训练对象"以强化效果，得到宪法适配器（CAs）。在基础模型上训练，零样本迁移至其后训练检查点，并在推理时缩放以调节防御强度。
AI.result: 训练中从未接触有害请求或越狱样本，仍能提升越狱防御成功率与对齐指标；在长上下文与多轮攻击场景中优于提示（prompted）与转向（steered）基线；减法操作进一步放大效果；CAs可在推理时按比例可预测地在防御与良性合规之间权衡。
AI.conclusion: CAs是一种轻量、可移植、可调的对齐杠杆，适用于API部署中缓解失配与滥用问题。

title: Transolver-$σ$: Joint Spectral-Physical Subspace Modeling for Neural PDE Solving
summary: Neural solvers offer efficient surrogates for numerical simulation of partial differential equations (PDEs). For time-dependent problems, strong one-step accuracy does not necessarily translate into reliable autoregressive rollout. We observe that a solver based only on physical-state modeling can achieve lower one-step error, whereas its spectral-only counterpart can become more accurate at later rollout steps. Motivated by this observation, we present Transolver-$σ$, a neural PDE solver based on joint spectral--physical subspace modeling. Within each block, adaptive physical-state interactions and spectral transformations are modeled in dedicated latent subspaces, whose responses are recomposed to enable information exchange between the two representations. Within the physical subspace, we introduce Slice-Residual Physics-Attention (SRPA), which preserves an explicit slice-space identity path while retaining learnable cross-slice interaction. In parallel, an axis-factorized Fourier operator captures global spectral structure. Across five well-established PDE benchmarks spanning steady-state prediction and time-dependent dynamics, Transolver-$σ$ achieves state-of-the-art with a benchmark-averaged relative error reduction of 33.4% over the strongest baseline for each metric, while consistently improving autoregressive rollout over single-operator counterparts. Transolver-$σ$ further delivers strong gains on coupled multiphysics systems and real-world fluid and combustion measurements from RealPDEBench, demonstrating its effectiveness beyond standard simulation benchmarks.

AI.tldr: 提出 Transolver-σ 神经 PDE 求解器，通过联合谱-物理子空间建模提升自回归展开精度，在五个基准上实现 SOTA，平均相对误差降低 33.4%。
AI.motivation: 仅基于物理状态建模的求解器单步误差更低，而纯谱方法在自回归展开后期更准确，说明单一表示难以同时兼顾两种优势，需要联合建模。
AI.method: 每个块内在独立的潜在子空间中分别建模自适应物理状态交互与谱变换，并将两者响应重组以实现信息交换；物理子空间中引入 Slice-Residual Physics-Attention (SRPA)，保留显式 slice-space 恒等路径同时保留可学习的跨 slice 交互；并行使用轴因子化 Fourier 算子捕获全局谱结构。
AI.result: 在五个涵盖稳态预测与时间相关动力学的 PDE 基准上达到 SOTA，相比每个指标的最强基线平均相对误差降低 33.4%，并持续改善自回归展开；在耦合多物理系统及 RealPDEBench 的真实流体与燃烧测量上也取得显著增益。
AI.conclusion: Transolver-σ 通过联合谱-物理子空间建模有效克服单算子局限，在标准仿真基准及真实多物理测量中均展现优越性与泛化能力。

title: On-Policy Parameter Update Direction Underlies Generalization in LLM Post-Training
summary: The strong generalization performance of on-policy post-training paradigms has motivated studies of their parameter update behaviors. However, these studies treat the observed behaviors only as byproducts in on-policy training, overlooking their potential to serve as optimization principles for improving the generalization of other paradigms such as supervised fine-tuning (SFT). To address this limitation, we investigate whether there exists a specific on-policy update behavior that can achieve such improvements. First, our analyses reveal that SFT updates parameters along consistent directions, while the on-policy paradigm continuously adjusts the direction during training. This difference inspires us to focus on the cumulative update direction of each parameter as a promising behavior. Then, we evaluate its effectiveness for improving generalization by proposing On-Policy direction-constrained Supervised Fine-Tuning (OPSFT), which constrains SFT updates to the direction identified by on-policy paradigms. The strong performance of OPSFT indicates that the generalization advantage of on-policy paradigms can be transferred to SFT through the parameter update direction. Once such a direction is identified, even SFT can generalize with its updates constrained to this direction. This finding offers two practical benefits by combining the strong generalization of on-policy paradigms with the advantages of SFT, including the high training efficiency and ability to leverage high-quality trajectories. For efficiency, we identify update directions that support strong generalization using a few on-policy training steps, and subsequently apply OPSFT to achieve high training efficiency. For leveraging high-quality trajectories, OPSFT can utilize these trajectories to continue improving a post-trained model along its update direction without disrupting the ability learned from on-policy training.

AI.tldr: 本文提出OPSFT，将on-policy范式中的累积更新方向作为优化原则迁移到SFT，实现泛化优势迁移。
AI.motivation: 已有研究仅将on-policy后训练的参数更新行为视为副产品，忽视其作为优化原则以提升其他范式（如SFT）泛化能力的潜力。
AI.method: 分析发现SFT沿一致方向更新参数，而on-policy范式持续调整方向；据此关注每个参数的累积更新方向，提出OPSFT，将SFT更新约束到on-policy范式识别的方向上。
AI.result: OPSFT表现强劲，表明on-policy范式的泛化优势可通过参数更新方向迁移到SFT；即使SFT在约束到该方向时也能实现良好泛化。
AI.conclusion: 该发现结合on-policy强泛化与SFT高效率、可利用高质量轨迹的优势：少量on-policy步骤识别方向后应用OPSFT提升效率；同时可沿该方向利用高质量轨迹持续改进后训练模型而不破坏已学能力。

title: AssayRouter: Historical Utility Priors for Frozen Molecular Predictor Routing
summary: Laboratories often face a new molecular assay with 16-64 labels and a bank of predictors whose training data and parameters are unavailable. The practical question is which frozen outputs to include in a small local model. AssayRouter treats completed assays as pseudo-targets and labels each candidate by its post-fit utility: the reduction in held-out discovery loss when the candidate is added to the local target predictor. A shared regressor learns to predict this utility from candidate behavior on the support set, without source identity; on a new assay, one frozen ranking selects four sources and separate labels fit a convex combiner. We train only on completed ChEMBL-MT assays and evaluate 24 external regression assays across six frozen interface families. AssayRouter-C lowers strict four-call negative log-likelihood (NLL) by 0.0409 relative to Support-CV@4. Frozen candidate-label permutations confirm that candidate-utility correspondence carries the transferred information, and leave-one-interface-out training shows that the mapping generalizes to unseen predictor families. Completed assays therefore provide transferable supervision for scarce-label routing through frozen prediction interfaces.

AI.tldr: AssayRouter将已完成的化验作为伪目标，通过学习候选预测器加入后的边缘增益（效用）来指导小标签分子化验中冻结预测器的选择，仅用ChEMBL-MT训练即可在24个外部回归化验上降低严格四调用NLL 0.0409。
AI.motivation: 实验室常面对标签数少（16–64个）的新分子化验，且可用的预测器库其训练数据与参数均不可获取。实际问题是：在构建小型本地模型时，应从这些"冻结输出"中选择哪些预测器。核心挑战在于缺乏源身份信息与目标标签稀缺的条件下，如何判断候选预测器的价值。
AI.method: 将已完成化验视为伪目标（pseudo-targets），为每个候选预测器标注其拟合后效用——即加入本地目标预测器后held-out discovery loss的下降量。采用共享回归器，仅依据候选在support set上的行为（不依赖源身份）来预测该效用。在新化验上，用一份冻结排名选出来源四个候选，再用少量标签拟合凸组合器。训练仅使用已完成的ChEMBL-MT化验；在24个外部回归化验、6个冻结接口家族上评估；并做冻结候选-标签置换与leave-one-interface-out实验进行验证。
AI.result: AssayRouter-C在严格四调用设定下，负对数似然（NLL）相对Support-CV@4降低0.0409。冻结候选-标签置换实验确认，候选-效用对应关系承载了迁移信息；leave-one-interface-out训练显示该映射可泛化到未见过的预测器家族。
AI.conclusion: 已完成的化验能够为冻结预测接口上的稀缺标签路由提供可迁移的监督信号，从而在源数据与参数不可得的情况下有效选择并组合少量局部预测器。

title: Byzantine-Robust Federated Representation Learning
summary: We study federated learning (FL) with adversarial clients, where the goal is to minimize the average loss of the honest (non-adversarial) clients without knowing their identity. Under heterogeneity, a single shared model parameter is statistically inappropriate: it cannot capture the distinct data-generating processes across clients, incurring an irreducible model-heterogeneity bias and severely limiting robustness to adversarial clients (a.k.a. Byzantine-robustness). We address this problem through representation learning, where each client learns a personalized linear head, while collaboratively estimating a shared nonlinear representation through Byzantine-robust aggregation. We demonstrate that the heterogeneity among honest representation gradients is controlled by the representation error and statistical errors that decay either with the number of data samples per client ($τ$) or the number of iterations ($T$). In particular, our non-asymptotic parameter recovery error bound reveals three terms: (i) an initialization-dependent error that goes away with $T$, (ii) finite-sample noise terms that decreases with $τ$ and the number of honest clients, and (iii) a stochastic gradient variance term that also reduces with $T$. Importantly, with no irreducible model-heterogeneity bias in our bounds. We extend the regression analysis to multiclass classification, and empirically validate it on CIFAR-10, FEMNIST, and School Exam Score datasets.

AI.tldr: 本文研究含对抗客户端的联邦学习，通过表示学习让各客户端学习个性化线性头、协同估计共享非线性表示，并采用拜占庭鲁棒聚合，首次在理论上消除了模型异质性偏差。
AI.motivation: 在客户端数据异质时，单一共享模型无法刻画各客户端不同的数据生成过程，带来不可约的模型异质性偏差，并严重削弱对拜占庭（对抗）客户端的鲁棒性。作者希望在不知道诚实客户端身份的前提下，最小化诚实客户端的平均损失，同时避免这一固有偏差。
AI.method: 采用表示学习框架：每个客户端学习个性化的线性头，同时通过拜占庭鲁棒聚合协同估计共享的非线性表示。理论上分析诚实客户端表示梯度之间的异质性，给出非渐近的参数恢复误差界；并将回归分析推广到多分类任务。
AI.result: 理论表明诚实客户端表示梯度的异质性由表示误差与统计误差控制，后者随每客户端样本数τ或迭代次数T衰减。非渐近参数恢复误差界包含三项：(i)依赖初始化的误差，随T消失；(ii)有限样本噪声项，随τ及诚实客户端数量下降；(iii)随机梯度方差项，亦随T减小。关键在于界中不含不可约的模型异质性偏差项。在CIFAR-10、FEMNIST和School Exam Score数据集上的实验验证了理论。
AI.conclusion: 通过表示学习结合拜占庭鲁棒聚合，可在异构联邦学习中实现无不可约模型异质性偏差的参数恢复，兼具理论保证与实验有效性。

title: MetaCtrl: Your Large Language Models Can Reason Better and More Concisely with a Metacognitive Controller
summary: Large reasoning models improve performance on challenging problems by allocating additional computation before answering, but longer reasoning does not always lead to better results and can introduce substantial redundant reasoning on simple problems. Conversely, aggressively shortening reasoning can degrade performance on difficult ones. Effective reasoning therefore requires dynamically deciding when additional computation is useful based on the reasoner's capabilities and evolving solution state. Existing approaches often rely on predefined budgets or intervention rules, retrain the target reasoner, or require additional supervision. We introduce MetaCtrl, a lightweight controller that adaptively regulates a frozen reasoner without predefined token budgets or reasoner retraining. We formulate reasoning regulation as a sequential metacognitive control problem: MetaCtrl observes the evolving reasoning trace and decides whether to continue, simplify, skip redundant steps, or conclude reasoning. It is trained directly with reinforcement learning using a reward that prioritizes correctness while favoring shorter trajectories among correct solutions, requiring neither supervised intervention trajectories nor problem-specific budgets. Across seven benchmarks spanning mathematics, science, and code, MetaCtrl consistently improves the accuracy of LRMs while reducing their reasoning length. On DeepSeek-R1-Distill-Qwen-7B, it improves average accuracy by 4.7 points while reducing generation length by 53.3%. Without further training, the same controller transfers to an unseen reasoner (e.g., Qwen3-14B), improving average accuracy by 2.9 points and reducing generation length by 50.3%. These results establish MetaCtrl as a plug-and-play controller for improving reasoning accuracy while substantially reducing inference-time generation. The code is available at https://github.com/binbin2xs/MetaCtrl.

AI.tldr: 提出MetaCtrl轻量控制器，无需预设token预算或重训练冻结推理器，将推理调控建模为序列元认知控制问题，用强化学习训练，在7个基准上同时提升准确率并大幅缩短推理长度，且可零样本迁移到未见推理器。
AI.motivation: 大推理模型通过增加推理计算量提升难题表现，但更长推理未必更好，简单问题上会引入大量冗余推理；而激进缩短推理又会损害难题性能。因此需要根据推理器能力和解题状态动态判断何时增加计算量。现有方法依赖预设预算或干预规则、需重训练目标推理器或额外监督信号，缺乏灵活性与通用性。
AI.method: 将推理调控形式化为序列元认知控制问题：MetaCtrl作为轻量控制器观察演化中的推理轨迹，决定继续、简化、跳过冗余步骤或结束推理。控制器直接以强化学习训练，奖励在优先保证正确性的前提下，在正确解中偏好更短轨迹，无需监督式干预轨迹也无需问题特定预算。目标推理器保持冻结，不进行重训练。
AI.result: 在数学、科学、代码等7个基准上，MetaCtrl持续提升LRM准确率并缩短推理长度。在DeepSeek-R1-Distill-Qwen-7B上平均准确率提升4.7个百分点，生成长度减少53.3%。无需额外训练，同一控制器可迁移至未见推理器（如Qwen3-14B），平均准确率提升2.9个百分点，生成长度减少50.3%。
AI.conclusion: MetaCtrl是一种即插即用的控制器，可在提升推理准确率的同时显著降低推理时生成开销，具备跨推理器泛化能力。代码已开源于https://github.com/binbin2xs/MetaCtrl。

title: AutoLoCo: Communication Efficient Distributed LLM Training via Adaptive Synchronization
summary: The pre-training of Large Language Models (LLMs) is increasingly conducted across multiple data centers. As training scales to a larger number of accelerators, the fraction of time spent on computation decreases, while the fraction spent on communication increases. Therefore, frequent synchronization becomes a growing bottleneck. Local update methods reduce this cost by allowing workers to perform several optimizer steps between synchronizations. Most local update methods set the number of local optimizer steps between synchronizations before training and keep this interval fixed throughout the run. However, the best interval can change during the entire train process. If the interval and optimizer are adapted to the current training state, the communication frequency is reduced while maintaining the training performance. In this work, we introduce AutoLoCo, an adaptive training framework to reduce communication in LLM training. It adapts the local interval using scalar training statistics and corrects each outer update. Our method is motivated by two observations: 1) the appropriate local interval varies across training stages, and 2) changing the number of inner steps per interval creates a mismatch with an unchanged outer optimizer, requiring a correction to the outer update. We optimize this mismatch by correction of the outer optimizer for the momentum and the learning rate using the accumulated inner learning rate. Our experiments under communication constraints demonstrate that AutoLoCo reduces communication frequency by 27% relative to DiLoCo while maintaining training performance.

AI.tldr: AutoLoCo：一种自适应本地更新框架，通过依据训练统计动态调整同步间隔并校正外层优化器，在通信受限下将通信频率较DiLoCo降低27%且保持性能。
AI.motivation: LLM预训练日益跨多数据中心进行，加速器规模扩大使通信占比上升、频繁同步成为瓶颈。本地更新方法虽可减少同步，但多数在训练前固定本地优化步数，而最佳间隔会随训练过程变化，固定间隔无法兼顾通信与性能。
AI.method: 提出AutoLoCo自适应训练框架：基于标量训练统计自适应调整本地更新间隔；针对间隔变化导致内层步数与不变外层优化器之间的不匹配，利用累积的内层学习率对外层优化器的动量与学习率进行校正。
AI.result: 在通信受限的实验条件下，AutoLoCo相较DiLoCo将通信频率降低27%，同时保持训练性能。
AI.conclusion: 两点观察得到验证：合适的本地间隔随训练阶段变化；改变每间隔内层步数会产生与固定外层优化器的不匹配，需校正外层更新。自适应间隔配合外层优化器校正可有效降低通信开销而不损失性能。

title: GenLimitLib: A Formal Library for Language Generation in the Limit and AI-Assisted Mathematical Research
summary: We present GenLimitLib, a source-aligned Lean 4 library for language generation in the limit. Introduced by Kleinberg and Mullainathan at NeurIPS 2024, language generation in the limit studies a theoretical question motivated by LLMs: how to generate valid new strings from observed examples. This young and rapidly evolving field offers a natural testbed for studying large-scale formalization. GenLimitLib contains formal developments for 30 papers. It extracts shared definitions and reusable proof components while preserving paper-specific assumptions and statements, and records relationships across papers. In this way, GenLimitLib provides a concrete and structured view of the literature. We show through mathematical case studies and LLM experiments how our library can support both human mathematical research and AI-assisted research. Our Library: https://github.com/pengzhang91/generation-in-the-limit-lib.

AI.tldr: 本文提出 GenLimitLib，一个面向“极限语言生成”领域的源对齐 Lean 4 形式化库，覆盖 30 篇论文，提取共用定义与可复用证明组件，并记录跨论文关系。
AI.motivation: “极限语言生成”由 Kleinberg 与 Mullainathan 在 NeurIPS 2024 提出，受 LLM 启发研究如何从观测样例生成合法新字符串。该领域年轻且发展迅速，适合作为大规模形式化的试验场，但缺乏结构化的形式化基础设施。
AI.method: 构建 GenLimitLib：以 Lean 4 实现，保持与原始论文对齐；抽取跨论文共享定义与可复用证明组件，同时保留各论文特有的假设与陈述，并记录论文间关系，从而给出文献的具象化与结构化视图。
AI.result: 库涵盖 30 篇论文的形式化成果，形成统一且结构化的文献框架；通过数学案例研究与 LLM 实验展示其在支持人类数学研究与 AI 辅助研究方面的作用。
AI.conclusion: GenLimitLib 为该新兴领域提供了可复用的形式化基础，既能支撑人类数学研究，也可用于 AI 辅助研究，并为大规模形式化提供了实践范例。

title: Stochastic Heavy Ball with Polyak Step Size and Armijo Line Search: A General Convergence Analysis
summary: Polyak step size (PS) and Armijo line search (ALS) have received increasing attention in stochastic optimization, with encouraging empirical performance and theoretical guarantees. However, their convergence theory for stochastic heavy ball (SHB) methods remains limited. In this work, we develop a unified convergence analysis for SHB equipped with PS and ALS. To this end, we introduce a modified Armijo rule that closely parallels the Polyak step size, together with a decoupling analysis that isolates the historical dependence induced by momentum. For SHB with standard PS and ALS, we establish expected convergence for strongly convex, convex, and non-convex objectives without interpolation or restrictive conditions on the momentum parameter. Under interpolation or strong growth, we further strengthen the results to almost sure rates and last-iterate convergence. Moreover, for general settings beyond interpolation, we prove almost sure convergence to the exact optimum or to stationarity for SHB with diminishing variants of PS and ALS. These results provide a more comprehensive theoretical view of Polyak step size and Armijo line search for stochastic heavy ball methods.

AI.tldr: 本文为配备Polyak步长与Armijo线搜索的随机重球法建立了统一收敛分析，涵盖凸、强凸与非凸目标。
AI.motivation: Polyak步长（PS）与Armijo线搜索（ALS）在随机优化中应用渐广且性能良好，但其针对随机重球法（SHB）的收敛理论仍不完善，缺乏统一且宽松条件下的分析。
AI.method: 提出与Polyak步长紧密对应的修正Armijo规则，并设计解耦分析以分离动量带来的历史依赖，从而对SHB结合PS与ALS进行统一收敛性分析。
AI.result: 对标准PS与ALS的SHB，在无需插值或动量参数限制条件下，建立了强凸、凸及非凸目标的期望收敛；在插值或强增长条件下进一步得到几乎必然速率与最后迭代收敛；在更一般情形下，对递减型PS与ALS证明了几乎必然收敛到精确最优解或稳定点。
AI.conclusion: 该工作为随机重球法中的Polyak步长与Armijo线搜索提供了更完整的理论图景。

title: VISTA: Value-Informed Event Appraisal for Multimodal Emotion Conflict
summary: Conflicting emotional cues can be individually valid: a subdued voice may reflect a blocked goal while a smile satisfies a social obligation. Their interpretation depends on what the event means to the person. We introduce VISTA (Value-Informed Semantic Trust Arbitration), a learned seven-field appraisal interface that conditions modality arbitration on concerns, event relations, and expression conditions while retaining a joint-evidence residual. A log-odds decomposition separates emotion expectation from cue diagnosticity, motivating an interface that lets appraisal change how evidence is interpreted. With a shared Qwen2.5-Omni-7B backbone and matched training examples and steps, VISTA reaches 64.5% conflict accuracy on CA-MER, improving on modality gating by 2.5 percentage points on conflict and 0.2 on consistency. Shuffling appraisal across scenes or removing its decision connection reduces this benefit. A common frozen-backbone probe reaches 0.600 macro CCC for appraisal readout, compared with 0.505 for emotion-only fine-tuning. Evaluations across five benchmarks connect recognition under increasing conflict with appraisal readout and downstream decision use. Together, the analyses and experiments support scene-specific appraisal as an intermediate representation that helps interpret conflicting emotional evidence.

AI.tldr: 本文提出VISTA（价值知情语义仲裁）——一个可学习的七字段评估接口，用评价（appraisal）来条件化多模态情绪识别中的模态仲裁，从而更好地解释冲突情绪线索。
AI.motivation: 冲突的情绪线索（如低沉的声音与微笑）各自都可能是有效的，其含义取决于事件对个体的意义。因此，模态仲裁不应是固定的证据加权，而应由评价（concerns、事件关系、表达条件）来调节证据的解释方式。
AI.method: 提出VISTA：一个七字段的appraisal接口，将模态仲裁条件化于concerns、事件关系与表达条件，同时保留联合证据残差；通过对数几率分解，将情绪期望与线索诊断性分离，使评价能改变证据的解释。使用共享的Qwen2.5-Omni-7B骨干，训练样本与步数匹配。并设置消融（打乱评价、移除其决策连接）与冻结骨干探针（appraisal readout 对比 emotion-only 微调）。
AI.result: 在CA-MER上冲突准确率达64.5%，相比模态门控在冲突上提升2.5个百分点、在一致性上提升0.2个百分点；打乱评价或切断其决策连接会削弱该收益。冻结骨干探针在appraisal readout上达到0.600 macro CCC，而仅情绪微调为0.505。五个基准上的评估将冲突加剧下的识别与appraisal readout及下游决策使用联系起来。
AI.conclusion: 分析与实验共同支持：场景特定的评价（scene-specific appraisal）是一种有助于解释冲突情绪证据的中间表征。

title: Human-inspired, Task-Dimension-Guided Exploration for Efficient Learning in High Dimensions
summary: Efficient exploration in high-dimensional decision spaces remains a central challenge for decision-making systems. Humans, in contrast, can navigate large decision spaces with remarkable efficiency. Recent behavioral studies suggest that humans reduce dimensionality in large decision spaces by probing candidate feature dimensions, identifying reward-relevant ones, and restricting the effective decision space. Inspired by this mechanism, we propose TDGE (Task-Dimension-Guided Exploration), a human-inspired, model-agnostic algorithm with an automatically constructed task-dimension--feature--item hierarchy. TDGE follows a top-down exploration strategy: it first selects task-relevant feature dimensions, then identifies informative features within those dimensions, and finally recommends concrete items based on the selected features. Experiments on MovieLens-20M, Last.fm, and Amazon recommendation datasets show that TDGE substantially improves exploration efficiency and cold-start adaptation over baseline algorithms. Comparisons with other structured algorithms and ablation studies attribute these gains to TDGE's hierarchical structure and semantic feature-space exploration, with robust results across clustering methods and hierarchy depths. Recommendation-trajectory visualizations also show exploration patterns similar to human dimension-guided behavior.

AI.tldr: 提出TDGE（任务-维度-引导探索），一种受人类启发、模型无关的算法，通过自动构建“任务-维度-特征-物品”层级结构实现高维决策空间的高效探索。
AI.motivation: 高维决策空间中的高效探索是决策系统的核心难题；而人类能通过探测候选特征维度、识别与奖励相关的维度、并限制有效决策空间来显著降低维度，行为研究对此提供了启发。
AI.method: TDGE构建“任务-维度-特征-物品”层级，采用自上而下的探索策略：先选择任务相关特征维度，再在维度内识别信息量高的特征，最后基于所选特征推荐具体物品；算法为模型无关且层级自动构建。
AI.result: 在MovieLens-20M、Last.fm、Amazon推荐数据集上，TDGE在探索效率与冷启动适应方面显著优于基线；与结构化算法对比及消融实验表明增益源于层级结构与语义特征空间探索，结果在不同聚类方法和层级深度下保持稳健；推荐轨迹可视化显示出类似人类维度引导行为的探索模式。
AI.conclusion: TDGE通过模仿人类维度引导的降维探索机制，有效提升高维决策空间中的探索效率与冷启动适应能力，为决策系统提供了一种可解释、可迁移的探索范式。

title: Solving Without Stopping: On-Policy Distillation at Small Scale
summary: On-policy distillation, where a student learns from a stronger teacher's feedback on its own outputs, is a common way to pass reasoning to smaller models. We analyze what it transfers at small scale, distilling Qwen3-8B into Qwen3 4B, 1.7B and 0.6B students, in thinking mode (reason at length, then end the reasoning and answer) and, for comparison, in non-thinking mode (no separate reasoning phase). Long reasoning needs two abilities, solving a problem and knowing when it is solved, and we find that distillation transfers the first, but in thinking mode not the second. Solving improves at every size, up to two ceilings, which we measure comprehensively across both modes and all student sizes: a student's single attempt never exceeds what it could already reach in many attempts before training, and the smaller the student, the further it stays below the teacher. Stopping is where the modes part. In non-thinking mode every student keeps stopping; in thinking mode students stop ending their reasoning early in training, and the smaller the student, the less of this ability survives: the teacher signals a stop almost only where a student already ends its reasoning, so distillation teaches no new stops; it only keeps the student's existing stops that land on a right answer, and a weak student has few such stops. The smallest students often reach the right value but do not commit to it: they either rarely mark it or mark it and write past it. Together, these results describe how small students behave under on-policy distillation, and a diagnostic that separates answer marking, correctness and stopping.

AI.tldr: 本文分析小规模on-policy蒸馏能传递什么：将Qwen3-8B蒸馏进4B/1.7B/0.6B学生，发现在thinking模式下蒸馏传递了"解题"能力但未传递"知道何时已解出"（停止）能力。
AI.motivation: On-policy蒸馏被广泛用于将推理能力迁移到小模型，但学界对其究竟传递了什么、以及在何种规模下有效缺乏细粒度理解。作者希望厘清长推理所需的两种能力（解题与停止）在蒸馏中各自的迁移情况。
AI.method: 将Qwen3-8B作为教师，对学生Qwen3 4B/1.7B/0.6B进行on-policy蒸馏，分别在thinking模式（长推理后作答）与非thinking模式（无独立推理阶段）下对比；跨两种模式与全部学生规模测量两项天花板效应；并设计诊断指标，将"答案标记、正确性、停止"三要素分离分析。
AI.result: 解题能力在所有规模上均有提升，但受两个天花板限制：（1）学生的单次尝试不超过训练前多次尝试所能达到的最好水平；（2）学生越小，与教师的差距越大。停止能力则分模式而异：非thinking模式下所有学生均保持停止；thinking模式下学生逐渐停止结束推理，学生越小该能力保留越少。原因是教师几乎只在学生已经结束推理之处发出停止信号，故蒸馏无法教会新的停止点，只能保留学生原本落在正确答案上的停止点，而弱学生此类停止点很少。最小规模学生常能到达正确值却不"承诺"它：要么极少标记，要么标记后继续写下去。
AI.conclusion: On-policy蒸馏在小模型上主要传递解题能力而非停止能力；停止能力受限于学生既有的正确停止点数量。作者提出一种分离答案标记、正确性与停止的诊断方法，用以刻画小学生在on-policy蒸馏下的行为。

title: Understanding Private Evolution as Learning-Augmented Clustering
summary: Private Evolution (PE) is a differentially private algorithm for synthetic data generation. While it can be viewed as a Wasserstein learning algorithm, it performs much better in practice than worst-case Wasserstein analyses would predict. We recast PE as generative model-augmented Wasserstein learning. We show theoretically that when we take into account the use of a generative model that is able to capture something about the true distribution, then we can obtain much better performance bounds. For example, if the generator gives samples in the same low-dimensional space as the distribution, then sample complexity depends on intrinsic, not ambient, dimension. We also show that standard variants of PE can fail to converge on simple well-clustered instances, and propose a new geometry-aware version of PE with provable convergence on such instances. Experimentally, we show that our new algorithm is competitive with standard baselines and can improve recall.

AI.tldr: 本文将 Private Evolution (PE) 重新表述为"生成模型增强的 Wasserstein 学习"，从理论上证明生成模型对真实分布的建模能力可显著改善样本复杂度（如依赖内在维度而非环境维度），并指出现有 PE 变体在良聚类实例上可能不收敛，进而提出几何感知的新 PE 变体并验证其竞争力与召回率提升。
AI.motivation: PE 作为差分隐私合成数据生成算法，实践表现远超最坏情况 Wasserstein 分析的预测，理论与实际之间存在明显差距，需要解释这一差距并改进其收敛性。
AI.method: 将 PE 重新解释为生成模型增强的 Wasserstein 学习；在理论层面引入生成模型对真实分布的先验刻画，推导更优的性能界；针对标准 PE 变体在良聚类实例上不收敛的问题，提出几何感知（geometry-aware）的 PE 新变体。
AI.result: 理论上，当生成器在与分布相同的低维空间中采样时，样本复杂度取决于内在维度而非环境维度；新算法在良聚类实例上具有可证明的收敛性；实验中与标准基线相比具有竞争力，并能提升召回率。
AI.conclusion: 生成模型增强视角可弥合 PE 理论与实践之间的鸿沟，几何感知的 PE 变体在保持竞争性能的同时提供了收敛保证并改善召回率。

title: Seek Before You Move: Evidence Seeking for Progress Grounding in Vision-Language Navigation
summary: Vision-Language Navigation (VLN) requires agents to continuously ground task progress from long-horizon instructions and partial egocentric observations. Existing VLM-based navigation agents typically reason only over available observations and may remain confident even when task-relevant evidence is missing. For example, an agent may confidently proceed forward and get lost even though the landmark indicating the next turn lies outside its current field of view. We term this failure mode Progress Myopia: the agent fails to recognize unreliable progress grounding and continues acting on insufficient evidence. To address it, we propose SeekVLN, an evidence-seeking framework that couples semantic progress reasoning with active acquisition of task-relevant observations. SeekVLN is trained in two stages: First, Future-guided Reverse Generation (FRG) uses future expert actions to augment offline expert trajectories with supplementary views and evidence annotations. Supervised fine-tuning on these trajectories establishes a prior for evidence seeking and progress reasoning without additional expert interaction. However, imitation alone does not reveal whether seeking improves subsequent navigation. We therefore introduce Counterfactual Contrastive Policy Optimization (C2PO) for reinforcement fine-tuning. By comparing each evidence-seeking branch with a counterfactual direct-navigation branch from the same state, C2PO uses a contrastive reward to assign credit to seeking decisions based on subsequent navigation benefit. Experiments on simulated benchmarks show that SeekVLN achieves state-of-the-art performance, improving success rate by 12.7% and 7.5% over the base model on R2R-CE and RxR-CE, respectively. Both simulated and real-world evaluations exhibit human-like evidence-seeking behaviors for more reliable progress grounding.

AI.tldr: 提出SeekVLN框架，通过"证据寻求"解决视觉语言导航中的"进度近视"问题：先用FRG生成补充视图与证据标注做监督微调，再用C2PO对比强化微调，在R2R-CE和RxR-CE上成功率分别提升12.7%和7.5%。
AI.motivation: 现有基于VLM的导航智能体仅对已获得的观测进行推理，即使任务相关证据缺失也可能保持自信，导致在证据不足时仍继续前进而迷路。作者将这一失败模式定义为"进度近视"（Progress Myopia），即智能体无法识别不可靠的进度锚定。
AI.method: SeekVLN将语义进度推理与任务相关观测的主动获取相耦合，分两阶段训练：(1) Future-guided Reverse Generation (FRG) 利用未来专家动作向离线专家轨迹中补充视图与证据标注，监督微调建立证据寻求与进度推理的先验，无需额外专家交互；(2) Counterfactual Contrastive Policy Optimization (C2PO) 进行强化微调，通过将每个证据寻求分支与同一状态下的反事实直接导航分支对比，用对比奖励依据后续导航收益为寻求决策分配信用。
AI.result: 在模拟基准上取得SOTA性能，相比基座模型在R2R-CE和RxR-CE上成功率分别提升12.7%和7.5%。模拟与真实世界评估均表现出类人的证据寻求行为，实现更可靠的进度锚定。
AI.conclusion: SeekVLN通过将主动证据获取与进度推理结合，并经反事实对比强化微调优化寻求决策，有效缓解了进度近视问题，提升了导航可靠性与成功率，并展现出类人行为。

title: MARCO: Multi-Round Agentic Reinforcement for Conditional Molecular Optimization
summary: Molecular optimization is inherently iterative: a candidate is proposed, evaluated against several objectives, and revised while preserving a relationship to the source molecule. Most instruction-following models instead emit one edited molecule, forcing validity, property improvement, and similarity control into a single response. We introduce MARCO, an evaluator-grounded reinforcement-learning framework that trains molecular editors on bounded proposal--feedback--revision trajectories. MARCO aggregates shaped turn rewards into an undiscounted trajectory return for group-relative policy optimization. We evaluate two consequences of this training: Same-1 tests the trained policy under a one-response budget, while Same-5 tests whether the same policy can use verifier feedback when up to five responses are available. Across the three-objective MuMOInstruct benchmark, three Qwen backbones, and seen/unseen instruction splits, SFT-initialized MARCO obtains the highest product of property success rate and similarity in every reported primary setting.
