Same-5 further improves the observed score under the tested budget, while four-objective and public-checkpoint experiments test transfer across constraint sets and initialization regimes.

AI.tldr: MARCO：基于评估器反馈的强化学习分子编辑框架，将分子优化建模为有界"提议—反馈—修订"轨迹，用组相对策略优化训练，在MuMOInstruct基准上取得最高"性质成功率×相似度"。
AI.motivation: 分子优化本质是迭代过程：提出候选分子、针对多目标评估、并在保持与源分子关系的前提下修订。然而多数指令遵循模型只输出单个编辑结果，把有效性、性质提升与相似度控制压缩进一次响应中，缺乏可反复利用验证器反馈的机制。
AI.method: 提出MARCO，一种以评估器为依托的强化学习框架，在受限的"提议—反馈—修订"轨迹上训练分子编辑器。将各轮次的塑形奖励聚合成无折扣的轨迹回报，用于组相对策略优化（GRPO）。以SFT初始化，并设计两种评测设定：Same-1（单次响应预算）与Same-5（最多五次响应、可利用验证器反馈）。
AI.result: 在三目标MuMOInstruct基准、三种Qwen主干、以及已见/未见指令划分上，SFT初始化的MARCO在所有报告的主要设定中均取得最高的"性质成功率×相似度"乘积；Same-5在测试预算下进一步提升观测分数；四目标实验与公开检查点实验检验了跨约束集与跨初始化范式的迁移能力。
AI.conclusion: 将分子优化显式建模为带评估器反馈的迭代轨迹并用强化学习训练，优于单次输出的指令遵循范式；迭代预算与验证器反馈可转化为性能增益，且该框架在约束数目与初始化方式变化时具备一定迁移性。

title: Teaching LLMs to Generate Challenging MILP Instances via Solver Feedback
summary: Generating optimization instances that are both feasible and computationally challenging is crucial for benchmarking solvers and training learning-based optimization algorithms. Existing non-LLM generators rely on seed instances or parameter tuning, resulting in high test-time computational cost, while existing LLM generators lack explicit hardness measures. Recent reinforcement learning methods with verifier feedback evaluate only binary correctness, which is misaligned with generating challenging problems. We note that an optimization solver reports the cost of solving at several stages of its pipeline, and leverage this to design a reward that scores both the solvability and the hardness of generated problems, measured by branch-and-bound nodes and post-cut relaxation gaps. Our key idea is a challenger-solver asymmetric self-play approach, where an LLM challenger generates progressively harder instances and the solver verifies feasibility and hardness, so no seed or training MILP instances are required. We fine-tune Gemma-4-12B and Qwen3.5-4B with GRPO and a size curriculum into OptiScribe-12B and OptiScribe-4B, which generate feasible yet challenging MILP problems from natural language instructions. On capacitated facility location and max-cut, OptiScribe-12B raises median SCIP search nodes by 1.7-5x and post-cut gaps by 1.1-1.7x over its base model and improves the feasibility rate on facility location by 9-19 points, while OptiScribe-4B raises median nodes by up to 15.6x. The problems cover a wider difficulty range than public benchmarks of the same size, follow instructions on density and difficulty, and can tune solver settings for families that public libraries lack. These results indicate that optimization-specific rewards, used in self-play mode, can teach LLMs to generate high-difficulty optimization benchmarks. We will release our code and models publicly on acceptance.

AI.tldr: 提出挑战者-求解器非对称自博弈方法，用优化求解器反馈的特定奖励微调LLM，使其能从自然语言指令生成可行且高难度的MILP问题。
AI.motivation: 生成既可行又具有计算挑战性的优化实例对求解器基准测试和训练学习型优化算法至关重要。现有非LLM生成器依赖种子实例或参数调优，测试阶段计算成本高；现有LLM生成器缺乏显式难度度量；近期带验证器反馈的强化学习方法仅评估二元正确性，与生成难题的目标不一致。
AI.method: 利用求解器管线各阶段报告的求解代价（分支定界节点数和割后松弛间隙）设计奖励，同时评估生成问题的可解性与难度。核心是挑战者-求解器非对称自博弈：LLM挑战者逐步生成更难实例，求解器验证可行性与难度，无需种子或训练MILP实例。用GRPO和规模课程微调Gemma-4-12B和Qwen3.5-4B，得到OptiScribe-12B和OptiScribe-4B。
AI.result: 在容量设施选址和最大割问题上，OptiScribe-12B相比基座模型将SCIP搜索节点中位数提高1.7-5倍，割后间隙提高1.1-1.7倍，设施选址可行性率提升9-19个百分点；OptiScribe-4B将节点中位数最高提升15.6倍。生成问题难度范围比同规模公开基准更广，能遵循密度和难度指令，并可为公开库缺乏的问题族调优求解器设置。
AI.conclusion: 优化专用的奖励在自博弈模式下可教会LLM生成高难度优化基准。代码与模型将在录用后公开。

title: Where Root Cause Analysis Fails: A Retrieval-Reranking Decomposition
summary: Identifying the root cause of an anomaly among hundreds of sensors is critical for preventing safety incidents and costly downtime in complex monitored systems. Existing studies evaluate root cause analysis (RCA) methods using top@k accuracy. We show that this metric has a fundamental blind spot: it conflates two failure modes, retrieval failure, where the true cause is never considered, and reranking failure, where it is considered but ranked too low. In this work, we introduce a retrieval-reranking decomposition and audit four well-known benchmarks to expose this blind spot. Our experiments show that, on benchmarks with complex faults, statistical baselines mis-rank the true cause 79-100% of the time, and graph-based methods never clearly beat the best statistical baseline, whether their causal graphs are learned on short fault windows, on retrieved candidate pools guaranteed to contain the cause, or on multi-day normal-operation data. Meanwhile, on simple benchmarks where faults manifest significantly at their origin, retrieval is nearly solved (98-100%). Guided by the decomposition, we build a two-stage pipeline combining a multi-signal retriever with an LLM reranker that, as one fixed configuration, matches or exceeds the best baseline's top@1 accuracy on all six benchmark suites (by up to +12 points), with no causal graph or labeled data required. When all methods rank the same retrieved candidates with the true cause guaranteed present, adding a short system-description document lets the reranker lead the best baseline by +7 to +18 points on every benchmark. Code is available at https://github.com/cruiseresearchgroup/DecompRCA.

AI.tldr: 本文指出top@k准确率在根因定位评估中存在盲点，提出检索-重排序分解框架，并基于该框架构建多信号检索器+LLM重排序器两阶段流水线，在六个基准套件上达到或超过最佳基线。
AI.motivation: 现有RCA研究普遍采用top@k准确率评估，但该指标混淆了两种失败模式：检索失败（真因从未进入候选集）与重排序失败（真因进入候选集但排名过低），导致无法定位方法瓶颈。作者希望通过分解指标暴露该盲点，重新审视既有方法的真实能力。
AI.method: 提出检索-重排序分解（retrieval-reranking decomposition），并据此审计四个知名基准。实验对比统计基线与图方法（因果图分别学习自短故障窗口、保证含真因的检索候选池、多日正常运行数据）。进一步构建两阶段流水线：多信号检索器 + LLM重排序器，单一固定配置，无需因果图或标注数据。
AI.result: 在复杂故障基准上，统计基线将真因排错的比例达79-100%；图方法不论因果图来源如何，均未能明显超越最佳统计基线。在故障于源头显著显现的简单基准上，检索几乎已被解决（98-100%）。所提两阶段流水线在所有六个基准套件上匹配或超过最佳基线top@1准确率（最高+12点）；当各方法在同一检索候选上重排序时，加入简短系统描述文档可使重排序器在每个基准上领先最佳基线+7至+18点。
AI.conclusion: top@k指标掩盖了RCA方法的真实瓶颈，检索-重排序分解能更清晰地刻画问题结构。基于该分解的两阶段无监督流水线在多个基准上表现优越，表明检索质量与重排序能力应被分别评估和优化，系统描述等辅助信息对重排序有显著增益。

title: Pretrain Once, Route Anywhere: Towards a Foundation Model for LLM Routing
summary: Large language model (LLM) routing aims to assign each query to the most suitable model from a heterogeneous candidate pool, improving the quality--efficiency trade-off of LLM inference. Existing routers are typically learned through local fitting: a router is optimized for a particular query workload and candidate pool, and often requires additional supervision or retraining as the routing environment changes. We ask whether LLM routing can instead be approached from a foundation-model perspective, learning a reusable routing capability that generalizes across tasks, candidate models, and deployment conditions. To this end, we introduce RouteFM, which learns to characterize anonymous candidate models from behavioral context and infer their target-specific capabilities, rather than binding routing decisions to fixed model identities or a single environment. Through episodic pretraining across heterogeneous routing environments, this capability can be reused by a frozen router and adapted to new environments through context alone. Experiments demonstrate transfer across changes in domains, modalities, candidate pools, and context budgets, with the largest gains when behavioral evidence is limited. On MMR-Bench, which is excluded from pretraining, RouteFM outperforms the strongest baseline by 2.23 quality points with only eight observations per candidate. These results support moving LLM routing from repeated local fitting toward a pretrain once, route anywhere paradigm. Our code is publicly available at https://github.com/LAMDA-Model-Reuse/RouteFM.

AI.tldr: 本文提出 RouteFM，将 LLM 路由从针对特定查询负载与候选池的局部拟合，转变为可跨任务、候选模型与部署条件泛化的基础模型式路由能力。
AI.motivation: 现有 LLM 路由器通常依赖局部拟合：需针对特定查询负载和候选池优化，并随路由环境变化而重新训练或引入额外监督，缺乏可复用性与泛化性。作者希望探索路由是否也能像基础模型一样，学习一种可迁移的路由能力。
AI.method: RouteFM 不将路由决策绑定到固定的模型身份或单一环境，而是从行为上下文（behavioral context）中刻画匿名候选模型，并推断其面向目标任务的能力。通过跨异构路由环境的回合式（episodic）预训练，该能力可被冻结的路由器复用，并仅依靠上下文适配新环境。
AI.result: 实验表明，RouteFM 可在领域、模态、候选池和上下文预算变化时实现迁移，且在行为证据有限时增益最大。在未参与预训练的 MMR-Bench 上，每个候选仅用 8 条观测即比最强基线高出 2.23 个质量分。
AI.conclusion: 结果支持将 LLM 路由从反复的局部拟合转向 "pretrain once, route anywhere"（一次预训练、随处路由）的新范式。代码已开源。

title: CHAIN: Calibrated LLM Forecasting via Causal-Temporal Hypergraph Inference
summary: Large language models have achieved significant progress in event forecasting, yet their probability outputs exhibit systematic calibration bias that varies heterogeneously across different domains and question types, undermining the trustworthiness of probabilistic outputs for decision-making under uncertainty. However, existing calibration methods typically correct probability outputs after prediction is complete, without modeling the structural sources of bias within the prediction process itself. To address this challenge, we decompose probabilistic prediction over causal-temporal hypergraphs into three stages, evidence weighting, evidence aggregation, and source fusion, and propose CHAIN, which designs stage-specific mechanisms to mitigate bias at each stage: (i) modulating the temporal decay function by causal topological distance, (ii) aggregating approximately independent causal chains via Noisy-OR after direction-aware deduplication, and (iii) driving adaptive fusion by causal coverage and directional balance. Experimental results on cross-domain forecasting benchmarks show CHAIN outperforms existing methods in expected calibration error, Brier score, and accuracy. Our project is available at https://github.com/QwenQKing/Chain.

AI.tldr: 针对大语言模型事件预测中的系统性校准偏差，提出CHAIN框架，将因果-时序超图上的概率预测分解为证据加权、证据聚合与来源融合三阶段，并在各阶段设计针对性去偏机制。
AI.motivation: 大语言模型在事件预测上进展显著，但其概率输出存在系统性校准偏差，且该偏差在不同领域和问题类型间呈异质性，削弱了不确定性决策中概率输出的可信度。现有校准方法多仅在预测完成后对概率进行后处理，未能建模预测过程内部偏差的结构性来源。
AI.method: 将因果-时序超图上的概率预测分解为证据加权、证据聚合、来源融合三阶段，提出CHAIN并设计各阶段专属机制：(i) 以因果拓扑距离调制时间衰减函数；(ii) 在方向感知去重后，通过Noisy-OR聚合近似独立的因果链；(iii) 由因果覆盖度与方向平衡度驱动自适应融合。
AI.result: 在跨领域预测基准上，CHAIN在期望校准误差（ECE）、Brier分数与准确率三项指标上均优于现有方法。
AI.conclusion: 通过在预测过程内部按阶段建模并缓解偏差来源，可有效改善大语言模型事件预测的概率校准与预测性能，代码已开源。

title: Beyond Prompt Count: How Data Shapes Transfer in On-Policy Distillation
summary: On-policy distillation (OPD) trains students using teacher feedback on their own sampled responses, yet how prompt choice shapes transfer across teacher-student pairs remains poorly understood. We systematically study prompt quantity, source, and selection across RL- and SFT-continuation pairs and cross-model settings. We find that OPD can be highly prompt-efficient: a few prompts can approach large-pool performance, with four DAPO prompts matching the observed mathematics score of 3,840 DeepMath prompts. However, prompt utility is relational rather than intrinsic: changing only the teacher can reverse the relative effectiveness of mathematics and code prompts. To characterize these transfer differences, we analyze parameter and functional changes across prompt supports and model pairs. Functional alignment with the teacher varies across supports and target tasks; in continuation pairs, teacher-aligned prediction changes can coexist with weak parameter alignment. Continued OPD on effective supports can restore performance after unfavorable transfer. Finally, targeted selection does not consistently outperform uniform random sampling, and filtering out a source that performs poorly alone yields no consistent gain across three paired support draws. Overall, our results distinguish prompt efficiency from prompt interchangeability and show that effective data choice depends on the teacher-student pair and target capability, with random sampling providing a competitive baseline in the studied settings.

AI.tldr: 本文系统研究 on-policy distillation (OPD) 中 prompt 的数量、来源与选择策略，发现 OPD 高度 prompt-efficient，但 prompt 效用是"关系性"的（取决于师生配对与目标任务），随机采样是强基线。
AI.motivation: OPD 使用教师对学生自采样回复的反馈进行训练，但 prompt 选择如何影响不同师生配对间的知识迁移尚不清楚，本文旨在填补这一理解空白。
AI.method: 在 RL 与 SFT-continuation 配对及跨模型设定下，系统操纵 prompt 的数量、来源与选择方式；通过分析不同 prompt 支持集与模型配对上的参数变化和功能变化（functional alignment）来刻画迁移差异，并考察在有效支持集上继续 OPD 的效果。
AI.result: OPD 极为 prompt-efficient：4 个 DAPO prompt 即可达到 3,840 个 DeepMath prompt 的数学分数。prompt 效用是关系性的：仅更换教师即可逆转数学与代码 prompt 的相对有效性。功能对齐随支持集与目标任务变化；在 continuation 配对中，与教师对齐的预测变化可与弱参数对齐共存。在有效支持集上继续 OPD 可恢复不利迁移后的性能。定向选择并未稳定优于均匀随机采样，剔除单独表现差的来源在三组配对支持抽取中也无一致增益。
AI.conclusion: 研究区分了 "prompt 效率" 与 "prompt 可互换性"，表明有效数据选择依赖于师生配对和目标能力，随机采样在所研究设定中是具有竞争力的基线。

title: Normalize-Then-Precondition: A Hierarchical Approach to Marginal Scale and Interaction Geometry for LLM Training
summary: Matrix optimizers have emerged as a promising direction, with Muon standing out as a prominent design. Revisiting Muon through its full-Gram representation, we observe that it jointly processes marginal-scale and interaction information. This opens an alternative way to organize geometric information hierarchically, motivating the Normalize-Then-Precondition framework. Specifically, it first uses diagonal-Gram information to construct a marginally normalized update, then applies spectral preconditioning to its directional interaction geometry. Building on this framework, we develop NormPre with NormPre-G and NormPre-L adopting global and localized spectral preconditioning, grounded in spectral-norm steepest descent and a regularized formulation followed by leading mode selection, respectively. To enable large-scale training, NormPre-G uses Newton-Schulz iterations and NormPre-L employs randomized sketching to approximate the leading interaction eigenspace. Theoretically, we establish $\mathcal{O}(T^{-1/2})$ convergence guarantees for simplified versions of NormPre. Across extensive pretraining experiments on GPT-2 Small, LLaMA and Qwen3, both variants consistently outperform AdamW, Muon and MANO under matched training budgets. Further efficiency and spectral analyses reveal the complementary strengths of two variants and characterize their performance-efficiency trade-off. We open-source our code through a GitHub repository at https://github.com/zx-gong/NormPre.

AI.tldr: 本文提出 Normalize-Then-Precondition 框架，并据此设计了矩阵优化器 NormPre（含 NormPre-G 与 NormPre-L），在大规模预训练中一致优于 AdamW、Muon 与 MANO。
AI.motivation: 矩阵优化器（如 Muon）发展迅速。作者从 Muon 的 full-Gram 表示出发，发现它同时处理边缘尺度信息与交互信息，这启发了一种层次化组织几何信息的替代方案，即先归一化再预条件。
AI.method: 提出 Normalize-Then-Precondition 框架：先用对角 Gram 信息构造边缘归一化更新，再对其方向性交互几何施加谱预条件。基于此开发 NormPre，其中 NormPre-G 采用全局谱预条件（基于谱范数最速下降），NormPre-L 采用局部化谱预条件（正则化公式加主导模式选择）。为支持大规模训练，NormPre-G 用 Newton-Schulz 迭代，NormPre-L 用随机草图近似主导交互特征子空间。
AI.result: 理论上证明了 NormPre 简化版本的 O(T^{-1/2}) 收敛保证。在 GPT-2 Small、LLaMA 与 Qwen3 的广泛预训练实验中，两种变体在相同训练预算下均持续优于 AdamW、Muon 和 MANO。效率与谱分析进一步揭示了两种变体的互补优势及其性能-效率权衡。
AI.conclusion: NormPre 通过层次化几何信息组织在性能与效率上均具优势，两种变体各有侧重，代码已开源。

title: Direct Experience World-Model Optimization: Learning the World Beyond Action Imitation
comment: World Action Model; post-deployment training; dexterous manipulation
summary: World-Action Models (WAMs) couple action generation with predictions of how physical interactions unfold. However, current post-deployment learning paradigms typically improve behavior without requiring better world predictions. Especially in dexterous manipulation, small execution errors can compound in high-dimensional action spaces, hindering policy improvement and pushing interactions beyond the world model's training distribution. Motivated by this, we propose Direct Experience World-Model Optimization (DEWO), a post-deployment learning paradigm for WAMs that, alongside action imitation, refines world representations through visual experience to better condition action generation. Specifically, it identifies interaction turning points and learns from successful and failed futures to support classifier-free guidance. An additional value head estimates task progress from video representations and activates guidance when progress stalls during inference. Across five DexJoCo tasks, DEWO improves average success across all three WAM formulations. Ablations show that visual supervision from successful and failed continuations improves both prediction and control beyond action supervision alone. On four real-world tasks across Wuji and Sharpa, 3 x 3 grid evaluations show that two rounds of deployment learning increase success from 51.0% to 71.7% in cells with at least one initial success, a gain of 20.7 percentage points. These findings support continued predictive learning for improving control through deployment experience, making world modeling an active part of WAM adaptation.

AI.tldr: 本文提出 DEWO，一种面向世界-动作模型（WAMs）的部署后学习范式，通过视觉经验优化世界表征以更好条件化动作生成，在仿真与真实灵巧操作任务中显著提升成功率。
AI.motivation: 当前部署后学习范式通常仅改进行为而不要求更好的世界预测；在灵巧操作中，高维动作空间的小误差会累积，阻碍策略改进，并使交互超出世界模型的训练分布。因此需要让世界建模成为 WAM 自适应中的主动部分。
AI.method: DEWO 在动作模仿之外，通过视觉经验精炼世界表征。它识别交互转折点，并从成功与失败的未来中学习以支持无分类器引导（classifier-free guidance）。额外的价值头从视频表征估计任务进度，并在推理时进度停滞时激活引导。
AI.result: 在五个 DexJoCo 任务上，DEWO 提升三种 WAM 形式的平均成功率。消融表明，来自成功与失败延续的视觉监督在预测和控制上均优于仅动作监督。在 Wuji 与 Sharpa 的四个真实任务上，3×3 网格评估显示两轮部署学习将至少有一次初始成功的单元格成功率从 51.0% 提升至 71.7%，增益 20.7 个百分点。
AI.conclusion: 结果支持通过部署经验进行持续预测学习来改进控制，使世界建模成为 WAM 自适应的主动组成部分。

title: Know Thyself, Teach Thyself: Internal Information Flow for Selective Self-Distillation
summary: Self-distillation turns knowledge distillation into a closed learning loop and offers a path toward recursive self-improvement. Without an external teacher, however, the model must determine both what information can improve its supervision and which induced changes should be learned. Existing methods typically improve teacher-generated data or select training examples in isolation, leaving the information transferred between these stages unmeasured. We introduce InFlow, a retrieval-guided on-policy self-distillation framework that models this process as potential-to-realized information flow. InFlow first retrieves potentially informative sources using certainty-calibrated hidden-state trajectories, then measures their realized effect through the Jensen--Shannon divergence between the teacher's initial and retrieval-conditioned answer beliefs. Examples with larger belief shifts are selected for on-policy distillation. Our analysis formalizes the information optimized by retrieval and selection and relates the answer-level shift to the teacher--student distillation gap. Across four open-weight language models and three knowledge domains, InFlow achieves the strongest cross-model average among the compared selection methods, with ablations supporting both stages of the framework. Our code is available at https://github.com/1240148048/INFLOW.

AI.tldr: 提出 InFlow 框架，将自蒸馏建模为"潜在信息→已实现信息"的流动过程，先基于确定性校准的隐状态轨迹检索潜在信息源，再通过教师初始与检索条件下答案信念的 JS 散度衡量已实现效果，选取信念位移大的样本进行 on-policy 蒸馏。
AI.motivation: 自蒸馏将知识蒸馏变为闭环学习回路，具备递归自我改进的潜力。但在缺少外部教师的情况下，模型必须自行判断哪些信息能改进其监督信号、以及哪些被诱导的变化应当被学习。现有方法通常孤立地改进教师生成数据或筛选训练样本，两阶段之间传递的信息量未被度量。
AI.method: InFlow 是一个检索引导的 on-policy 自蒸馏框架：1）利用确定性校准的隐状态轨迹检索潜在信息源；2）通过教师模型初始答案信念与检索条件化答案信念之间的 Jensen-Shannon 散度衡量其已实现效果；3）选取信念位移较大的样本进行 on-policy 蒸馏。文中还对检索与选择所优化的信息进行了形式化分析，并将答案层级的位移与师生蒸馏差距建立联系。
AI.result: 在四个开放权重语言模型和三个知识领域上，InFlow 在所比较的样本选择方法中取得了最强的跨模型平均表现；消融实验支持框架的两个阶段均有效。
AI.conclusion: InFlow 通过将自蒸馏中的检索与选择统一为潜在到已实现的信息流建模，提供了可度量的信息传递视角，并在多模型多领域上验证了其有效性。代码已开源。

title: Routing Should Pay for Itself: Sparse Supervision for Economical LLM Routing
summary: Large language model (LLM) routing reduces serving cost by assigning each query to an appropriate model while preserving response quality. Learning such a router, however, often requires executing multiple candidate models on historical queries to collect query--model quality feedback, creating a nontrivial supervision cost before deployment. Existing work largely focuses on serving-time efficiency, overlooking whether the resulting savings are sufficient to recover this upfront expenditure. We further observe that routing quality often saturates well before all query--model feedback is collected, suggesting that dense supervision can be economically over-provisioned. We propose SaveRouter, a sparse-supervision routing framework that selectively acquires informative model feedback and shares capability information across related queries, while retaining query-level refinement for fine-grained routing. We evaluate routing by jointly accounting for supervision expenditure and subsequent serving-time savings. Across four routing benchmarks, the main setting uses only about 33--41% of available training feedback while maintaining competitive or better routing quality, and reduces the break-even deployment volume by approximately 1.9--9.5 times compared with the fastest conventional router. Further analysis shows that acquiring more supervision is not always economically preferable: the supervision level that minimizes serving cost can differ from the one that achieves the earliest payback. Our code is publicly available at https://github.com/LAMDA-Model-Reuse/SaveRouter.

AI.tldr: 本文提出SaveRouter稀疏监督路由框架，通过选择性获取有信息量的模型反馈并跨相关查询共享能力信息，在仅使用33–41%训练反馈的情况下保持竞争力路由质量，并将盈亏平衡部署量降低约1.9–9.5倍。
AI.motivation: LLM路由通过为查询分配合适模型降低服务成本并保持响应质量，但学习路由器通常需在历史查询上执行多个候选模型以收集查询—模型质量反馈，产生不可忽视的部署前监督成本。现有工作多聚焦服务时效率，忽视节省是否足以回收前期支出；且路由质量常在收集全部反馈前就饱和，密集监督可能经济上过度供给。
AI.method: 提出SaveRouter稀疏监督路由框架：选择性获取有信息量的模型反馈，跨相关查询共享能力信息，同时保留查询级细化以实现细粒度路由；并在评估中联合考虑监督支出与后续服务时节省。
AI.result: 在四个路由基准上，主设置仅使用约33–41%可用训练反馈，保持竞争性或更优的路由质量，并将盈亏平衡部署量相比最快的传统路由器降低约1.9–9.5倍。分析表明获取更多监督并非总是经济上更优：最小化服务成本的监督水平可能与实现最早回本的水平不同。
AI.conclusion: 路由应联合优化监督成本与服务节省，稀疏监督可在保持质量的同时显著降低盈亏平衡部署量，且最优服务成本与最早回本的监督水平可能不一致，代码已公开。

title: Learned Queries and Keys Are All You Need: Replacing the Value Projection with Structured Transforms
summary: To reduce the number of parameters and cache memory requirements of transformers we introduce dual-headed transformers instead of three heads. We studied Walsh-Hadamard Transform (WHT), Discrete Cosine Transform (DCT), Discrete Fourier Transform, filterbank based Shearlet Transform, and Multiplication-Avoiding (MA) operators to construct dual heads. We combine spatial patches and their orthogonal transforms (or Shearlet and MA operators) in a structure similar to the attention block. We obtained better results than triple headed transformers in ImageNet. Extensive simulation examples are presented.

AI.tldr: 提出双头Transformer替代标准三头结构以减少参数量和缓存需求，通过结合空间patch与其正交变换（WHT、DCT、DFT、Shearlet、MA算子）构建双头注意力模块，在ImageNet上取得优于三头Transformer的结果。
AI.motivation: 标准Transformer的三头结构带来较高的参数量和缓存内存开销，需要一种更轻量的替代方案来降低资源需求，同时保持或提升性能。
AI.method: 用双头Transformer替代三头结构，考察多种变换方式构建头：Walsh-Hadamard变换(WHT)、离散余弦变换(DCT)、离散傅里叶变换(DFT)、基于滤波器组的Shearlet变换，以及免乘法(MA)算子。将空间patch与其正交变换（或Shearlet与MA算子）以类似注意力块的结构进行组合。
AI.result: 在ImageNet上取得优于三头Transformer的性能表现，并给出了大量仿真实验示例。
AI.conclusion: 双头Transformer可有效减少参数与缓存内存，同时通过正交变换或MA算子组合空间信息，在视觉任务中超越传统三头Transformer，验证了该轻量化设计的有效性。

title: Demistifying Data and Simulator Assumptions in Supervised Causal Discovery
summary: Supervised causal discovery learns to infer causal structure for a new dataset from training datasets paired with structural labels. These training pairs are typically simulated, making the simulator both a source of supervision and a carrier of assumptions about causal graphs, mechanisms, and noise. Understanding the resulting predictions therefore requires examining how these assumptions supplement the information available in observational data, which may be compatible with multiple causal graphs. This paper examines that relationship across representative methods available through June 2026. We organize these methods by prediction target, prediction granularity, encoder, structural decoder, and training regime to relate what each method predicts to how it uses data and simulator-based supervision. Using this framework, we distinguish two questions: whether the target is identifiable under the assumed model class, and whether a trained predictor generalizes beyond its training distribution. Restrictions on mechanisms and noise can make otherwise ambiguous causal directions identifiable, but predictive accuracy under those restrictions does not establish transfer when they change. This distinction motivates evaluation that matches metrics to the identifiable graph target and tests changes in graphs, mechanisms, and noise between training and deployment. Extending such evaluation to real data also requires documenting the external causal evidence and uncertainty behind benchmark reference graphs. Together, these analyses guide method comparison and identify open questions in transfer, test-time adaptation, and uncertainty assessment.

AI.tldr: 本文综述截至2026年6月的有监督因果发现方法，按预测目标、粒度、编码器、结构解码器与训练范式分类，并区分"可识别性"与"泛化性"两个问题，提出应使评价指标匹配可识别的图目标，并检验图、机制与噪声分布偏移下的迁移能力。
AI.motivation: 有监督因果发现依赖模拟数据生成训练对，模拟器既是监督来源，也承载了关于因果图、机制与噪声的假设。观测数据本身常与多个因果图相容，因此理解预测结果必须厘清这些假设如何补充观测信息、在多大程度上决定了所推断的结构，而现有工作缺乏对这一关系的统一梳理。
AI.method: 采用文献综述与概念框架构建的方法，覆盖截至2026年6月的代表性方法，按预测目标、预测粒度、编码器、结构解码器和训练范式五个维度进行归类，将每种方法"预测什么"与"如何使用数据及模拟器监督"对应起来，并在该框架下区分两个独立问题：在假定模型类下目标是否可识别，以及训练后的预测器能否泛化到训练分布之外。
AI.result: 分析表明，对机制与噪声施加限制可使原本模糊的因果方向变得可识别，但在这些限制下取得的预测精度并不能保证限制条件变化时的迁移能力。据此，评价应当使度量指标与可识别的图目标相匹配，并系统测试训练与部署之间在图结构、机制和噪声上的变化；将此类评价扩展到真实数据还需记录基准参考图背后的外部因果证据及其不确定性。
AI.conclusion: 本文通过统一的分类框架厘清了有监督因果发现中模拟器假设、可识别性与泛化性之间的关系，为方法比较提供了依据，并指出迁移学习、测试时自适应与不确定性评估等方面的开放问题。

title: When Is Coarse Supervision Worth It? Cost-Aware Learning under Unknown Aggregation
summary: Modern learning systems often acquire supervision at multiple resolutions, trading annotation cost against information content. We study cost-aware two-resolution learning, where expensive fine labels reveal a vector response and cheaper coarse labels reveal a scalar aggregate formed with unknown weights, while the target remains the full response. The challenge is that unknown aggregation changes which directions coarse data can identify, so the value of coarse supervision depends jointly on cost, noise, and identification. We characterize this information geometry and develop an estimate-and-track policy that learns the aggregation rule and tracks the optimal resolution mix. We derive a closed-form break-even condition for coarse supervision and prove that the online policy attains the optimal leading cumulative-risk coefficient, with a matching local asymptotic minimax lower bound. Synthetic experiments support the predicted all-fine/mixed transition, show the online learner approaching the oracle-share benchmark, and demonstrate a finite-budget gain over all-fine acquisition when coarse supervision is sufficiently favorable. Our results provide a principled way to balance information and annotation cost across supervision resolutions.

AI.tldr: 研究成本感知的两种分辨率学习：昂贵细标签揭示向量响应，廉价粗标签揭示未知权重的标量聚合，目标为完整响应；刻画信息几何并提出估计-跟踪策略实现最优分辨率混合。
AI.motivation: 现代学习系统常在多种分辨率下获取监督以权衡标注成本与信息量，但未知聚合规则会改变粗数据可识别的方向，使粗监督的价值同时取决于成本、噪声与可识别性，现有方法缺乏统一刻画。
AI.method: 将问题建模为成本感知的两种分辨率学习；刻画其信息几何；提出"估计-跟踪"（estimate-and-track）策略，同时学习未知聚合规则并跟踪最优分辨率混合；推导粗监督的闭式盈亏平衡条件，并给出在线策略的累积风险系数分析与局部渐近极小极大下界证明。
AI.result: 证明在线策略达到最优的首阶累积风险系数，且具有匹配的局部渐近极小极大下界；合成实验验证了"全细/混合"相变现象，在线学习器逼近oracle份额基准，并在粗监督足够有利时相对全细采集取得有限预算增益。
AI.conclusion: 研究为跨监督分辨率平衡信息与标注成本提供了有理论依据的原则性方法。

title: Commitment Hierarchies under Intent Revision: A Belief-Revision Account of Salvage in Tool-Use Agents
comment: Accepted in the 27th International Conference on Principles and Practice of Multi-Agent Systems
summary: When a user changes their mind partway through a task, an agent that has already split the task into sub-goals and paid for tool calls must decide, per cached sub-result, whether to keep, patch, or discard it (salvage), restarting wastes valid work and continuing unchanged answers the old question. Our main finding is that salvage quality is a matter of role design rather than model capability: a language model asked the keep/patch/discard question one node at a time is unreliable, but asked to classify the revision once, with a deterministic layer propagating the decision, it reaches the cost-optimal oracle on all three models tested, from two vendors. Modeling the plan as a commitment hierarchy and the intent change as a belief-revision operator with AGM style postulates, we prove that no policy observing only a node's local view can be both safe and cost optimal, while the single classification design is both. Across three environments the policy recovers the full achievable savings, 43% cheaper than restart, at 100% correctness.

AI.tldr: 将计划建模为承诺层级、把意图变更视为AGM信念修正算子后，证明仅依赖节点局部视图的策略无法兼得安全与成本最优，而"一次性分类+确定性传播"设计可同时满足，并在三个环境、两家厂商的三个模型上达到成本最优oracle（较重启省43%，正确率100%）。
AI.motivation: 用户中途改变意图时，已完成子目标拆分并支付工具调用成本的智能体，需对每个缓存子结果决定保留/修补/丢弃。重启会浪费有效工作，原样继续则答非所问，因此需要一个既能保证正确性又能最大化复用已有成本的"抢救"（salvage）策略。
AI.method: 将任务计划建模为承诺层级（commitment hierarchy），把意图变更形式化为满足AGM公设的信念修正算子；在此基础上论证策略性质，并对比两种设计：逐节点向语言模型询问keep/patch/discard，与只做一次修订分类、再由确定性层传播该决策。
AI.result: 逐节点询问的模型表现不可靠；单次分类+确定性传播设计在两家厂商的三个测试模型上均达到成本最优oracle。理论证明：任何仅观察节点局部视图的策略都无法同时保证安全与成本最优，而单次分类设计两者兼具。三个环境中该策略均完全获得可达节省，比重启便宜43%，正确率100%。
AI.conclusion: 抢救质量取决于角色设计而非模型能力：把决策收敛为一次分类、由确定性层传播，即可在无需更强模型的情况下实现安全且成本最优的复用策略。

title: CALIBUDGET: Calibration-Guided Source Allocation for Fixed-Budget Mixed-Reasoning Adaptation
summary: Fixed-budget adaptation from heterogeneous data sources requires deciding not only how much data to use, but how much exposure each source receives. Size-proportional rules can crowd out small sources, whereas difficulty-only rules can chase noisy estimates or allocate residual budget to nearly saturated pools. We introduce CALIBUDGET, a floor-protected, reliability-aware integer allocator that treats source exposure as an explicit adaptation variable. From small train-internal calibration splits, it combines model need, post-floor availability, and bootstrap stability, then produces exact capacity-respecting quotas without changing the model, objective, or total budget. In a controlled setting combining mathematical and commonsense data, CALIBUDGET improves CommonAvg, FragileAvg, and MacroAvg over validation-error-with-floor, the strongest matched comparator, in all three paired LLaMA-2-7B LoRA+ runs. The respective mean gains are 0.56, 0.46, and 0.41 percentage points (pp). Overall increases by 0.18 pp, whereas MathAvg decreases by 0.20 pp, exposing a coverage-retention boundary rather than a uniform gain. CALIBUDGET changes only 1.14-1.42% of the source budget but improves performance in 15 of 24 comparisons across commonsense tasks and seeds. These results suggest that small changes in source quotas can matter; example-level selection can then determine which examples fill each quota.

AI.tldr: CALIBUDGET：一种带下限保护、考虑可靠性的整数预算分配器，将数据源曝光量作为显式适配变量，在固定预算下分配异构数据源配额。
AI.motivation: 固定预算下从异构数据源适配数据时，不仅要决定用多少数据，还要决定各数据源获得多少曝光。按规模比例分配会挤压小数据源；仅按难度分配又会追逐噪声估计，或把剩余预算分给接近饱和的数据池。
AI.method: CALIBUDGET 在小规模训练内部校准集上，结合模型需求、扣减下限后的可用量与 bootstrap 稳定性，生成严格满足容量约束的整数配额；不改变模型、目标函数或总预算。
AI.result: 在数学与常识数据混合的受控设置中，CALIBUDGET 在三次 LLaMA-2-7B LoRA+ 配对运行中，相对最强匹配对照 validation-error-with-floor，同时提升 CommonAvg、FragileAvg、MacroAvg，平均增益分别为 0.56、0.46、0.41 个百分点；Overall 提升 0.18 pp，但 MathAvg 下降 0.20 pp。仅改变 1.14–1.42% 的源预算，却在 24 组常识任务与随机种子比较中 15 组性能提升。
AI.conclusion: 源配额的小幅变化即可产生显著影响；在配额确定后，可由样本级选择决定哪些样本填充各配额，并存在覆盖-保留权衡边界，而非一致增益。

title: Governing the Edge: Automating Commercial Property and Casualty Insurance Underwriting via a Hybrid Local-Cloud Multi-Agent Framework
comment: Accepted at AIxB 2026. 6 pages, 2 figures, 7 tables. Data and Code in github: https://github.com/vsingh45/governing-the-edge
summary: Underwriters in commercial Property and Casualty (P&C) insurance spend 30 to 40% of their time on administrative work rather than risk judgment, and a single submission takes about 40 minutes by hand. We present Governing the Edge, a multi-agent framework for that layer, organized around a data-residency constraint: sensitive submission data must not leave the perimeter. Eleven agents and two deterministic control nodes, one a human-escalation interrupt, form a 13-node LangGraph workflow across two tiers. Agents touching raw submissions run locally on Gemma 2, each bound through a tool interface logging every invocation (synthetic stubs in the current prototype); only anonymized scores and non-identifying fields cross to Claude Sonnet in the cloud. Compliance rules are encoded as conditions on graph edges, so a non-compliant submission never reaches pricing. We walk through one full scenario end to end, a commercial auto submission whose principal driver carries serious violations, showing every agent call, every tool invocation, and the resulting routing decision. The framework processes a 40-minute manual submission in a few minutes on a single edge device, dominated by serialized on-device inference. On the hard-stop violation tier the framework enforces every rule correctly and reproducibly, since hard stops are deterministic predicates over fields extracted at temperature 0; overall compliance accuracy across the 20-scenario benchmark is 70%, with the remaining gap concentrated in softer, judgment-based tiers. It keeps a complete audit trail and respects the privacy boundary throughout. We release all code, compliance rules, tool stubs, and synthetic datasets.

AI.tldr: 提出多智能体框架"Governing the Edge"，以数据驻留为约束，将P&C保险承保流程部署在边缘设备上：11个智能体+2个确定性控制节点组成13节点LangGraph双层工作流，敏感数据本地处理、仅匿名化结果上云。可将40分钟人工提交缩短至数分钟，硬性违规层级100%正确，整体合规准确率70%，全程保留审计轨迹并遵守隐私边界。
AI.motivation: 商业财产与意外险（P&C）承保人员将30–40%的时间耗费在行政性工作上而非风险判断，单次投保提交人工处理约需40分钟。同时，承保涉及敏感提交数据，须满足数据驻留要求，即敏感数据不得离开本地边界。
AI.method: 提出"Governing the Edge"多智能体框架。采用双层架构：11个智能体与2个确定性控制节点（其中之一为人工升级中断）构成13节点LangGraph工作流。接触原始提交数据的智能体在本地以Gemma 2运行，各自通过工具接口绑定并记录每次调用（当前原型使用合成桩）；仅匿名化评分与非标识字段传至云端Claude Sonnet。合规规则以图边条件形式编码，不合规提交无法进入定价环节。
AI.result: 以一份商业车险提交（主驾驶员存在严重违规）进行端到端场景演示，展示每次智能体调用、工具调用及路由决策。单台边缘设备上数分钟即可完成原本40分钟的人工提交，耗时主要由串行化的端侧推理主导。在硬性违规层级，由于硬性中止温度0提取字段上的确定性谓词，框架正确且可复现地执行每条规则；20场景基准上的整体合规准确率为70%，剩余差距集中在较软、依赖判断的层级。
AI.conclusion: 该框架全程保留完整审计轨迹并遵守隐私边界。作者开源全部代码、合规规则、工具桩及合成数据集。

title: Routing in Gradient Space: Balanced Usage Is Not Expert Specialization
summary: Sparse expert models can distribute traffic evenly while still grouping incompatible training signals within the same experts. We study routing as a gradient-partitioning problem and introduce gradient-aligned routing (GAR), whose load-normalized router objective rewards grouping observations with aligned gradients. On five multi-task text-classification mixtures, we compare GAR with task-loss-only routing, gradient-combination and gradient-conflict methods, and load-balancing losses. With a fully trainable RoBERTa backbone and classification-head experts, GAR has the highest aggregate validation accuracy, 1.07 percentage points above task-loss-only routing. With frozen DeBERTa and Qwen3-1.7B backbones and low-rank adapter experts, it again ranks first, 1.10 points above task-loss-only routing, with better-balanced expert load and higher gradient-mass purity, the share of each expert's gradient-norm mass from its dominant task; the load-balancing losses flatten load further but leave this purity near its task-loss-only level. Top-1 routing, trainable full-parameter feed-forward network (FFN) experts, and a larger backbone also show positive aggregate gains. The results distinguish expert-load balance from gradient-based routing organization and indicate the predictive value of gradient-informed routing in multi-task text classification.

AI.tldr: 该论文将稀疏专家模型的路由问题重新表述为梯度划分问题，提出梯度对齐路由（GAR），在多任务文本分类上取得最优聚合准确率，并揭示了专家负载均衡与梯度组织之间的区别。
AI.motivation: 稀疏专家模型虽能均匀分配流量（负载均衡），但仍可能将梯度不兼容（相互冲突）的训练信号归入同一专家，导致专家内部信号混杂。作者希望从梯度划分的视角研究路由，使同一专家内聚合的观测具有对齐的梯度。
AI.method: 提出梯度对齐路由（GAR）：采用负载归一化的路由目标，奖励将梯度对齐（一致）的观测分到同一专家。在五个多任务文本分类混合数据集上，将GAR与仅任务损失路由、梯度组合与梯度冲突方法以及负载均衡损失进行对比。实验设置包括：(1) 完全可训练的RoBERTa主干 + 分类头专家；(2) 冻结的DeBERTa与Qwen3-1.7B主干 + 低秩适配器专家。评估指标包括聚合验证准确率、专家负载均衡度，以及梯度质量纯度（gradient-mass purity，即某专家梯度范数质量中来自其主导任务的占比）。
AI.result: 在可训练RoBERTa+分类头专家设置下，GAR聚合验证准确率最高，比仅任务损失路由高1.07个百分点；在冻结DeBERTa/Qwen3-1.7B+低秩适配器专家设置下同样排名第一，比仅任务损失路由高1.10个百分点，同时专家负载更均衡、梯度质量纯度更高。负载均衡损失能进一步拉平负载，但纯度仍停留在仅任务损失路由的水平。Top-1路由、可训练全参数FFN专家以及更大主干也均显示正向聚合增益。
AI.conclusion: 结果区分了专家负载均衡与基于梯度的路由组织这两个不同概念，表明梯度信息驱动的路由在多任务文本分类中具有预测价值。

title: Backpropagated Output Momentum: Relocating Optimizer History from Parameters to Task Space
summary: Optimizer momentum is usually stored as a parameter-sized moving average of past gradients, which makes history costly and fixes each past signal in the coordinates in which it was computed. We introduce Backpropagated Output Momentum (BOM), which instead stores a compact moving average of prediction errors at the model output and reprojects that history through the current network at every step. A batch-level analysis characterizes the information retained and omitted by this relocation, while the implementation preserves the current supervised gradient and can replace the first-moment component of several adaptive optimizers. As a plug-in for momentum-based optimizers, including ones that already compress their state, BOM reduces parameter-shaped optimizer state by 49.7-99.8% in three compositions and, averaged over three language backbones, paired step time by 4.0%. It also improves mean validation performance across language and vision fine-tuning, by 1.42 points in the primary five-task comparison. Language and vision pretraining studies, together with matched mechanism controls, further test the construction across output spaces and model scales.

AI.tldr: 提出Backpropagated Output Momentum (BOM)，将动量存储从参数级梯度移动平均改为模型输出的紧凑预测误差移动平均，并在每步通过当前网络重投影。作为插件可替换多种自适应优化器的一阶矩，参数级状态减少49.7–99.8%，步时平均缩短4.0%，语言与视觉微调平均验证性能提升1.42分。
AI.motivation: 传统优化器动量以参数规模存储历史梯度移动平均，导致历史存储开销大，且每个历史信号被固定在计算时的坐标中，无法随网络参数变化而重新表达。
AI.method: BOM在模型输出端存储预测误差的紧凑移动平均，每步通过当前网络将该历史重投影回参数空间；给出批次级分析刻画该重定位所保留与丢失的信息；实现上保持当前监督梯度，可替换多种自适应优化器的第一矩组件，包括已压缩状态的优化器。
AI.result: 在三种组合中参数形状优化器状态减少49.7–99.8%；在三个语言骨干上平均步时提升4.0%；语言与视觉微调平均验证性能提升，主要五任务比较中提高1.42分；语言与视觉预训练研究及匹配机制对照进一步验证其跨输出空间与模型规模的构造。
AI.conclusion: BOM通过将动量历史从参数空间迁移到输出空间并动态重投影，在显著降低优化器状态开销与步时的同时提升下游微调性能，具备作为通用插件的潜力。

title: CRASM-Gate: Deterministic-First Constraint- and Role-Aware Semantic Mapping with Selective Model Assistance Across Heterogeneous Industrial Standards
summary: Industrial standards often encode the same engineering concept through incompatible hierarchies, identifiers, roles, and structural constraints, so the nearest lexical or embedding match can still be technically inadmissible. This article presents CRASM, a deterministic constraint- and role-aware semantic mapping method, and CRASM-Gate, its selectively model-assisted extension. The framework separates standard-specific canonicalization, bounded retrieval, deterministic rules, destination-versus-origin role interpretation, semantic and structural ranking, ambiguity refusal, and target validation. CRASM-Gate adds a confidence/disagreement gate that may invoke a candidate-constrained large language model, while final authority remains with deterministic validation. A controlled artifact covers six directed industrial-standard pairs, three difficulty levels, and ten configurations, yielding 14,400 sample-level decisions. With a fixed local model endpoint, CRASM-Gate reaches mean F1 0.9938 and an implemented structural-validity rate of 1.0000; deterministic CRASM reaches 0.9931 without generative-model calls; and the model-only baseline reaches 0.5347. Relative to the model-only baseline, CRASM reduces top-1 errors from 670 to 10 while exhibiting 0.0688 s/sample rather than 24.5263 s/sample observed latency. CRASM-Gate improves CRASM by one additional correct decision out of 1,440, with observed latency increasing to 15.7666 s/sample. The results support a deterministic-first interoperability architecture in which model assistance is optional, measurable, candidate-bounded, and unable to bypass structural validation.

AI.tldr: 本文提出 CRASM（确定性约束与角色感知语义映射方法）及其可选模型辅助扩展 CRASM-Gate，用于工业标准间的语义映射，实现确定性优先、模型辅助受控的互操作架构。
AI.motivation: 工业标准常以不兼容的层次结构、标识符、角色和结构约束编码相同的工程概念，导致最近的词法或嵌入匹配在技术上仍可能不可接受，因此需要更可靠的映射方法。
AI.method: 框架将标准特定的规范化、有界检索、确定性规则、目标对来源的角色解释、语义与结构排序、歧义拒识和目标验证分离；CRASM-Gate 增加置信度/分歧门控，可调用候选受限的大语言模型，但最终裁决权仍归确定性验证。
AI.result: 在六个有向工业标准对、三个难度级别、十种配置、共14,400条样本级决策的受控工件上：固定本地模型端点时，CRASM-Gate 平均 F1 为 0.9938，结构有效率为 1.0000；确定性 CRASM 为 0.9931 且无生成模型调用；纯模型基线为 0.5347。相比基线，CRASM 将 top-1 错误从 670 降至 10，延迟为 0.0688 s/样本 vs 24.5263 s/样本；CRASM-Gate 在 1,440 条中多出 1 条正确决策，延迟升至 15.7666 s/样本。
AI.conclusion: 结果支持确定性优先的互操作架构：模型辅助是可选的、可度量的、候选受限的，且无法绕过结构验证。

title: Efficient Offline Learning of Ranking Policies via Top-$k$ Policy Decomposition
comment: Published as a conference paper at CIKM 2026
summary: Many recommender systems such as for e-commerce and news platforms aim to provide users with rankings they are likely to interact with. Off-Policy Learning (OPL) of ranking policies enables us to learn new ranking policies using only historical logged data. However, ranking settings make OPL remarkably challenging because their action spaces consist of permutations of unique items, being extremely large. Existing methods primarily use either policy- or regression-based approaches. The policy-based approach, which typically uses importance-weighted policy gradients, can suffer from high variance due to large action spaces. The regression-based approach, on the other hand, estimates the expected reward using conventional machine learning methods, avoiding variance issues but potentially suffering from severe bias. To circumvent these issues of existing methods, we propose a new OPL method for ranking, named Ranking Policy Optimization via Top-$k$ Policy Decomposition (R-POD), which combines the policy- and regression-based approaches in an effective fashion. Specifically, R-POD decomposes a ranking policy into a first-stage policy for selecting top-$k$ actions and a second-stage policy for choosing the bottom actions given the top-$k$ actions. It learns the first-stage policy using a new policy gradient estimator and the second-stage policy via the regression-based approach. This method can substantially reduce variance, since it applies importance weighting only to the top-$k$ actions. We also demonstrate that our policy-gradient estimator for the first-stage policy is unbiased under a conditional pairwise correctness condition, which only requires that the expected reward differences of pairs of rankings sharing the same top-$k$ actions can be estimated correctly.

AI.tldr: 提出R-POD方法，将排序策略分解为top-k选择与底部动作两阶段，分别用策略梯度和回归方法学习，在降低方差的同时保持无偏性。
AI.motivation: 排序策略的离线学习（OPL）面临动作空间极大（唯一项目的排列）的挑战。策略梯度方法因重要性加权而方差过大，回归方法虽回避方差但偏差严重，需要兼顾两者优势的新方法。
AI.method: R-POD将排序策略分解为：第一阶段策略选择top-k动作，第二阶段策略在给定top-k条件下选择剩余（底部）动作。第一阶段用新的策略梯度估计器学习（仅对top-k动作施加重要性加权），第二阶段用基于回归的方法学习。
AI.result: 大幅降低方差，因为重要性加权仅作用于top-k动作；并证明第一阶段的策略梯度估计器在条件成对正确性条件下是无偏的，该条件仅要求共享相同top-k动作的成对排序的期望奖励差能被正确估计。
AI.conclusion: R-POD有效地结合策略与回归方法，为大规模排列动作空间的离线排序策略学习提供了低方差且具无偏性保证的解决方案。

title: Authority Before Utility: Non-Compensatory Control for Persistent LLM Memory
summary:
Persistent memory creates a control problem that retrieval relevance alone does not solve: a memory can remain highly useful after an update, deletion, or revocation makes it inadmissible for the current answer. We formalize this as a separation between utility and authority. A fixed finite penalty applied to an unnormalized utility score cannot guarantee exclusion under arbitrary positive-affine reparameterization of that score; by contrast, rank-normalized compensation is scale-invariant and therefore forms a stronger empirical comparator.
  Our prospectively frozen TIDE/LongMemEval primary was quarantined before a valid HELDOUT comparison because the materialized TIDE adapter conflated historical age with query-relative inadmissibility and the aligned LongMemEval split left no DEV set for the predeclared penalty selection. We therefore report a post-primary replacement diagnostic on Memora Remembering, where update/delete operations provide item-level forgetting state.
  On Qwen3-8B, DEV selected lambda = 0.6 from a ten-point normalized SOFT family. Across 185 HELDOUT units in 28 dependency clusters, HARD exclusion yields 4.04% balanced construct error versus 19.66% for locked SOFT, a paired difference of 15.61 points with a 20,000-replicate cluster-bootstrap 95% interval of [13.07, 18.76].
  The effect is driven primarily by forgotten-value leakage while current-value recall is preserved. This is same-Q operator-comparison evidence, not a universal claim that scalar control fails, not an evaluation of learned authority inference, and not an independent downstream-harm endpoint.

AI.tldr: 该论文区分记忆的“效用”与“可采纳性（权威性）”，形式化持久记忆中的控制问题，并在一项后验替代诊断实验中验证硬排除（HARD）相对归一化软惩罚（SOFT）的优势。
AI.motivation: 检索相关性无法解决持久记忆的控制问题：记忆在更新、删除或撤销后可能仍然“有用”，但已不具备回答当前问题的资格（不可采纳）。作者因此将效用与权威性分离，并指出固定有限惩罚在任意正仿射重参数化下无法保证排除，而秩归一化补偿具有尺度不变性，是更强的经验对照基线。
AI.method: 原预注册 TIDE/LongMemEval 主实验因材料化适配器混淆历史时效与查询相对不可采纳性、且对齐后的 LongMemEval 划分无 DEV 集用于预先声明的惩罚选择，在有效 HELDOUT 比较前被隔离。作者改为在 Memora Remembering（更新/删除操作提供条目级遗忘状态）上报告后验替代诊断。在 Qwen3-8B 上，从十点归一化 SOFT 族中经 DEV 选择 lambda = 0.6，并在 28 个依赖簇、共 185 个 HELDOUT 单元上比较 HARD 与锁定的 SOFT 排除。
AI.result: HARD 排除的平衡构念错误率为 4.04%，锁定 SOFT 为 19.66%，配对差为 15.61 个百分点，20,000 次重复的簇自举 95% 区间为 [13.07, 18.76]。效应主要来源于遗忘值泄漏，而当前值召回得以保持。
AI.conclusion: 该结果属于同一 Q 算子比较证据，不构成“标量控制普遍失败”的普适性主张，也不是对学习式权威推断的评估，亦非独立的 downstream-harm 端点。其结论限于：在具有条目级遗忘状态的持久记忆场景中，归一化补偿框架下 HARD 排除显著优于 SOFT 惩罚。

title: Group-Marginalized Self-Rewarding RL Drives Zero-Label Self-Evolving
summary: Self-rewarding reinforcement learning (RL) enables large language models (LLMs) to self-evolve without human labels. Existing ensemble-based methods construct reward references from rollout groups and assign rewards accordingly. However, a response's reward representation also depends on its randomly sampled group context, i.e., the other responses in its group. Using only one group-context realization may miss desired reward signals and provide unreliable guidance for policy optimization. To address this issue, we propose Group-Marginalized Advantage Estimation (GMAE), which aggregates reward realizations across possible contexts into a response-level distribution and estimates expected advantages. Experiments across eight benchmarks and four base models demonstrate strong performance and cross-domain generalization. GMAE also exhibits stable learning, low extra cost, and good applicability across training datasets and RL backbones.

AI.tldr: 提出GMAE（组边缘化优势估计），通过对响应在所有可能组上下文上的奖励实现进行聚合，构建响应级奖励分布并估计期望优势，缓解单一组上下文导致的奖励信号缺失问题。
AI.motivation: 现有基于集成（ensemble）的自奖励强化学习方法依赖rollout分组构建奖励参考，但单个响应的奖励表示还取决于其随机采样的组上下文（即同组其他响应）。仅使用一种组上下文实现可能遗漏期望的奖励信号，从而为策略优化提供不可靠的指导。
AI.method: 提出Group-Marginalized Advantage Estimation (GMAE)：将响应在不同可能组上下文下的多种奖励实现进行边缘化聚合，形成响应级（response-level）奖励分布，并基于该分布估计期望优势（expected advantages），用于策略优化。
AI.result: 在八个基准和四个基座模型上实验，GMAE展现出强劲性能与跨域泛化能力；同时具备稳定的学习过程、较低的额外开销，并在不同训练数据集和RL骨干网络上具有良好的适用性。
AI.conclusion: GMAE通过边缘化组上下文消除了自奖励RL中因组采样随机性带来的奖励估计偏差，是一种高效、稳定且通用的优势估计方案。

title: Boundary-State Control for Tool-Using Language-Model Agents: Commit-Time Consistency under State Drift
summary: Tool-using language-model agents can decide that an action is permissible and execute it only after security-relevant state has changed. We study this proposal-to-commit gap and introduce BSC-R, a deterministic effect-boundary mechanism that binds a single-use commit authorization to the exact action and to a semantic projection of the authorization state that justified it. On 2,847 attacked AgentDojo episodes, the boundary kernel preserves the unprotected agent's behavior exactly (80.576% utility; 1.616% attack success). On 10,302 frozen proposals, it accepts every unchanged commit and rejects every instance of ten prospectively specified changed or replayed classes. In an independently generated boundary-drift experiment, full joint binding commits 0/4,403 invalid contexts while retaining 5,899/5,899 valid contexts. A prospective external evaluation on the 3,460-scenario CONTINUITY suite retains all 700 benign cases, prevents 1,200/1,200 represented non-replay invalid effects, handles 160/160 replay lifecycles correctly, and withholds 200/200 ambiguous no-release cases. The broader external suite also exposes the method's limit: across all 2,560 attacks, BSC-R has a 25% invalid-effect commit rate versus 0% for CONTINUITY. The result is therefore a scoped commit-time consistency mechanism, not a universal agent-safety claim.

AI.tldr: 本文研究工具调用型语言模型智能体中"提议—提交"间隙的安全风险，提出确定性效应边界机制BSC-R，将一次性提交授权绑定到具体动作及授权状态语义投影，并在多组受控与外部评测中验证其一致性与局限。
AI.motivation: 工具使用型LLM智能体可能在安全相关状态已变更后，仍判定某动作可允许并执行，从而产生"提议—提交"间隙。现有防护缺乏提交时刻的状态一致性约束，需要一种能在提交时精确校验授权依据是否仍成立的机制。
AI.method: BSC-R为确定性效应边界机制：将单次提交授权绑定到（1）确切动作与（2）支撑该授权的授权状态之语义投影。通过边界内核在提交时刻进行联合绑定校验，区分未变更、变更与重放等类别。评估使用AgentDojo攻防回合、冻结提议集、独立生成的边界漂移实验，以及前瞻性外部评测CONTINUITY套件。
AI.result: 在2,847个受攻击AgentDojo回合上，边界内核完全保持未受保护智能体行为（效用80.576%，攻击成功率1.616%）；在10,302个冻结提议上，接受全部未变更提交，拒绝十类前瞻指定变更/重放实例的全部样本；边界漂移实验中，完整联合绑定对4,403个无效上下文提交0个，同时保留5,899/5,899有效上下文；CONTINUITY套件3,460场景中保留全部700个良性用例，阻止1,200/1,200非重放无效效应，正确处理160/160重放生命周期，并对200/200模糊无释放用例不予提交。局限方面，在更广外部套件的全部2,560次攻击中，BSC-R无效效应提交率为25%，而CONTINUITY为0%。
AI.conclusion: BSC-R是一种有明确适用范围的提交时刻一致性机制，而非通用智能体安全方案。其在受控与部分外部评测中表现出一致性与精确性，但在更广攻击分布下仍存在25%的无效效应提交率，表明其有效性依赖于状态投影与效应类别的覆盖范围。

title: cktFormer: Transformer-Based Approach for Automated Analog Circuit Design
comment: 6 pages, 6 figures, IECON 2025 51st Annual Conference of the IEEE Industrial Electronics Society
summary: Circuit design is a complex and iterative process that requires expertise in electronic engineering. It involves selecting components while meeting performance constraints, such as power efficiency, cost-effectiveness, and signal integrity. However, manual design is time-consuming and prone to errors. Although other stages of the manufacturing pipeline have benefited from AI-driven optimizations, circuit design remains a bottleneck, limiting overall productivity. Generative AI and machine learning offer the potential to automate and improve this stage, boosting efficiency and accuracy. To address this, we introduce a dual transformer architecture that bridges the gap between AI and circuit design by leveraging attention mechanisms to model complex, non-sequential circuit relationships. Our approach structures netlist data into graph-based representations, enabling effective learning of circuit topology and component interactions. The system consists of two interlinked models: a node prediction model that proposes components and an edge prediction model that infers valid connections. This collaborative and decoupled design captures both component-level semantics and global structural coherence. In our experiments, this architecture outperforms recent models such as AnalogGenie and cktGNN in the validity of generated circuits. By addressing key limitations in existing methods, our work advances automation in electronics engineering and contributes a benchmark for AI-driven circuit synthesis.

AI.tldr: 本文提出一种双Transformer架构，通过图表示与注意力机制实现电路网表的元件预测与连接推断，生成电路的合法性优于AnalogGenie与cktGNN。
AI.motivation: 电路设计高度依赖专家经验且需迭代权衡功耗、成本、信号完整性等约束，人工设计耗时易错；制造流程其他环节已受益于AI优化，而电路设计仍是效率瓶颈。生成式AI与机器学习有望自动化该环节，但现有方法在建模电路复杂关系上存在局限。
AI.method: 提出双Transformer架构：将网表数据组织为图结构表示，以学习电路拓扑与元件交互；架构由两个相互关联但解耦的模型组成——节点预测模型负责提出元件，边预测模型负责推断有效连接，从而同时捕捉元件级语义与全局结构一致性。
AI.result: 实验表明，该架构在生成电路的有效性上优于AnalogGenie和cktGNN等近期模型。
AI.conclusion: 该工作针对现有方法的关键局限，推动了电子工程设计的自动化，并为AI驱动的电路综合提供了基准。

title: SkillGym: Training Skill-Use Agents with Automatic Verifiable Environment Generation
summary: Skills equip LLM agents with professional knowledge and guidance to complete long-horizon and complex tasks. Although skills have been widely adopted in recent agent paradigms and harnesses, how to synthesize reliable training data and how to train agents for skill use remain underexplored. In this work, we propose SkillGym, an automatic pipeline to build verifiable environments, collect trajectories, and train skill-use agents. SkillGym first crawls a large volume of skills from the internet, then keeps those whose workflows can run reproducibly offline. A builder-reviewer pipeline is used to construct difficulty-controlled tasks, spanning four task types, each with a reference solution and an executable verifier. With this pipeline, we build 6.8k environments and collect 19k verified successful trajectories for supervised finetuning. Finetuning on these trajectories improves LLMs of different families and sizes, from 2B to 122B parameters across four skill-use benchmarks; Our Qwen3.5-9B SFT model outperforms the 397B untrained model on two of them. Further analysis shows that training teaches agents to invoke skills, raising the rate of reading the relevant skill from 28% to 96%, and that the gains hold across reasoning structures, extending to task types that form a minority of the training data and to skills held out from training

AI.tldr: 提出SkillGym，一个自动构建可验证环境、采集轨迹并训练技能使用智能体的流水线，生成6.8k环境与19k验证成功轨迹，SFT后显著提升多规模LLM的技能使用能力。
AI.motivation: 技能已被广泛用于LLM智能体范式与工具框架中，但如何合成可靠的训练数据、如何训练智能体学会使用技能仍缺乏研究。
AI.method: SkillGym首先从互联网爬取大量技能，保留可离线可复现运行的技能；再通过builder-reviewer流水线构建难度可控的任务，覆盖四类任务，每类配有参考解与可执行验证器；据此构建6.8k环境并采集19k条经验证的成功轨迹，用于监督微调。
AI.result: 在四个技能使用基准上，对2B至122B不同家族与规模的LLM微调均有提升；Qwen3.5-9B SFT模型在其中两个基准上超过397B未训练模型。分析显示读取相关技能的比例从28%升至96%，且增益跨推理结构保持，并泛化到少数任务类型和训练中未见的技能。
AI.conclusion: SkillGym验证了自动化构建可验证环境与轨迹用于技能使用训练的可行性，训练能有效教会智能体调用技能并具备良好的泛化性。

title: QuantMLA: Function-Aligned Dual-Path Quantization for Low-Bit MLA KV Caching
summary: Multi-Head Latent Attention (MLA) enables expressive multi-head attention with compact caches for its content and decoupled RoPE paths, yet cache memory still scales linearly with context length and batch size. In this work, we establish a systematic model of MLA's dual-path quantization errors, characterizing their distinct effects on attention-output distortion and explaining the pronounced amplification of RoPE-path errors. Guided by this analysis, we introduce QuantMLA, a function-aligned framework for low-bit dual-path quantization. We derive path-specific transformation spaces that preserve full-precision computation while remaining fully fusible into model parameters offline, eliminating online transformation overhead. Within these spaces, QuantMLA learns path-specific transformations with function-aligned objectives: attention-output reconstruction captures the content path's coupled matching and aggregation errors, while positional QK reconstruction preserves the RoPE-induced component of the attention logits and admits a theoretical bound on output distortion. Across four MLA model families, QuantMLA enables, to our knowledge, the first reported joint INT4 caching of the content and RoPE caches with minimal accuracy degradation. Further compressing the content cache to INT2 while retaining the RoPE key cache at INT4 maintains competitive performance on challenging reasoning and code benchmarks. We develop a native low-bit MLA attention kernel that integrates unpacking and dequantization directly into attention computation. The physical cache layout provides 3.59x compression at 128K context, while a cache-pressure serving workload achieves 5.168x higher whole-job output throughput than BF16. The code will be released upon acceptance.

AI.tldr: 本文提出 QuantMLA，一个针对 MLA 双路径（content 与 RoPE）低比特量化的函数对齐框架，首次实现 content 与 RoPE 缓存联合 INT4 缓存，并在 128K 上下文下取得 3.59x 物理压缩与 5.168x 吞吐提升。
AI.motivation: MLA 虽以紧凑缓存支持多头注意力与解耦 RoPE 路径，但缓存显存仍随上下文长度和批量线性增长，成为长上下文推理的瓶颈。现有量化方法未系统刻画 MLA 双路径量化误差的差异，尤其未解释 RoPE 路径误差被显著放大的现象，缺乏针对性低比特方案。
AI.method: 1) 建立 MLA 双路径量化误差的系统模型，刻画其对注意力输出失真的不同影响，并解释 RoPE 路径误差的放大机制；2) 提出 QuantMLA 函数对齐框架：推导路径特定的变换空间，使其保持全精度计算且可离线融合进模型参数，消除在线变换开销；3) 在变换空间内以函数对齐目标学习路径特定变换——content 路径用注意力输出重构捕获耦合匹配与聚合误差，RoPE 路径用位置 QK 重构保留注意力 logits 的 RoPE 分量并给出输出失真理论界；4) 开发原生低比特 MLA 注意力 kernel，将解包与反量化直接集成进注意力计算。
AI.result: 在四个 MLA 模型族上，首次实现 content 与 RoPE 缓存联合 INT4 缓存且精度损失极小；将 content 缓存进一步压至 INT2、RoPE key 缓存保持 INT4 时，在困难推理与代码基准上仍具竞争力。物理缓存布局在 128K 上下文下实现 3.59x 压缩；在缓存压力型服务负载下，整体作业输出吞吐较 BF16 提升 5.168x。
AI.conclusion: QuantMLA 通过双路径误差建模与函数对齐的低比特量化，突破了 MLA 缓存随上下文线性增长的瓶颈，兼顾精度与效率，为长上下文 MLA 推理提供了可落地的低比特缓存方案。

title: How Can Recommendation Feedback Evolve Agent Memory?
summary: Content-generation agents continuously receive impressions, clicks, conversions, and negative feedback from recommendation systems, providing real-world outcome signals for memory evolution. However, these signals are delayed and noisy, confounded by audience composition, placement, and recommendation policies, and may result from the combined influence of multiple memories, making accurate attribution difficult. Existing methods rely primarily on immediate feedback or semantic retrieval and therefore struggle to reliably translate recommendation outcomes into memory fitness. To address this challenge, we propose TIDE (Trajectory-Informed Directed Memory Evolution), an external memory evolution framework driven by delayed recommendation feedback. We further introduce Memory Evolution Gain (MEG), which measures the utility improvement of evolved memory over a no memory baseline on strictly future tasks. TIDE treats memory as a capacity-constrained population of experiences: temporal and semantic credit assignment estimates contextual fitness, while responsibility credit distributes outcome signals according to the memories referenced during generation. These signals are then used to reinforce, crossover, mutate, or evict memories. On an e-commerce membership marketing content-generation agent, TIDE achieves a +7.75-percentage-point MEG in offline temporal replay and significantly improves both unique click-through rate (UCTR) and activation rate in an online A/B test. On a delayed-label benchmark, TIDE achieves the lowest mean absolute error (MAE) and root mean squared error (RMSE) and the highest MEG among the compared methods, demonstrating its effectiveness.

AI.tldr: 提出TIDE框架，利用延迟推荐反馈驱动外部记忆进化，并引入MEG指标衡量记忆效用，在电商内容生成代理上取得显著离线与在线提升。
AI.motivation: 内容生成代理能从推荐系统获得印象、点击、转化和负反馈等真实结果信号，但这些信号存在延迟、噪声，且受受众构成、投放位置与推荐策略混杂，并可能由多个记忆共同作用，导致归因困难。现有方法依赖即时反馈或语义检索，难以可靠地将推荐结果转化为记忆适应度。
AI.method: 提出TIDE（Trajectory-Informed Directed Memory Evolution），一个由延迟推荐反馈驱动的外部记忆进化框架；并引入记忆进化增益（MEG），在严格未来任务上衡量进化记忆相对无记忆基线的效用提升。TIDE将记忆视为容量受限的经验种群：通过时序与语义信用分配估计上下文适应度，通过责任信用按生成过程中引用的记忆分配结果信号，进而对记忆执行强化、交叉、变异或淘汰。
AI.result: 在电商会员营销内容生成代理上，TIDE离线时间回放中取得+7.75个百分点MEG，在线A/B测试中显著提升独立点击率（UCTR）与激活率。在延迟标签基准上，TIDE在所比较方法中取得最低MAE与RMSE以及最高MEG。
AI.conclusion: TIDE通过延迟推荐反馈驱动的记忆进化机制，有效解决了结果信号延迟、噪声与多记忆混杂归因难题，验证了其在真实场景与基准测试中的有效性。

title: Federated Clustering with Unknown Local and Global Cluster Cardinalities
summary: Federated clustering methods that do not require the global number of clusters $K$ still assume that each client knows its local number $K_g$. This assumption is hard to justify when clients know no more about their data than the server does, as in fault diagnosis across independently operated industrial sites. We propose a two-phase framework in which neither count is known: each client first estimates $K_g$ from its own data, and an aggregator that requires local counts, such as FedGEM, then uses these estimates in place of the true values. For the first phase we introduce Adaptive Split--Merge (ASM), which grows a spherical Gaussian mixture by BIC-driven splitting and then merges excess components. ASM uses no labels, selects its hyperparameters on held-out client data only, and makes no assumption about how clusters are shared across clients. We derive a closed-form split criterion whose critical cluster size falls with anisotropy and rises with dimension, and show empirically that over-fragmentation grows with the number of points per cluster, which federation divides among clients. Across eight datasets, ASM with FedGEM attains a mean ARI of 0.333, against 0.256 for the next best label-free estimator and 0.361 when the true local counts are supplied. It also gives the most reliable global estimates of $K$ and is robust when client size is decoupled from local cardinality.

AI.tldr: 提出两阶段联邦聚类框架，客户端用ASM自适应估计本地簇数，替代需已知本地簇数的聚合方法（如FedGEM），实现全局与本地簇数均未知的聚类。
AI.motivation: 现有免全局簇数K的联邦聚类方法仍假设每个客户端已知本地簇数Kg，这在客户端对其数据认知不优于服务器的场景（如独立运营工业站点的故障诊断）中难以成立。
AI.method: 两阶段框架：第一阶段提出Adaptive Split--Merge (ASM)，通过BIC驱动的分裂扩展球形高斯混合，再合并多余分量；不使用标签，超参数仅在留出客户端数据上选择，且不假设簇在客户端间的共享方式。理论上推导闭式分裂准则，其临界簇大小随各向异性下降、随维度上升。
AI.result: 八数据集上ASM+FedGEM平均ARI为0.333，优于次优无标签估计器的0.256，接近提供真实本地簇数时的0.361；同时给出最可靠的全局K估计，并在客户端规模与本地基数解耦时保持稳健。实证显示过度碎片化随每簇点数增加而增长。
AI.conclusion: ASM使联邦聚类在全局与本地簇数均未知条件下仍可行，性能接近已知真实本地簇数的上界，且对客户端规模与簇基数解耦具有稳健性。

title: Rational Clarification by Assistive Agents via Value-of-Information Reasoning
summary: Users of language-based assistive agents often make ambiguous requests. In response, an assistant can either directly act on its interpretation of the request --- risking misalignment with the user --- or ask a clarifying question. Which option is the most safe and helpful? A common approach is to ask questions that minimize uncertainty about the user's intent until a threshold is reached. However, this neglects the impact of uncertainty reduction on downstream performance, the costs of asking versus acting immediately, and the possibility that users may provide corrections without being asked. To navigate these trade-offs, we introduce Rational Enquiry via Value-of-Information Reasoning (REVOIR). REVOIR makes clarification decisions via inference-time reasoning about the value-of-information of a question, which captures the expected improvement in task reward due to the answer received. In two assistive tasks --- ambiguous question answering (CondAmbigQA) and preference-aligned household task planning (ADAPT) --- we show that REVOIR achieves greater success with fewer questions than approaches based on prompting, chain-of-thought, fine-tuning, or information gain, improving preference satisfaction on ADAPT by 13-15% over a fine-tuned clarification policy while requiring no training and asking five times fewer questions. Furthermore, when the assistant can receive cheap user corrections after acting, REVOIR naturally infers that asking questions is not always efficient, demonstrating the adaptivity of our approach. In contrast, we find that vanilla reasoning agents fail to adaptively clarify user requests, and request fewer clarifications as reasoning effort increases.

AI.tldr: 提出REVOIR方法，通过推理问题的信息价值来决定是否澄清用户歧义请求，在无需训练的情况下以更少提问实现更高任务成功率。
AI.motivation: 语言辅助智能体常面临歧义请求，是直接行动还是提问澄清存在权衡。常用做法是提问直至不确定性低于阈值，但忽略了不确定性降低对下游性能的影响、提问与立即行动的成本对比，以及用户可能主动纠正的可能。
AI.method: REVOIR在推理时估计提问的信息价值（value-of-information），即收到的回答所带来的任务奖励的期望提升，据此做出澄清决策。
AI.result: 在CondAmbigQA和ADAPT两个辅助任务上，REVOIR相比提示、思维链、微调和信息增益方法，用更少提问获得更高成功率；在ADAPT上偏好满意度比微调澄清策略提升13-15%，且无需训练、提问次数减少五倍。当允许廉价的事后纠正时，REVOIR能推断出提问并非总是高效，体现自适应性。
AI.conclusion: 基于信息价值的推理能有效权衡提问与行动的取舍；普通推理智能体无法自适应澄清，且随着推理努力增加反而更少请求澄清。

title: Graph-Spectral Flow Matching for Multivariate Time Series Anomaly Detection
summary: Multivariate time series anomaly detection typically relies on evaluating discrepancies between observations and outputs produced by models trained on normal data. An alternative perspective is to characterize the distribution of normal data through the generative dynamics, i.e., the velocity field, of flow matching models. However, standard flow matching typically adopts linear probability paths that overlook dependencies among variables, leading to a misalignment with the structured data distribution. To address this issue, we propose GRASP, a flow matching framework with a graph-spectral path for multivariate time series anomaly detection. GRASP incorporates graph structure into the probability path by minimizing a fixed-endpoint action that combines kinetic energy with graph Dirichlet energy. This formulation yields a closed-form path based on graph-frequency-dependent hyperbolic interpolation. A velocity predictor trained on normal data then detects anomalies using weighted velocity discrepancies aggregated across source samples, flow times, and graph frequencies. Theoretically, we establish that GRASP is invariant to the choice of Laplacian eigenbasis and decompose its expected oracle anomaly score into bounded endpoint uncertainty and graph-frequency-weighted Fisher discrepancy. Experiments on four benchmarks demonstrate the superior anomaly detection performance of GRASP and validate the effectiveness of its graph-spectral path and weighting mechanism.

AI.tldr: 提出GRASP框架，用图-谱概率路径的流匹配模型进行多变量时间序列异常检测，性能优于现有方法。
AI.motivation: 现有多变量时间序列异常检测方法多依赖观测与模型输出的差异，而基于流匹配生成动力学（速度场）刻画正常数据分布是一种替代思路。但标准流匹配采用线性概率路径，忽略变量间依赖关系，与结构化数据分布不匹配。
AI.method: GRASP将图结构引入概率路径，通过最小化结合动能与图Dirichlet能量的固定端点作用量，得到基于图频率相关双曲插值的闭式路径。训练正常数据上的速度预测器，利用跨源样本、流时间与图频率聚合的加权速度差异进行异常检测。
AI.result: 理论证明GRASP对Laplacian特征基选择不变，并将期望oracle异常分数分解为有界端点不确定性与图频率加权Fisher差异。四个基准实验表明其异常检测性能优越，验证了图-谱路径与加权机制的有效性。
AI.conclusion: GRASP通过图-谱概率路径实现变量依赖感知的流匹配，提升多变量时间序列异常检测性能，并提供理论保证与加权机制。

title: FOCUS: Training-Free Decision-Preserving Context Compression for LLM Agents
summary: LLM agents accumulate interaction histories that grow linearly with task length, causing quadratic inference cost scaling and performance degradation from attention dilution. Existing context-compression methods learn what to discard offline: by contrastively optimizing guidelines, distilling compressors, or training compression policies. This incurs a substantial cost. Further, the compression policy is learned a priori and is not dynamically conditioned on the evolving test-time trajectories. In this paper we ask a complementary question: Which past interactions causally shape the agent's future decisions? We recast context compression as a causal decision preservation problem over discrete interaction units and introduce FOCUS, a training-free context compression framework that operates entirely at test time. Our method requires no offline data collection or fine-tuning, and is architecture-agnostic, attaching to any closed-API frontier model as a modular compression layer. We evaluate FOCUS on diverse agentic benchmarks including API and tool-calling, QA, web domain and multi-turn dialogue. Our method establishes new state of the art performance, cutting peak context by up to 48% and dependency by 73% while improving task success by up to 8.9 percentage points over uncompressed execution.

AI.tldr: 该论文提出 FOCUS，一种无需训练的测试时上下文压缩框架，将上下文压缩重构为离散交互单元上的因果决策保持问题，在多种智能体基准上取得最优性能。
AI.motivation: LLM 智能体交互历史随任务长度线性增长，导致推理成本呈二次方扩展，并因注意力稀释造成性能退化。现有上下文压缩方法依赖离线学习压缩策略（对比优化指导、蒸馏压缩器、训练压缩策略），成本高且压缩策略为先验学习，无法根据测试时不断演化的轨迹动态调整。
AI.method: 作者提出互补性问题：哪些过去的交互对智能体未来决策具有因果影响？据此将上下文压缩重新表述为离散交互单元上的因果决策保持问题，并引入 FOCUS——一种完全在测试时运行、无需训练的上下文压缩框架。该方法无需离线数据收集或微调，且与架构无关，可作为模块化压缩层附加到任意闭源 API 前沿模型上。
AI.result: 在包括 API 与工具调用、问答、网页领域及多轮对话等多种智能体基准上进行评估，FOCUS 取得新的最优性能：峰值上下文最多减少 48%，依赖度降低 73%，同时任务成功率较未压缩执行最多提升 8.9 个百分点。
AI.conclusion: 通过因果决策保持视角实现测试时无需训练的上下文压缩，FOCUS 在降低上下文规模与依赖的同时提升任务成功率，具备架构无关、可即插即用的通用性。

title: When Can Prefixes Compile LoRA? Exact Resource-Capped Tests for Frozen Attention
summary: Can a fixed continuous prefix replace a given low-rank adapter while the attention head stays frozen? In this research, we show that the answer depends on the adapter's target through three conditions. First, observability: at one causal readout, every independent key--value prefix sees the content only through the query, attention partition, and value numerator, so a target that differs on two inputs with equal summaries incurs an error floor at every prefix length; norm caps extend this floor to nearly equal summaries. Second, realizability: at a common query, any prefix reduces exactly to two aggregate variables, and the norm-capped optimum is an attained second-order-cone program, also after a fixed output projection; it places two equal-norm rank-one value updates on opposite sides of compilability. Third, implementation: under affine query exposure, $2r$ signed slots approximate a rank-$r$ value update, but their values grow as $O(ε^{-3/2})$, and the construction passes all 400 tolerance checks in float64 yet only 38 in bfloat16. A first-layer GPT-2 readout with fixed token and position meets the common-query condition without clamping activations; at three such heads, the capped optimum leaves 18.4\% to 74.2\% of the projected adapter effect uncompiled, with a head-dependent value--query ordering. All claims concern local approximation at one head, not whole-network equivalence.

AI.tldr: 本文研究一个固定连续前缀（fixed prefix）能否在注意力头冻结的情况下替代给定的低秩适配器（adapter），并给出刻画该问题可行性的三项条件。
AI.motivation: 探究"前缀提示"与"低秩适配"之间的功能等价性：即能否用一个固定的连续前缀替代给定的低秩适配器，为理解前缀微调与适配器微调的等价关系提供理论依据。
AI.method: 从可观测性（observability）、可实现性（realizability）与实现（implementation）三个条件展开分析：1）在单次因果读出下，分析前缀仅通过 query、注意力划分和 value 分子获取内容，给出在等摘要输入上存在误差下界的条件，并将该下界由范数上限推广到近似等摘要情形；2）在公共 query 下将任意前缀精确归约为两个聚合变量，证明范数受限最优解是可达的二阶锥规划，并在固定输出投影下依旧成立，构造两个等范数秩一 value 更新位于可编译性两侧；3）在仿射 query 暴露下，用 2r 个带符号槽位近似秩-r 的 value 更新，分析其数值增长与精度影响。
AI.result: 1）等摘要输入导致每个前缀长度都存在误差下界；2）范数受限最优解构成可达二阶锥规划，两个等范数秩一 value 更新分居可编译性两侧；3）2r 个带符号槽位可近似秩-r value 更新，但其数值按 O(ε^{-3/2}) 增长，构造在 float64 下通过全部 400 项容差检验，而在 bfloat16 下仅通过 38 项。4）在首层 GPT-2 读出（固定 token 与位置）满足公共 query 条件且无需钳制激活，在三个此类头上，受限最优解仍留下 18.4%–74.2% 的投影适配器效应未被编译，且 value–query 顺序依赖具体头。
AI.conclusion: 固定前缀替代低秩适配器的可行性取决于适配器目标，受可观测性、可实现性与实现三方面条件限制；所有结论仅适用于单个注意力头内的局部近似，而非整网等价。

title: XU-RS: Explaining Credal Width in Random-Set Language Models
summary: Uncertainty estimates tell us how unsure a model is, but not why. Without knowing which parts of an input influences a model's uncertainty, we cannot tell whether that uncertainty score depends on input features that are relevant for the task. We study this problem in randomset classifiers built using pretrained language models. These classifiers assign probability to individual answers and to groups of answers, producing lower and upper probabilities for each answer; The difference between these probabilities, called credal width, is used to represent epistemic uncertainty about an answer arising from limited training data. We propose XU-RS, a framework that attributes an answer's credal width to the input tokens (words or word pieces) supplied to a language model. XU-RS uses Expected Gradients (a standard feature attribution method) to estimate how input tokens contribute to credal width. The proposed framework is evaluated on a MedQA dataset using SmolLM3-3B and Llama-2-7B models, demonstrating that setting the embedding of a token ranked highly by XU-RS to zero (zero-masking) causes larger changes in credal width than zero-masking randomly selected tokens. In addition, we show that normalisation can cause other answer groups to influence an answer's width, reveal how token attribution can mask numerical errors, and provide diagnostic checks to verify whether a token ranked highly by XU-RS meaningfully explains model uncertainty.

AI.tldr: 本文提出XU-RS框架，利用Expected Gradients将随机集合分类器中答案的credal width归因到输入token，并在MedQA上验证高排名token置零比随机置零引起更大的credal width变化。
AI.motivation: 不确定性估计只能说明模型有多不确定，却无法解释不确定性的来源。若不知道输入的哪些部分影响了模型的不确定性，就无法判断该不确定性是否依赖于与任务相关的输入特征。因此需要将不确定性归因到具体输入token。
AI.method: 研究对象为基于预训练语言模型构建的随机集合分类器，其为单个答案及答案组分配概率，进而给出每个答案的下概率与上概率，二者之差（credal width）表示由训练数据有限引起的认识不确定性。提出XU-RS框架，采用Expected Gradients（一种标准特征归因方法）估计输入token对credal width的贡献，将答案的credal width归因到词或子词单元。
AI.result: 在MedQA数据集上使用SmolLM3-3B与Llama-2-7B模型评估：将XU-RS排名高的token嵌入置零（zero-masking）所引起的credal width变化，大于随机选择token置零所引起的变化。此外发现归一化会使其他答案组影响某答案的width，揭示token归因可能掩盖数值误差，并给出诊断性检查以验证高排名token是否真正解释模型不确定性。
AI.conclusion: XU-RS能够将随机集合分类器的不确定性归因到输入token，且高归因token对credal width具有实质性影响；但归因结果需结合归一化影响与数值误差的诊断检查，避免把高排名token误读为对不确定性的真实解释。

title: Beyond Conditional Independence: Root Cause Analysis with Deep Causal Models
summary: Root cause analysis (RCA) is a critical problem in many real-world scenarios. RCA enables the identification of faulty or failing mechanisms in a system by comparing anomalous observations with corresponding reference (i.e., regular) observations. However, existing approaches rely either on heuristic methods or on conditional independence tests with a strong unconfoundedness assumption, and thus fail to exploit other complicated distributional constraints in the presence of latent variables. To relax these assumptions, we model the underlying system as a causal model and the anomalous system as a change in the structural functions of the same causal model. Specifically, to handle unobserved confounders, we establish an implicit connection between distributional constraint testing and root cause analysis. To adapt our approach to data generated from arbitrary causal models, we employ the deep causal model (DCM) framework, in which we design the causal model using neural networks. Finally, we illustrate how our method, RCA-DCM, can utilize different levels of partial graphical knowledge to perform RCA. We evaluate RCA-DCM against state-of-the-art baselines on simulated datasets, a physics-based causal chamber and two micro-service applications. RCA-DCM improves top-1 accuracy over the strongest baseline on both Sock Shop (0.880 vs. 0.752) and Online Boutique (0.776 vs. 0.712), and when the true root cause in the causal chamber is unobserved and acts as a latent confounder, it recovers the exact root-cause set more often than any competing method (perfect recovery rate (PRR) 0.846 vs. 0.731).

AI.tldr: 本文提出 RCA-DCM，将系统建模为因果模型，并把异常视为结构函数的变化，通过分布约束检验与根因分析的隐式联系处理潜在混杂因子，利用深度因果模型适配任意因果结构，支持不同层级的部分图知识。在模拟数据、物理因果舱及两个微服务应用上超越现有基线。
AI.motivation: 现有根因分析方法依赖启发式方法或带强无混杂假设的条件独立性检验，无法利用潜在变量存在时的复杂分布约束，导致在含未观测混杂因子的场景中失效。
AI.method: 将底层系统建模为因果模型，异常系统视为同一因果模型结构函数的变化；建立分布约束检验与根因分析之间的隐式联系以处理未观测混杂因子；采用深度因果模型（DCM）框架，用神经网络设计因果模型，使方法适配任意因果模型产生的数据；并支持利用不同层级的部分图知识进行根因分析。
AI.result: 在模拟数据集、基于物理的因果舱和两个微服务应用上与最先进基线对比：Sock Shop 上 top-1 准确率 0.880 对 0.752，Online Boutique 上 0.776 对 0.712；当因果舱中真实根因未被观测且作为潜在混杂因子时，完美恢复率（PRR）0.846 对最强基线的 0.731。
AI.conclusion: RCA-DCM 通过因果建模与分布约束检验的隐式连接，放宽了传统方法的无混杂假设，可处理潜在混杂因子并适配任意因果模型，在多个场景中一致优于现有方法。

title: Flattening the Connectome Spectrum: A Spectral Filter for FC Induces a Pretraining Target for fMRI Encoders
summary: Self-supervised pretraining reshaped prediction in language and vision, and brain foundation models (BFMs) inherited its promise. Representations learned from large unlabelled corpora should capture individual functional dynamics and generalise across cohorts. However, kernel ridge regression (KRR) fitted on functional connectivity (FC) matrices still predicts individual phenotypes more accurately than any BFM we tested. In this paper, we show that KRR is weighted by the eigenvalues of the FC which are miscalibrated for phenotype prediction. We apply an efficient spectral filter to recalibrate the eigenvalues of each subject's FC matrix, enabling the model to exploit more inter-individual variance. Across the 5 datasets, 11 parcellations and 6 prediction targets we tested, we match or exceed the KRR baseline. Based on this finding, we then pretrain a small encoder model on about 4,000 hours of fMRI from 162 open datasets, whereby we align the pairwise similarities between the embeddings of recording snippets with those between the recalibrated connectomes. Our model performs on par with the best of the 6 published BFMs we tested while having an order of magnitude fewer parameters. Our encoder performs better than FC on short scans and in smaller cohorts, especially in fingerprinting. We release the pretrained model weights, the code and the pretraining data, preprocessed and parcellated.

AI.tldr: 本文发现核岭回归（KRR）在功能连接（FC）上的表型预测优势源于FC特征值失校准，提出谱滤波重校准方法，并据此预训练了一个小规模脑基础模型，以更少参数达到与现有脑基础模型相当的性能。
AI.motivation: 自监督预训练在语言和视觉领域取得显著成功，脑基础模型（BFM）也期望从大规模无标注语料中学习到能够刻画个体功能动态并跨队列泛化的表征。然而，在实际的表型预测任务中，基于功能连接（FC）矩阵的核岭回归（KRR）仍然比所测试的所有BFM预测更准确，这一矛盾现象需要被解释和解决。
AI.method: 作者首先分析指出KRR的预测权重受FC矩阵特征值影响，而这些特征值对表型预测而言是失校准的（miscalibrated）。为此，他们对每个被试的FC矩阵施加一种高效的谱滤波，重新校准其特征值，使模型能够利用更多的个体间方差。在此基础上，作者使用约4000小时的fMRI数据（来自162个公开数据集）预训练一个小型编码器模型，通过对齐记录片段嵌入之间的成对相似性与重校准连接组之间的相似性来实现表征学习。
AI.result: 在5个数据集、11种脑区划分和6个预测目标上，重校准方法达到或超过KRR基线。预训练的编码器模型在参数量少一个数量级的情况下，性能与所测试的6个已发表BFM中最优者相当。在短时扫描和较小队列中，该编码器优于FC方法，尤其是在指纹识别（fingerprinting）任务上表现更好。
AI.conclusion: FC特征值失校准是KRR优于BFM的关键原因，通过谱滤波重校准可有效改善预测。基于此，作者训练出参数高效的小型脑编码器，在多种条件下超越或匹敌现有方法，并公开了预训练权重、代码及预处理和分区的预训练数据。

title: Harnessing Large Language Models to Compile Task-Relevant Context into Bayesian Optimisation
summary: Incorporating rich task-relevant context, such as domain knowledge and external observations, is a key capability yet remains challenging for Bayesian optimisation (BO). Recently, practitioners have started to use large language models (LLMs) to generate and execute BO programs through coding harnesses. In such emerging practices, the posterior belief is shaped not only by Bayesian inference but also by LLM-generated model and data artefacts, offering a flexible route for task context to enter BO as executable code. To study whether and how LLMs can be harnessed to compile diverse contextual signals for BO, we formulate LLM-compiled BO as generalised-context decision making. We propose HarBO, a BO-specialised harness that compiles generalised context into the core artefacts of standard BO through a validated multi-stage workflow. Our theory analyses the regret under imperfect compilation and the effect of adding new context. Across synthetic functions and real-world benchmarks, we find that LLM harnesses can effectively compile context into standard BO, achieving competitive performance with specialised LLM-embedding-based and direct LLM-in-the-loop BO methods. General coding harnesses can be effective in familiar domains such as hyperparameter optimisation, but fall short in unfamiliar, context-rich domains. Together, these results establish LLM harnesses as a promising, but not automatically reliable, route for making rich task context usable in BO.

AI.tldr: 提出 HarBO，用 LLM 代码框架把广义上下文编译进标准贝叶斯优化的核心构件，理论分析不完美编译下的遗憾与新上下文增益，实验显示其性能有竞争力但通用编码框架在新领域不可靠。
AI.motivation: 贝叶斯优化（BO）难以有效融入领域知识与外部观测等丰富任务上下文。虽已有实践用大语言模型通过编码框架生成执行 BO 程序，使后验信念同时受贝叶斯推断与 LLM 生成的模型/数据产物影响，但尚不清楚 LLM 能否及如何为 BO 编译多样上下文信号。
AI.method: 将 LLM 编译的 BO 形式化为广义上下文决策问题；提出 HarBO——面向 BO 的专用框架，经经验证的多阶段流程把广义上下文编译为标准 BO 的核心构件；并从理论上分析不完美编译下的遗憾及新增上下文的影响。
AI.result: 在合成函数与真实基准上，LLM 框架可将上下文有效编译进标准 BO，性能与基于 LLM 嵌入和直接 LLM-in-the-loop 的专用 BO 方法相当；通用编码框架在超参数优化等熟悉领域有效，但在陌生、上下文丰富的领域表现不足。
AI.conclusion: LLM 框架是让丰富任务上下文在 BO 中可用的有前景但并非自动可靠的途径。

title: Beyond a single latent space: a dual-latent world model for long-horizon planning
comment: 31 pages, 22 figures, 9 tables. Main text: 9 pages
summary: Latent world models often struggle with long-horizon planning despite accurate short-term predictions. Recursive rollouts accumulate errors, while distance concentration in high-dimensional latent spaces can weaken goal discrimination. We introduce the Dual-Latent World Model (Dual-WM), which separates local execution and long-range planning through distinct state representations and dynamics models. The low-level model predicts action-conditioned transitions, while the high-level model uses learned macro-actions to plan over longer temporal spans. We also propose Long-Horizon Representation Learning with Weighted Rollout (LoRe), which supervises self-generated predictions at both levels. An analysis of recursive error propagation motivates exponential horizon weights with separate decay rates for the two temporal scales. During planning, the high-level model generates latent subgoals that the low-level model refines into actions for precise execution. We evaluate from-scratch Dual-WM on five goal-conditioned visual control tasks against the task-wise strongest baselines without actor-guided proposals. At goal offsets of 50 and 100 environment steps, mean success increases from 75.9% to 84.4% and from 61.4% to 69.5%, respectively. At offset 100, Dual-WM outperforms these baselines on all five tasks and improves mean success over LeWM by 30.8 percentage points. Ablations and supporting analyses provide evidence of more informative representations for goal evaluation and greater consistency under recursive prediction. These results highlight the value of separating temporal roles and training across multiple horizons for reliable latent planning. Our core implementation is available at https://github.com/DeLin1001/Dual-WM-Official.

AI.tldr: 本文提出双潜世界模型（Dual-WM）与长时域表示学习（LoRe），通过分离局部执行与长程规划的状态表示和动力学模型，并采用指数时域加权监督，提升潜空间长时域规划的成功率。
