AI.motivation: 潜世界模型在短时预测上较准确，但长时域规划困难：递归展开会累积误差，高维潜空间中的距离集中现象会削弱目标区分能力。现有方法难以兼顾精确执行与长程规划。
AI.method: 提出Dual-WM：低层模型预测动作条件转移，高层模型利用学习到的宏动作在更长时域上规划；规划时高层生成潜子目标，低层将其细化为动作精确执行。同时提出LoRe训练方法，对两个层级的自生成预测进行监督，并基于递归误差传播分析，采用两个时间尺度上分别衰减的指数时域权重。
AI.result: 在五个目标条件视觉控制任务上，从零训练评估，未使用actor引导的候选提议。目标偏移50步时平均成功率由75.9%提升至84.4%，偏移100步时由61.4%提升至69.5%；偏移100步时在全部五个任务上超过基线，较LeWM平均成功率提升30.8个百分点。消融与分析表明表示更具目标评估信息量，递归预测下一致性更强。
AI.conclusion: 分离时间角色并在多时域上训练，对可靠的潜空间规划具有重要价值。

title: RAE-PPG: Duration-Grounded Retain-and-Extend Pretraining for PPG Foundation Models
summary: Signal features derived from photoplethysmography (PPG) require different signal durations to characterize. Existing PPG foundation models treat duration as a pretraining or evaluation condition rather than using the different durations required by PPG features to organize self-supervision. We hypothesize that self-supervision should expand with signal duration, allowing a single encoder to progressively acquire additional features while preserving and reusing earlier learning. We introduce Retain-and-Extend PPG (RAE-PPG), which trains a single Transformer encoder successively on 10 s, 30 s, and 240 s inputs, adding supervision for signal features supported by each longer observation. The encoder is partitioned into duration-specific parameter groups, allowing later stages to reuse earlier groups while updating only the group assigned to the current stage. Selected earlier targets are reused to supervise later stages, encouraging the corresponding features to remain accessible in longer-input representations. Direct decoding from the final encoder shows that earlier features remain recoverable from longer-input representations, while later-stage features show higher mean decoding performance at their introduction durations. Controlled comparisons further show that prior-stage learning provides a better basis for learning newly introduced features at both transitions. Across 18 tasks from eight datasets, the final frozen encoder achieves the best observed score on 12 tasks compared with five existing PPG foundation models.

AI.tldr: 提出RAE-PPG，按10s→30s→240s逐阶段训练单一Transformer编码器，通过时长专属参数组复用与目标复用实现"保留-扩展"式自监督，冻结编码器在18任务中12项最优。
AI.motivation: PPG不同信号特征所需的信号时长不同，而现有PPG基础模型仅把时长当作预训练或评测条件，未利用"特征所需时长差异"来组织自监督。作者假设自监督应随信号时长扩展，使单一编码器在渐进获取新特征的同时保留并复用早期学习成果。
AI.method: RAE-PPG依次在10s、30s、240s输入上训练同一Transformer编码器，为每个更长观测所支持的特征增加监督；将编码器划分为时长专属参数组，后期阶段复用早期参数组，仅更新当前阶段对应组；并复用部分早期目标来监督后期阶段，促使相应特征在长输入表征中保持可访问。
AI.result: 从最终编码器直接解码显示，早期特征在长输入表征中仍可恢复，后期特征在其引入时长上平均解码性能更高；控制实验表明两个阶段转换处，前一阶段学习均为学习新引入特征提供了更好基础；在8个数据集18项任务上，冻结的最终编码器相较5个现有PPG基础模型在12项任务取得最佳观测分数。
AI.conclusion: 按特征所需时长组织渐进式自监督、并配合参数组复用与目标复用，可在单一编码器中实现特征保留与扩展，使长时长表征兼容早期特征，并在多任务上优于现有PPG基础模型。

title: EnterpriseBench: Benchmarking LLM Agents on Enterprise-Level Strategic Reasoning and Decision-Making
summary: LLM agents are increasingly expected to support enterprise workflows, where tasks often involve missing information, uncertainty, feedback, and long-term trade-offs. However, existing enterprise and financial benchmarks mainly test static capabilities such as information extraction, numerical calculation, domain knowledge, and financial QA, leaving interactive and long-horizon decision-making underexplored. To bridge this gap, we introduce EnterpriseBench, a benchmark that evaluates LLM agents across this spectrum, from static question answering to dynamic decision-making. Specifically, EnterpriseBench reorganizes existing enterprise and financial QA datasets into a unified foundational suite annotated by capability and difficulty, and introduces three professional interactive settings: Consulting, based on management-consulting-style business cases for client problem diagnosis through multi-turn information seeking; the Beer Game, adapted from a classic supply-chain management simulation for inventory control under delayed feedback; and Enterprise Digital Twin, a project-based business simulator for workforce, risk, and project planning. Experiments with nine agent methods under four backbone models show that current agents have not yet achieved stable, comprehensive, and cross-task reliability in enterprise scenarios. These results show that EnterpriseBench provides a practical benchmark for evaluating LLM agents in realistic enterprise strategic reasoning and decision-making.

AI.tldr: 本文提出EnterpriseBench基准，将企业/金融问答数据集整合为统一基础套件，并新增咨询、啤酒游戏、企业数字孪生三类交互式长周期场景，用于评测LLM智能体从静态问答到动态决策的能力。实验表明现有智能体尚不具备稳定、全面、跨任务的可靠性。
AI.motivation: 现有企业金融基准主要测评静态能力（信息抽取、数值计算、领域知识、金融问答），忽视了真实企业工作流中的信息缺失、不确定性、反馈与长期权衡等交互式、长周期决策需求，亟需覆盖从静态问答到动态决策全谱系的评测基准。
AI.method: 构建EnterpriseBench：1）将已有企业金融问答数据集重组为统一基础套件，按能力与难度标注；2）设计三个专业交互场景——Consulting（基于管理咨询式商业案例，多轮信息搜集进行客户问题诊断）、Beer Game（改编自经典供应链管理模拟，考察延迟反馈下库存控制）、Enterprise Digital Twin（项目式商业模拟器，用于人力、风险与项目规划）；3）在4个主干模型上评测9种智能体方法。
AI.result: 在4个主干模型、9种智能体方法的实验中，当前智能体在企业场景中尚未达到稳定、全面、跨任务的可靠性。
AI.conclusion: EnterpriseBench为评测LLM智能体在真实企业战略推理与决策中的表现提供了实用基准，揭示了从静态能力到动态决策全谱系评测的必要性。

title: Where Does Randomness Matter in Neural Cellular Automata?
summary: Stochastic cell updates are often used throughout the life of a neural cellular automaton (NCA), from backpropagation through time to final rollout. This leaves two questions entangled: does update randomness help learn a useful rule, and must that randomness remain at execution? We separate training and evaluation update modes in controlled Growing NCA experiments, then vary the states shown during training. Under the standard constant-rate persist recipe, asynchronous training passes the short-horizon quality test in 10/10 runs, compared with 3/10 synchronous runs. All ten asynchronous models also retain the target for 4,096 steps under deterministic evaluation. For a scalar translation-invariant lattice, we derive an exact mean-square criterion: random masking can damp mean modes, but it also injects variance, and a mean-only test misclassifies four non-marginal settings. Finally, among 30 models that all pass the same reconstruction test, eight of ten grow-trained models become off-target at 4,096 steps, while all persist and regenerate models retain the target; damage recovery separates persist from regenerate. The results distinguish optimization reliability, execution mode, and task-specific behavior instead of treating them as one stability property.

AI.tldr: 该文通过分离训练与评估的更新模式，系统研究随机性在神经细胞自动机（NCA）中"是否有助学习"与"是否必须保留于执行"两个问题。
AI.motivation: 随机细胞更新贯穿NCA全程（从BPTT到最终rollout），导致"随机性是否有助于学到有用规则"与"该随机性是否必须在执行阶段保留"两个问题相互纠缠，难以厘清。作者希望将优化可靠性、执行模式与任务特定行为三者解耦，而非笼统地当作单一稳定性属性处理。
AI.method: 在受控的Growing NCA实验中分离训练与评估的更新模式，并改变训练时呈现的状态；对比异步与同步训练在短时程质量测试上的表现；针对标量平移不变格点推导精确的均方判据，分析随机掩码对均值模态的阻尼与方差注入；并比较30个通过同一重建测试的模型（grow、persist、regenerate）在4,096步长时程与损伤恢复中的表现。
AI.result: 标准恒定速率persist配方下，异步训练10/10次通过短时程质量测试，而同步仅3/10；10个异步模型在确定性评估下均能保持目标达4,096步。均方判据显示随机掩码虽能阻尼均值模态，但会注入方差，仅用均值检验会误判四种非边缘设置。在30个通过同一重建测试的模型中，10个grow-trained模型有8个在4,096步偏离目标，而persist与regenerate模型全部保持目标；损伤恢复可区分persist与regenerate。
AI.conclusion: 研究将优化可靠性、执行模式与任务特定行为区分开来，而非视为单一稳定性属性；随机性对学习有益，但不必然需要在执行阶段保留，且不同训练状态（persist/regenerate/grow）对应不同的长时程与鲁棒性行为。

title: MeanFlowAdvantage: Stable Reward Fine-Tuning for Few-Step Average-Velocity Generators
summary: MeanFlow enables efficient few-step generation by predicting interval-average velocities, but this representation creates a mismatch for reward fine-tuning: existing advantage-based objectives are typically defined on instantaneous velocities or equivalent $x_0$-space predictions, whereas inference directly uses the learned average-velocity map. We introduce MeanFlowAdvantage, a signed advantage-weighted least-squares objective for average-velocity generators. Our key construction uses a shared, detached MeanFlow derivative correction to express the reward objective in prediction space while making rollout and reference regularization exact penalties on the average-velocity network deployed at inference. The resulting formulation preserves MeanFlow's native few-step sampler and provides a direct mechanism for transferring reward improvements to the deployed flow map. On SD3.5-Medium, MeanFlowAdvantage improves all eight reported metrics over the matched four-step MeanFlowNFT baseline and, with only four NFEs, matches or exceeds the 40-step DiffusionNFT baseline on six of eight metrics. The same objective also transfers to DNA promoter design, where it supports both teacher-free on-policy RL for a generator defined on a manifold and teacher-guided reward-graded distillation, with the latter yielding the lowest one-step Sei profile MSE among the compared configurations.

AI.tldr: 本文提出 MeanFlowAdvantage，一种针对平均速度生成器的带符号优势加权最小二乘目标，用于 MeanFlow 的奖励微调，使推理阶段部署的平均速度网络能直接获得奖励改进，并在图像生成与 DNA 启动子设计任务上验证有效性。
AI.motivation: MeanFlow 通过预测区间平均速度实现高效少步生成，但该表示与奖励微调存在不匹配：现有基于优势的目标通常定义在瞬时速度或等价的 x0 空间预测上，而推理时直接使用学习到的平均速度映射，导致优化目标与部署模型不一致，奖励提升难以有效迁移到实际采样的流映射。
AI.method: 提出 MeanFlowAdvantage：一种针对平均速度生成器的带符号优势加权最小二乘目标。核心构造使用共享的、detached 的 MeanFlow 导数校正，将奖励目标表达在预测空间中，同时使 rollout 与参考正则化成为部署于推理的平均速度网络上的精确惩罚项，从而保留 MeanFlow 原生少步采样器，并提供将奖励改进转移到部署流映射的直接机制。
AI.result: 在 SD3.5-Medium 上，MeanFlowAdvantage 在全部八项报告指标上优于匹配的四步 MeanFlowNFT 基线；仅用 4 次 NFE 即在八项指标中的六项上达到或超过 40 步 DiffusionNFT 基线。该目标同样迁移到 DNA 启动子设计：支持流形上定义生成器的无教师 on-policy RL，以及教师引导的奖励分级蒸馏，其中后者在所比较配置中取得最低的一步 Sei profile MSE。
AI.conclusion: MeanFlowAdvantage 通过将奖励目标与推理时部署的平均速度映射对齐，解决了 MeanFlow 奖励微调中的表示不匹配问题，在保持原生少步采样器的同时实现了高效的奖励迁移，并在图像生成与生物序列设计两类任务上展现出良好效果与泛化性。

title: EasyPPO: Stabilizing the Critic Is Key
summary: A key strength of Proximal Policy Optimization (PPO) is its learned critic, which uses historical trajectories collected during reinforcement learning to estimate expected returns and reduce policy-gradient variance. However, we find that the critic is also a major source of instability in reinforcement learning for large language models (LLMs). We identify two critic failure modes that destabilize PPO. First, filtering truncated rollouts from both actor and critic shifts the policy objective to reward conditioned on completion, allowing truncation to increase even as conditional reward improves. Second, heterogeneous return noise can cause high-variance prompts to dominate critic updates in finite batches. We introduce EasyPPO to address these failures. Actor-only overlong filtering trains the critic on returns from both completed and truncated rollouts. Noise-normalized critic regression weights each prompt's critic loss by the inverse standard deviation of its sampled returns, balancing noise contributions across prompts. Moderately smaller critic mini-batches confine outlier influence to fewer rollouts during gradient clipping. Across continuous-reward coding on FrontierCS, binary-reward mathematical reasoning on AIME24, and multi-turn search on Search-R1, EasyPPO remains stable throughout the full training horizon and consistently outperforms vanilla PPO, VAPO, and HL-Gauss PPO. Its best validation scores show relative gains of 14.89%, 2.28%, and 9.47% over PPO, respectively.

AI.tldr: 本文发现PPO在大语言模型强化学习中，critic是主要的不稳定来源，并识别出两种失效模式，提出EasyPPO进行修复。
AI.motivation: PPO的critic虽能降低策略梯度方差，但在LLM强化学习中反而成为不稳定性的主要来源，作者希望定位并解决这一矛盾。
AI.method: 作者识别两种critic失效模式：一是同时从actor和critic中过滤截断rollout，使策略目标转变为以完成为条件的reward，导致截断率上升而条件reward虽改善；二是异构回报噪声使高方差prompt在有限batch中主导critic更新。EasyPPO提出三项改进：actor-only的过长过滤（用完成和截断rollout的回报共同训练critic）、噪声归一化critic回归（按每个prompt采样回报标准差的倒数加权其critic损失）、适度减小critic mini-batch以限制clipping时异常值影响范围。
AI.result: 在FrontierCS连续reward编码、AIME24二元reward数学推理和Search-R1多轮搜索任务上，EasyPPO在整个训练周期内保持稳定，并持续优于vanilla PPO、VAPO和HL-Gauss PPO；相对PPO的最佳验证分数分别提升14.89%、2.28%和9.47%。
AI.conclusion: 通过针对critic的两类失效模式进行修复，EasyPPO显著提升了LLM强化学习的稳定性与性能。

title: KUPAS MASTER: Distilling the Tacit Expertise of Master Practitioners into Agent-Ready Experience Corpora
comment: Technical Report. Official website: https://lsf.kupasai.com/ Report homepage: https://tongjiai4e.github.io/KUPAS-MASTER-Report/
summary: Experienced professionals know more than just facts and conclusions. They know which cues matter, why a judgment is reasonable, and which action to take. Routine work records often leave out this tacit knowledge, making it difficult for Large Language Model (LLM) agents to use professional experience effectively. We introduce KUPAS MASTER, an experience engineering platform built around nine-layer cognitive corpus construction. It turns heterogeneous work records and practitioner interviews into traceable, reusable experience corpora for agents. Six case elements preserve the task process: context, cues, judgment, action, boundaries, and outcomes. Nine-layer cognitive corpus construction organizes tacit experience along nine extraction dimensions and stores the resulting assets in six libraries: rules, constraints, best practices, negative examples, corner cases, and skills. Semantic alignment, individual experience distillation, organizational consolidation, and cross-review preserve source evidence, conditions of use, and unresolved disagreements. The platform packages these assets into callable skills with explicit inputs, steps, dependencies, and stopping conditions, connecting experience collection to task execution and evaluation feedback. Using authorized samples from 20 randomly selected practitioners, the platform processed 1,576 source files into 23,024 individual experience records and 13,113 organizational assets. The evaluation spans multiple professional domains. Under common task inputs and scoring criteria, the base model, raw corpus retrieval-augmented generation (RAG), and KUPAS MASTER agent scored 70.63, 79.75, and 89.58, respectively. The KUPAS MASTER agent improved on raw-corpus RAG in all seven scoring dimensions. The platform provides a practical path from individual tacit experience to organizational knowledge and agent capabilities.

AI.tldr: 本文提出KUPAS MASTER经验工程平台，通过九层认知语料库构建，将异构工作记录与从业者访谈转化为可溯源、可复用的经验语料，并封装为可调用的技能供LLM智能体使用。
AI.motivation: 资深专业人员的知识不仅包括事实与结论，还包含哪些线索重要、判断为何合理、应采取何种行动等隐性知识，而常规工作记录往往缺失这些内容，导致LLM智能体难以有效利用专业经验。
AI.method: 平台包含：六类案例要素（情境、线索、判断、行动、边界、结果）保留任务过程；九层认知语料库构建沿九个抽取维度组织隐性经验，并将资产存入六个库（规则、约束、最佳实践、反例、边角案例、技能）；通过语义对齐、个体经验蒸馏、组织级整合与交叉评审保留来源证据、使用条件与未解决分歧；最终封装为具有显式输入、步骤、依赖与停止条件的可调用技能，连接经验收集、任务执行与评估反馈。
AI.result: 使用20名随机抽取从业者的授权样本，平台将1,576个源文件处理为23,024条个体经验记录和13,113项组织资产。在相同任务输入与评分标准下，基座模型、原始语料RAG与KUPAS MASTER智能体得分分别为70.63、79.75和89.58；KUPAS MASTER在全部七个评分维度上均优于原始语料RAG。
AI.conclusion: 该平台为从个体隐性经验到组织知识及智能体能力提供了一条实用路径。

title: Diffusion Policy Improvement with Proposal-Conditioned Refinement Flows
summary: Diffusion and flow policies can model complex behaviors in offline reinforcement learning (RL). However, penalizing their KL divergence from the behavior policy can discourage actions having high critic values with low behavior density. Directly refining behavior proposals may be an alternative, yet Gaussian or deterministic editors limit expressiveness to represent multiple separated modes for the same proposal. In this work, we introduce Proposal-Conditioned Refinement Flows (PReFlow), a policy extraction method combining critic-based proposal selection with a conditional refinement flow. To optimize proposal selection and refinement together, we formulate a KL-regularized objective whose optimum induces a Gibbs policy over final actions under a Gaussian-smoothed behavior prior. The refinement flow can represent multiple high value modes, while a proposal-centered Gaussian reference regulates large action changes. This Gaussian reference further enables us to make use of simulation-free, closed form adjoint matching targets from sampled endpoints and critic gradients, yielding a single velocity regression loss without a backward adjoint solve. On 50 OGBench tasks, PReFlow achieves competitive offline performance and the highest aggregate score among the compared methods after online fine-tuning, reaching 91\% after 500K environment steps.

AI.tldr: 提出PReFlow，将critic引导的提议选择与条件精炼流结合，通过KL正则化目标导出高斯平滑行为先验下的Gibbs策略，并采用无模拟的闭式伴随匹配目标训练单一速度回归损失，在50个OGBench任务上取得竞争性离线性能与最优在线微调综合得分（500K步达91%）。
AI.motivation: 扩散与流策略能建模复杂行为，但对行为策略的KL散度惩罚会抑制"高critic值但行为密度低"的动作；直接精炼行为提议又受限于高斯或确定性编辑器表达力不足，难以表示同一提议对应的多个分离模式。
AI.method: PReFlow把基于critic的提议选择与条件精炼流耦合，构建KL正则化目标，其最优解在高斯平滑行为先验下诱导出关于最终动作的Gibbs策略。精炼流可表示多个高价值模式，提议中心的高斯参考约束动作大幅变动，并支持从采样端点与critic梯度得到无模拟、闭式的伴随匹配目标，从而只需一个速度回归损失，无需反向伴随求解。
AI.result: 在50个OGBench任务上，PReFlow离线性能具竞争力；经在线微调后综合得分在对比方法中最高，500K环境步达到91%。
AI.conclusion: PReFlow通过提议选择与流精炼的联合优化，兼顾多模态表达与行为先验约束，并借助闭式伴随匹配实现高效训练，验证了其在离线学习与在线微调中的有效性。

title: Learning from Shared-Control Overrides: Context-Driven Acceleration Profile Prediction for Personalized Overtaking
summary: Adaptive Cruise Control (ACC) systems are typically calibrated for an average driver, often resulting in a mismatch between vehicle behavior and individual expectations during time-critical maneuvers such as highway overtaking. When the ACC is perceived as too conservative and inconsistent, drivers intervene through throttle overrides, providing implicit feedback on the system's behavior. This paper reframes these override actions as human-in-theloop supervisory signals and proposes a data-driven framework for personalized vehicle adaptation, termed Context-driven Personalized ACC (CoP-ACC). Rather than relying solely on end-to-end regression, which tends to over-smooth dynamic responses, we introduce a hybrid pipeline combining: (i) unsupervised hierarchical clustering to extract representative acceleration profiles from override events; (ii) a context classifier that maps pre-maneuver driving conditions to the appropriate profile; and (iii) a residual regressor that refines the selected profile into a smooth, personalized acceleration profile tailored to the immediate context. Evaluated on real-world public-road data against a withheld forced-ACC baseline, the approach demonstrates high reconstruction fidelity and generates acceleration profiles that tend toward the driver's expected behavior in potential override contexts. The results highlight the potential of learning from shared-control overrides to enable anticipatory, personalized ACC behavior, reducing manual interventions and improving ride comfort.

AI.tldr: 该论文提出CoP-ACC框架，将驾驶员油门超控行为视为人类在环监督信号，通过无监督层次聚类、上下文分类器与残差回归的混合流程，实现个性化自适应巡航控制。
AI.motivation: ACC系统通常按平均驾驶员标定，导致在高速公路超车等时间关键机动中，车辆行为与个体预期不匹配。当ACC被认为过于保守或不一致时，驾驶员会通过油门超控介入，这种介入隐含了对系统行为的反馈。论文试图利用这种共享控制中的超控信号，实现个性化的车辆自适应。
AI.method: 提出Context-driven Personalized ACC (CoP-ACC)数据驱动框架，采用混合流程：(i) 无监督层次聚类，从超控事件中提取代表性加速度曲线；(ii) 上下文分类器，将机动前的驾驶条件映射到合适的曲线；(iii) 残差回归器，将所选曲线细化为平滑的、针对即时上下文定制的个性化加速度曲线。避免仅依赖易过度平滑动态响应的端到端回归。
AI.result: 在真实公开道路数据上，与保留的强制ACC基线对比评估，方法展现出高重建保真度，并能生成倾向于驾驶员预期行为的加速度曲线，特别是在潜在超控情境下。
AI.conclusion: 结果表明，从共享控制超控中学习有望实现预判式个性化ACC行为，从而减少人工干预并提升乘坐舒适性。

title: RESCUE: Repairing Language Model Errors to Sparse Circuits via Reinforcement Learning
summary: Large language models (LLMs) exhibit strong general capabilities that mechanistic interpretability has attributed to sparse computational circuits. However, existing circuit studies emphasize preserving functionality or explaining safety, leaving the mechanisms underlying failures across a broader range of tasks largely unexplored. Extending circuit analysis from abilities to errors, we explore the perspective that such failures may likewise arise from erroneous internal computations and that targeted tuning of the corresponding parameters can correct such errors while largely preserving other capabilities. Motivated by this insight, we introduce RESCUE (Reasoning-Error Sparse-Circuit Uncovering and Editing), a framework that localizes error-associated circuits and surgically repairs them for performance enhancement. General tasks typically involve multi-step reasoning and long-form generation, where early deviations can cause prefixes to drift from supervised references, leading SFT-based mask optimization to overlook circuits involved in generation-time errors. RESCUE therefore refines these masks through reinforcement learning with multiple masked-model rollouts, improving their relevance to observed task failures. Finally, RESCUE introduces a pruning technique and precisely fine-tunes error circuits to correct task failures, thereby translating error localization into a sparse and targeted model update. We validate RESCUE on heterogeneous repair sets across two domains: (1) mathematical reasoning, identifying a math error circuit of 1.40% density whose repair raises accuracy from 6.0% to 75.5%; and (2) medical QA, where a similarly compact 1.44% circuit improves repair-set accuracy from 0% to 81%. Our code is available at: https://github.com/chuanpupig/RESCUE.

AI.tldr: 本文提出RESCUE框架，将机制可解释性中的电路分析从"能力"扩展到"错误"，通过定位错误相关稀疏电路并对其进行外科式修复来提升模型性能，在数学推理和医学问答任务上均取得显著效果。
AI.motivation: 现有电路研究主要强调保持功能或解释安全性，而跨任务失败的机制尚未被充分探索。作者提出一个视角：任务失败同样源于错误的内部计算，且对相应参数进行针对性调整可纠正错误，同时基本保留其他能力。
AI.method: RESCUE（Reasoning-Error Sparse-Circuit Uncovering and Editing）框架：首先定位错误关联电路；针对多步推理与长文本生成中早期偏差导致前缀漂移、使基于SFT的掩码优化忽略生成时错误电路的问题，采用强化学习结合多次掩码模型rollout来精化掩码；最后引入剪枝技术并精确微调错误电路，将错误定位转化为稀疏且有针对性的模型更新。
AI.result: 在两个领域的异构修复集上验证：(1)数学推理中识别出密度为1.40%的数学错误电路，修复后准确率从6.0%提升至75.5%；(2)医学问答中，1.44%的紧凑电路将修复集准确率从0%提升至81%。
AI.conclusion: 实验表明，任务失败可由稀疏的错误电路解释，定位并精准编辑这些电路能在极低参数密度下大幅修复性能，验证了从能力分析扩展到错误分析这一视角的有效性。

title: EngiWorld: What Can Frontier Agents Deliver in Professional Engineering Environments?
summary: Autonomous agents have made rapid progress in general-purpose computer use, but reliable automation of professional industrial engineering remains out of reach, as engineering workflows demand reasoning over geometric and physical constraints and dependencies preserved across software and design stages. We present EngiWorld, the first benchmark structured around the complete design loop: 1,301 expert-curated tasks spanning 6 engineering domains (CAD, CAE, CAM, BIM, EDA, and 3D visualization) and 26 professional software platforms, with both GUI and CLI interfaces and 6 task types ranging from software-selection to open-ended tasks. We further introduce an artifact-centric evaluation methodology built on a unified domain-verifier suite, which programmatically checks the geometric validity, physical feasibility, and rule compliance of final and intermediate artifacts, and scores quantitative design tasks continuously by specification attainment rather than binary success. Evaluation of seven frontier models reveals a substantial capability gap: the strongest model achieves an EngiScore of only 44.3, and just 3.6% of multi-software attempts succeed. EngiWorld provides the first rigorous foundation for measuring progress toward agents that operate professional engineering software end to end.

AI.tldr: EngiWorld是首个面向完整工程设计闭环的自主智能体基准，涵盖6大工程领域、26个专业软件、1,301个专家任务，并提出以产物为中心、基于统一领域验证器的评估方法。评测显示前沿模型能力差距显著，最强模型EngiScore仅44.3，多软件任务成功率仅3.6%。
AI.motivation: 通用计算机使用智能体进展迅速，但专业工业工程自动化仍难实现，因为工程工作流需要在软件与设计阶段之间保持几何、物理约束与依赖关系的推理。现有基准无法衡量此类端到端专业工程能力。
AI.method: 提出EngiWorld基准：1,301个专家策划任务，覆盖CAD、CAE、CAM、BIM、EDA、3D可视化6个工程领域和26个专业软件平台；提供GUI与CLI两类接口；含6类任务（从软件选择到开放式任务）。同时提出以产物为中心的评估方法，基于统一领域验证器套件，对最终与中间产物的几何有效性、物理可行性与规则合规性进行程序化校验，并按规格达成度对定量设计任务连续打分，而非二元成功判定。
AI.result: 对7个前沿模型评测显示存在显著能力差距：最强模型EngiScore仅为44.3；多软件协同任务中仅3.6%尝试成功。
AI.conclusion: EngiWorld为衡量智能体端到端操作专业工程软件的能力提供了首个严谨基础，揭示了当前模型在专业工业工程自动化上的巨大差距。

title: Towards Better Training Signal: Advantage Clipped Policy Optimization
summary: Reinforcement learning (RL) has become a cornerstone for improving the reasoning capabilities of large language models (LLMs), but the need for on-policy data substantially limits training efficiency. Reusing off-policy data through importance sampling (IS) can improve efficiency but introduce considerable instability. Hence, algorithms such as PPO and GRPO widely adopt IS-ratio clipping to stabilize training. However, training stability and gradient estimate are mainly determined by the product of IS ratio and advantage. To further stabilize training, we propose ACPO, which clips the product of the IS ratio and the advantage, leading to more stable gradient estimates. We also establish a connection between ACPO and gradient clipping in policy mirror descent (PMD), which is a standard technique to stabilize optimization process, and prove the convergence of clipped-PMD under the standard RL setting. Experiments on widely used mathematical reasoning benchmarks show that ACPO consistently outperforms PPO and GRPO in both accuracy and training efficiency, delivering 4-6 percentage points gains on standard math benchmarks, with Qwen3-8B+PPO. Hence, ACPO is a practical and effective alternative to conventional IS-ratio clipping for RL post-training of LLMs.

AI.tldr: 提出ACPO算法，通过裁剪重要性采样比率与优势的乘积来获得更稳定的梯度估计，并证明其与策略镜像下降中梯度裁剪的联系及收敛性。
AI.motivation: 强化学习是提升大语言模型推理能力的关键手段，但依赖on-policy数据严重制约训练效率。复用off-policy数据可借助重要性采样（IS）提升效率，却会引入不稳定性。PPO、GRPO等算法采用IS比率裁剪来稳定训练，然而训练稳定性与梯度估计主要由IS比率与优势的乘积决定，仅裁剪比率本身不足以充分稳定训练。
AI.method: 提出ACPO算法，直接对IS比率与优势的乘积进行裁剪，从而获得更稳定的梯度估计。进一步建立ACPO与策略镜像下降（PMD）中梯度裁剪的联系，并在标准强化学习设定下证明裁剪版PMD的收敛性。
AI.result: 在广泛使用的数学推理基准上，ACPO在准确率与训练效率上稳定优于PPO和GRPO，在标准数学基准上相对Qwen3-8B+PPO取得4-6个百分点的提升。
AI.conclusion: ACPO是LLM强化学习后训练中传统IS比率裁剪的实用且有效的替代方案。

title: WISE-ATTA: When to Ask for Labels in Budgeted Active Test-Time Adaptation
summary: Active test-time adaptation (ATTA) improves robustness under distribution shift by updating a deployed model during inference while selectively querying supervision. However, most existing ATTA methods implicitly assume that supervision can be requested for every incoming test batch, which can incur substantial annotation cost over long test streams. In this work, we introduce \emph{budgeted ATTA} in which labels are available for only a fraction of test batches. This formulation shifts the central challenge from deciding \emph{what} to label within a batch to deciding \emph{when} supervision should be applied over time. To address this challenge, we propose a budget-aware approach \emph{WISE-ATTA} that allocates supervision over the test stream based on lightweight signals computed online, prioritizing periods where supervision is likely to be most useful. When a batch is selected for supervision, we further employ a drift-based sample selection criterion that targets samples exhibiting ongoing, unconverged adaptation dynamics, enabling effective updates from a single labeled example. We evaluate this approach on synthetic corruptions (ImageNet-C) and natural distribution shifts (ImageNet-R/K/A). Across settings, WISE-ATTA achieves competitive or improved performance compared to recent ATTA methods while requiring substantially fewer labels. Overall, we find that the timing of supervision is a key, yet underexplored, aspect of active test-time adaptation. Code: https://github.com/Muhammad-Huzaifaa/WISE-ATTA

AI.tldr: 本文提出"预算受限的主动测试时自适应(budgeted ATTA)"设定，标签仅可用于部分测试批次，并设计WISE-ATTA方法在线分配监督时机，以更少标签达到竞争性或更优性能。
AI.motivation: 现有主动测试时自适应(ATTA)方法隐含假设可对每个到来的测试批次请求监督，导致长测试流上标注成本过高。因此需要将标签预算限制在部分批次，核心问题从"在一个批次内标注哪些样本"转变为"何时施加监督"。
AI.method: 提出预算感知的WISE-ATTA：(1)基于在线计算的轻量信号将监督分配到测试流中，优先选择监督最有用的时段；(2)当某批次被选中监督时，采用基于漂移的样本选择准则，聚焦仍处于未收敛自适应动态的样本，使单标签样本即可有效更新。
AI.result: 在合成损坏(ImageNet-C)与自然分布偏移(ImageNet-R/K/A)上评估，WISE-ATTA在显著减少标签需求的同时，性能与近期ATTA方法相当或更优。
AI.conclusion: 监督的时机(timing)是主动测试时自适应中关键但研究不足的方面。代码已开源。

title: CorrGRPO: Correlation-Normalized GRPO for Multi-Reward Learning
summary: Group Relative Policy Optimization (GRPO) is widely used to train reasoning language models, where it computes advantages by centering and normalizing rewards across rollouts of the same prompt. For multiple rewards, GRPO sums the reward components and normalizes the total reward by its within-group standard deviation. The corresponding variance equals the sum of all pairwise reward covariances. For a fixed centered reward, larger aggregate covariance produces smaller advantages, and vice versa, allowing update magnitudes to adapt to reward dependence. However, correlated rewards with large scales can dominate this normalization and suppress signals from smaller-scale rewards. We propose Correlation-Normalized GRPO (CorrGRPO), which normalizes pairwise covariances into Pearson correlation coefficients. CorrGRPO keeps the centered total reward unchanged while balancing the influence of differently scaled rewards on the correlation-based normalization. This allows advantage magnitudes to adapt to reward correlations without the normalization being dominated by large-scale reward components. We compare CorrGRPO with GRPO and other variants on code generation, tool calling, and agent security, using models ranging from 0.5B to 8B parameters. These tasks all involve multiple rewards that can improve together or present tradeoffs. Results show improvements across three domains, including code generation, tool calling, and agent security. Our code is available at https://github.com/HKUST-KnowComp/CorrGRPO.

AI.tldr: 论文提出CorrGRPO，将GRPO多奖励归一化中的成对协方差替换为Pearson相关系数，避免大尺度相关奖励主导归一化，在代码生成、工具调用与智能体安全三任务上均优于GRPO及其变体。
AI.motivation: GRPO在多奖励设置下通过组内标准差归一化总奖励，其方差等于所有成对奖励协方差之和，虽能让优势幅度自适应奖励依赖关系，但大尺度且相关的奖励分量会主导归一化，压制小尺度奖励的信号。
AI.method: 提出CorrGRPO：保持中心化总奖励不变，将成对协方差归一化为Pearson相关系数，从而在基于相关性的归一化中平衡不同尺度奖励的影响，使优势幅度自适应奖励相关性而不被大尺度分量主导。
AI.result: 在代码生成、工具调用和智能体安全三个涉及多奖励（可协同或存在权衡）的任务上，使用0.5B至8B参数的模型，CorrGRPO相比GRPO及其他变体均取得提升。
AI.conclusion: CorrGRPO通过相关性归一化改进了GRPO的多奖励优势估计，缓解尺度主导问题，在多领域任务上验证了有效性，代码已开源。

title: Locating Answer-Correctness Signals in Frozen Large Language Models
summary: Language models expose internal signals that predict whether an answer is correct, readable from a single forward pass of a frozen model without additional generations. Yet existing probes often commit to one signal family or layer and can be brittle under distribution shift; in retrieval-augmented settings, many specialized detectors instead target passage faithfulness, which can diverge from correctness when retrieved evidence is unhelpful or conflicting. We therefore ask where answer correctness is readable, which internal signal families carry it, and how they should be combined. We search over hidden states, token probabilities, residual-stream features, attention, and their fusion, treating the selected readouts as a predictive measurement rather than a mechanistic localization. We run this analysis separately in closed-book and with-context settings, since context can change which readouts are informative. A consistent anatomy emerges: correctness concentrates in the answer span, recovered from the answer tokens even under retrieval, and the families carry it complementarily, so fusing them helps most out of distribution, where a single signal is weakest. The protocol is effective across two backbones and gates a retrieval controller as one downstream use.

AI.tldr: 该研究系统性地探究了语言模型内部哪些信号家族可读取答案正确性、如何组合，以及闭卷与有上下文两种设置下的差异，发现正确性主要集中在答案跨度、各信号家族互补，融合后在分布外场景增益最大。
AI.motivation: 现有探针往往局限于单一信号家族或某一层，分布偏移下易失效；检索增强场景中许多检测器聚焦于段落忠实度，但当检索证据无用或冲突时，忠实度与正确性会背离。因此需要回答：答案正确性在哪里可读取、由哪些内部信号家族承载、应如何组合。
AI.method: 对隐藏状态、token 概率、残差流特征、注意力及其融合进行搜索，将所选读出视为预测性测量而非机制定位；分别在闭卷与带上下文两种设置下进行分析。
AI.result: 呈现出一致的"解剖结构"：正确性集中在答案跨度，即使在检索条件下也能从答案 token 恢复；各信号家族互补地承载正确性，融合在分布外（单一信号最弱处）收益最大。该协议在两个骨干模型上均有效，并可作为检索控制器的门控用于下游任务。
AI.conclusion: 答案正确性可从冻结模型单次前向传播中读取且集中在答案跨度，多信号家族融合优于单一信号，尤其利于分布外场景，并可支持检索控制等下游应用。

title: RolloutFaith: Auditing Persistent Internal Interventions in Visual World Model
summary: Interpretability methods such as probes, activation patches and learned editors are designed to reveal or modify a model's current computation. World models pose a harder requirement: because their predictions become inputs to later predictions, a useful internal correction must survive after editing stops. We therefore propose RolloutFaith, a framework that measures semantic improvement both in the prediction produced at intervention time and over later autonomous predictions under fixed events, actions, noise, and information budgets. We evaluate ten fitted editors on three world models across Crafter, Cartpole, and CoinRun. We also use Reference Activation Patching, which replaces a model activation with the paired activation computed from the real observation, to measure the correction available at the chosen interface. This reference intervention improves later predictions in all nine model and task combinations and outperforms the best fitted editor in eight, yet its sustained gain decreases with horizon in five of nine combinations. Current fitted editors recover only limited and inconsistent long term effects. By restoring individual state components to their untouched values, we find that persistent effects travel through the newest generated frame in DIAMOND, recurrent memory in DreamerV3, and both in STORM. These findings suggest that training should reward future consequences. To test this hypothesis, we propose Delayed LoReFT, which optimizes the same low rank intervention through four frozen future transitions and improves sustained intervention effects to some extent.

AI.tldr: 本文提出 RolloutFaith 框架，用于评估世界模型内部干预在停止干预后对后续自主预测的持续改善效果，并在多个模型与任务上系统评测了十种编辑器与参考激活补丁干预。
AI.motivation: 现有可解释性方法（探针、激活补丁、学习型编辑器）多针对模型当前计算进行揭示或修改，但世界模型的预测会成为后续预测的输入，因此真正有用的内部修正必须在干预停止后仍能持续生效，而这一点此前缺乏衡量手段。
AI.method: 提出 RolloutFaith 框架，在固定事件、动作、噪声与信息预算下，同时衡量干预时刻预测的语义改进以及后续自主预测中的改进。在 Crafter、Cartpole、CoinRun 三类任务上，跨三个世界模型评估十种拟合编辑器；并引入 Reference Activation Patching，用真实观测配对激活替换模型激活以度量接口处可用的修正。此外通过将单个状态分量恢复为未干预值来定位持续效应的传播路径，并提出 Delayed LoReFT，通过四个冻结的未来转移优化同一低秩干预。
AI.result: 参考干预在全部九个模型—任务组合中均改善后续预测，并在八个组合中优于最佳拟合编辑器；但其持续增益在九个组合中的五个随预测时域增加而衰减。当前拟合编辑器仅能恢复有限且不一致的长期效应。持续效应在 DIAMOND 中经由最新生成帧传播，在 DreamerV3 中经由循环记忆传播，在 STORM 中两者皆有。Delayed LoReFT 在一定程度上提升了持续干预效果。
AI.conclusion: 结果表明，要获得持久有效的内部修正，训练目标应奖励未来后果，而非仅优化干预时刻的即时效果；Delayed LoReFT 为此提供了初步验证。

title: Generative Interactions: Weaving Multiparty Human Motion with Bilevel Latent Dynamics
summary: Human social behaviour is not a collection of independent motions, but a jointly organised process in which group dynamics and individual variation continuously shape one another. Yet existing social motion models often prioritise plausible trajectories while leaving interaction state implicit, limiting their ability to transfer across groups, tasks, and partial-observation regimes. To address this gap, we introduce Bilevel Representations for Agent Interaction Dynamics (BRAID), a hierarchical sequential latent-variable model for generative multi-person interaction. BRAID explicitly formulates social motion generation as a meta-transfer learning problem: shared interaction priors are learned across datasets and adapted through arbitrary context sets of observed people and joints. The model represents each scene through a group-level latent state that captures shared interaction dynamics and person-level latent states that capture individual behaviour conditioned on the evolving group context. This modelling choice enables coherent generation under full, sparse, or partial observations while exposing compact social-state vectors that can serve as an interface for downstream embodied-agent systems. We evaluate BRAID under a unified SMPL-based representation on social forecasting, tracking and in-filling, and response generation, using metrics that assess not only reconstruction accuracy but also realism, diversity, temporal alignment, and interpersonal coordination. We further analyse the hierarchical latent space, showing that it captures separable group- and individual-level structure.

AI.tldr: 本文提出BRAID，一种用于生成式多人交互的分层序列潜变量模型，将社会运动生成显式建模为元迁移学习问题，通过群体级与个人级潜状态实现跨数据集、跨任务的连贯生成，并暴露紧凑的社会状态向量供下游具身智能体使用。
AI.motivation: 现有社会运动模型多侧重生成合理轨迹，却将交互状态隐式化，导致跨群体、跨任务及部分观测场景下泛化能力受限。人类社交行为本质是群体动态与个体差异相互塑造的联合过程，需显式建模交互状态以提升可迁移性。
AI.method: BRAID采用分层序列潜变量框架，将社会运动生成形式化为元迁移学习：跨数据集学习共享交互先验，并通过任意上下文集合（观测到的人与关节）进行自适应。模型以群体级潜状态捕捉共享交互动态，以个人级潜状态捕捉在演化群体上下文下的个体行为，从而支持完整、稀疏或部分观测下的连贯生成。
AI.result: 在统一SMPL表示下，BRAID在社会预测、跟踪与补全、响应生成任务上进行了评估，指标涵盖重建精度、真实感、多样性、时间对齐及人际协调性。分层潜空间分析表明其可分离出群体级与个体级结构。
AI.conclusion: BRAID通过显式分层交互表征与元迁移学习范式，克服了传统模型的隐式交互状态瓶颈，实现了跨群体、跨任务及部分观测下的强泛化能力，并提供了可作为下游具身智能体接口的紧凑社会状态向量。

title: An Effective, Reliable, and Robust Framework for Human Activity Recognition Using Wearable Sensors
summary: Human Activity Recognition (HAR) through wearable sensors greatly improves the quality of human life through its multiple applications. For HAR, multi-sensor channel information is vital for optimal performance. Current work states that applying an attention neural network to prioritize discriminatory sensor channels helps the model classify activity more precisely. However, obtaining discriminatory information from multisensory channels is not always trivial, such as when collecting data from older hospitalized patients. In this context, existing HAR methods struggle to classify activities, particularly activities with similar natures. Moreover, HAR models predominantly suffer from overfitting due to the small size of available datasets, which leads to poor performance. Data augmentation (DA) is a viable solution to this problem. However, available DA methods have various drawbacks, including the possibility of being domain-dependent, resulting in distorted models for test sequences. To address these HAR problems, we propose a novel framework, ALAE-TAE-CutMix+, which focuses on two aspects. First, it enhances the latent information across each sensor channel and learns to exploit the relation among multiple latent features and the ongoing activity. Consequently, the discriminatory feature representations of each activity is enriched. Second, a new augmentation strategy is introduced to address the shortcomings of existing multi-sensor channel data augmentation. We then extend the framework to create a further enhanced version, namely ALAE-CIE-TAE-CutMix+, which learns to capture the interactions between the features of each pair of sensor channels. We find that although the first framework performs slightly better than the latter, the latter is nonetheless more reliable and robust. Both frameworks significantly outperform SOTA approaches on the four HAR datasets from diverse domains.

AI.tldr: 该文针对多传感器HAR中判别性通道信息难获取、数据集小导致过拟合及现有数据增强方法域依赖等问题，提出ALAE-TAE-CutMix+框架及其扩展版ALAE-CIE-TAE-CutMix+，通过增强各传感器通道潜在信息、建模多潜在特征与活动关系、捕获通道对间特征交互并引入新的多通道数据增强策略，在四个不同领域HAR数据集上显著优于SOTA。
AI.motivation: 基于可穿戴传感器的HAR应用广泛且能改善生活质量，多传感器通道信息对性能至关重要。但现有方法在老年住院患者等场景下难以从多通道中提取判别性信息，尤其对相似活动分类困难；同时HAR模型因数据集规模小易过拟合，现有数据增强方法存在域依赖、导致测试序列模型失真等缺陷。
AI.method: 提出ALAE-TAE-CutMix+框架：一方面增强每个传感器通道的潜在信息，学习利用多潜在特征与当前活动之间的关系，从而丰富各活动的判别性特征表示；另一方面引入新的增强策略以克服现有多传感器通道数据增强的不足。进一步扩展为ALAE-CIE-TAE-CutMix+，学习捕获每对传感器通道特征之间的交互。
AI.result: 第一个框架性能略优于第二个框架，但第二个框架更可靠、更鲁棒。两个框架在来自不同领域的四个HAR数据集上均显著优于SOTA方法。
AI.conclusion: 通过增强通道潜在信息、建模多特征关系与通道间交互并改进数据增强，可有效缓解多传感器HAR中的判别信息提取难与过拟合问题；扩展框架虽精度略低但鲁棒性更强，二者整体均显著超越现有先进方法。

title: Context Language Models
summary: We introduce Context Language Models (CLMs), language models that natively manage their own context. We implement this by treating the context as a file and allowing the model to make unrestricted updates to this file. This allows the model to learn what is most important to maintain in context, and naturally extends to multi-agent systems where multiple agent contexts coexist as files. Building CLMs zero-shot with existing models outperforms SOTA context management strategies across a variety of tasks: 11.4% higher accuracy with 21.5% fewer FLOPs on BrowseComp-Plus, 5% higher scores with 59% fewer FLOPs on 12-hour EdgeBench, and 65% greater improvement with the same compute on a 24-hour multi-repository agent-swarm task. Moreover, by shifting context management from external harness control to intrinsic model behavior, CLMs naturally enable both in-context and parametric learning of context-management strategies. We show that CLMs can be steered with natural-language instructions evolved through a standard skill-optimization loop, improving held-out accuracy by up to 35.9 points on a context-management task while reducing compute. We also introduce an online reinforcement learning method for CLMs, improving Qwen3.5-9B performance on BrowseComp-Plus by 47.6% while using 12% fewer FLOPs. Finally, we co-design Suffix Cache Reuse for CLM serving, further reducing server-side compute by 35% relative to standard SGLang at matched performance.

AI.tldr: 本文提出上下文语言模型（CLM），将上下文视为模型可自主编辑的文件，实现内生的上下文管理，在多项长时任务上以更低算力取得更优表现。
AI.motivation: 现有上下文管理依赖外部框架的启发式规则或harness控制，模型无法自主学习"什么值得保留在上下文中"，导致长时程与多智能体场景下算力浪费严重。
AI.method: 将上下文表示为文件并允许模型无限制更新，使上下文管理从外部控制转为模型内在行为；零样本方式基于现有模型构建，天然支持多智能体多文件上下文；并引入自然语言技能优化循环与在线强化学习方法，同时协同设计Suffix Cache Reuse推理服务方案。
AI.result: BrowseComp-Plus准确率提升11.4%且FLOPs减少21.5%；12小时EdgeBench得分提升5%且FLOPs减少59%；24小时多仓库agent-swarm任务同等算力下提升65%；技能优化使留出集准确率最多提升35.9分；在线RL使Qwen3.5-9B在BrowseComp-Plus提升47.6%且FLOPs减少12%；服务端Suffix Cache Reuse在同等性能下算力再降35%。
AI.conclusion: 上下文管理可由外部harness控制转为模型内在能力，从而同时支持上下文内与参数化学习该策略，并在性能、算力效率及服务部署三方面均取得一致收益。

title: Markovian Nonconvex ADMM for Reinforcement Learning: Bellman-Resolvent Stability Beyond Smooth Blocks
summary: We identify and study a structural mechanism for Markovian nonconvex ADMM in reinforcement learning. Using finite discounted MDPs as a canonical proving ground, we show that the discounted Bellman resolvent $(I-γP_π)^{-1}$ can provide the multiplier stability that classical nonconvex ADMM analyses often obtain from a designated smooth block. Starting from this mechanism, we establish convergence under controlled Markov sampling and then under stochastic observations using an empirical Bellman surrogate that jointly represents the random residual and its Jacobian. Markov mixing, initialization drift, observation noise, and decaying bias enter as one operator perturbation, avoiding unbiased product and double sampling requirements. When the perturbations are square summable, the true KKT residual converges almost surely to zero. Under a finite conditional fourth moment condition, a companion iterate satisfies $ \mathbb{E}[\widetilde G_{K+1}] \le A/T+(B/T)\sum_{k<T}m_k^{-1}, $ which becomes $O(T^{-1}+T/N)$ for total Markov sample budget $N$, giving $O(ε^{-1})$ iteration complexity and $O(ε^{-2})$ sample complexity for squared KKT accuracy $ε$. Beyond stationarity, discounted occupancy coverage yields $J^\star-J(π)=O(\sqrt G)$ for direct tabular policies, so covered exact KKT points are globally optimal, while a statewise quadratic Bellman-improvement condition sharpens the relation to $O(G)$. Finally, nonlinear policy, projected Bellman, and explicit occupancy formulations exhibit the same chain of operator invertibility, dual representation, and multiplier stability. This supports discounted operator invertibility as a reusable structural principle for primal-dual reinforcement learning.

AI.tldr: 本文识别并研究了马尔可夫非凸ADMM在强化学习中的一种结构性机制：贴现Bellman预解算子$(I-\gamma P_\pi)^{-1}$可提供经典非凸ADMM分析中通常由光滑块获得的多乘子稳定性。作者在有限贴现MDP上建立了在受控马尔可夫采样及随机观测下的收敛性，证明真实KKT残差几乎必然收敛到零，并给出迭代复杂度和样本复杂度界，同时刻画了KKT点与全局最优性的关系。
AI.motivation: 经典非凸ADMM的乘子稳定性通常依赖某个指定的光滑块，但在强化学习的马尔可夫非凸设定下这一条件难以满足。本文旨在寻找一种适用于强化学习的、可复用的结构性机制来保证乘子稳定性与收敛性，并避免无偏乘积采样与双重采样等苛刻要求。
AI.method: 以有限贴现MDP为理论基准，利用贴现Bellman预解算子$(I-\gamma P_\pi)^{-1}$提供乘子稳定性。先在受控马尔可夫采样下建立收敛，再通过同时表示随机残差及其雅可比的经验Bellman替代量扩展到随机观测情形，将马尔可夫混合、初始化漂移、观测噪声与衰减偏差统一为一个算子扰动。进一步分析贴现占用覆盖下的次优性界，考察非线性策略、投影Bellman与显式占用等公式化形式。
AI.result: 当扰动平方可和时，真实KKT残差几乎必然收敛到零；在有限条件四阶矩条件下，伴随迭代满足$\mathbb{E}[\widetilde G_{K+1}] \le A/T+(B/T)\sum_{k<T}m_k^{-1}$，对总马尔可夫样本预算$N$化为$O(T^{-1}+T/N)$，从而得到平方KKT精度$\epsilon$下的迭代复杂度$O(\epsilon^{-1})$与样本复杂度$O(\epsilon^{-2})$。在平稳性之外，贴现占用覆盖给出直接表格策略的$J^\star-J(\pi)=O(\sqrt G)$，故被覆盖的精确KKT点为全局最优；逐状态二次Bellman改进条件将该关系强化为$O(G)$。
AI.conclusion: 贴现算子可逆性可作为主对偶强化学习中一种可复用的结构性原理，所提出的机制在多种公式化形式（非线性策略、投影Bellman、显式占用）下均展现出一致的算子可逆性、对偶表示与乘子稳定性链条，为马尔可夫非凸ADMM的收敛性分析提供了统一框架。

title: Spatiotemporal Hyperedges for EEG Seizure Detection and Prediction
summary: Seizure detection and prediction from EEG are clinically important but challenging because seizures are rare, temporally localized, and propagate as coordinated events across multiple channels. Recent dynamic graph neural networks model this by running a temporal model over a sequence of per-time-step pairwise channel edges. However, this pairwise construction misses the spatiotemporal coupling that constitutes a seizure, at substantial training cost. We propose HyBrain, which summarizes spatiotemporal EEG evidence through a small set of soft hyperedges rather than pairwise edges. A per-channel Mamba backbone produces one token per (channel, second), and a spatiotemporal hyperedge block pools these tokens into E_h shared group embeddings through soft memberships and broadcasts them back. The same encoder serves three downstream tasks: window-based detection, one-second point-wise detection, and preictal seizure prediction. On TUSZ and CHB-MIT, HyBrain achieves the best AUROC on every reported setting against ten baselines, with the largest gap on long-clip preictal prediction. It also matches the most efficient baselines in training time and peak GPU memory. A qualitative analysis shows that even a single learned hyperedge cleanly captures the preictal -> ictal -> postictal trajectory on a real seizure clip.

AI.tldr: HyBrain 用少量软超边取代逐时刻成对通道边来建模 EEG 时空耦合，单编码器支持三类任务，在 TUSZ 与 CHB-MIT 上各项指标均取得最优 AUROC 且训练开销低。
AI.motivation: 癫痫发作稀少、时间局部化，且以多通道协同事件形式传播，检测与预测在临床上重要但困难。现有动态图神经网络通过逐时刻成对通道边上的时序模型来刻画，但成对构造忽略了构成发作的时空耦合，且训练代价高昂。
AI.method: 提出 HyBrain：以少量软超边（soft hyperedges）汇总时空 EEG 证据，而非成对边。采用逐通道 Mamba 主干，为每个（通道, 秒）生成一个 token；时空超边模块通过软隶属度将这些 token 池化为 E_h 个共享组嵌入，再广播回原 token。同一编码器服务三个下游任务：窗口级检测、逐秒点检测与发作前预测。
AI.result: 在 TUSZ 与 CHB-MIT 上，HyBrain 在所有报告设置中 AUROC 均优于十个基线，优势在长片段发作前预测上最大；训练时间与峰值 GPU 显存与最高效基线相当。定性分析显示，单一学习到的超边即可清晰刻画真实发作片段中 preictal -> ictal -> postictal 的轨迹。
AI.conclusion: 软超边结构为避免成对图构造的计算负担、同时捕捉癫痫的时空耦合提供了一种高效统一方案，单一编码器可跨检测与预测任务复用，并具备良好的可解释性。

title: Where the Model Changes Its Mind: Hindsight-Divergence Localization for Efficient Reinforcement Learning with Verifiable Rewards
summary: Group-relative methods for reinforcement learning with verifiable rewards (RLVR) learn from differences in rollout outcomes. Independently sampling complete trajectories is costly and does not explicitly explore the decision space at critical positions. Feedback on a completed trajectory can reveal which earlier choices the policy reconsiders, suggesting where to sample alternative continuations. We introduce Hindsight-Divergence Localization (HDL), which uses hindsight-induced changes in token log-likelihoods to select branch points. HDL generates a small number of complete root trajectories and fills each training group with continuations from the selected positions under the original task context. Each continuation reuses its root prefix and contributes policy updates only through its newly generated suffix, reducing generation cost while focusing additional exploration and learning on decisions after branching. Experiments with three models across math, code, and agent tasks show gains in both rollout efficiency and task performance. Compared with GRPO at matched group sizes and training steps, HDL yields up to a 2.5$\times$ reduction in generated tokens and a 1.8$\times$ speedup in rollout wall-clock time. Despite this reduced generation budget, HDL improves performance across all three domains, with gains of up to 12.5 points on agent tasks.

AI.tldr: 提出 Hindsight-Divergence Localization (HDL)，利用事后 token 对数似然变化定位分支点，通过少量根轨迹+续写扩充训练组，在降低生成成本的同时提升多领域任务表现。
AI.motivation: 现有 RLVR 中的组相对方法依赖对完整轨迹的独立采样，代价高昂，且无法显式探索关键决策位置的决策空间；而完整轨迹上的反馈可以揭示策略会重新考量的早期选择，提示可在哪些位置采样替代续写。
AI.method: HDL 使用事后（hindsight）引起的 token 对数似然变化来选取分支点；先产生少量完整的根轨迹，再在原始任务上下文下从所选位置生成续写填充每个训练组。每条续写复用其根前缀，仅通过新生成的后续片段贡献策略更新，从而降低生成成本，并将额外探索与学习集中在分支之后的决策上。
AI.result: 在数学、代码与智能体任务上，用三个模型进行实验。在相同组大小与训练步数下与 GRPO 相比，HDL 最多减少 2.5 倍生成 token，rollout 墙钟时间加速最多 1.8 倍；尽管生成预算更低，HDL 在三个领域均提升性能，智能体任务上最高提升 12.5 个点。
AI.conclusion: HDL 通过事后似然变化定位分支点并复用根前缀，实现了 rollout 效率与任务性能的双重提升，为 RLVR 提供了一种更省算力且聚焦关键决策的采样与更新方案。

title: ContextRender: From Execution Dependencies to Agent Context
summary: LLM agents performing long-horizon tasks accumulate tool results that later steps may need. Passing the full history to every invocation is costly even when it fits within the context window, while reducing it risks omitting needed information. Existing context management methods can overlook how earlier tool results are used in subsequent execution, leaving needed information out of context. We introduce ContextRender, which manages context through a persistent graph of execution dependencies. We develop Tool-Flow Analysis to track how later operations reuse information from earlier tool results, providing a signal called observed reuse. A renderer combines this signal with recency and semantic relevance to select results within a fixed history budget, retaining omitted results for later use. Across AppWorld and 8-objective QA with three execution models, ContextRender outperforms the evaluated context management baselines using a 6K history budget, well below the models' maximum context windows. Within this budget, it achieves task performance close to or above that of passing the full history while reducing mean inference cost by 10.2%-32.2% relative to Full history. Ablations show that observed reuse improves task performance and retention of results reused later.

AI.tldr: 本文提出 ContextRender，通过执行依赖图管理 LLM agent 的上下文，利用 Tool-Flow Analysis 追踪工具结果的后续复用（observed reuse），并在固定历史预算下渲染上下文，在降低推理成本的同时保持或提升任务表现。
AI.motivation: LLM agent 执行长程任务时会累积大量工具调用结果，后续步骤可能需要这些结果。但每次都传入完整历史成本高，即使未超出上下文窗口；而压缩历史又有遗漏关键信息的风险。现有上下文管理方法忽视了早期工具结果在后续执行中如何被使用，容易把需要的信息排除在上下文之外。
AI.method: ContextRender 通过一个持续维护的执行依赖图来管理上下文。其核心是 Tool-Flow Analysis，用于追踪后续操作如何复用早期工具结果，并产生一个称为 observed reuse 的信号。渲染器将该信号与时间新近性（recency）和语义相关性（semantic relevance）结合，在固定的历史预算内选择要保留的结果，同时把被省略的结果留存以供后续使用。
AI.result: 在 AppWorld 与 8-objective QA 任务上，使用三种执行模型，ContextRender 在 6K 历史预算（远低于模型最大上下文窗口）下优于所评估的上下文管理基线。在该预算内，其任务表现接近或超过传入完整历史，同时相对于 Full history 将平均推理成本降低 10.2%–32.2%。消融实验表明 observed reuse 能提升任务表现，并提高对后续被复用结果的保留能力。
AI.conclusion: 通过执行依赖图与 observed reuse 信号驱动的上下文渲染，可在有限历史预算下有效管理 LLM agent 的工具结果上下文，在保持任务性能的同时显著降低推理成本。

title: Seeing Time: Visual-Temporal Representation Learning for Interpretable Time Series Clustering
summary: Multivariate Time Series (MTS) clustering is an important tool in temporal data mining, aiming to discover latent group structures from complex observations without supervision. Although existing deep clustering methods can learn discriminative temporal representations, the resulting latent clusters are often difficult to relate back to waveform characteristics that practitioners can directly inspect and compare, limiting their ability to assess whether the discovered patterns reflect meaningful temporal behaviors. This paper, therefore, proposes WAVE (Waveform Aligned Visual-temporal Embedding), which treats time series and their deterministically rendered waveform plots as complementary views of the same observations. To produce discriminative representations whose cluster structures can be traced to observable waveform characteristics, WAVE aligns and integrates fine-grained temporal variations with holistic visual patterns, while associating each discovered cluster with its centroid-nearest authentic sample. Accordingly, interpretability in this work specifically refers to waveform-level traceability rather than a general explanation of model decisions. Extensive evaluations across 10 real-world public datasets show that WAVE achieves the highest macro-averaged clustering performance and the best average rank among the compared methods, while qualitative case studies illustrate how the discovered clusters can be inspected through authentic waveform records. The source code is available at https://github.com/Zheng-Zhu1/WAVE.

AI.tldr: 提出WAVE方法，将多元时间序列及其确定性渲染的波形图视为互补视图，对齐融合细粒度时序变化与整体视觉模式，并将每个聚类关联到质心最近的真实样本，从而实现波形级可追溯的聚类。
AI.motivation: 现有多元时间序列深度聚类方法虽能学到判别性时序表示，但其潜在聚类难以回溯到从业者可直接检查比较的波形特征，导致无法评估所发现模式是否反映有意义的时序行为，缺乏可解释性。
AI.method: WAVE（Waveform Aligned Visual-temporal Embedding）将时间序列与其确定性渲染的波形图作为同一观测的互补视图；对齐并融合细粒度时序变化与整体视觉模式，产生判别性表示，使聚类结构可追溯到可观测的波形特征；同时将每个聚类与其质心最近的真实样本关联。
AI.result: 在10个真实世界公开数据集上，WAVE在宏平均聚类性能上最高，平均排名最优；定性案例研究显示所发现的聚类可通过真实波形记录进行检查。
AI.conclusion: WAVE通过视觉-时序互补视图对齐与质心最近真实样本关联，实现了波形级可追溯的聚类，兼顾判别性能与面向领域实践者的可解释性；代码已开源。

title: Cross-Entropy Guided Routing in Mixture-of-Experts Large Language Models
summary: Sparse mixture-of-experts (MoE) large language models scale model capacity by routing each token to a small subset of experts. Their routers are regularized with load balancing terms and learn affinity scores through the language-model objective. However, these objectives do not provide direct alignment between routing affinities and token-level error. We introduce token-error supervision for sparse routing in two forms. The first form predicts an error score per expert. The affinity-weighted aggregate of these scores is aligned to the next-token cross-entropy loss, while the individual scores attenuate affinity before top-$K$ selection. The second directly aligns the router's affinities to the model's objective without requiring an additional head or inference-time modification. Both formulations use the Itakura--Saito divergence or an exponential negative log-likelihood for aligning affinities and token errors. Across two sparse MoE backbones and four multiple-choice question-answering benchmarks, we evaluate both supervision mechanisms. On Granite, our method improves accuracy by approximately 2.3 percentage points on average over a parameter-matched routing baseline. With stronger supervision, the gain on ARC-Challenge reaches 2.94 points. Both mechanisms preserve the native sparse execution budget and aggregation policy. Our code is available in the supplementary materials.

AI.tldr: 本文提出两种"token-error supervision"稀疏路由监督机制，利用Itakura–Saito散度或指数负对数似然将路由亲和度与token级误差对齐，在不改变稀疏执行预算的情况下提升MoE大模型的多选题问答精度。
AI.motivation: 稀疏MoE路由器仅靠负载均衡项和语言建模目标训练，缺乏路由亲和度与token级误差之间的直接对齐，导致路由决策与模型实际错误不匹配。
AI.method: 提出两种token-error监督形式：（1）为每个专家预测误差分数，其亲和度加权聚合对齐next-token交叉熵损失，个体分数在top-K选择前衰减亲和度；（2）直接将路由器亲和度对齐模型目标，无需额外head或推理时修改。两者均使用Itakura–Saito散度或指数负对数似然进行对齐。
AI.result: 在两个稀疏MoE骨干和四个多选题问答基准上评估：Granite上平均精度提升约2.3个百分点（对比参数匹配路由基线），强监督下ARC-Challenge提升达2.94点。两种机制均保持原生稀疏执行预算与聚合策略。
AI.conclusion: 显式的token-error监督可有效对齐稀疏路由与token级误差，在保持稀疏计算预算的前提下显著提升MoE模型性能。

title: What You Observe Determines How You Identify Causal Effects: Evaluating Causal Models across Observational Views
summary: Causal foundation models (CFMs) pre-trained on data generated from various structural causal models (SCMs) have been proposed for estimating causal effects from observational data. However, differences in pre-training environments and evaluation protocols make it difficult to assess how their performance depends on the information available for causal identification. To enable controlled comparisons, we introduce CausalIDView, a multi-view benchmark that holds fixed SCM realization and target estimand while varying only the observational view available to the estimator. Each observational view corresponds to a distinct identification regime under the benchmark's maintained causal assumptions. Across these matched views, no CFM consistently performs best and model rankings vary substantially. Under controlled structural changes, CFMs exhibit model-specific failures to maintain stable estimates when true effects are unchanged and to track genuine effect changes. We also examine whether combining explicit identification with strong predictive estimation is effective. A modular approach that pairs a predictive tabular foundation model with regime-specific identification procedures is competitive with CFMs and outperforms several of them. These findings motivate cross-regime comparisons to assess the empirical value of CFMs.

AI.tldr: 本文提出 CausalIDView 多视角基准，在固定 SCM 实现与目标估计量的条件下仅改变观测视角，以受控方式比较因果基础模型（CFM）在不同因果识别机制下的表现。
AI.motivation: 现有 CFM 虽在多种 SCM 数据上预训练，但预训练环境与评估协议不一致，导致难以判断其性能如何依赖可用于因果识别的信息，缺乏受控、可比的评价手段。
AI.method: 构建 CausalIDView 多视角基准：固定 SCM 实现与目标估计量，仅变化估计器可获得的观测视角，每个视角对应基准假设下的一种识别机制；并引入受控结构变化实验，考察估计稳定性与对真实效应变化的追踪能力；同时测试将显式识别与强预测估计相结合的模块化方案。
AI.result: 在匹配视角下没有 CFM 持续最优，模型排序差异显著；受控结构变化下，CFM 出现模型特定的失效，既不能在真实效应不变时保持估计稳定，也不能追踪真实效应变化；将预测型表格基础模型与特定机制识别程序配对的模块化方法，与 CFM 具竞争力并优于其中若干模型。
AI.conclusion: 应开展跨识别机制的比较，以评估 CFM 的实际经验价值；模块化“识别+预测”路线是具竞争力的替代方案。

title: OmniVCBench: Benchmarking Evidence-Grounded Multimodal Reasoning Towards AI Virtual Cells
summary: Artificial Intelligence Virtual Cells (AIVCs) are envisioned as scientific agents that simulate cellular responses, explain underlying mechanisms, and support hypothesis-driven discovery. Existing AIVC benchmarks, however, operate primarily at the simulation layer, motivating complementary evaluation of how models interpret experimental evidence and formulate biological hypotheses. We introduce OmniVCBench, a figure-centric, source-traceable benchmark for the interpretation component of an AIVC. It contains 6,077 curated single- and multi-subfigure question--answer pairs derived from figures and experimental contexts in the scientific literature. Guided by Bloom's taxonomy, we instantiate interpretation-layer counterparts of the AIVC Predict--Explain--Discover agenda through three scientific reasoning tasks. We further introduce AIVC-Judge, a task-conditioned MLLM-as-a-judge framework with category-specific, reference-aware rubrics for evaluating open-ended responses. A complementary Model-Derived Hard-Negative Mining (MDHNM) strategy converts plausible errors observed during model inference into MCQ distractors for lower-cost evaluation. Within the evaluated heterogeneous model pool, MCQ accuracy correlates positively with AIVC-Judge scores, providing a complementary view of performance alongside open-response evaluation. Code and data demo are available at https://anonymous.4open.science/r/OmniVCBench.

AI.tldr: 本文提出 OmniVCBench，一个以图表为中心、来源可追溯的基准，用于评估 AI 虚拟细胞（AIVC）在“解释”层面的能力，并配套提出 AIVC-Judge 评测框架与 MDHNM 难负例挖掘策略。
AI.motivation: 现有 AIVC 基准主要停留在仿真（simulation）层面，缺乏对模型如何解读实验证据、提出生物学假设（interpretation 层面）的评估，因此需要构建互补的评测体系。
AI.method: 构建含 6,077 个单/多子图问答对的图表中心基准，覆盖基于 Bloom 分类学设计的三个科学推理任务（对应 Predict–Explain–Discover 议程的解释层对应项）；提出任务条件化的 MLLM-as-a-judge 框架 AIVC-Judge，采用分类别、参考感知的评分规则评估开放式回答；并提出 MDHNM 策略，将模型推理中出现的合理错误转化为 MCQ 干扰项以降低评测成本。
AI.result: 在异构模型池中，MCQ 准确率与 AIVC-Judge 分数呈正相关，为开放式回答评测提供了互补的性能视角。
AI.conclusion: OmniVCBench 填补了 AIVC 解释层评测的空白，结合 AIVC-Judge 与 MDHNM 形成了兼顾开放式与低成本 MCQ 的评测方案，代码与数据已公开。

title: Architecture Alignment With Sparse Priors in Tabular Foundation Models
summary: Tabular foundation models (TFMs) are increasingly popular because they deliver strong predictions on new datasets through in-context learning, without task-specific training or extensive tuning. Yet released TFMs differ simultaneously in their pretraining priors, architectures, and objectives, obscuring their respective inductive biases. We therefore examine one concrete capability: irrelevant-feature suppression. Across synthetic tasks and real-world datasets, adding null features causes substantially greater predictive degradation in the row-token model TabDPT, whereas the cell-token alternating-axis model TabPFN v2 and other TFMs remain comparatively stable. This gap motivates us to ask whether architecture contributes to irrelevant-feature suppression. Because released TFMs remain confounded by other design choices, we train streamlined row-token and alternating-axis transformers under identical sparse-to-dense linear priors. Exact Bayes analysis shows that sparse prediction requires context-dependent feature gating, whereas the dense endpoint requires only uniform feature weighting. Consistent with this distinction, the alternating-axis model is substantially closer to the Bayesian optimal predictor on sparse tasks, while the architecture gap becomes negligible on dense tasks; almost all of the sparse gap arises from linear coefficient-estimation error. Finally, in both the controlled model and frozen TabPFN v2, we examine the effect of interventions on the feature-attention outputs on the linear coefficients, finding evidence of task-dependent selective routing of computation through feature-indexed pathways. Together, these results support architecture-prior alignment: preserving an addressable feature axis provides an inductive bias for task-adaptive relevance inference. Code is available at https://github.com/Tianqi-Zhao/ArchitecturePriorTFMs.

AI.tldr: 本文通过控制实验探究架构对表格基础模型「无关特征抑制」能力的影响，发现保留可寻址特征轴的交替轴架构比行标记架构更具任务自适应相关性推断的归纳偏置。
AI.motivation: 已发布的表格基础模型（TFM）在预训练先验、架构和目标上同时存在差异，导致其各自的归纳偏置被混淆，难以判断某一具体能力（如无关特征抑制）由何种设计选择驱动。
AI.method: 在合成任务与真实数据集上对比 TabDPT（行标记）与 TabPFN v2（单元格标记交替轴）及其他 TFM 在加入空特征时的性能退化；随后在相同稀疏到稠密线性先验下训练精简的行标记与交替轴 Transformer 以消除混杂；并用精确贝叶斯分析、系数估计误差分解以及特征注意力输出干预实验进行机理验证。
AI.result: 加入空特征使 TabDPT 预测退化显著大于 TabPFN v2 等模型；在稀疏任务上交替轴模型更接近贝叶斯最优预测器，稠密任务上架构差距可忽略，稀疏差距几乎全部来自线性系数估计误差；对特征注意力输出的干预显示存在任务相关的、经特征索引通路的选择性计算路由。
AI.conclusion: 结果支持「架构—先验对齐」观点：保留可寻址的特征轴为任务自适应的相关性推断提供了归纳偏置，架构是影响无关特征抑制能力的重要因素。

title: Adam under Generalized Smoothness with Second-Moment-Type Stochastic Gradients
summary: Adam is widely observed to remain stable even when the objective deviates significantly from global smoothness. Under the generalized smoothness framework, however, existing analyses rely on strong tail assumptions on the stochastic gradients, such as almost-sure boundedness or sub-Gaussianity. Whether Adam converges on generalized smooth objectives under only second moment information on the stochastic gradients, without such concentration assumptions, was identified as an important open direction by Li et al. (2023). This paper gives an affirmative answer under fairly general conditions: such tail assumptions are not necessary. Building on the Adam self-normalization framework of Jin et al. (2026), developed for classical smoothness and bounded variance, we extend the stopping-time and de-preconditioning strategy to the $L_0$-$L_p$ generalized smoothness condition and a generalized second moment ABC condition. Even when the stochastic-gradient condition provides only second moment information that may grow along the trajectory, the stochastic trajectory of Adam remains in a locally well-behaved smoothness region, with stretched-exponential tail decay under bounded variance and global smoothness. Consequently, we establish high-probability convergence rate guarantees over the full range $p<2$, with confidence dependence of order $δ^{-1/2}$, while the stepsize prefactor depends on $δ$ only through a single logarithmic factor. We further construct a hard instance showing that, under only second-moment information, this $δ^{-1/2}$-type confidence dependence is sharp. Finally, in the regime $p<1$, we combine the trajectory control with polynomial-growth estimates on rare events to obtain convergence rate guarantees in expectation.

AI.tldr: 本文在广义光滑框架下（$L_0$-$L_p$条件）结合广义二阶矩ABC条件，证明Adam无需梯度尾部分布假设即可高概率收敛，给出$p<2$全范围的收敛率（置信度依赖$\\delta^{-1/2}$，步长前因子仅含单个对数因子），并构造下界实例说明该依赖阶数在仅用二阶矩信息时是最优的；$p<1$时进一步给出期望收敛保证。
AI.motivation: Adam在实践中即使目标函数明显不满足全局光滑性也表现稳定，但在广义光滑框架下的已有分析都依赖随机梯度上的强尾部假设（几乎必然有界或次高斯性）。Li et al. (2023)提出开放问题：仅凭随机梯度的二阶矩信息、不含集中性假设，Adam是否仍能收敛。本文正面回答该问题。
AI.method: 基于Jin et al. (2026)为经典光滑与有界方差情形建立的Adam自归一化框架，将停时（stopping-time）与去预条件（de-preconditioning）策略扩展到$L_0$-$L_p$广义光滑条件与广义二阶矩ABC条件；利用停时控制证明随机轨迹停留在局部良态光滑区域内，并给出拉伸指数（stretched-exponential）尾衰减。
AI.result: 在仅提供沿轨迹可能增长的二阶矩信息时，Adam轨迹仍保持局部良好光滑性，并在有界方差与全局光滑条件下具有拉伸指数尾衰减；据此建立$p<2$全范围的高概率收敛率，置信度依赖为$\\delta^{-1/2}$量级，步长前因子对$\\delta$仅通过单个对数因子依赖；并构造困难实例证明该$\\delta^{-1/2}$型置信度依赖是紧的；在$p<1$时结合轨迹控制与稀有事件上的多项式增长估计，得到期望意义下的收敛率保证。
AI.conclusion: Adam在广义光滑目标上仅凭二阶矩信息即可收敛，无需传统尾部集中假设，这正面回答了Li et al. (2023)的开放问题；所给高概率收敛率在置信度依赖上是紧的，并扩展到$p<1$的期望收敛情形。

title: SINO: Scale-Invariant Neural Operator
summary: In scientific machine learning, physical fields governed by partial differential equations exhibit low-rank structure and scale invariance. When solving equations on coarse grids, missing information leads to the closure problem: modeling unresolved physics to recover lost dynamics. Although closure terms depend on grid resolution, they represent scale-invariant physical laws. A model truly learning physics should capture these mechanisms with low-rank parameterization rather than memorizing grid-specific patterns. Inspired by this, we propose the Scale-Invariant Neural Operator (SINO), which learns on normalized physical scales via a dual-branch architecture operating in spectral and spatial domains. SINO uses bottleneck MLPs to generate continuous convolution kernels, embedding an explicit low-rank inductive bias that concentrates more than 95 percent of variance in 2-3 modes, as validated by PCA across benchmarks, while drastically reducing parameters. This principled design yields 38 times steeper scaling law exponents than FNO, demonstrating superior parameter efficiency. We compare SINO with traditional models (U-Net, DeepONet), Transformer models (Transolver, Oformer, GK-Transformer), and frequency-domain models (FNO, AMFNO, UFNO) on closure problems spanning externally forced Burgers turbulence, decaying Burgers turbulence, KS turbulence, Kolmogorov-forced NS turbulence, and decaying NS turbulence. Experiments show SINO achieves 1.5-38 times error reduction and 2-23 times parameter efficiency over baselines, with superior scaling laws reflecting exceptional data efficiency from principled low-rank design. Code is available at https://github.com/AI4Science-WestlakeU/SINO.

AI.tldr: 提出尺度不变神经算子SINO,在归一化物理尺度上以谱-空间双分支架构学习,嵌入显式低秩归纳偏置,在多个闭合问题上显著降低误差并提升参数效率。
AI.motivation: 科学机器学习中PDE物理场具有低秩结构与尺度不变性。粗网格求解时存在闭合问题,需建模未解析物理以恢复丢失动力学。闭合项虽依赖网格分辨率,却代表尺度不变的物理规律,因此真正学习物理的模型应以低秩参数化捕获其机制,而非记忆网格特定的模式。
AI.method: 提出尺度不变神经算子(SINO):在归一化物理尺度上学习,采用谱域与空间域的双分支架构;使用瓶颈MLP生成连续卷积核,嵌入显式的低秩归纳偏置,并通过PCA验证其将95%以上方差集中于2-3个模态,同时大幅减少参数量。
AI.result: 在五类闭合问题(外力驱动Burgers湍流、衰减Burgers湍流、KS湍流、Kolmogorov强迫NS湍流、衰减NS湍流)上与U-Net、DeepONet、Transolver、Oformer、GK-Transformer、FNO、AMFNO、UFNO对比:误差降低1.5-38倍,参数效率提升2-23倍,缩放律指数比FNO陡峭38倍,数据效率优越。
AI.conclusion: SINO通过原理性低秩设计实现尺度不变物理学习,在闭合问题上兼具高精度与高参数效率,并呈现更优的缩放律,验证了显式低秩归纳偏置在科学机器学习中的价值。

title: A neural network that maintains and retrieves memories based on context
summary: Every day, people continuously infer situational context and adjust the way they understand and remember the world. Context, signaled by the prefrontal cortex, is known to modulate working memory and episodic memory, but the algorithmic understanding of this modulation remains limited. Here, we train a recurrent neural network (RNN), augmented with an episodic memory buffer, to infer context using Bayesian inference as it continuously makes predictions of upcoming scenes while watching naturalistic movies. When the inferred context modulates the RNN's recurrent connectivity (the basis of working memory) in a low-rank manner, the model's activity patterns best match neural responses in human participants who watched the same movies during fMRI. Context also modulates episodic memory retrieval, such that the model retrieves memories based on not only content similarity but also context similarity. This is implemented as a key-value system with self-attention, designed to additionally encode context and retrieve context-congruent memories. The resulting model not only better resembles human brain representations but also learns to retrieve memories like humans much faster than a model without context modulation. Together, our findings suggest a computational mechanism by which context modulates information maintenance and long-term memory retrieval in naturalistic environments.

AI.tldr: 研究训练了配备情景记忆缓冲的循环神经网络(RNN),以贝叶斯推断在观看自然电影时持续预测并推断情境;当推断出的情境以低秩方式调制RNN循环连接时,模型活动模式与人类fMRI反应最匹配,且情境还通过键值自注意力机制调制情景记忆提取,使模型更快地习得类人记忆提取。
AI.motivation: 情境(由前额叶皮层发出信号)已知能调制工作记忆与情景记忆,但其算法层面的机制理解仍然有限。作者希望在自然场景下揭示情境如何调制信息维持与长期记忆提取的计算机制。
AI.method: 构建带情景记忆缓冲的RNN,在观看自然电影时持续预测即将出现的场景,并用贝叶斯推断推断当前情境。情境以低秩方式调制RNN的循环连接(工作记忆基础);情景记忆提取则用带自注意力的键值系统实现,额外编码情境以提取情境一致的记忆。将模型活动模式与观看相同电影被试的fMRI反应进行对比。
AI.result: 低秩情境调制循环连接时,模型活动模式与人类被试fMRI神经反应最为匹配;情境调制的情景记忆提取使模型不仅依据内容相似性、也依据情境相似性提取记忆;所得模型更接近人脑表征,且比无情境调制的模型更快地习得类人记忆提取。
AI.conclusion: 研究提出了一个计算机制,说明情境如何在自然环境背景下调制信息维持与长期记忆提取,为前额叶情境信号对工作记忆和情景记忆的算法性调控提供了统一解释。

title: Variational Mixtures and Multi-Marginal Flow Matching: Advancing Statistical Inference with Biological Applications
summary: In this thesis I develop methods for statistical inference when the distributions arising from complex biological systems are multi-modal, geometrically structured, and sometimes only defined up to a normalizing constant. I start from variational inference and, when analytic update equations are unavailable, move to black-box variational inference. To build intuition regarding inference challenges and the proposed methodologies, I introduce a novel unnormalized target density (the CoLN distribution) and reuse it as a controlled test case in the kappa. I then trace a trajectory of increasingly expressive approximations: ensembles evaluated with the multiple importance sampling ELBO (Paper A) and variational mixtures that automate component cooperation and exploration (Paper B). Because expressivity comes at a cost, I develop efficient mixture learning ideas, including Monte Carlo objective estimators to scale mixture learning more efficiently (Paper C). As a new result in the kappa, I overturn a three decades long misconception regarding the potential performance benefits of using mixtures in variational inference. Finally, I move from variational inference to flow matching, where I address the need for specialized treatment of interpolant learning in multi-marginal settings (Paper D). By combining insights from Papers A-D, I derive in Section 5.5 a new method: multi-marginal flow matching with mixtures of variational interpolants. I connect these methodological developments to biological applications, with special emphasis on three-dimensional spatial transcriptomics, where stacked tissue slices induce multi-modal dynamics across space.

AI.tldr: 本论文面向复杂生物系统产生的多模态、几何结构化且常仅定义到归一化常数的分布，发展统计推断方法，从变分推断经黑盒变分推断、集成/混合近似与流匹配，最终提出多边际流匹配结合变分插值混合的新方法，并应用于三维空间转录组学。
AI.motivation: 复杂生物系统的分布具有多模态、几何结构化、且有时仅定义到归一化常数（未归一化）的特点，给统计推断带来挑战；同时提升近似表达能力会带来计算代价，且多边际（multi-marginal）场景下插值学习缺乏专门处理。
AI.method: 方法路线：从变分推断出发，在无法获得解析更新方程时转向黑盒变分推断；提出新的未归一化目标密度（CoLN分布）作为受控测试用例；采用表达力递增的近似——以多重重要性采样ELBO评估的集成（论文A）与自动实现分量协作与探索的变分混合（论文B）；发展混合学习的有效方法，包括更高效扩展混合学习的蒙特卡洛目标估计量（论文C）；进而转向流匹配，处理多边际情形下插值学习的专门需求（论文D）；在5.5节结合A–D提出多边际流匹配结合变分插值混合的方法。
AI.result: 作为本论文（kappa）中的新结果，推翻了关于在变分推断中使用混合模型可能带来性能收益的、长达三十年的误解；并提出多边际流匹配结合变分插值混合的新方法（5.5节）。
AI.conclusion: 方法学贡献与生物应用相连接，特别强调三维空间转录组学，其中堆叠的组织切片在空间上诱发多模态动态。整体形成从变分推断到流匹配、由低到高表达力的统一推断方法链条。

title: DIET: Deletion-response Expert Trimming for Video Diffusion Transformers
summary: Video diffusion transformers (DiTs) increasingly adopt mixture-of-experts (MoE) architectures to reduce active computation, but their full expert storage remains costly. Existing one-shot pruning criteria mainly rely on static activation or routing statistics and cannot capture layer-level re-routing after expert deletion. We introduce DIET, a training-free expert pruning framework based on deletion responses. A single all-expert calibration pass records expert outputs and router states for matched conditional and unconditional tokens. Candidate deletions are then replayed from cached tensors, requiring no additional model forward passes. The resulting deletion-response signatures characterize each expert by the changes induced when it is removed. DIET selects retained experts by minimizing Overall Diversity Loss (ODL), which preserves directional coverage in signature space, and combines intra-layer local search with an inter-layer regression-guided budget search to allocate experts across layers. On LingBot-Video 30B-A3B, pruning 50% of experts (6,144 to 3,072) reduces the checkpoint from 57 GB to 30 GB and enables single-card deployment on a 48 GB GPU without fine-tuning. Under a fixed 284-case VBench protocol, the VBench Total increases from 0.7941 to 0.8115. Across tested retention budgets, DIET consistently outperforms competitive pruning baselines adapted from large language models.

AI.tldr: DIET：一种基于"删除响应"的无训练专家剪枝框架，用于视频扩散Transformer的MoE架构，在LingBot-Video 30B-A3B上剪掉50%专家后显存从57GB降至30GB，VBench总分反升。
AI.motivation: 视频DiT采用MoE降低激活计算，但全部专家的存储开销仍很高。现有的一次性剪枝准则依赖静态激活或路由统计，无法捕捉专家删除后层级的重路由（re-routing）效应，导致剪枝决策不准确。
AI.method: 提出DIET，免训练专家剪枝框架：(1) 一次全专家校准前向，记录匹配的条件/无条件token的专家输出与路由状态；(2) 从缓存张量重放候选删除，无需额外前向；(3) 以删除引起的输出变化构成"删除响应签名"刻画每个专家；(4) 通过最小化Overall Diversity Loss (ODL)保持签名空间的方向覆盖度来选择保留专家；(5) 层内局部搜索+层间回归引导的预算搜索，完成跨层专家配额分配。
AI.result: 在LingBot-Video 30B-A3B上，剪除50%专家（6,144→3,072）使checkpoint从57GB降至30GB，可在48GB GPU单卡部署且无需微调；固定284例VBench协议下，VBench Total从0.7941提升至0.8115；在各保留预算下均优于从大语言模型迁移的剪枝基线。
AI.conclusion: 基于删除响应而非静态统计的剪枝准则能更有效地刻画MoE专家重要性，实现显著压缩的同时不损失甚至提升生成质量，验证了无训练MoE专家剪枝在视频扩散模型上的可行性与优越性。

title: State Transport Routing for Short-horizon Adaptation in Multi-horizon Photovoltaic Forecasting
summary: Recent power measurements provide valuable information for photovoltaic(PV) power forecasting, but directly extrapolating short-term trends can introduce substantial errors over longer forecast horizons. To address this challenge, we propose state transport routing (STR), a lightweight adapter that refines the predictions of a frozen forecasting model. STR combines the original forecast with two complementary trajectories derived from the latest measured power level and its recent trend. A horizon-conditioned router adjusts their contributions over the first 120 min, while leaving subsequent predictions unchanged. Experiments on four public PV datasets show that STR consistently outperforms a parameter-matched residual adapter. On PVDAQ, the same approach improves five neural forecasting backbones, reducing all-horizon normalized mean absolute error by 0.0201-0.2364 percentage points, with paired 95% confidence intervals excluding zero. No reliable improvement is observed for LightGBM. These findings demonstrate the potential of structured state adaptation to improve short-term forecasting across different neural architectures without retraining the underlying models or altering their longer-horizon predictions.

AI.tldr: 提出状态传输路由（STR）轻量适配器，用最新实测功率及其趋势修正冻结预测模型，在120分钟内按预测步长调节权重，显著降低神经模型短期光伏预测误差。
AI.motivation: 最新功率测量对光伏功率预测有价值，但直接外推短期趋势在长预测步长上会引入显著误差，需在保留原模型长步长预测的前提下利用近期信息。
AI.method: STR为轻量适配器，作用于冻结的预测模型。它将原预测与两条互补轨迹（基于最新实测功率水平、基于近期趋势）融合，由步长条件路由器在前120分钟内调整三者贡献，之后保持不变。与参数匹配的残差适配器对比，并在四个公开光伏数据集上测试。
AI.result: STR稳定优于参数匹配残差适配器。在PVDAQ上提升五种神经预测骨干，全步长归一化平均绝对误差降低0.0201–0.2364个百分点，配对95%置信区间不含零；LightGBM未见可靠提升。
AI.conclusion: 结构化状态适配可在不重训模型、不改变长步长预测的情况下改善多种神经架构的短期预测，但该方法对非神经模型（LightGBM）效果不明显。

title: Can a Cacheable Decision Model Follow Rules?
summary:
Certo is a small non-generative decision model (Qwen3-4B): it scores candidate actions from their text and returns a probability, instead of generating an answer. The accurate design reads the state, the rules, and each candidate together (a joint scorer), so cost grows with the menu. Independent encoding lets each candidate be encoded once and reused across states (about 5x cheaper at 77 candidates), but separates state from candidate. We ask how much rule-sensitivity survives that move, and whether it can be trained back.
  Four experiments on Certo: (1) the tested conversion to cacheable scoring loses rule-sensitivity (recall@1 1.00 -> 0.24) while the joint scorer holds 1.00, and a shortlist+rerank rescue fails; (2) targeted counterfactual supervision restores strong performance on held-out synthetic rule tasks (paraphrase, counterfactual, composition; reproducible across seeds), though we do not isolate whether predictions depend on the supplied rule; (3) on real rules the added benefit is not established -- after fixing a truncation confound, the joint scorer wins significantly on the short tier (0.861 vs 0.500) and directionally on the hard tier (0.655 vs 0.483, n=29); (4) a matched cross-domain real-prose mixture did not help and reduced contract accuracy (-9.3, -16.2 points). A cacheable encoder can be made rule-sensitive on its training distribution, but transfer to unseen-source real rules is not established; the joint scorer keeps an edge at the cost of caching.

AI.tldr: Certo是一个小型非生成式决策模型，将动作评分与生成分离。实验表明可缓存编码会损失规则敏感性，针对性反事实监督可在训练分布内恢复，但对真实未见规则的迁移未被证实；联合评分器保持优势但无法缓存。
AI.motivation: 联合评分器（同时读状态、规则与候选）成本随候选数量增长；独立编码可缓存复用候选表示（77候选下约省5倍），但将状态与候选分离。作者追问这种缓存转换后还能保留多少规则敏感性，以及能否通过训练重新获得。
AI.method: 基于Certo（Qwen3-4B）开展四项实验：(1)测试可缓存评分转换对规则敏感性的影响，并尝试shortlist+rerank补救；(2)用针对性反事实监督训练恢复规则敏感性；(3)在真实规则上评估增益，并修正截断混淆；(4)匹配的跨领域真实文本混合实验。
AI.result: (1) 可缓存转换后recall@1由1.00降至0.24，联合评分器维持1.00，shortlist+rerank补救失败；(2) 反事实监督在留出合成规则任务（改写、反事实、组合）上恢复强性能且跨随机种子可复现，但未隔离预测是否依赖所给规则；(3) 修正截断混淆后，联合评分器在短难度层显著更优（0.861 vs 0.500），在困难层方向性更优（0.655 vs 0.483, n=29）；(4) 跨领域真实文本混合无帮助，并使合同准确率下降9.3和16.2个百分点。
AI.conclusion: 可缓存编码器可在其训练分布上变得规则敏感，但向未见来源的真实规则的迁移尚未确立；联合评分器以牺牲缓存为代价保持一定优势。

title: Safe-by-Design Learning via Energy-based Neural Networks
summary: Learning neural-network models of dynamical systems with safety guarantees is a fundamental requirement for their deployment in safety-critical settings. Safety is commonly established by proving the invariance of a desired subset in state-space, ensuring that every trajectory initialized in this subset remains confined to it for all time under admissible inputs. Existing frameworks, however, either rely on computationally expensive post-hoc verification or employ safety-enforcing mechanisms without formal correctness guarantees. In this paper, we introduce a novel neural architecture grounded in energy-based modern Hopfield networks to guarantee safety-by-design while retaining sufficient expressiveness to model complex nonlinear dynamics. Specifically, we integrate modern Hopfield networks with a port-Hamiltonian neural ODE, enabling by design the construction of barrier functions yielding explicit admissible-input sets and quantitative robustness radii. Across several benchmarks, including an 12-dimensional nanodrone model, our framework achieves state-of-the-art performance while producing certified invariant sets that are more robust to external solicitations than comparable existing approaches.

AI.tldr: 该论文提出一种基于能量型现代Hopfield网络的安全神经网络架构，将现代Hopfield网络与端口-哈密顿神经ODE结合，实现"设计即安全"，可构造障碍函数并给出显式容许输入集与量化鲁棒半径，在包括12维纳米无人机在内的基准上取得最优性能与更鲁棒的可证实不变集。
AI.motivation: 在安全关键场景部署动力系统的神经网络模型时，安全性至关重要，通常通过证明状态空间中期望子集的前向不变性来保证。但现有框架要么依赖计算昂贵的后验验证，要么采用强制安全机制却缺乏形式化正确性保证，因此需要一种兼顾表达力与安全保证的设计方法。
AI.method: 提出一种以能量型现代Hopfield网络为基础的新型神经架构，将其与现代Hopfield网络和端口-哈密顿神经ODE相融合，从而在设计层面保证安全性，并能够构造障碍函数，导出显式的容许输入集合与量化鲁棒半径。
AI.result: 在多个基准任务（含12维纳米无人机模型）上，该框架达到当前最优性能，并生成经认证的不变集，对外部扰动的鲁棒性优于可比现有方法。
AI.conclusion: 通过将现代Hopfield网络与端口-哈密顿神经ODE结合，可在保持建模复杂非线性动力学所需表达力的同时实现"设计即安全"，为安全关键场景下的学习型动力学模型提供具有形式化保证的解决方案。

title: Mixture of Self-Improving Branches For Agent Harness Optimization
summary: Harness optimization provides a practical setting for recursive self-improvement (RSI), where agent-generated modifications inform subsequent changes through execution feedback. Recent work such as Meta-Harness implements this process through iterative code generation and evaluation, but retains a fixed development set and proposal policy. These constraints channel evolution along a single search trajectory, increasing the risk of converging to a local optimum. We make the improvement process itself adaptive by organizing search into branches with evolving development subsets and proposal policies. Each branch retains development cases solved by more of its leading harnesses than by those of other branches, drops cases solved by every leading harness across all branches, and revises its proposal policy using its own search history. To deploy the resulting complementary harnesses, we propose a router to select one development-selected branch head for each new input before execution. Across mathematical reasoning and agentic coding benchmarks, our system achieves relative improvements over Meta-Harness of 34.8% on Olympiad-level mathematical reasoning, 11.6% on Terminal-Bench 2.0, and 3.8% on SWE-bench Lite, with harness selection and router configuration based solely on development data.
